    def quick_export_pdfs(self, issue_name, issue_date_text, selected_print_set=None, create_placeholders_on_fail=True):
        if self.document is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No active document.")

        setup = self.build_package_setup(issue_name, issue_date_text, selected_print_set=selected_print_set)
        preview = setup.get("preview") or {}
        expected = preview.get("expected_files") or []
        profile_mode = setup.get("selected_printer_mode") or "Auto"
        print_setting_name = setup.get("selected_print_setting") or ""

        if not expected:
            return {
                "status": "warning",
                "message": "No sheets found for the selected print set.",
                "exported": 0,
                "placeholders": 0,
                "failed": 0,
                "failures": []
            }

        target_folder = preview.get("pdf_folder") or ""
        ensure_dir(target_folder)

        manager = self.document.PrintManager
        manager.PrintToFile = True
        setting_error = self._apply_print_setting(manager, print_setting_name)
        mode_error = self._configure_print_mode(manager, profile_mode, is_combined=False)
        if setting_error or mode_error:
            failures = []
            if setting_error:
                failures.append(setting_error)
            if mode_error:
                failures.append(mode_error)
            return {
                "status": "warning",
                "message": "Quick export setup failed.",
                "exported": 0,
                "placeholders": 0,
                "failed": len(failures),
                "failures": failures
            }

        exported = 0
        placeholders = 0
        failures = []

        for row in expected:
            sheet_id = row.get("sheet_id")
            out_path = row.get("path") or ""
            ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(out_path) if out_path else "")

            sheet = None
            try:
                sheet = self.document.GetElement(DB.ElementId(int(sheet_id)))
            except Exception:
                sheet = None

            if sheet is None:
                failures.append("Missing sheet for id {0}".format(sheet_id))
                continue

            try:
                view_set = DB.ViewSet()
                view_set.Insert(sheet)
                manager.PrintToFileName = out_path
                try:
                    manager.ViewSheetSetting.CurrentViewSheetSet.Views = view_set
                except Exception:
                    pass
                manager.Apply()
                manager.SubmitPrint()
                exported += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                if create_placeholders_on_fail:
                    try:
                        with open(out_path, "wb") as stream:
                            stream.write(b"")
                        placeholders += 1
                    except Exception:
                        failures.append("{0}: {1}".format(row.get("filename") or out_path, exc))
                else:
                    failures.append("{0}: {1}".format(row.get("filename") or out_path, exc))

        return {
            "status": "ok" if not failures else "warning",
            "message": "Quick export complete.",
            "exported": exported,
            "placeholders": placeholders,
            "failed": len(failures),
            "failures": failures[:20]
        }

    def quick_export_internal_approval(self, issue_name, issue_date_text, selected_print_set=None, create_placeholder_on_fail=True):
        if self.document is None:
            raise RuntimeError("No active document.")

        setup = self.build_package_setup(issue_name, issue_date_text, selected_print_set=selected_print_set)
        preview = setup.get("preview") or {}
        profile_mode = setup.get("selected_printer_mode") or "Auto"
        print_setting_name = setup.get("selected_print_setting") or ""
        out_path = preview.get("internal_approval_file") or ""
        sheet_rows = self._sheet_rows_for_print_set(None if selected_print_set in [None, "", "<All Sheets>"] else selected_print_set)
        ensure_dir(preview.get("internal_approval_folder") or "")

        manager = self.document.PrintManager
        manager.PrintToFile = True
        setting_error = self._apply_print_setting(manager, print_setting_name)
        mode_error = self._configure_print_mode(manager, profile_mode, is_combined=True)
        if setting_error:
            return {
                "status": "warning",
                "message": "Could not apply print setting for approval export.",
                "exported": 0,
                "placeholders": 0,
                "failed": 1,
                "failures": [setting_error],
                "path": out_path
            }
        if mode_error and profile_mode == "CombinedStrict":
            return {
                "status": "warning",
                "message": "Could not configure combined print mode for approval export.",
                "exported": 0,
                "placeholders": 0,
                "failed": 1,
                "failures": [mode_error],
                "path": out_path
            }

        failures = []
        exported = 0
        placeholders = 0
        try:
            view_set = DB.ViewSet()
            for row in sheet_rows:
                sheet = self.document.GetElement(DB.ElementId(int(row.get("sheet_id"))))
                if sheet:
                    view_set.Insert(sheet)

            manager.PrintToFileName = out_path
            try:
                manager.ViewSheetSetting.CurrentViewSheetSet.Views = view_set
            except Exception:
                pass
            manager.Apply()
            manager.SubmitPrint()
            exported = 1
        except Exception as exc:
            if create_placeholder_on_fail and out_path:
                try:
                    with open(out_path, "wb") as stream:
                        stream.write(b"")
                    placeholders = 1
                except Exception:
                    failures.append(str(exc))
            else:
                failures.append(str(exc))

        return {
            "status": "ok" if not failures else "warning",
            "message": "Internal Approval export complete.",
            "exported": exported,
            "placeholders": placeholders,
            "failed": len(failures),
            "failures": failures[:20],
            "path": out_path
        }

```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import os
import uuid

from pyrevit import forms, revit

from package_creator_orchestrator import PackageCreatorOrchestrator


def _compute_panel_id():
    extension_root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__))
    normalized_root = os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(extension_root))
    panel_uuid = uuid.uuid5(
        uuid.UUID('f55c1b89-1451-455e-94da-8b8c7316e7a7'),
        'PackageCreatorDockPanel|{0}'.format(normalized_root)
    )
    return str(panel_uuid)


PANEL_ID = _compute_panel_id()
PANEL_TITLE = "Package Creator"


def get_panel_source():
    extension_root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__))
    tab_names = [
        "RBG_SYD_Tools_Working.tab",
        "RBG_SYD_Tools.tab"
    ]
    relative_locations = [
        (
            "RBG Tools_Data.panel",
            "DataStack3.stack",
            "PackageCreator.pushbutton",
            "panel.xaml"
        ),
        (
            "WIP.panel",
            "WIPDrop1.pulldown",
            "PackageCreator.pushbutton",
            "panel.xaml"
        )
    ]

    candidates = []
    for tab_name in tab_names:
        for relative_location in relative_locations:
            candidates.append(os.path.join(extension_root, tab_name, *relative_location))

    for candidate in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(candidate):
            return candidate

    # Fallback: discover panel.xaml anywhere under this extension root.
    discovered = []
    for root, _, files in os.walk(extension_root):
        if "panel.xaml" not in files:
            continue
        if os.path.basename(root) != "PackageCreator.pushbutton":
            continue
        discovered.append(os.path.join(root, "panel.xaml"))

    if discovered:
        preferred = [p for p in discovered if "RBG Tools_Data.panel" in p]
        return preferred[0] if preferred else discovered[0]

    return candidates[0]


_ACTIVE_PANEL = None


def get_active_panel():
    return _ACTIVE_PANEL


class PackageCreatorDockPanel(forms.WPFPanel):
    panel_id = PANEL_ID
    panel_title = PANEL_TITLE
    panel_source = get_panel_source()

    def __init__(self):
        forms.WPFPanel.__init__(self)
        global _ACTIVE_PANEL
        _ACTIVE_PANEL = self
        self._state = {}
        self._binding_selector = False

        self._bind_controls()
        try:
            self.refresh_state()
        except Exception:
            if hasattr(self, "TxtStatus"):
                self.TxtStatus.Text = "Package Creator panel initialized. Context refresh failed during startup. Use Refresh after opening a model."

    def _bind_controls(self):
        if hasattr(self, "BtnRefresh") and self.BtnRefresh:
            self.BtnRefresh.Click += self.refresh_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnSearchProjects") and self.BtnSearchProjects:
            self.BtnSearchProjects.Click += self.search_projects_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplyProject") and self.BtnApplyProject:
            self.BtnApplyProject.Click += self.apply_project_click
        if hasattr(self, "CmbOffice") and self.CmbOffice:
            self.CmbOffice.SelectionChanged += self.office_changed
        if hasattr(self, "CmbYearFolder") and self.CmbYearFolder:
            self.CmbYearFolder.SelectionChanged += self.year_changed
        if hasattr(self, "BtnPreviewPackage") and self.BtnPreviewPackage:
            self.BtnPreviewPackage.Click += self.preview_package_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnCreatePackage") and self.BtnCreatePackage:
            self.BtnCreatePackage.Click += self.create_package_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnOpenPendingRoot") and self.BtnOpenPendingRoot:
            self.BtnOpenPendingRoot.Click += self.open_pending_root_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnOpenLatestIssue") and self.BtnOpenLatestIssue:
            self.BtnOpenLatestIssue.Click += self.open_latest_issue_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnRunNamingCheck") and self.BtnRunNamingCheck:
            self.BtnRunNamingCheck.Click += self.run_naming_check_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplyNamingRules") and self.BtnApplyNamingRules:
            self.BtnApplyNamingRules.Click += self.apply_naming_rules_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnRefreshSetup") and self.BtnRefreshSetup:
            self.BtnRefreshSetup.Click += self.refresh_setup_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplySetup") and self.BtnApplySetup:
            self.BtnApplySetup.Click += self.apply_setup_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplyPrinterPreset") and self.BtnApplyPrinterPreset:
            self.BtnApplyPrinterPreset.Click += self.apply_printer_preset_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplyNamingTemplates") and self.BtnApplyNamingTemplates:
            self.BtnApplyNamingTemplates.Click += self.apply_templates_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnPreviewTemplates") and self.BtnPreviewTemplates:
            self.BtnPreviewTemplates.Click += self.preview_templates_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnQuickExportPdf") and self.BtnQuickExportPdf:
            self.BtnQuickExportPdf.Click += self.quick_export_pdf_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnValidatePdfNames") and self.BtnValidatePdfNames:
            self.BtnValidatePdfNames.Click += self.validate_pdf_names_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnQuickExportApproval") and self.BtnQuickExportApproval:
            self.BtnQuickExportApproval.Click += self.quick_export_approval_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnSaveWorkflow") and self.BtnSaveWorkflow:
            self.BtnSaveWorkflow.Click += self.save_workflow_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnApplyWorkflow") and self.BtnApplyWorkflow:
            self.BtnApplyWorkflow.Click += self.apply_workflow_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionStage1") and self.BtnActionStage1:
            self.BtnActionStage1.Click += self.action_stage1_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionStage2") and self.BtnActionStage2:
            self.BtnActionStage2.Click += self.action_stage2_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionStage3") and self.BtnActionStage3:
            self.BtnActionStage3.Click += self.action_stage3_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionStage4") and self.BtnActionStage4:
            self.BtnActionStage4.Click += self.action_stage4_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionStage5") and self.BtnActionStage5:
            self.BtnActionStage5.Click += self.action_stage5_click
        if hasattr(self, "BtnActionRunAll") and self.BtnActionRunAll:
            self.BtnActionRunAll.Click += self.action_run_all_click
        if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") and self.CmbPrintSet:
            self.CmbPrintSet.SelectionChanged += self.print_set_changed

    def refresh_click(self, sender, args):
        self.refresh_state()

    def _make_orchestrator(self):
        document = None
        try:
            document = revit.doc
        except Exception:
            document = None
        return PackageCreatorOrchestrator(document)

    def _set_status(self, message):
        if hasattr(self, "TxtStatus"):
            self.TxtStatus.Text = message or ""
        if hasattr(self, "TxtFlowStatus"):
            self.TxtFlowStatus.Text = message or ""

    def _combo_selected_text(self, combo):
        try:
            value = combo.SelectedItem
            if value is not None:
                return str(value)
            if hasattr(combo, "Text"):
                return str(combo.Text or "")
            return ""
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def _set_combo_items(self, combo, items, selected_value):
        combo.Items.Clear()
        for item in items or []:
            combo.Items.Add(item)
        if selected_value in (items or []):
            combo.SelectedItem = selected_value
        elif combo.Items.Count > 0:
            combo.SelectedIndex = 0
        elif hasattr(combo, "Text"):
            combo.Text = selected_value or ""

        # Preserve custom typed values for editable ComboBoxes.
        if hasattr(combo, "IsEditable") and combo.IsEditable and selected_value and selected_value not in (items or []):
            combo.Text = selected_value

    def _render_project_selector(self, selector):
        selector = selector or {}
        self._binding_selector = True
        try:
            if hasattr(self, "TxtProjectDocsRoot"):
                self.TxtProjectDocsRoot.Text = selector.get("projectdocs_root") or ""

            if hasattr(self, "CmbOffice"):
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbOffice, selector.get("offices") or [], selector.get("selected_office") or "")
            if hasattr(self, "CmbYearFolder"):
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbYearFolder, selector.get("year_folders") or [], selector.get("selected_year") or "")
            if hasattr(self, "CmbProject"):
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbProject, selector.get("projects") or [], selector.get("selected_project") or "")

            if hasattr(self, "InpProjectSearch"):
                self.InpProjectSearch.Text = selector.get("query_text") or ""
            if hasattr(self, "TxtProjectFolder"):
                self.TxtProjectFolder.Text = selector.get("project_folder") or "(not resolved)"
            if hasattr(self, "TxtPendingRoot"):
                self.TxtPendingRoot.Text = selector.get("pending_root") or "(not resolved)"
        finally:
            self._binding_selector = False

    def _reload_selector_from_inputs(self):
        orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
        office = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbOffice) if hasattr(self, "CmbOffice") else ""
        year_folder = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbYearFolder) if hasattr(self, "CmbYearFolder") else ""
        query = self.InpProjectSearch.Text if hasattr(self, "InpProjectSearch") else ""
        selector = orchestrator.get_project_selector_state(office=office, year_folder=year_folder, query_text=query)
        self._render_project_selector(selector)

    def office_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self._binding_selector:
            return
        try:
            self._reload_selector_from_inputs()
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Office selection failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def year_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self._binding_selector:
            return
        try:
            self._reload_selector_from_inputs()
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Year selection failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def search_projects_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            self._reload_selector_from_inputs()
            self._set_status("Project list refreshed.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Project search failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def apply_project_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            profile = orchestrator.apply_project_selection(
                self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbOffice) if hasattr(self, "CmbOffice") else "",
                self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbYearFolder) if hasattr(self, "CmbYearFolder") else "",
                self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbProject) if hasattr(self, "CmbProject") else "",
                query_text=self.InpProjectSearch.Text if hasattr(self, "InpProjectSearch") else "",
                default_issue_name=self.InpDefaultIssueName.Text if hasattr(self, "InpDefaultIssueName") else ""
            )

            pending_root = profile.get("pending_issue_root") or ""
            if pending_root:
                message = "Stage 1 complete. Project applied and existing pending root found: {0}".format(pending_root)
            else:
                message = "Stage 1 warning. Project applied but no existing folder containing 'pending' was found."
            self.refresh_state(status_override=message)
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply project failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def _render_setup(self, setup, preserve_template_inputs=False):
        setup = setup or {}
        print_sets = setup.get("print_sets") or []
        selected = setup.get("selected_print_set") or ""
        printer_presets = setup.get("printer_presets") or []
        selected_printer_preset = setup.get("selected_printer_preset") or "(None)"
        printer_modes = setup.get("printer_modes") or []
        selected_printer_mode = setup.get("selected_printer_mode") or "Auto"
        print_settings = setup.get("print_settings") or []
        selected_print_setting = setup.get("selected_print_setting") or ""
        parameter_options = setup.get("parameter_options") or {}
        templates = setup.get("templates") or {}
        workflows = setup.get("workflows") or {}
        preview = setup.get("preview") or {}
        expected = preview.get("expected_files") or []
        expected_dwgs = preview.get("expected_dwgs") or []

        if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet"):
            self._binding_selector = True
            try:
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbPrintSet, print_sets, selected)
            finally:
                self._binding_selector = False

        if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterProfileMode"):
            self._binding_selector = True
            try:
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbPrinterProfileMode, printer_modes, selected_printer_mode)
            finally:
                self._binding_selector = False

        if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterPreset"):
            self._binding_selector = True
            try:
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbPrinterPreset, printer_presets, selected_printer_preset)
            finally:
                self._binding_selector = False

        if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSetting"):
            self._binding_selector = True
            try:
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbPrintSetting, print_settings, selected_print_setting)
            finally:
                self._binding_selector = False

        # Keep naming parameter pickers synced with discovered sheet/titleblock parameter names.
        sheet_params = parameter_options.get("sheet_params") or []
        tb_params = parameter_options.get("titleblock_params") or []
        naming_options = (self._state.get("naming") or {}).get("options") if isinstance(self._state, dict) else {}
        naming_options = naming_options or {}

        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceSheetNumberParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbSourceSheetNumberParam, [""] + sheet_params, naming_options.get("source_sheet_number_param") or "")
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbSourceRevisionParam, [""] + sheet_params, naming_options.get("source_revision_param") or "")
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionDateParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbSourceRevisionDateParam, [""] + sheet_params, naming_options.get("source_revision_date_param") or "")
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSheetNumberParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbSheetNumberParam, tb_params, naming_options.get("sheet_number_param") or "SHEET_NUMBER")
        if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbRevisionParam, tb_params, naming_options.get("revision_param") or "REVISION")
        if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionDateParam"):
            self._set_combo_items(self.CmbRevisionDateParam, tb_params, naming_options.get("revision_date_param") or "REVISION_DATE")

        if hasattr(self, "TxtSetupSummary"):
            self.TxtSetupSummary.Text = "Print Set: {0} | Expected PDFs: {1} | Expected DWGs: {2}".format(
                selected or "",
                len(expected),
                len(expected_dwgs)
            )

        if hasattr(self, "CmbWorkflow"):
            self._binding_selector = True
            try:
                self._set_combo_items(self.CmbWorkflow, workflows.get("names") or [], workflows.get("selected") or "")
            finally:
                self._binding_selector = False
        if hasattr(self, "InpWorkflowName") and (not preserve_template_inputs or not (self.InpWorkflowName.Text or "").strip()):
            self.InpWorkflowName.Text = workflows.get("selected") or ""

        if hasattr(self, "InpPdfTemplate") and (not preserve_template_inputs or not (self.InpPdfTemplate.Text or "").strip()):
            self.InpPdfTemplate.Text = templates.get("pdf_filename_template") or ""

        if hasattr(self, "InpDwgTemplate") and (not preserve_template_inputs or not (self.InpDwgTemplate.Text or "").strip()):
            self.InpDwgTemplate.Text = templates.get("dwg_filename_template") or ""

        if hasattr(self, "InpApprovalTemplate") and (not preserve_template_inputs or not (self.InpApprovalTemplate.Text or "").strip()):
            self.InpApprovalTemplate.Text = templates.get("internal_approval_filename_template") or ""

        if hasattr(self, "TxtSetupExpectedList"):
            lines = []
            for item in expected[:200]:
                lines.append(item.get("filename") or "")
            self.TxtSetupExpectedList.Text = "\n".join(lines)

        if hasattr(self, "TxtSetupExpectedDwgList"):
            lines = []
            for item in expected_dwgs[:200]:
                lines.append(item.get("filename") or "")
            self.TxtSetupExpectedDwgList.Text = "\n".join(lines)

    def _render_template_preview(self, setup):
        preview = (setup or {}).get("preview") or {}
        expected_pdf = preview.get("expected_files") or []
        expected_dwg = preview.get("expected_dwgs") or []

        lines = []
        if expected_pdf:
            lines.append("PDF sample: {0}".format((expected_pdf[0] or {}).get("filename") or ""))
        if expected_dwg:
            lines.append("DWG sample: {0}".format((expected_dwg[0] or {}).get("filename") or ""))
        if preview.get("internal_approval_file"):
            lines.append("Approval PDF: {0}".format(os.path.basename(preview.get("internal_approval_file") or "")))
        lines.append("Total PDF: {0}".format(len(expected_pdf)))
        lines.append("Total DWG: {0}".format(len(expected_dwg)))

        if hasattr(self, "TxtTemplatePreview"):
            self.TxtTemplatePreview.Text = "\n".join(lines)

    def _render_pdf_name_validation(self, validation):
        validation = validation or {}
        lines = [
            "Status: {0}".format(validation.get("status") or ""),
            "Summary: {0}".format(validation.get("summary") or ""),
            "Folder: {0}".format(validation.get("pdf_folder") or ""),
            "Expected: {0} | Actual: {1} | Matched: {2}".format(
                validation.get("expected_count", 0),
                validation.get("actual_count", 0),
                validation.get("matched_count", 0)
            ),
            ""
        ]

        missing = validation.get("missing_expected") or []
        extra = validation.get("unexpected_actual") or []

        lines.append("Missing Expected:")
        if missing:
            lines.extend(["  - {0}".format(x) for x in missing[:30]])
        else:
            lines.append("  - none")

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Unexpected Actual:")
        if extra:
            lines.extend(["  - {0}".format(x) for x in extra[:30]])
        else:
            lines.append("  - none")

        if hasattr(self, "TxtPdfNameValidation"):
            self.TxtPdfNameValidation.Text = "\n".join(lines)

    def _read_naming_options(self):
        return {
            "source_sheet_number_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbSourceSheetNumberParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceSheetNumberParam") else "",
            "source_revision_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbSourceRevisionParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionParam") else "",
            "source_revision_date_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbSourceRevisionDateParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionDateParam") else "",
            "sheet_number_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbSheetNumberParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbSheetNumberParam") else "SHEET_NUMBER",
            "revision_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbRevisionParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionParam") else "REVISION",
            "revision_date_param": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbRevisionDateParam) if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionDateParam") else "REVISION_DATE",
            "compare_sheet_number": bool(self.ChkCompareSheetNumber.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareSheetNumber") else True,
            "compare_revision": bool(self.ChkCompareRevision.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareRevision") else True,
            "compare_revision_date": bool(self.ChkCompareRevisionDate.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareRevisionDate") else True,
            "trim_values": bool(self.ChkTrimNamingValues.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkTrimNamingValues") else True,
            "case_sensitive": bool(self.ChkCaseSensitiveNaming.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCaseSensitiveNaming") else False,
            "treat_both_blank_as_match": bool(self.ChkBothBlankMatchNaming.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkBothBlankMatchNaming") else True
        }

    def _render_naming_options(self, options):
        options = options or {}
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceSheetNumberParam"):
            self.CmbSourceSheetNumberParam.Text = options.get("source_sheet_number_param") or ""
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionParam"):
            self.CmbSourceRevisionParam.Text = options.get("source_revision_param") or ""
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSourceRevisionDateParam"):
            self.CmbSourceRevisionDateParam.Text = options.get("source_revision_date_param") or ""
        if hasattr(self, "CmbSheetNumberParam"):
            self.CmbSheetNumberParam.Text = options.get("sheet_number_param") or "SHEET_NUMBER"
        if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionParam"):
            self.CmbRevisionParam.Text = options.get("revision_param") or "REVISION"
        if hasattr(self, "CmbRevisionDateParam"):
            self.CmbRevisionDateParam.Text = options.get("revision_date_param") or "REVISION_DATE"
        if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareSheetNumber"):
            self.ChkCompareSheetNumber.IsChecked = bool(options.get("compare_sheet_number", True))
        if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareRevision"):
            self.ChkCompareRevision.IsChecked = bool(options.get("compare_revision", True))
        if hasattr(self, "ChkCompareRevisionDate"):
            self.ChkCompareRevisionDate.IsChecked = bool(options.get("compare_revision_date", True))
        if hasattr(self, "ChkTrimNamingValues"):
            self.ChkTrimNamingValues.IsChecked = bool(options.get("trim_values", True))
        if hasattr(self, "ChkCaseSensitiveNaming"):
            self.ChkCaseSensitiveNaming.IsChecked = bool(options.get("case_sensitive", False))
        if hasattr(self, "ChkBothBlankMatchNaming"):
            self.ChkBothBlankMatchNaming.IsChecked = bool(options.get("treat_both_blank_as_match", True))

    def apply_naming_rules_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            saved = orchestrator.save_naming_options(self._read_naming_options())
            naming = orchestrator.run_naming_check()
            if isinstance(self._state, dict):
                self._state["naming"] = naming
                self._state["profile"] = saved
            self._render_naming_options(naming.get("options") or {})
            self._render_naming(naming)
            self._set_status("Naming rules saved and check complete.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply naming rules failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def apply_templates_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            pdf_template = self.InpPdfTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpPdfTemplate") else ""
            dwg_template = self.InpDwgTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpDwgTemplate") else ""
            approval_template = self.InpApprovalTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpApprovalTemplate") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            orchestrator.save_filename_templates(pdf_template, dwg_template, approval_template)
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            self._set_status("Filename templates applied.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply templates failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def preview_templates_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            overrides = {
                "pdf_filename_template": self.InpPdfTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpPdfTemplate") else "",
                "dwg_filename_template": self.InpDwgTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpDwgTemplate") else "",
                "internal_approval_filename_template": self.InpApprovalTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpApprovalTemplate") else ""
            }
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
            setup = orchestrator.build_package_setup(
                issue_name,
                issue_date,
                selected_print_set=selected_set,
                template_overrides=overrides
            )
            self._render_setup(setup, preserve_template_inputs=True)
            self._render_template_preview(setup)
            self._set_status("Template preview updated (unsaved).")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Template preview failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def _refresh_setup_from_inputs(self, template_overrides=None):
        orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
        issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
        selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
        setup = orchestrator.build_package_setup(
            issue_name,
            issue_date,
            selected_print_set=selected_set,
            template_overrides=template_overrides
        )
        self._render_setup(setup, preserve_template_inputs=bool(template_overrides))
        self._render_template_preview(setup)

    def refresh_setup_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            self._set_status("Stage 2 complete. Package setup preview refreshed.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Package setup refresh failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def apply_setup_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
            selected_mode = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrinterProfileMode) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterProfileMode") else "Auto"
            selected_print_setting = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSetting) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSetting") else ""
            selected_preset = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrinterPreset) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterPreset") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            create_placeholders = bool(self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders") else False
            orchestrator.save_package_setup(
                selected_set,
                create_placeholder_pdfs=create_placeholders,
                printer_profile_mode=selected_mode,
                print_setting_name=selected_print_setting,
                printer_preset_name=selected_preset
            )
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            self._set_status("Stage 2 complete. Package setup applied.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply setup failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def apply_printer_preset_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            preset_name = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrinterPreset) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterPreset") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            orchestrator.apply_printer_preset(preset_name)
            self.refresh_state(status_override="Printer preset applied.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply printer preset failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def _current_workflow_values(self):
        values = self._read_naming_options()
        values.update({
            "print_set_name": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else "",
            "printer_preset_name": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrinterPreset) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterPreset") else "",
            "printer_profile_mode": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrinterProfileMode) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrinterProfileMode") else "Auto",
            "print_setting_name": self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSetting) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSetting") else "",
            "create_placeholder_pdfs": bool(self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders") else False,
            "pdf_filename_template": self.InpPdfTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpPdfTemplate") else "",
            "dwg_filename_template": self.InpDwgTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpDwgTemplate") else "",
            "internal_approval_filename_template": self.InpApprovalTemplate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpApprovalTemplate") else ""
        })
        return values

    def save_workflow_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            workflow_name = self.InpWorkflowName.Text if hasattr(self, "InpWorkflowName") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            orchestrator.save_workflow_preset(workflow_name, self._current_workflow_values())
            self.refresh_state(status_override="Workflow preset saved.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Save workflow failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def apply_workflow_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            workflow_name = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbWorkflow) if hasattr(self, "CmbWorkflow") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            orchestrator.apply_workflow_preset(workflow_name)
            self.refresh_state(status_override="Workflow preset applied.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Apply workflow failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def print_set_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self._binding_selector:
            return
        try:
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _read_issue_inputs(self):
        issue_name = self.InpIssueName.Text if hasattr(self, "InpIssueName") else ""
        issue_date = self.InpIssueDate.Text if hasattr(self, "InpIssueDate") else ""
        return issue_name, issue_date

    def _render_preview(self, preview):
        target = (preview or {}).get("target") or ""
        subfolders = (preview or {}).get("subfolders") or []

        if hasattr(self, "TxtPreviewTarget"):
            self.TxtPreviewTarget.Text = target
        if hasattr(self, "TxtPreviewTree"):
            lines = [target] if target else []
            for folder in subfolders:
                lines.append("  - {0}".format(folder))
            self.TxtPreviewTree.Text = "\n".join(lines)

    def preview_package_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            preview = orchestrator.preview_package(issue_name, issue_date)
            self._render_preview(preview)
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            self._set_status("Stage 3 complete. Package preview updated.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Preview failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def validate_pdf_names_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            result = orchestrator.validate_expected_pdf_names(issue_name, issue_date, selected_print_set=selected_set)
            self._render_pdf_name_validation(result)
            self._set_status("Stage 3 complete. PDF name validation run.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("PDF name validation failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def action_stage2_click(self, sender, args):
        self.apply_setup_click(sender, args)

    def action_stage1_click(self, sender, args):
        self.apply_project_click(sender, args)

    def action_stage3_click(self, sender, args):
        self.preview_package_click(sender, args)
        if bool(self.ChkActionValidateNames.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkActionValidateNames") else True:
            self.validate_pdf_names_click(sender, args)

    def action_stage4_click(self, sender, args):
        if bool(self.ChkActionExportPdf.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkActionExportPdf") else True:
            self.quick_export_pdf_click(sender, args)
        if bool(self.ChkActionExportApproval.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkActionExportApproval") else True:
            self.quick_export_approval_click(sender, args)

    def action_stage5_click(self, sender, args):
        if bool(self.ChkActionCreatePackage.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkActionCreatePackage") else True:
            self.create_package_click(sender, args)

    def action_run_all_click(self, sender, args):
        self.action_stage1_click(sender, args)
        self.action_stage2_click(sender, args)
        self.action_stage3_click(sender, args)
        self.action_stage4_click(sender, args)
        self.action_stage5_click(sender, args)

    def create_package_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            move_files = bool(self.ChkMoveFiles.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkMoveFiles") else False
            recursive = bool(self.ChkRecursive.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkRecursive") else True
            create_placeholders = bool(self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders") else False

            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            result = orchestrator.create_package(issue_name, issue_date, move_files, recursive, create_placeholder_pdfs=create_placeholders)
            message = "Package created: {0} | Files routed: {1} | Expected PDFs: {2} | Placeholder PDFs: {3} (PDF={4}, DWG={5}, REV={6})".format(
                result.get("package_dir") or "",
                result.get("file_count", 0),
                result.get("expected_count", 0),
                result.get("placeholder_pdf_count", 0),
                (result.get("counts") or {}).get("PDF", 0),
                (result.get("counts") or {}).get("DWG", 0),
                (result.get("counts") or {}).get("REV", 0)
            )
            self.refresh_state(status_override="Stage 5 complete. {0}".format(message))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Create package failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def quick_export_pdf_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
            create_placeholders = bool(self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders") else True

            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            result = orchestrator.quick_export_pdfs(
                issue_name,
                issue_date,
                selected_print_set=selected_set,
                create_placeholders_on_fail=create_placeholders
            )

            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            if hasattr(self, "TxtExporterFailures"):
                failures = result.get("failures") or []
                self.TxtExporterFailures.Text = "\n".join(failures) if failures else "No exporter failures."
            self._set_status(
                "Stage 4 complete. Quick PDF export: exported={0}, placeholders={1}, failed={2}".format(
                    result.get("exported", 0),
                    result.get("placeholders", 0),
                    result.get("failed", 0)
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Quick PDF export failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def quick_export_approval_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            issue_name, issue_date = self._read_issue_inputs()
            selected_set = self._combo_selected_text(self.CmbPrintSet) if hasattr(self, "CmbPrintSet") else ""
            create_placeholders = bool(self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked) if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders") else True
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            result = orchestrator.quick_export_internal_approval(
                issue_name,
                issue_date,
                selected_print_set=selected_set,
                create_placeholder_on_fail=create_placeholders
            )
            if hasattr(self, "TxtExporterFailures"):
                failures = result.get("failures") or []
                self.TxtExporterFailures.Text = "\n".join(failures) if failures else "No exporter failures."
            self._refresh_setup_from_inputs()
            self._set_status(
                "Stage 4 complete. Approval PDF export: exported={0}, placeholders={1}, failed={2}".format(
                    result.get("exported", 0),
                    result.get("placeholders", 0),
                    result.get("failed", 0)
                )
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Approval PDF export failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def _open_folder(self, path):
        if not path:
            return False
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            return False
        try:
            os.startfile(path)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _render_naming(self, naming):
        naming = naming or {}
        summary = naming.get("summary") or "No naming summary available."
        rows = naming.get("rows") or []
        description_lines = naming.get("description_lines") or []

        if hasattr(self, "TxtNamingSummary"):
            self.TxtNamingSummary.Text = summary
        if hasattr(self, "TxtNamingWhatItChecks"):
            self.TxtNamingWhatItChecks.Text = "\n".join(description_lines)

        lines = []
        issue_rows = [r for r in rows if r.get("overall_status") != "OK"]
        for row in issue_rows[:10]:
            sheet_no = row.get("sheet_number") or ""
            sheet_name = row.get("sheet_name") or ""
            lines.append("[{0}] {1}".format(sheet_no, sheet_name))

            if not row.get("has_titleblock"):
                lines.append("  - No titleblock on sheet")
                continue

            fields = row.get("fields") or {}

            sheet_info = fields.get("sheet_number") or {}
            if sheet_info.get("status") != "ok" and bool((naming.get("options") or {}).get("compare_sheet_number", True)):
                lines.append("  - Sheet Number mismatch | {0}='{1}' vs Titleblock.{2}='{3}'".format(
                    sheet_info.get("source") or "ViewSheet.SheetNumber",
                    sheet_info.get("sheet") or "",
                    (naming.get("options") or {}).get("sheet_number_param") or "SHEET_NUMBER",
                    sheet_info.get("titleblock") or ""
                ))

            rev_info = fields.get("revision") or {}
            if rev_info.get("status") != "ok" and bool((naming.get("options") or {}).get("compare_revision", True)):
                lines.append("  - Revision mismatch | {0}='{1}' vs Titleblock.{2}='{3}'".format(
                    rev_info.get("source") or "latest revision number on sheet",
                    rev_info.get("revision_table") or "",
                    (naming.get("options") or {}).get("revision_param") or "REVISION",
                    rev_info.get("titleblock") or ""
                ))

            date_info = fields.get("revision_date") or {}
            if date_info.get("status") != "ok" and bool((naming.get("options") or {}).get("compare_revision_date", True)):
                lines.append("  - Revision Date mismatch | {0}='{1}' vs Titleblock.{2}='{3}'".format(
                    date_info.get("source") or "latest revision date on sheet",
                    date_info.get("revision_table") or "",
                    (naming.get("options") or {}).get("revision_date_param") or "REVISION_DATE",
                    date_info.get("titleblock") or ""
                ))

        if not lines:
            lines = ["No discrepancies found in sampled rows."]

        if hasattr(self, "TxtNamingDetails"):
            self.TxtNamingDetails.Text = "\n".join(lines)

    def run_naming_check_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
            naming = orchestrator.run_naming_check()
            if isinstance(self._state, dict):
                self._state["naming"] = naming
            self._render_naming_options(naming.get("options") or {})
            self._render_naming(naming)
            self._set_status("Naming discrepancy check complete.")
        except Exception as exc:
            self._set_status("Naming discrepancy check failed: {0}".format(exc))

    def open_pending_root_click(self, sender, args):
        profile = (self._state.get("profile") if isinstance(self._state, dict) else {}) or {}
        pending = (self._state.get("pending") if isinstance(self._state, dict) else {}) or {}
        path = pending.get("root") or profile.get("pending_issue_root") or profile.get("project_folder")
        if not self._open_folder(path):
            self._set_status("Pending root is not set or does not exist.")

    def open_latest_issue_click(self, sender, args):
        pending = (self._state.get("pending") if isinstance(self._state, dict) else {}) or {}
        path = pending.get("latest_issue_folder")
        if not self._open_folder(path):
            self._set_status("Latest issue folder is not available.")

    def refresh_state(self, status_override=None):
        orchestrator = self._make_orchestrator()
        state = orchestrator.build_panel_state()
        self._state = state or {}

        context = state.get("context", {})
        profile = state.get("profile", {})
        selector = state.get("project_selector", {})
        pending = state.get("pending", {})
        naming = state.get("naming", {})
        preview = state.get("preview", {})
        setup = state.get("package_setup", {})

        if hasattr(self, "TxtModel"):
            self.TxtModel.Text = context.get("document_title") or ""
        if hasattr(self, "TxtProject"):
            self.TxtProject.Text = context.get("project_identity") or ""
        if hasattr(self, "TxtModelKey"):
            self.TxtModelKey.Text = context.get("model_key") or ""

        self._render_project_selector(selector)

        if hasattr(self, "InpDefaultIssueName"):
            self.InpDefaultIssueName.Text = profile.get("default_issue_name") or context.get("project_identity") or ""

        if hasattr(self, "InpIssueName"):
            current_name = self.InpIssueName.Text or ""
            if not current_name.strip():
                self.InpIssueName.Text = profile.get("default_issue_name") or context.get("project_identity") or "Issue"
        if hasattr(self, "InpIssueDate"):
            current_date = self.InpIssueDate.Text or ""
            if not current_date.strip():
                import datetime
                self.InpIssueDate.Text = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%y%m%d")
        if hasattr(self, "ChkCreatePlaceholders"):
            self.ChkCreatePlaceholders.IsChecked = bool(profile.get("create_placeholder_pdfs", False))

        if hasattr(self, "TxtLatestIssue"):
            self.TxtLatestIssue.Text = pending.get("latest_issue_folder") or "No issue package found"

        if hasattr(self, "TxtCounts"):
            self.TxtCounts.Text = "PDF: {0} | DWG: {1} | Revision: {2} | Binder: {3}".format(
                pending.get("pdf_count", 0),
                pending.get("dwg_count", 0),
                pending.get("revision_count", 0),
                pending.get("binder_count", 0)
            )

        if hasattr(self, "TxtLastScan"):
            self.TxtLastScan.Text = pending.get("scan_time") or ""

        self._render_naming(naming)
        self._render_naming_options((naming or {}).get("options") or {})
        self._render_preview(preview)
        self._render_setup(setup)
        self._render_template_preview(setup)
        self._render_pdf_name_validation({
            "status": "info",
            "summary": "Run Validate PDF Names after export or manual placement.",
            "pdf_folder": (setup.get("preview") or {}).get("pdf_folder") or "",
            "expected_count": len(((setup.get("preview") or {}).get("expected_files") or [])),
            "actual_count": 0,
            "matched_count": 0,
            "missing_expected": [],
            "unexpected_actual": []
        })
        if hasattr(self, "TxtExporterFailures") and not (self.TxtExporterFailures.Text or "").strip():
            self.TxtExporterFailures.Text = "No exporter failures."
        self._set_status(status_override or (state.get("status") or {}).get("message") or "")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import datetime
import io
import json
import os
import re
import shutil


_RUNTIME_SUBDIR = "PackageCreatorDock"
_PROJECTDOCS_ROOT_CANDIDATES = [
    r"Z:\ProjectDocs",
    r"\\rbgshare.sjgroup.local\dfs\ProjectDocs"
]

_DEFAULT_NAMING_OPTIONS = {
    "sheet_number_param": "SHEET_NUMBER",
    "revision_param": "REVISION",
    "revision_date_param": "REVISION_DATE",
    "source_sheet_number_param": "",
    "source_revision_param": "",
    "source_revision_date_param": "",
    "compare_sheet_number": True,
    "compare_revision": True,
    "compare_revision_date": True,
    "trim_values": True,
    "case_sensitive": False,
    "treat_both_blank_as_match": True
}

_DEFAULT_FILENAME_TEMPLATES = {
    "pdf_filename_template": "{date} - {issue} - {sheet_number} - {sheet_name}.pdf",
    "dwg_filename_template": "{date} - {issue} - {sheet_number} - {sheet_name}.dwg",
    "internal_approval_filename_template": "{date} - {issue} - Internal Approval.pdf"
}


def ensure_dir(path):
    if path and not os.path.isdir(path):
        os.makedirs(path)


def read_json(path, default_value=None):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return default_value
    with io.open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        return json.load(stream)


def write_json(path, payload):
    folder = os.path.dirname(path)
    ensure_dir(folder)
    with io.open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(payload, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def get_runtime_root():
    appdata = os.getenv("APPDATA") or os.path.expanduser("~")
    root = os.path.join(appdata, "pyRevit", _RUNTIME_SUBDIR)
    ensure_dir(root)
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(root, "profiles"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(root, "reports"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(root, "snapshots"))
    return root


def get_profiles_path():
    return os.path.join(get_runtime_root(), "profiles", "profiles.json")


def _default_profiles_payload():
    return {
        "profiles": {},
        "updated_at": None
    }


def _profile_defaults(project_identity=""):
    defaults = {
        "project_identity": project_identity or "",
        "office": "",
        "year_folder": "",
        "project_folder_name": "",
        "project_folder": "",
        "export_folder": "",
        "pending_issue_root": "",
        "default_issue_name": "",
        "print_set_name": "",
        "printer_preset_name": "",
        "printer_profile_mode": "Auto",
        "print_setting_name": "",
        "create_placeholder_pdfs": False,
        "workflow_presets": {},
        "selected_workflow_name": "",
        "last_used_at": None
    }
    defaults.update(_DEFAULT_NAMING_OPTIONS)
    defaults.update(_DEFAULT_FILENAME_TEMPLATES)
    return defaults


def _apply_profile_defaults(profile, project_identity=""):
    merged = _profile_defaults(project_identity=project_identity)
    if isinstance(profile, dict):
        merged.update(profile)
    return merged


def load_profiles():
    payload = read_json(get_profiles_path(), default_value=None)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        payload = _default_profiles_payload()
    if "profiles" not in payload or not isinstance(payload.get("profiles"), dict):
        payload["profiles"] = {}
    return payload


def save_profiles(payload):
    payload = payload or _default_profiles_payload()
    payload["updated_at"] = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    write_json(get_profiles_path(), payload)


def resolve_profile(model_context):
    payload = load_profiles()
    profiles = payload.get("profiles", {})
    model_key = model_context.get("model_key")

    profile = profiles.get(model_key)
    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
        profile = _apply_profile_defaults({}, project_identity=model_context.get("project_identity"))
        profiles[model_key] = profile
        payload["profiles"] = profiles
        save_profiles(payload)
    else:
        profile = _apply_profile_defaults(profile, project_identity=model_context.get("project_identity"))
        profiles[model_key] = profile
        payload["profiles"] = profiles
        save_profiles(payload)

    return profile


def update_profile(model_context, updates):
    payload = load_profiles()
    profiles = payload.get("profiles", {})
    model_key = model_context.get("model_key")

    profile = profiles.get(model_key)
    profile = _apply_profile_defaults(profile if isinstance(profile, dict) else {}, project_identity=model_context.get("project_identity"))

    for key, value in (updates or {}).items():
        if value is None:
            profile[key] = ""
        elif isinstance(value, (dict, list, bool, int, float)):
            profile[key] = value
        else:
            profile[key] = value

    profile["project_identity"] = model_context.get("project_identity") or profile.get("project_identity") or ""
    profile["last_used_at"] = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

    profiles[model_key] = profile
    payload["profiles"] = profiles
    save_profiles(payload)
    return profile


def resolve_projectdocs_root():
    for candidate in _PROJECTDOCS_ROOT_CANDIDATES:
        if os.path.isdir(candidate):
            return candidate
    return _PROJECTDOCS_ROOT_CANDIDATES[0]


def _list_dirs(path):
    if not path or not os.path.isdir(path):
        return []
    output = []
    for name in os.listdir(path):
        full = os.path.join(path, name)
        if os.path.isdir(full):
            output.append(name)
    return sorted(output)


def list_offices(projectdocs_root):
    return _list_dirs(projectdocs_root)


def list_year_folders(projectdocs_root, office):
    office_path = os.path.join(projectdocs_root, office) if projectdocs_root and office else ""
    return [name for name in _list_dirs(office_path) if re.match(r"^\d{4}\s*JOBS$", name.upper())]


def _score_project_name(name, query_tokens):
    if not query_tokens:
        return 0
    lower_name = (name or "").lower()
    score = 0
    for token in query_tokens:
        if not token:
            continue
        if token in lower_name:
            score += len(token)
    return score


def list_projects(projectdocs_root, office, year_folder, query_text=None, max_items=300):
    year_path = os.path.join(projectdocs_root, office, year_folder) if projectdocs_root and office and year_folder else ""
    names = _list_dirs(year_path)

    query_text = (query_text or "").strip().lower()
    tokens = [t for t in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", query_text) if t]

    scored = []
    for name in names:
        score = _score_project_name(name, tokens)
        if tokens and score <= 0:
            continue
        scored.append((score, name))

    if tokens:
        scored = sorted(scored, key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1].lower()))
        ordered = [name for _score, name in scored]
    else:
        ordered = names

    return ordered[:max(1, int(max_items))]


def suggest_year_folder(year_folders, revit_version):
    if not year_folders:
        return ""
    rv = (revit_version or "").strip()
    preferred = "{0} JOBS".format(rv) if rv else ""
    for name in year_folders:
        if name.upper() == preferred.upper():
            return name
    return year_folders[-1]


def build_project_search_query(model_context):
    chunks = [
        model_context.get("project_number") or "",
        model_context.get("project_name") or "",
        model_context.get("project_identity") or ""
    ]
    text = " ".join([x for x in chunks if x]).strip()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text


def derive_pending_issue_root(project_folder):
    if not project_folder:
        return ""
    search_roots = [
        os.path.join(project_folder, "5_Working"),
        project_folder
    ]

    matches = []
    for root in search_roots:
        if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
            continue
        for name in os.listdir(root):
            full = os.path.join(root, name)
            if not os.path.isdir(full):
                continue
            if "pending" in (name or "").lower():
                matches.append(full)

    if not matches:
        return ""

    exact = [m for m in matches if "pending issue" in os.path.basename(m).lower()]
    if exact:
        return sorted(exact)[0]
    return sorted(matches)[0]


def sanitize_filename(text):
    value = (text or "").strip()
    value = re.sub(r"[\\/:*?\"<>|]+", " ", value)
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()
    return value


def build_filename_from_template(template, issue_date_text, issue_name, sheet_number, sheet_name, extension_with_dot=None):
    base_template = (template or "").strip()
    if not base_template:
        base_template = "{date} - {issue} - {sheet_number} - {sheet_name}"

    date_token = _resolve_date_prefix(issue_date_text)
    token_values = {
        "date": sanitize_filename(date_token),
        "issue": sanitize_filename(issue_name) or "Issue",
        "sheet_number": sanitize_filename(sheet_number) or "Sheet",
        "sheet_name": sanitize_filename(sheet_name) or "Unnamed"
    }

    value = base_template
    for token_name, token_value in token_values.items():
        value = value.replace("{" + token_name + "}", token_value)
    value = sanitize_filename(value)

    stem, ext = os.path.splitext(value)
    if extension_with_dot:
        if not ext:
            value = value + extension_with_dot
    return value


def format_expected_pdf_filename(issue_date_text, issue_name, sheet_number, sheet_name):
    date_prefix = _resolve_date_prefix(issue_date_text)
    issue_part = sanitize_filename(issue_name) or "Issue"
    number_part = sanitize_filename(sheet_number) or "Sheet"
    name_part = sanitize_filename(sheet_name) or "Unnamed"
    return "{0} - {1} - {2} - {3}.pdf".format(date_prefix, issue_part, number_part, name_part)


def build_package_setup_preview(profile, issue_name, issue_date_text, sheet_rows):
    base = build_package_preview(profile, issue_name, issue_date_text)
    drawings_dir = os.path.join(base.get("target") or "", "Drawings")
    pdf_dir = os.path.join(drawings_dir, "PDF")
    dwg_dir = os.path.join(drawings_dir, "DWG")
    approval_dir = os.path.join(base.get("target") or "", "Internal Approval")
    pdf_template = (profile or {}).get("pdf_filename_template") or _DEFAULT_FILENAME_TEMPLATES["pdf_filename_template"]
    dwg_template = (profile or {}).get("dwg_filename_template") or _DEFAULT_FILENAME_TEMPLATES["dwg_filename_template"]
    approval_template = (profile or {}).get("internal_approval_filename_template") or _DEFAULT_FILENAME_TEMPLATES["internal_approval_filename_template"]

    expected_pdf = []
    expected_dwg = []
    for row in sheet_rows or []:
        pdf_filename = build_filename_from_template(
            pdf_template,
            issue_date_text,
            issue_name,
            row.get("sheet_number"),
            row.get("sheet_name"),
            extension_with_dot=".pdf"
        )

        dwg_filename = build_filename_from_template(
            dwg_template,
            issue_date_text,
            issue_name,
            row.get("sheet_number"),
            row.get("sheet_name"),
            extension_with_dot=".dwg"
        )

        expected_pdf.append({
            "sheet_id": row.get("sheet_id"),
            "sheet_number": row.get("sheet_number"),
            "sheet_name": row.get("sheet_name"),
            "filename": pdf_filename,
            "path": os.path.join(pdf_dir, pdf_filename)
        })

        expected_dwg.append({
            "sheet_id": row.get("sheet_id"),
            "sheet_number": row.get("sheet_number"),
            "sheet_name": row.get("sheet_name"),
            "filename": dwg_filename,
            "path": os.path.join(dwg_dir, dwg_filename)
        })

    return {
        "target": base.get("target") or "",
        "drawings_folder": drawings_dir,
        "pdf_folder": pdf_dir,
        "dwg_folder": dwg_dir,
        "internal_approval_folder": approval_dir,
        "internal_approval_file": os.path.join(
            approval_dir,
            build_filename_from_template(
                approval_template,
                issue_date_text,
                issue_name,
                "",
                "",
                extension_with_dot=".pdf"
            )
        ),
        "expected_files": expected_pdf,
        "expected_dwgs": expected_dwg,
        "expected_count": len(expected_pdf),
        "expected_dwg_count": len(expected_dwg),
        "pdf_template": pdf_template,
        "dwg_template": dwg_template,
        "internal_approval_template": approval_template
    }


def validate_exported_pdf_names(pdf_folder, expected_pdfs):
    expected_items = expected_pdfs or []
    expected_names = sorted(list(set([(item.get("filename") or "").strip() for item in expected_items if (item.get("filename") or "").strip()])))
    expected_lookup = set([name.lower() for name in expected_names])

    actual_names = []
    if pdf_folder and os.path.isdir(pdf_folder):
        for name in os.listdir(pdf_folder):
            full = os.path.join(pdf_folder, name)
            if os.path.isfile(full) and name.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
                actual_names.append(name)
    actual_names = sorted(actual_names)
    actual_lookup = set([name.lower() for name in actual_names])

    missing_expected = [name for name in expected_names if name.lower() not in actual_lookup]
    unexpected_actual = [name for name in actual_names if name.lower() not in expected_lookup]
    matched = [name for name in expected_names if name.lower() in actual_lookup]

    if not pdf_folder or not os.path.isdir(pdf_folder):
        status = "warning"
        summary = "PDF folder not found for validation."
    elif not expected_names:
        status = "warning"
        summary = "No expected PDF names available from current setup."
    elif not missing_expected and not unexpected_actual:
        status = "ok"
        summary = "PDF naming matches expected list."
    else:
        status = "warning"
        summary = "PDF naming differences found."

    return {
        "status": status,
        "summary": summary,
        "pdf_folder": pdf_folder or "",
        "expected_count": len(expected_names),
        "actual_count": len(actual_names),
        "matched_count": len(matched),
        "missing_expected": missing_expected,
        "unexpected_actual": unexpected_actual,
        "matched": matched
    }


def build_project_selector_state(model_context, profile, office_override=None, year_override=None, query_override=None):
    root = resolve_projectdocs_root()
    offices = list_offices(root)

    selected_office = office_override or (profile or {}).get("office") or ""
    if not selected_office and offices:
        selected_office = "Sydney" if "Sydney" in offices else offices[0]
    if selected_office and selected_office not in offices and offices:
        selected_office = offices[0]

    year_folders = list_year_folders(root, selected_office)
    selected_year = year_override or (profile or {}).get("year_folder") or suggest_year_folder(year_folders, model_context.get("revit_version"))
    if selected_year and selected_year not in year_folders and year_folders:
        selected_year = year_folders[-1]

    query_text = query_override
    if query_text is None:
        query_text = build_project_search_query(model_context)

    projects = list_projects(root, selected_office, selected_year, query_text=query_text)
    selected_project = (profile or {}).get("project_folder_name") or ""
    if selected_project and selected_project not in projects:
        selected_project = ""
    if not selected_project and projects:
        selected_project = projects[0]

    project_folder = os.path.join(root, selected_office, selected_year, selected_project) if selected_office and selected_year and selected_project else ""
    pending_root = derive_pending_issue_root(project_folder)

    return {
        "projectdocs_root": root,
        "offices": offices,
        "selected_office": selected_office,
        "year_folders": year_folders,
        "selected_year": selected_year,
        "query_text": query_text,
        "projects": projects,
        "selected_project": selected_project,
        "project_folder": project_folder,
        "pending_root": pending_root
    }


def _looks_like_issue_folder(name):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{6}\s*-\s*.+$", name or ""))


def _latest_subfolder(path):
    if not path or not os.path.isdir(path):
        return None

    candidates = []
    for name in os.listdir(path):
        child = os.path.join(path, name)
        if os.path.isdir(child) and _looks_like_issue_folder(name):
            candidates.append(child)

    if not candidates:
        return None

    candidates = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: os.path.getmtime(p), reverse=True)
    return candidates[0]


def _collect_files(folder, extensions):
    results = []
    if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
        return results

    for name in os.listdir(folder):
        full = os.path.join(folder, name)
        if not os.path.isfile(full):
            continue
        if extensions and not any(name.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in extensions):
            continue
        results.append({
            "name": name,
            "path": full,
            "modified": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(full)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        })

    results = sorted(results, key=lambda item: item["modified"], reverse=True)
    return results


def snapshot_pending_issue(profile):
    root = (profile or {}).get("pending_issue_root") or (profile or {}).get("project_folder")
    latest_issue = _latest_subfolder(root)

    if latest_issue:
        pdf_dir = os.path.join(latest_issue, "Drawings", "PDF")
        dwg_dir = os.path.join(latest_issue, "Drawings", "DWG")
        ia_dir = os.path.join(latest_issue, "Internal Approval")
    else:
        pdf_dir = ""
        dwg_dir = ""
        ia_dir = ""

    revision_files = _collect_files(latest_issue, [".xlsx", ".xls", ".xlsm"]) if latest_issue else []
    pdf_files = _collect_files(pdf_dir, [".pdf"])
    dwg_files = _collect_files(dwg_dir, [".dwg", ".dxf"])
    binder_files = _collect_files(ia_dir, [".pdf"])

    return {
        "scan_time": datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "root": root or "",
        "latest_issue_folder": latest_issue or "",
        "pdf_count": len(pdf_files),
        "dwg_count": len(dwg_files),
        "revision_count": len(revision_files),
        "binder_count": len(binder_files),
        "latest_pdfs": pdf_files[:8],
        "latest_dwgs": dwg_files[:8],
        "latest_revisions": revision_files[:3],
        "latest_binders": binder_files[:3]
    }


def _clean_issue_name(text):
    value = (text or "").strip()
    value = re.sub(r"[\\/:*?\"<>|]+", " ", value)
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip()
    return value


def _resolve_date_prefix(issue_date_text=None):
    text = (issue_date_text or "").strip()
    if re.match(r"^\d{6}$", text):
        return text
    return datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%y%m%d")


def _package_folder_name(issue_name, issue_date_text=None):
    date_prefix = _resolve_date_prefix(issue_date_text)
    clean_name = _clean_issue_name(issue_name) or "Issue"
    return "{0} - {1}".format(date_prefix, clean_name)


def build_package_preview(profile, issue_name, issue_date_text=None):
    root = (profile or {}).get("pending_issue_root") or (profile or {}).get("project_folder") or ""
    folder_name = _package_folder_name(issue_name, issue_date_text)
    target = os.path.join(root, folder_name) if root else folder_name

    return {
        "root": root,
        "folder_name": folder_name,
        "target": target,
        "subfolders": [
            os.path.join(target, "Drawings"),
            os.path.join(target, "Drawings", "PDF"),
            os.path.join(target, "Drawings", "DWG"),
            os.path.join(target, "Internal Approval")
        ]
    }


def _iter_export_candidates(export_folder, recursive):
    if not export_folder or not os.path.isdir(export_folder):
        return []

    if recursive:
        collected = []
        for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(export_folder):
            for name in files:
                collected.append(os.path.join(root, name))
        return collected

    return [
        os.path.join(export_folder, name)
        for name in os.listdir(export_folder)
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(export_folder, name))
    ]


def _is_revision_history(path):
    name = os.path.basename(path or "")
    stem, ext = os.path.splitext(name)
    if ext.lower() not in [".xlsx", ".xls", ".xlsm"]:
        return False
    key = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "", stem.lower())
    return key == "revisionhistory"


def _route_export_destination(package_dir, src_path):
    ext = os.path.splitext(src_path)[1].lower()
    if ext == ".pdf":
        return os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "PDF", os.path.basename(src_path)), "PDF"
    if ext in [".dwg", ".dxf"]:
        return os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "DWG", os.path.basename(src_path)), "DWG"
    if _is_revision_history(src_path):
        return os.path.join(package_dir, os.path.basename(src_path)), "REV"
    return None, None


def current_workflow_settings(profile):
    profile = profile or {}
    keys = [
        "print_set_name",
        "printer_preset_name",
        "printer_profile_mode",
        "print_setting_name",
        "create_placeholder_pdfs",
        "pdf_filename_template",
        "dwg_filename_template",
        "internal_approval_filename_template",
        "sheet_number_param",
        "revision_param",
        "revision_date_param",
        "source_sheet_number_param",
        "source_revision_param",
        "source_revision_date_param",
        "compare_sheet_number",
        "compare_revision",
        "compare_revision_date",
        "trim_values",
        "case_sensitive",
        "treat_both_blank_as_match"
    ]
    return dict((key, profile.get(key)) for key in keys)


def _create_empty_pdf(path):
    ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(path))
    if os.path.exists(path):
        return False
    with io.open(path, "wb") as stream:
        stream.write(b"")
    return True


def create_issue_package(
    profile,
    issue_name,
    issue_date_text=None,
    move_files=False,
    recursive=True,
    expected_pdfs=None,
    expected_dwgs=None,
    create_placeholder_pdfs=False
):
    preview = build_package_preview(profile, issue_name, issue_date_text)
    package_dir = preview.get("target")
    ensure_dir(package_dir)
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "PDF"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "DWG"))
    ensure_dir(os.path.join(package_dir, "Internal Approval"))

    export_folder = (profile or {}).get("export_folder") or ""
    candidates = _iter_export_candidates(export_folder, recursive)

    counts = {"PDF": 0, "DWG": 0, "REV": 0}
    copied_files = []
    for source in candidates:
        destination, bucket = _route_export_destination(package_dir, source)
        if not destination:
            continue

        ensure_dir(os.path.dirname(destination))
        if move_files:
            if os.path.exists(destination):
                os.remove(destination)
            shutil.move(source, destination)
        else:
            shutil.copy2(source, destination)

        counts[bucket] += 1
        copied_files.append(destination)

    manifest_path = ""
    expected_pdfs = expected_pdfs or []
    expected_dwgs = expected_dwgs or []
    if expected_pdfs:
        manifest_path = os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "PDF", "_Expected PDFs.txt")
        lines = ["Expected PDFs", ""]
        for item in expected_pdfs:
            lines.append(item.get("filename") or "")
        with io.open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write("\n".join(lines))

    dwg_manifest_path = ""
    if expected_dwgs:
        dwg_manifest_path = os.path.join(package_dir, "Drawings", "DWG", "_Expected DWGs.txt")
        lines = ["Expected DWGs", ""]
        for item in expected_dwgs:
            lines.append(item.get("filename") or "")
        with io.open(dwg_manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write("\n".join(lines))

    placeholder_count = 0
    if create_placeholder_pdfs and expected_pdfs:
        for item in expected_pdfs:
            if _create_empty_pdf(item.get("path") or ""):
                placeholder_count += 1

    return {
        "package_dir": package_dir,
        "folder_name": preview.get("folder_name"),
        "counts": counts,
        "file_count": len(copied_files),
        "expected_count": len(expected_pdfs),
        "expected_dwg_count": len(expected_dwgs),
        "manifest_path": manifest_path,
        "dwg_manifest_path": dwg_manifest_path,
        "placeholder_pdf_count": placeholder_count
    }

class BaseRenaming(forms.WPFWindow):

    def start(self, title, version="Version: _"):
        xaml_dir_abs_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__))

        if self.selected_elements:
            self.ShowDialog()
        else:
            forms.alert("No matching elements for renaming were selected. \nPlease Try again.", exitscript=True, title="Script Cancelled.")

    # ╔═╗╔╗ ╔═╗╔╦╗╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗

    @abstractproperty
    def element_types(self):
        """Abstract property of a list of types that should be filtered from selection."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def rename_elements(self):
        """This is an abstract method that will be replaced with a function that contains renaming logic for given elements."""
        pass

    def get_selected_elements(self):
        return [self.doc.GetElement(elem_id) for elem_id in self.uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds() if type(self.doc.GetElement(elem_id)) in self.element_types]

    # ╔═╗╦ ╦╦  ╔═╗╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╦╔═╗╔═╗
    # ║ ╦║ ║║  ╠═╝╠╦╝║ ║╠═╝║╣ ╠╦╝ ║ ║║╣ ╚═╗
    # ╚═╝╚═╝╩  ╩  ╩╚═╚═╝╩  ╚═╝╩╚═ ╩ ╩╚═╝╚═╝ GUI PROPERTIES
    # ====================================================================================================

    @property
    def find(self):
        return self.input_find.Text

    @property
    def replace(self):
        return self.input_replace.Text

    @property
    def prefix(self):
        return self.input_prefix.Text

    @property
    def suffix(self):
        return self.input_suffix.Text

    # ╔═╗╦ ╦╦  ╔═╗╦  ╦╔═╗╔╗╔╔╦╗╔═╗
    # ║ ╦║ ║║  ║╣ ╚╗╔╝║╣ ║║║ ║ ╚═╗
    # ╚═╝╚═╝╩  ╚═╝ ╚╝ ╚═╝╝╚╝ ╩ ╚═╝ GUI EVENTS (BUTTONS)
    # ====================================================================================================
    def button_close(self,sender,e):
        """Stop application by clicking on a <Close> button in the top right corner."""
        self.Close()

    def Hyperlink_RequestNavigate(self, sender, e):
        """Forwarding for a Hyperlink"""
        Start(e.Uri.AbsoluteUri)

    def header_drag(self,sender,e):
        """Drag window by holding LeftButton on the header."""
        if e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed:
            DragMove(self)

    def button_run(self, sender, e):
        """Button action: Rename view with given """
        self.rename_elements()

```

<Window

    <Window.Resources>

                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
