```
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="button_bg_normal"   Color="#39385D" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="button_bg_hover"    Color="#FF4C70" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="border_magenta"     Color="#EE82EE" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="border_blue"     Color="DodgerBlue" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="uncheckbox_checked_colour"     Color="Gray" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="checkbox_checked_colour"     Color="#EE82EE" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="footer_donate"     Color="#FF4C70" />






            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - REPEAT BUTTON? -->

            <Style x:Key="RepeatButtonTransparent" TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="#505050"/>
                <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                            <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" CornerRadius="10"/>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>


            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - THUMB -->

            <Style x:Key="ScrollBarThumbVertical" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <!--<Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>-->

                <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                            <Border x:Name="rectangle" Background="Black" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" CornerRadius="8"/>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" TargetName="rectangle" Value="Black"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsDragging" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" TargetName="rectangle" Value="Black"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - BUTTON -->
            <Style TargetType="Button">
                <!--[BUTTON] STYLES-->
                <Setter Property="TextElement.FontFamily"   Value="Arial"/>
                <Setter Property="Background"               Value="{StaticResource button_bg_normal}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground"               Value="{StaticResource button_fg_normal}"/>
                <Setter Property="Cursor"                   Value="Hand"/>

                <!--[BUTTON] TEMPLATE-->
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border CornerRadius="8"
                            Background="{TemplateBinding Background}">

                                <ContentPresenter  VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>

                <!--[BUTTON] TRIGGERS-->
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource button_bg_hover}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - TextBlock -->

                            <Border  BorderBrush="{DynamicResource border_magenta}"

            <Style TargetType="Border">

                <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - LABEL -->
            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - LABEL -->
            <Style TargetType="Label">
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource text_magenta}"/>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - CheckBox -->

            <Style TargetType="CheckBox">

                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource border_blue}"/>
                <Setter Property="Cursor" Value="Hand"/>

                <Style.Triggers>

                    <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="False">
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource uncheckbox_checked_colour}"/>
                    </Trigger>

                    <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="True">
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource checkbox_checked_colour}"/>
                    </Trigger>

                </Style.Triggers>

            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - DockPanel -->
            <Style TargetType="DockPanel">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="2"/>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>HEADER -->
            <Style x:Key="Header" TargetType="ContentControl">
                <Setter Property="ContentTemplate">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <!--HEADER START-->
                            <Grid
                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                Grid.ColumnSpan="2">
                                <!--HEADER GRID-->
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="100"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <!--LOGO-->
                                <DockPanel  Grid.Column="0"
                        Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                    <Image Width="20" Height="20"
                      />
                                    <!--Source="https://www.erikfrits.com/media/images/LOGO.png"-->

                                    <TextBlock>
                    <Hyperlink  RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate"
                                NavigateUri="https://erikfrits.com/blog/"
                                FontSize="14px"
                                FontWeight="Heavy"
                                Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}">
                                EF-Tools
                    </Hyperlink>
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </DockPanel>

                                <!--__TITLE__-->
                                <TextBlock x:Name="main_title"
                                            Text="__title__"

                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"

                                            Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>

                                <!--CLOSE-->
                                <Button Content="Close"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Width="60" Height="20"
                                        FontSize="10"
                                        Click="button_close"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <!--HEADER END-->
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[ComboBox] -->
            <ControlTemplate x:Key="ComboBoxToggleButton" TargetType="{x:Type ToggleButton}">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition />
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <!-- ARROW BOX-->
                    <Border x:Name="Border"
                            Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                            CornerRadius="2"
                            Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"
                            BorderThickness="1" />

                    <!-- MAIN BOX-->
                    <Border
                            Grid.Column="0"
                            CornerRadius="0"
                            Margin="1"
                            Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"
                            BorderThickness="0,0,1,0" />

                    <!-- MAIN BOX-->
                    <Path   x:Name="Arrow"
                            Grid.Column="1"
                            Fill="White"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                            Data="M0,0 L0,2 L4,6 L8,2 L8,0 L4,4 z"/>

                </Grid>
            </ControlTemplate>

            <ControlTemplate x:Key="ComboBoxTextBox" TargetType="{x:Type TextBox}">
                <Border x:Name="PART_ContentHost" Focusable="False" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" />
            </ControlTemplate>

            <Style x:Key="{x:Type ComboBox}" TargetType="{x:Type ComboBox}">
                <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Auto"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Auto"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="120"/>
                <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="20"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ComboBox}">
                            <Grid>
                                <ToggleButton Name="ToggleButton"
                                                Template="{StaticResource ComboBoxToggleButton}"
                                                Grid.Column="2"
                                                Focusable="false"
                                                IsChecked="{Binding Path=IsDropDownOpen,Mode=TwoWay,RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"
                                                ClickMode="Press">
                                </ToggleButton>

                                <ContentPresenter Name="ContentSite" IsHitTestVisible="False"  Content="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItem}"
                                                ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItemTemplate}"
                                                ContentTemplateSelector="{TemplateBinding ItemTemplateSelector}"
                                                Margin="3,3,23,3"
                                                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
                                <TextBox x:Name="PART_EditableTextBox"
                                            Style="{x:Null}"
                                            Template="{StaticResource ComboBoxTextBox}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Margin="3,3,23,3"
                                            Focusable="True"
                                            Background="#FF3F3F3F"
                                            Foreground="Green"
                                            Visibility="Hidden"
                                            IsReadOnly="{TemplateBinding IsReadOnly}"/>

                                <Popup Name="Popup"
                                        Placement="Bottom"
                                        IsOpen="{TemplateBinding IsDropDownOpen}"
                                        AllowsTransparency="True"
                                        Focusable="False"
                                        PopupAnimation="Slide">

                                    <Grid Name="DropDown"
                                          SnapsToDevicePixels="True"
                                          MinWidth="{TemplateBinding ActualWidth}"
                                          MaxHeight="{TemplateBinding MaxDropDownHeight}">

                                        <Border x:Name="DropDownBorder"
                                                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"/>

                                        <ScrollViewer Margin="4,6,4,6" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                                            <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" />
                                        </ScrollViewer>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Popup>
                            </Grid>


                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="HasItems" Value="false">
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="MinHeight" Value="95"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="false">
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#888888"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsGrouping" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="false"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger SourceName="Popup" Property="Popup.AllowsTransparency" Value="true">
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="CornerRadius" Value="0"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="Margin" Value="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsEditable"  Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="PART_EditableTextBox" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="ContentSite" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden"/>
                                </Trigger>

                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
                <Style.Triggers>
                </Style.Triggers>

            <!-- SimpleStyles: ComboBoxItem -->
            <Style x:Key="{x:Type ComboBoxItem}" TargetType="{x:Type ComboBoxItem}">

                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="false">
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#888888"/>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[SCROLLBAR] -->

            <Style TargetType="ScrollBar">

                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ScrollBar}">
                            <Grid x:Name="Bg"
                                              SnapsToDevicePixels="true">
                                <Border BorderBrush     = "{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"

                            </Grid>

                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[EXTRA] -->

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[EXTRA] -->
        </ResourceDictionary>
    </Window.Resources>

    <!--MAIN-->
    <Grid>
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="25"></RowDefinition>
            <RowDefinition></RowDefinition>
            <RowDefinition Height="25"></RowDefinition>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition></ColumnDefinition>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <!--HEADER START-->
        <Grid   MouseDown="header_drag"
                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                Grid.ColumnSpan="2">
            <!--HEADER GRID-->
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="100"/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!--LOGO-->
            <DockPanel  Grid.Column="0"
                        Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                <Image Width="20" Height="20"
                      />
                <!--Source="https://www.erikfrits.com/media/images/LOGO.png"-->

                <TextBlock>
                    <Hyperlink
                        RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate"
                        NavigateUri="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1LgjdE6zW3HNWg-IGo2d-Q"
                        FontSize="14px"
                        FontWeight="Heavy"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}">
                        EF-Tools
                    </Hyperlink>
                </TextBlock>
            </DockPanel>

            <!--__TITLE__-->
            <TextBlock x:Name="main_title"
                Text="__title__"
                Grid.Column="1"
                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>

            <!--CLOSE-->
            <Button Content="Close"
                    Grid.Column="2"
                    Width="60" Height="20"
                    FontSize="10"
                    Click="button_close"
                    VerticalAlignment="Center"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>
        </Grid>
        <!--HEADER END-->

        <StackPanel Grid.Row="1"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                    VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                    Margin="5">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="15*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>


                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0"
                                    Margin="5" >
                    <Label Content="Renaming Parameters"
                           Margin="0, -25,0,0 "
                           Foreground="{StaticResource text_magenta}"/>
                    <Border  Height="110"
                          BorderBrush="{DynamicResource border_magenta}"
                         BorderThickness="1,1,1,1" CornerRadius="10" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" Width="Auto">



                        <StackPanel Grid.Row="2"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                        Margin="10">

                            <!--FIND-->
                            <DockPanel  HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                        Margin="2">
                                <TextBlock Text="Find:"
                                            Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"
                                            Width="60"/>

                                <TextBox x:Name="input_find"
                                         Width="200"
                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                         Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
                            </DockPanel>

                            <!--REPLACE-->
                            <DockPanel HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                       Margin="2">

                                <TextBlock  Text="Replace:"
                                            Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"
                                            Width="60"/>

                                <TextBox x:Name="input_replace"
                                            Width="200"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                            Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
                            </DockPanel>

                            <!--PREFIX-->
                            <DockPanel HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                        Margin="2">
                                <TextBlock Text="Prefix:"
                                           Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"
                                           Width="60"/>

                                <TextBox x:Name="input_prefix"
                                         Width="200"
                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                         Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
                            </DockPanel>

                            <!--SUFFIX-->
                            <DockPanel HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                        Margin="2">
                                <TextBlock Text="Suffix:"
                                           Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"
                                           Width="60"/>

                                <TextBox x:Name="input_suffix"
                                         Width="200"
                                         HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                         VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                         Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
                            </DockPanel>


                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <Button Click="button_run"
                            Content="Rename"
                            Margin="0,10,0,0"
                            Width="75"
                            Height="25"/>





                </StackPanel>




            </Grid>



        </StackPanel>


        <!--FOOTER START-->
        <Grid   Grid.Row="2"
                Background="{StaticResource header_background}">
            <!--FOOTER GRID-->
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!--VERSION-->
            <TextBlock x:Name="footer_version"
                        Text="Version: 1.0"
                        Grid.Column="1"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource text_gray}"
                />

            <!--PATREON-->
            <TextBlock  Grid.Column="2"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                        Margin="0,0,10,0">
                    <Hyperlink
                        RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate"
                        NavigateUri="https://www.patreon.com/ErikFrits"
                        FontWeight="Medium"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource footer_donate}">
                        Donate
                    </Hyperlink>
            </TextBlock>


        </Grid>
        <!--FOOTER END-->

    </Grid>
</Window>
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import io
import sys
import json
import argparse


def read_json(path):
    with io.open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        return json.load(handle)


def write_json(path, data):
    folder = os.path.dirname(path)
    if folder and not os.path.isdir(folder):
        os.makedirs(folder)
    with io.open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(data, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)


def build_conn_str(target):
    driver = target.get("driver", "ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server")
    server = target["server"]
    database = target["database"]
    timeout = int(target.get("timeout", 10))
    auth_mode = (target.get("auth_mode") or "windows").lower()
    trust_fragment = "TrustServerCertificate=yes;" if "ODBC Driver" in driver else ""

    if auth_mode == "sql":
        username, password, user_env, pass_env = get_sql_credentials(target)
        if not username or not password:
            raise RuntimeError("SQL auth selected but env vars are missing: {0}, {1}".format(user_env, pass_env))
        conn_str = (
            "DRIVER={{{driver}}};"
            "SERVER={server};"
            "DATABASE={database};"
            "UID={username};"
            "PWD={password};"
            "{trust_fragment}"
        ).format(
            driver=driver,
            server=server,
            database=database,
            username=username,
            password=password,
            trust_fragment=trust_fragment
        )
    else:
        conn_str = (
            "DRIVER={{{driver}}};"
            "SERVER={server};"
            "DATABASE={database};"
            "Trusted_Connection=yes;"
            "{trust_fragment}"
        ).format(
            driver=driver,
            server=server,
            database=database,
            trust_fragment=trust_fragment
        )

    return conn_str, timeout


def get_sql_credentials(target):
    user_env = target.get("sql_user_env", "RTV_SQL_USER")
    pass_env = target.get("sql_pass_env", "RTV_SQL_PASS")

    # Support both RTV-specific and legacy extractor env conventions.
    username = (
        target.get("sql_user")
        or os.getenv(user_env)
        or os.getenv("SQL_USER")
    )
    password = (
        target.get("sql_pass")
        or os.getenv(pass_env)
        or os.getenv("SQL_PASS")
    )
    return username, password, user_env, pass_env


def get_auth_attempt_order(target):
    mode = (target.get("auth_mode") or "windows").lower()
    if mode == "auto":
        return ["windows", "sql"]
    if mode == "windows":
        return ["windows", "sql"]
    if mode == "sql":
        return ["sql"]
    return ["windows", "sql"]


def connect_with_auth_fallback(pyodbc, target):
    timeout = int(target.get("timeout", 10))
    attempts = []
    sql_user, sql_pass, sql_user_env, sql_pass_env = get_sql_credentials(target)

    for mode in get_auth_attempt_order(target):
        attempt_target = dict(target)
        attempt_target["auth_mode"] = mode

        if mode == "sql" and (not sql_user or not sql_pass):
            attempts.append({
                "mode": mode,
                "error": "SQL credentials missing (expected env vars: {0}, {1})".format(sql_user_env, sql_pass_env)
            })
            continue

        try:
            conn_str, timeout = build_conn_str(attempt_target)
            connection = pyodbc.connect(conn_str, timeout=timeout)
            return connection, mode, attempts
        except Exception as exc:
            attempts.append({
                "mode": mode,
                "error": str(exc)
            })

    lines = ["Connection failed for all authentication modes attempted."]
    for item in attempts:
        lines.append("- {0}: {1}".format(item.get("mode"), item.get("error")))
    raise RuntimeError("\n".join(lines))


def build_database_candidates(database_name):
    if not database_name:
        return []
    candidates = [database_name]
    if not database_name.startswith("RTVD_"):
        candidates.append("RTVD_{0}".format(database_name))
    if database_name.startswith("RTVD_"):
        candidates.append(database_name.replace("RTVD_", "", 1))
    seen = set()
    output = []
    for item in candidates:
        if item and item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            output.append(item)
    return output


def connect_with_database_fallback(pyodbc, target):
    last_error = None
    attempts = []

    for db_name in build_database_candidates(target.get("database")):
        db_target = dict(target)
        db_target["database"] = db_name
        try:
            connection, mode, auth_attempts = connect_with_auth_fallback(pyodbc, db_target)
            return connection, mode, db_name, attempts
        except Exception as exc:
            text = str(exc)
            attempts.append({"database": db_name, "error": text})
            last_error = exc
            if "4060" not in text:
                raise

    if last_error:
        lines = ["Database open failed for attempted names:"]
        for item in attempts:
            lines.append("- {0}: {1}".format(item.get("database"), item.get("error")))
        raise RuntimeError("\n".join(lines))
    raise RuntimeError("Database connection failed.")


def resolve_driver_name(requested_driver, installed_drivers):
    installed_drivers = installed_drivers or []
    if requested_driver and requested_driver in installed_drivers:
        return requested_driver, None

    preferred = [
        "ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server",
        "ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server",
        "ODBC Driver 13 for SQL Server",
        "SQL Server Native Client 11.0",
        "SQL Server"
    ]
    for name in preferred:
        if name in installed_drivers:
            if requested_driver and requested_driver != name:
                return name, "Configured driver '{0}' not installed. Falling back to '{1}'.".format(requested_driver, name)
            return name, None

    return None, "No supported SQL Server ODBC driver found. Installed drivers: {0}".format(", ".join(installed_drivers) if installed_drivers else "(none)")


def get_table_columns(cursor, table_name):
    sql = """
    SELECT COLUMN_NAME
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
    WHERE TABLE_NAME = ?
    ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
    """
    cursor.execute(sql, table_name)
    return [row[0] for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def get_table_column_types(cursor, table_name):
    sql = """
    SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE
    FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
    WHERE TABLE_NAME = ?
    """
    cursor.execute(sql, table_name)
    output = {}
    for row in cursor.fetchall():
        output[row[0]] = (row[1] or "").lower()
    return output


def get_fetch_columns(table_map, key_column):
    component_columns = table_map.get("sheet_number_component_columns") or []
    if not component_columns:
        for key in [
            "sheet_number_prefix_column",
            "sheet_number_series_column",
            "sheet_number_numeric_column"
        ]:
            col = table_map.get(key)
            if col:
                component_columns.append(col)

    columns = [
        key_column,
        table_map.get("sheet_number_column"),
        table_map.get("sheet_number_prefix_column"),
        table_map.get("sheet_number_series_column"),
        table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_column"),
        table_map.get("sheet_name_column"),
        table_map.get("full_number_column"),
        table_map.get("scale_column"),
        table_map.get("issue_stamp_column"),
        table_map.get("rev_amendment_column"),
        table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_column"),
        table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list_column")
    ]
    columns.extend(component_columns)
    output = []
    seen = set()
    for col in columns:
        if col and col not in seen:
            output.append(col)
            seen.add(col)
    return output


def get_lookup_value(sheet, table_map, key_column):
    key_value_field = (table_map.get("key_value_field") or "").strip()
    if key_value_field:
        return sheet.get(key_value_field)

    key_column_lower = (key_column or "").lower()
    if key_column_lower == "revitid":
        return sheet.get("unique_id")

    previous_sheet_number = sheet.get("previous_sheet_number")
    current_sheet_number = sheet.get("sheet_number") or ""
    return previous_sheet_number or current_sheet_number


def fetch_row(cursor, table_name, key_column, key_value, fetch_columns):
    select_clause = ", ".join(["[{0}]".format(col) for col in fetch_columns])
    sql = "SELECT {0} FROM [{1}] WHERE [{2}] = ?".format(select_clause, table_name, key_column)
    cursor.execute(sql, key_value)
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None
    output = {}
    for index, column_name in enumerate(fetch_columns):
        output[column_name] = row[index]
    return output


def to_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None
    return str(value)


def compose_configured_value(format_config, value_context, column_values=None):
    if not format_config:
        return None
    parts = format_config.get("parts") or []
    delimiter = format_config.get("delimiter")
    rendered = []
    for part in parts:
        if isinstance(part, dict):
            if part.get("literal") is not None:
                value = part.get("literal")
            elif part.get("field"):
                value = value_context.get(part.get("field"))
            elif part.get("column") and column_values is not None:
                value = column_values.get(part.get("column"))
            else:
                value = None
        else:
            value = value_context.get(part)

        text = to_text(value)
        if text:
            rendered.append(text)

    if not rendered:
        return None
    if delimiter is None:
        return "".join(rendered)
    return delimiter.join(rendered)


def build_db_values(table_map, db_row):
    if not db_row:
        return {}

    sheet_name_column = table_map.get("sheet_name_column")
    rtv_title_column = table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_column")
    rtv_sheet_list_column = table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list_column")

    sheet_number_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_column")
    prefix_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_prefix_column")
    series_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_series_column")
    numeric_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_column")
    numeric_width = int(table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_width") or 0)

    output = {
        "sheet_number": to_text(db_row.get(sheet_number_column)) if sheet_number_column else None,
        "sheet_name": to_text(db_row.get(sheet_name_column)),
        "rtv_sheet_title": to_text(db_row.get(rtv_title_column)) if rtv_title_column else None,
        "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list": to_text(db_row.get(rtv_sheet_list_column)) if rtv_sheet_list_column else None,
        "rtv_sheet_number_full": to_text(db_row.get(table_map.get("full_number_column"))),
        "rtv_scale": to_text(db_row.get(table_map.get("scale_column"))),
        "issue_stamp": to_text(db_row.get(table_map.get("issue_stamp_column"))),
        "rev_amendment": to_text(db_row.get(table_map.get("rev_amendment_column")))
    }

    if output.get("rtv_sheet_title") is None:
        output["rtv_sheet_title"] = output.get("sheet_name")
    if output.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list") is None:
        output["rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"] = output.get("sheet_name")

    if not output.get("sheet_number") and (prefix_column or series_column or numeric_column):
        prefix_value = to_text(db_row.get(prefix_column)) if prefix_column else ""
        series_value = to_text(db_row.get(series_column)) if series_column else ""
        number_value = to_text(db_row.get(numeric_column)) if numeric_column else ""

        prefix_value = prefix_value or ""
        series_value = series_value or ""
        number_value = number_value or ""

        if number_value and numeric_width > 0 and number_value.isdigit():
            number_value = number_value.zfill(numeric_width)

        composed = "{0}{1}{2}".format(prefix_value, series_value, number_value)
        output["sheet_number"] = composed or None

    if not output.get("rtv_sheet_number_full"):
        output["rtv_sheet_number_full"] = compose_configured_value(
            table_map.get("full_number_format"),
            output,
            column_values=db_row
        )

    return output


def parse_sheet_number_components(sheet_number, table_map):
    sheet_number = to_text(sheet_number) or ""
    if not sheet_number:
        return None

    prefix_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_prefix_column")
    series_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_series_column")
    numeric_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_column")
    if not (prefix_column or series_column or numeric_column):
        return None

    import re
    match = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z]+)(\d+)$", sheet_number)
    if not match:
        return None

    prefix_value = match.group(1)
    digits = match.group(2)

    numeric_width = int(table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_width") or 0)
    if numeric_width <= 0 or numeric_width >= len(digits):
        numeric_width = min(2, len(digits) - 1) if len(digits) > 1 else len(digits)
    if numeric_width <= 0:
        return None

    series_value = digits[:-numeric_width]
    numeric_text = digits[-numeric_width:]

    output = {}
    if prefix_column:
        output[prefix_column] = prefix_value
    if series_column:
        output[series_column] = series_value
    if numeric_column:
        try:
            output[numeric_column] = int(numeric_text)
        except Exception:
            output[numeric_column] = numeric_text
    return output


def build_update_parts(columns, table_map, sheet, db_row=None):
    updates = []
    params = []
    db_row = db_row or {}

    sheet_number_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_column")
    component_prefix_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_prefix_column")
    component_series_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_series_column")
    component_numeric_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_column")
    sheet_name_column = table_map.get("sheet_name_column")
    full_number_column = table_map.get("full_number_column")
    scale_column = table_map.get("scale_column")
    issue_stamp_column = table_map.get("issue_stamp_column")
    rev_amendment_column = table_map.get("rev_amendment_column")

    if sheet_name_column and sheet_name_column in columns:
        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(sheet_name_column))
        params.append(sheet.get("sheet_name") or "")

    if sheet_number_column and sheet_number_column in columns:
        current_sheet_number = sheet.get("sheet_number") or ""
        db_sheet_number = to_text(db_row.get(sheet_number_column)) or ""
        if current_sheet_number and current_sheet_number != db_sheet_number:
            updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(sheet_number_column))
            params.append(current_sheet_number)

    component_values = None
    if not sheet_number_column and (component_prefix_column or component_series_column or component_numeric_column):
        current_sheet_number = sheet.get("sheet_number") or ""
        component_values = parse_sheet_number_components(current_sheet_number, table_map)
        if component_values:
            for col_name in [component_prefix_column, component_series_column, component_numeric_column]:
                if col_name and col_name in columns and col_name in component_values:
                    desired_value = component_values[col_name]
                    current_value = db_row.get(col_name)
                    if to_text(desired_value) != to_text(current_value):
                        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(col_name))
                        params.append(desired_value)

    if full_number_column and full_number_column in columns and sheet.get("rtv_sheet_number_full") is not None:
        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(full_number_column))
        params.append(sheet.get("rtv_sheet_number_full"))

    if scale_column and scale_column in columns and sheet.get("rtv_scale") is not None:
        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(scale_column))
        params.append(sheet.get("rtv_scale"))

    if issue_stamp_column and issue_stamp_column in columns and sheet.get("issue_stamp") is not None:
        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(issue_stamp_column))
        params.append(sheet.get("issue_stamp"))

    if rev_amendment_column and rev_amendment_column in columns and sheet.get("rev_amendment") is not None:
        updates.append("[{0}] = ?".format(rev_amendment_column))
        params.append(sheet.get("rev_amendment"))

    return updates, params


def normalize_compare(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    return str(value)


def build_verification_diffs(sheet, db_values):
    field_pairs = [
        ("sheet_number", "Sheet Number"),
        ("sheet_name", "Sheet Name"),
        ("rtv_sheet_title", "RTVSheet Title"),
        ("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list", "RTVSheet Title Sheet List"),
        ("rtv_sheet_number_full", "RTVSheet Number Full"),
        ("rtv_scale", "RTVScale"),
        ("issue_stamp", "RTVIssueStamp"),
        ("rev_amendment", "RTVRev Amendment")
    ]

    diffs = []
    for field_name, label in field_pairs:
        revit_value = normalize_compare(sheet.get(field_name))
        db_value = normalize_compare((db_values or {}).get(field_name))
        if revit_value != db_value:
            reason = "value_mismatch"
            if revit_value and not db_value:
                reason = "db_blank"
            elif db_value and not revit_value:
                reason = "revit_blank"
            diffs.append({
                "field": field_name,
                "label": label,
                "revit_value": revit_value,
                "rtv_value": db_value,
                "reason": reason
            })
    return diffs


def fetch_number_collision(cursor, table_name, key_column, lookup_value, sheet_number_column, desired_number):
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 1 [{0}], [{1}]
    FROM [{2}]
    WHERE [{1}] = ? AND [{0}] <> ?
    """.format(key_column, sheet_number_column, table_name)
    cursor.execute(sql, desired_number, lookup_value)
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None
    return {
        "key": row[0],
        "sheet_number": row[1]
    }


def sheet_number_exists(cursor, table_name, sheet_number_column, number_value):
    sql = "SELECT COUNT(1) FROM [{0}] WHERE [{1}] = ?".format(table_name, sheet_number_column)
    cursor.execute(sql, number_value)
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    return bool(row and row[0])


def generate_collision_number(cursor, table_name, sheet_number_column, base_number):
    base = normalize_compare(base_number) or "SHEET"
    for index in range(1, 100):
        candidate = "{0}-{1:02d}".format(base, index)
        if not sheet_number_exists(cursor, table_name, sheet_number_column, candidate):
            return candidate
    return None


def sync_payload(payload):
    target = payload["target"]
    table_map = payload.get("table_map", {})
    sheet_table = table_map.get("sheet_table", "SheetInfo")
    key_column = table_map.get("key_column", "SheetNumber")

    result = {
        "status": "ok",
        "message": "",
        "action": (payload.get("sync", {}).get("action") or "push").lower(),
        "auth_mode_used": None,
        "database_used": None,
        "updated_count": 0,
        "verified_count": 0,
        "verify_mismatch_count": 0,
        "skipped_count": 0,
        "missing_count": 0,
        "warnings": [],
        "rows": []
    }

    dry_run = bool(payload.get("sync", {}).get("dry_run", True))
    action = result["action"]
    connection = None
    cursor = None

    try:
        try:
            import pyodbc
        except Exception:
            raise RuntimeError("Missing Python dependency: pyodbc. Install with: python -m pip install pyodbc")

        installed_drivers = list(pyodbc.drivers())
        requested_driver = target.get("driver", "ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server")
        resolved_driver, driver_note = resolve_driver_name(requested_driver, installed_drivers)
        if not resolved_driver:
            raise RuntimeError(driver_note)
        if driver_note:
            result["warnings"].append(driver_note)

        target = dict(target)
        target["driver"] = resolved_driver

        try:
            connection, used_auth_mode, used_database, db_attempts = connect_with_database_fallback(pyodbc, target)
            result["auth_mode_used"] = used_auth_mode
            result["database_used"] = used_database
            if used_auth_mode != (payload.get("target", {}).get("auth_mode") or "windows").lower():
                result["warnings"].append("Authentication fallback applied. Using '{0}' mode.".format(used_auth_mode))
            configured_db = payload.get("target", {}).get("database")
            if configured_db and used_database and configured_db != used_database:
                result["warnings"].append("Database name fallback applied. Configured '{0}', connected to '{1}'.".format(configured_db, used_database))
        except Exception as conn_exc:
            message = str(conn_exc)
            if "IM002" in message:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "ODBC driver/source error (IM002). Requested='{0}', Resolved='{1}', Installed={2}. Original: {3}".format(
                        requested_driver,
                        resolved_driver,
                        ", ".join(installed_drivers) if installed_drivers else "(none)",
                        message
                    )
                )
            if "28000" in message or "Login failed for user" in message:
                sql_user, _sql_pass, sql_user_env, sql_pass_env = get_sql_credentials(target)
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "SQL authentication/permission error (28000). {0}\nHint: configure a valid login with DB access. "
                    "If using SQL auth, set env vars {1} and {2} (or SQL_USER/SQL_PASS). Current SQL user resolved: {3}".format(
                        message,
                        sql_user_env,
                        sql_pass_env,
                        sql_user or "(none)"
                    )
                )
            raise
        cursor = connection.cursor()

        columns = get_table_columns(cursor, sheet_table)
        column_types = get_table_column_types(cursor, sheet_table)
        if not columns:
            raise RuntimeError("No columns found for table: {0}".format(sheet_table))
        if key_column not in columns:
            raise RuntimeError("Key column '{0}' not found on table '{1}'".format(key_column, sheet_table))

        fetch_columns = get_fetch_columns(table_map, key_column)
        for fetch_col in fetch_columns:
            if fetch_col not in columns:
                raise RuntimeError("Mapped column '{0}' not found on table '{1}'".format(fetch_col, sheet_table))

        if not dry_run and action == "push":
            connection.autocommit = False

        for sheet in payload.get("sheets", []):
            current_sheet_number = sheet.get("sheet_number") or ""
            lookup_value = get_lookup_value(sheet, table_map, key_column)

            if not lookup_value:
                result["skipped_count"] += 1
                result["warnings"].append("Skipped sheet with no lookup value: {0}".format(sheet.get("unique_id")))
                continue

            db_row_raw = fetch_row(cursor, sheet_table, key_column, lookup_value, fetch_columns)
            if not db_row_raw:
                result["missing_count"] += 1
                result["rows"].append({
                    "sheet_number": current_sheet_number,
                    "status": "missing",
                    "lookup_value": lookup_value,
                    "db_values": {}
                })
                continue

            db_values = build_db_values(table_map, db_row_raw)

            if action in ["compare", "pull_preview", "pull"]:
                result["rows"].append({
                    "sheet_number": current_sheet_number,
                    "status": "compared",
                    "lookup_value": lookup_value,
                    "db_values": db_values
                })
                continue

            updates, params = build_update_parts(columns, table_map, sheet, db_row_raw)

            conflict_resolution = None
            sheet_number_column = table_map.get("sheet_number_column")
            desired_number = sheet.get("sheet_number") or ""
            current_number = normalize_compare(db_values.get("sheet_number"))
            previous_number = sheet.get("previous_sheet_number") or ""
            number_change_requested = bool(
                sheet_number_column
                and desired_number
                and desired_number != current_number
            )

            if number_change_requested:
                collision_row = fetch_number_collision(
                    cursor,
                    sheet_table,
                    key_column,
                    lookup_value,
                    sheet_number_column,
                    desired_number
                )
                if collision_row:
                    data_type = (column_types.get(sheet_number_column) or "").lower()
                    if data_type not in ["varchar", "nvarchar", "char", "nchar", "text", "ntext"]:
                        result["warnings"].append(
                            "Sheet number collision detected for '{0}', but mapped column '{1}' type '{2}' cannot store suffix values."
                            .format(desired_number, sheet_number_column, data_type or "unknown")
                        )
                        conflict_resolution = {
                            "status": "not_supported",
                            "desired_number": desired_number,
                            "clashing_key": collision_row.get("key")
                        }
                    elif dry_run:
                        conflict_seed = collision_row.get("sheet_number") or desired_number
                        preview_number = "{0}-01".format(normalize_compare(conflict_seed) or "SHEET")
                        conflict_resolution = {
                            "status": "would_renumber",
                            "desired_number": desired_number,
                            "clashing_key": collision_row.get("key"),
                            "renumber_to": preview_number
                        }
                    else:
                        conflict_seed = collision_row.get("sheet_number") or desired_number
                        replacement = generate_collision_number(
                            cursor,
                            sheet_table,
                            sheet_number_column,
                            conflict_seed
                        )
                        if not replacement:
                            raise RuntimeError(
                                "Failed to allocate collision suffix for sheet number '{0}' in column '{1}'"
                                .format(desired_number, sheet_number_column)
                            )

                        rename_sql = "UPDATE [{0}] SET [{1}] = ? WHERE [{2}] = ?".format(sheet_table, sheet_number_column, key_column)
                        cursor.execute(rename_sql, replacement, collision_row.get("key"))
                        conflict_resolution = {
                            "status": "renumbered",
                            "desired_number": desired_number,
                            "clashing_key": collision_row.get("key"),
                            "renumber_to": replacement
                        }

            if not updates:
                result["skipped_count"] += 1
                result["rows"].append({
                    "sheet_number": current_sheet_number,
                    "status": "skipped",
                    "lookup_value": lookup_value,
                    "db_values": db_values,
                    "conflict_resolution": conflict_resolution
                })
                continue

            sql = "UPDATE [{0}] SET {1} WHERE [{2}] = ?".format(sheet_table, ", ".join(updates), key_column)
            params.append(lookup_value)

            if dry_run:
                result["updated_count"] += 1
                result["rows"].append({
                    "sheet_number": current_sheet_number,
                    "status": "dry-run",
                    "lookup_value": lookup_value,
                    "db_values": db_values,
                    "conflict_resolution": conflict_resolution,
                    "sql": sql,
                    "params": params
                })
            else:
                cursor.execute(sql, params)

                verified_row_raw = fetch_row(cursor, sheet_table, key_column, lookup_value, fetch_columns)
                verified_db_values = build_db_values(table_map, verified_row_raw)
                verification_diffs = build_verification_diffs(sheet, verified_db_values)
                verification_status = "verified" if not verification_diffs else "mismatch"
                if verification_status == "verified":
                    result["verified_count"] += 1
                else:
                    result["verify_mismatch_count"] += 1

                result["updated_count"] += 1
                result["rows"].append({
                    "sheet_number": current_sheet_number,
                    "status": "updated",
                    "lookup_value": lookup_value,
                    "db_values": db_values,
                    "conflict_resolution": conflict_resolution,
                    "verification": {
                        "status": verification_status,
                        "db_values": verified_db_values,
                        "diffs": verification_diffs
                    }
                })

        if not dry_run and action == "push":
            connection.commit()

    except Exception as exc:
        if not dry_run and action == "push":
            try:
                connection.rollback()
            except Exception:
                pass
        result["status"] = "error"
        result["message"] = str(exc)
    finally:
        try:
            if cursor:
                cursor.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if connection:
                connection.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--payload", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    payload = read_json(args.payload)
    result = sync_payload(payload)

    result_path = payload.get("result_path")
    if result_path:
        write_json(result_path, result)

    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

    if result.get("status") != "ok":
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

## CLASSES: ['RTVSyncOrchestrator']
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-


class RTVSyncOrchestrator(object):
    def __init__(self, context):
        self.ctx = context or {}

    def _get(self, name):
        fn = self.ctx.get(name)
        if not fn:
            raise RuntimeError("Orchestrator context is missing dependency: {0}".format(name))
        return fn

    def _doc(self):
        document = self.ctx.get("doc")
        if not document:
            raise RuntimeError("Orchestrator context is missing 'doc'.")
        return document

    def resolve_helper_environment(self, config, config_path):
        helper_config = (config or {}).get("helper", {})
        helper_python_config = helper_config.get("python_exe")

        resolve_helper_python = self._get("resolve_helper_python")
        helper_python, checked_python_paths = resolve_helper_python(helper_python_config, config_path)

        helper_script = helper_config.get("script_path")
        if helper_script and not self._get("os_path_isabs")(helper_script):
            helper_script = self._get("os_path_join")(self._get("os_path_dirname")(config_path), helper_script)
        if helper_script:
            helper_script = self._get("os_path_normpath")(helper_script)

        return helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script

    def validate_helper_environment(self, helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script):
        if not helper_python:
            message_lines = [
                "Helper Python executable not found.",
                "",
                "Checked paths:"
            ]
            for checked in (checked_python_paths or [])[:12]:
                message_lines.append("- {0}".format(checked))
            raise RuntimeError("\n".join(message_lines))

        if not helper_script or not self._get("os_path_exists")(helper_script):
            raise RuntimeError("Helper script not found in config.")

        dep_ok, dep_details = self._get("ensure_helper_dependency")(helper_python, "pyodbc")
        if not dep_ok:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Required dependency 'pyodbc' is missing and auto-install failed.\n\n{0}".format(dep_details)
            )

    def execute_mapping_discovery(self, config, config_path, project_identity, project_config, previous_state):
        sync_options = (project_config or {}).get("sync_options", {})
        exclude_names = sync_options.get("exclude_sheet_names", ["_RTVDM"])

        runtime_root = self._get("get_runtime_root")()
        db_config = (project_config or {}).get("database", {})
        self._get("ensure_sql_credentials_for_session")(db_config)

        helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script = self.resolve_helper_environment(config, config_path)
        self.validate_helper_environment(helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script)

        discovery_sheets = self._get("collect_all_sheets")(self._doc(), exclude_names)
        build_sheet_record = self._get("build_sheet_record")
        discovery_records = [build_sheet_record(s, previous_state, project_config) for s in discovery_sheets]

        discovered_mapping, discovery_error = self._get("discover_sheet_number_mapping")(
            helper_python,
            db_config,
            (project_config or {}).get("table_map", {}),
            discovery_records
        )
        if discovery_error:
            raise RuntimeError("Mapping discovery failed.\n\n{0}".format(discovery_error))

        updated = self._get("write_discovered_mapping_to_config")(config_path, project_identity, discovered_mapping)
        if not updated:
            raise RuntimeError("Could not find project entry in config to update mapping.")

        reloaded_config = self._get("read_json")(config_path, default_value={}) or {}
        project_config = self._get("resolve_project_config")(
            reloaded_config,
            self._doc().Title,
            self._get("get_document_key")(self._doc()),
            project_identity
        )

        return project_config, {
            "runtime_root": runtime_root,
            "mapping": discovered_mapping
        }

    def execute_sync_run(self, config, config_path, project_identity, project_config, action_mode, sync_mode, conflict_policy, dry_run, selected_unique_ids=None):
        document = self._doc()
        document_title = document.Title
        document_key = self._get("get_document_key")(document)

        sync_options = (project_config or {}).get("sync_options", {})
        write_model_mirror_parameters = bool(sync_options.get("write_model_mirror_parameters", True))
        exclude_names = sync_options.get("exclude_sheet_names", ["_RTVDM"])

        state_path = self._get("get_state_path")(project_identity)
        previous_state = self._get("read_json")(state_path, default_value={}) or {}

        all_sheets = self._get("collect_all_sheets")(document, exclude_names)
        if selected_unique_ids:
            selected_set = set(selected_unique_ids)
            candidate_sheets = [s for s in all_sheets if s.UniqueId in selected_set]
            if not candidate_sheets:
                raise RuntimeError("No selected sheets are available in the current model.")
        elif sync_mode == "selected":
            raise RuntimeError("Scope is 'selected' but no dashboard selection is active. Use Selected first.")
        else:
            candidate_sheets = all_sheets

        build_sheet_record = self._get("build_sheet_record")
        all_records_for_state = [build_sheet_record(s, previous_state, project_config) for s in all_sheets]
        current_state_all = self._get("build_current_state")(all_records_for_state)

        sheet_records = []
        for sheet in candidate_sheets:
            record = build_sheet_record(sheet, previous_state, project_config)
            if sync_mode == "changed":
                prior = previous_state.get(record.get("unique_id"), {})
                if prior.get("hash") != record.get("hash"):
                    sheet_records.append(record)
            else:
                sheet_records.append(record)

        if not sheet_records:
            raise RuntimeError("No sheets need syncing.")

        runtime_root = self._get("get_runtime_root")()
        payload_name = self._get("sanitize_filename")(project_identity) + "_payload.json"
        result_name = self._get("sanitize_filename")(project_identity) + "_result.json"
        payload_path = self._get("os_path_join")(runtime_root, "payloads", payload_name)
        result_path = self._get("os_path_join")(runtime_root, "results", result_name)

        db_config = (project_config or {}).get("database", {})
        self._get("ensure_sql_credentials_for_session")(db_config)

        helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script = self.resolve_helper_environment(config, config_path)
        self.validate_helper_environment(helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script)

        if action_mode == "push" and not self._get("has_sheet_number_mapping")((project_config or {}).get("table_map", {})):
            raise RuntimeError("No sheet-number mapping is configured. Run Discover Mapping first.")

        payload = {
            "project": {
                "document_title": document_title,
                "document_key": document_key,
                "project_identity": project_identity
            },
            "sync": {
                "mode": sync_mode,
                "action": action_mode,
                "conflict_policy": conflict_policy,
                "dry_run": dry_run,
                "write_model_mirror_parameters": write_model_mirror_parameters
            },
            "target": db_config,
            "table_map": (project_config or {}).get("table_map", {}),
            "result_path": result_path,
            "sheets": sheet_records
        }

        self._get("write_json")(payload_path, payload)
        exit_code, stdout, stderr = self._get("run_helper")(helper_python, helper_script, payload_path)
        if exit_code != 0:
            details = self._get("parse_helper_error")(stdout, stderr)
            raise RuntimeError("RTV helper failed.\n\nExit code: {0}\n\nDetails:\n{1}".format(exit_code, details))

        result = self._get("read_json")(result_path, default_value=None)
        if not result:
            raise RuntimeError("Helper completed but no result file was returned.\n\nSTDOUT:\n{0}".format(stdout))
        if result.get("status") != "ok":
            raise RuntimeError("RTV sync failed.\n\n{0}".format(result.get("message", "Unknown error")))

        if not dry_run and action_mode == "push":
            if write_model_mirror_parameters:
                self._get("update_revit_mirror_parameters")(sheet_records, result.get("rows", []), project_config)
            self._get("write_json")(state_path, current_state_all)

        pull_outcomes = []
        if not dry_run and action_mode == "pull":
            pull_outcomes = self._get("apply_pull_updates")(sheet_records, result.get("rows", []), conflict_policy)
            refreshed_sheets = self._get("collect_all_sheets")(document, exclude_names)
            refreshed_records = [build_sheet_record(s, previous_state, project_config) for s in refreshed_sheets]
            self._get("write_json")(state_path, self._get("build_current_state")(refreshed_records))

        report_rows = self._get("build_report_rows")(
            sheet_records,
            result.get("rows", []),
            previous_state,
            (project_config or {}).get("table_map", {}),
            action_mode,
            dry_run,
            pull_outcomes=pull_outcomes
        )
        report_csv_path = self._get("write_report_csv")(runtime_root, project_identity, report_rows)
        reason_counts = self._get("build_reason_counts")(report_rows, pull_outcomes, result.get("warnings", []))

        summary = [
            "RTV DB Sync: {0}".format("DRY-RUN" if dry_run else "LIVE"),
            "",
            "Project: {0}".format(project_identity),
            "Action: {0}".format(action_mode),
            "Scope: {0}".format(sync_mode),
            "Conflict Policy: {0}".format(conflict_policy),
            "Auth Used: {0}".format(result.get("auth_mode_used") or "unknown"),
            "Database Used: {0}".format(result.get("database_used") or db_config.get("database") or "unknown"),
            "Sheets sent: {0}".format(len(sheet_records)),
            "Updated rows: {0}".format(result.get("updated_count", 0)),
            "Verified rows: {0}".format(result.get("verified_count", 0)),
            "Post-push mismatches: {0}".format(result.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0)),
            "Skipped rows: {0}".format(result.get("skipped_count", 0)),
            "Missing rows: {0}".format(result.get("missing_count", 0)),
            "Report CSV: {0}".format(report_csv_path)
        ]
        summary.extend([""] + self._get("format_reason_counts")(reason_counts, top_n=8))

        report = {
            "status": result.get("status"),
            "project_identity": project_identity,
            "action": action_mode,
            "scope": sync_mode,
            "dry_run": dry_run,
            "sheet_count": len(sheet_records),
            "updated_count": result.get("updated_count", 0),
            "verified_count": result.get("verified_count", 0),
            "verify_mismatch_count": result.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0),
            "skipped_count": result.get("skipped_count", 0),
            "missing_count": result.get("missing_count", 0),
            "warnings": result.get("warnings", []),
            "reason_counts": reason_counts,
            "summary_lines": summary,
            "rows": report_rows,
            "pull_outcomes": pull_outcomes,
            "report_csv_path": report_csv_path
        }

        report_path = self._get("write_report")(runtime_root, project_identity, report)
        report["report_path"] = report_path
        report["report_stamp"] = self._get("format_report_stamp")(report_path)
        return report
```

```python
def open_sample_file(file_name):
    """Function to open Sample file located at:
    ...\pyRevitStarterKit.extension\lib\Samples\{{file_name}}"""
    import os

    # Find Base Path to .extension
    current_path = os.path.abspath(__file__)
    base_path = current_path
    while not base_path.endswith('.extension'):
        base_path = os.path.dirname(base_path)

    # Open Sample File
    target_path = os.path.join(base_path, 'lib', 'Samples', file_name)
    os.startfile(target_path)
    os.startfile(os.path.dirname(target_path))
```

```python
# ╚═╝╩╚═╚═╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╚═╝  ╩╚═╚═╝╚═╝╩ ╩
#====================================================================================================
# ARGUMENTS
pt = UV(10,0)

# CREATE ROOM
room = doc.Create.NewRoom(active_level, pt)

# CREATE ROOM TAG
room_link = LinkElementId(room.Id)
doc.Create.NewRoomTag(room_link, pt, active_view.Id )

# ╔═╗╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗  ╔╦╗╔═╗═╗ ╦╔╦╗
# ║  ╠╦╝║╣ ╠═╣ ║ ║╣    ║ ║╣ ╔╩╦╝ ║
# ╚═╝╩╚═╚═╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╚═╝   ╩ ╚═╝╩ ╚═ ╩
#====================================================================================================
# ARGUMENTS
text_type_id = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(TextNoteType).FirstElementId()
pt           = XYZ(0,0,0)
text         = 'Hello BIM World!'

# CREATE TEXT NOTE
TextNote.Create(doc, active_view.Id, pt, text, text_type_id)

# ╔═╗╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗  ╔╗ ╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗
# ║  ╠╦╝║╣ ╠═╣ ║ ║╣   ╠╩╗║╣ ╠═╣║║║
# ╚═╝╩╚═╚═╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╚═╝  ╚═╝╚═╝╩ ╩╩ ╩
#====================================================================================================
# Create Line
pt_start = XYZ(0,0,0)
pt_end   = XYZ(20,0,0)
line = Line.CreateBound(pt_start, pt_end)

# Get Default Beam Type
beam_type_id   = doc.GetDefaultFamilyTypeId(ElementId(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming))
beam_type      = doc.GetElement(beam_type_id)


# Create Beam
t = Transaction(doc,'Create Beam')
t.Start()

beam = doc.Create.NewFamilyInstance(line, beam_type, active_level, StructuralType.Beam)


t.Commit()

print('Created Beam: {}'.format(beam.Id))

# ╔═╗╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗  ╔═╗╦╦  ╦  ╔═╗╔╦╗  ╦═╗╔═╗╔═╗╦╔═╗╔╗╔
# ║  ╠╦╝║╣ ╠═╣ ║ ║╣   ╠╣ ║║  ║  ║╣  ║║  ╠╦╝║╣ ║ ╦║║ ║║║║
# ╚═╝╩╚═╚═╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╚═╝  ╚  ╩╩═╝╩═╝╚═╝═╩╝  ╩╚═╚═╝╚═╝╩╚═╝╝╚╝
#====================================================================================================
# ARGUMENTS
region_type_id = doc.GetDefaultElementTypeId(ElementTypeGroup.FilledRegionType)

# POINTS
pt_0 = XYZ(50, 0, 0)
pt_1 = XYZ(55, 0, 0)
pt_2 = XYZ(55, 5, 0)
pt_3 = XYZ(50, 5, 0)

# LINES
l_0 = Line.CreateBound(pt_0, pt_1)
l_1 = Line.CreateBound(pt_1, pt_2)
l_2 = Line.CreateBound(pt_2, pt_3)
l_3 = Line.CreateBound(pt_3, pt_0)

# BOUNDARY
boundary = CurveLoop()
boundary.Append(l_0)
boundary.Append(l_1)
boundary.Append(l_2)
boundary.Append(l_3)

# LIST OF BOUNDARIES
list_boundaries = List[CurveLoop]()
list_boundaries.Add(boundary)

# CREATE FILLED REGION
region = FilledRegion.Create(doc, region_type_id, active_view.Id, list_boundaries)

# ╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╦ ╦  ╦ ╦╦╔╦╗╦ ╦  ╦  ╦╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗╦═╗
# ║  ║ ║╠═╝╚╦╝  ║║║║ ║ ╠═╣  ╚╗╔╝║╣ ║   ║ ║ ║╠╦╝
# ╚═╝╚═╝╩   ╩   ╚╩╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╩   ╚╝ ╚═╝╚═╝ ╩ ╚═╝╩╚═ COPY WITH VECTOR
#====================================================================================================
# 👉 Get Walls
wallsToCopy = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
    .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls)\
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
    .ToElementIds()

#📐 Vector
vector = XYZ(50, 50, 0)

#🔓 Start Transaction
t = Transaction(doc, __title__)
t.Start()

#✅ Copy Elements
ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(doc, wallsToCopy, vector)

#🔒 End Transaction
t.Commit()


# ╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╦ ╦  ╔╗ ╔═╗╔╦╗╦ ╦╔═╗╔═╗╔╗╔  ╦  ╦╦╔═╗╦ ╦╔═╗
# ║  ║ ║╠═╝╚╦╝  ╠╩╗║╣  ║ ║║║║╣ ║╣ ║║║  ╚╗╔╝║║╣ ║║║╚═╗
# ╚═╝╚═╝╩   ╩   ╚═╝╚═╝ ╩ ╚╩╝╚═╝╚═╝╝╚╝   ╚╝ ╩╚═╝╚╩╝╚═╝ COPY BETWEEN VIEWS
#=======================================================================================

#👉 Get TextNotes
textToCopy = FilteredElementCollector(doc, doc.ActiveView.Id)\
    .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes)\
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
    .ToElementIds()

#👁️ ️Get Views
src_view = doc.ActiveView
dest_view = select_views(__title__,multiple=False)

#⚙ Transform & Options
transform = Transform.Identity
opts      = CopyPasteOptions()

#🔓 Start Transaction
t = Transaction(doc, __title__)
t.Start()

#✅ Copy Elements
ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(src_view, textToCopy, dest_view, transform, opts)

#🔒 End Transaction
t.Commit()


# ╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╦ ╦  ╔╗ ╔═╗╔╦╗╦ ╦╔═╗╔═╗╔╗╔  ╔═╗╦═╗╔═╗ ╦╔═╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║  ║ ║╠═╝╚╦╝  ╠╩╗║╣  ║ ║║║║╣ ║╣ ║║║  ╠═╝╠╦╝║ ║ ║║╣ ║   ║ ╚═╗
# ╚═╝╚═╝╩   ╩   ╚═╝╚═╝ ╩ ╚╩╝╚═╝╚═╝╝╚╝  ╩  ╩╚═╚═╝╚╝╚═╝╚═╝ ╩ ╚═╝ COPY BETWEEN PROJECTS
#=======================================================================================
# 👉 Get Walls
wallsToCopy = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
    .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls)\
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
    .ToElementIds()


#🏠 Get all Docs
all_docs = list(app.Documents)
doc_A = all_docs[0]
doc_B = all_docs[1]


#⚙ Transform & Options
transform = Transform.Identity
opts      = CopyPasteOptions()

#🔓 Start Transaction
t = Transaction(doc_B, __title__)
t.Start()

#✅ Copy Elements
ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(doc_A, wallsToCopy, doc_B, transform, opts)

#🔒 End Transaction
t.Commit()
```

```python
# WELCOME TO SAMPLES FILE:


# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
```
