                                    </StackPanel>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </Border>
                            <ListBox x:Name="lstRight"/>
                        </DockPanel>
                    </Grid>
                </DockPanel>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ═══ RESULTS TAB ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
            <TabItem Header="  Results  " x:Name="tabResults" IsEnabled="False">
                <DockPanel Margin="10,8,10,6">
                    <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1A1A2E" BorderBrush="#2D2D4E"
                            BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="3" Padding="12,10" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="pnlSummary"/>
                    </Border>
                    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="pnlResults"/>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                </DockPanel>
            </TabItem>

        </TabControl>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>
"""


class ParamCopierWindow(forms.WPFWindow):

    def __init__(self):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, WINDOW_XAML, literal_string=True)

        self._elements = []
        self._all_items = []
        self._src_info = None
        self._tgt_info = None
        self.copy_result = None

        # Populate scope dropdown with grouped ComboBoxItem objects.
        # Header items (IsEnabled=False) act as section labels.
        from System.Windows.Controls import ComboBoxItem as _CBI
        _SCOPE_ITEMS = [
            (u"All 2D Elements",           u"all_2d_model",   False),
            (u"All 3D Elements",           u"all_3d_model",   False),
            (u"All 2D and 3D Elements",    u"all_model",      False),
            (u"\u2500\u2500  2D Element Selection  \u2500\u2500", u"", True),
            (u"    All in Active View",    u"2d_active_view",  False),
            (u"\u2500\u2500  3D Element Selection  \u2500\u2500", u"", True),
            (u"    All in Active View",    u"3d_active_view",  False),
            (u"    By Selection",          u"3d_selection",   False),
        ]
        for display, key, is_hdr in _SCOPE_ITEMS:
            ci = _CBI()
            ci.Content = display
            ci.Tag = key
            ci.IsEnabled = not is_hdr
            self.cmbScope.Items.Add(ci)
        # Default to "All 2D and 3D Elements" (index 2)
        self.cmbScope.SelectedIndex = 2

        # Wire events
        self.txtLeftFilter.TextChanged  += self._on_left_filter
        self.txtRightFilter.TextChanged += self._on_right_filter
        self.lstLeft.SelectionChanged   += self._on_left_select
        self.lstRight.SelectionChanged  += self._on_right_select
        self.btnLoad.Click              += self._on_load
        self.btnCopy.Click              += self._on_copy
        self.btnCancel.Click            += self._on_cancel
        self.txtPrefix.TextChanged      += self._on_format_changed
        self.txtSuffix.TextChanged      += self._on_format_changed
        self.chkIncludeUnit.Click       += self._on_format_changed
        # Initial data is injected by the entry point after ProgressBar scan;
        # user can click \u21ba Load at any time to rescan the selected scope.

    def _on_load(self, sender, e):
        self._load_scope()

    def _load_scope(self):
        """Collect elements for the selected scope and refresh both parameter lists."""
        try:
            selected = self.cmbScope.SelectedItem
            if not selected or not getattr(selected, 'IsEnabled', True):
                self._set_status(u"Select a scope and click \u21ba Load.")
                return
            key   = str(selected.Tag or u"")
            label = str(selected.Content or u"").strip()

            self._set_status(u"Loading: {0}...".format(label))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Scanning..."

            if key == u"all_2d_model":
                elems = _all_2d_in_model()
            elif key == u"all_3d_model":
                elems = _all_3d_in_model()
            elif key == u"all_model":
                elems = _all_in_model()
            elif key == u"2d_active_view":
                elems = _all_2d_in_active_view()
            elif key == u"3d_active_view":
                elems = _all_3d_in_active_view()
            elif key == u"3d_selection":
                elems = _current_selection()
                if not elems:
                    self._set_status(
                        u"No elements selected in Revit. "
                        u"Select elements first, then click \u21ba Load.")
                    self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                    return
            else:
                elems = []

            if not elems:
                self._set_status(u"No elements found for: {0}".format(label))
                self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                return

            self._elements = elems
            if len(elems) > 5000:
                self._set_status(u"Scanning {0:,} elements...".format(len(elems)))

            items = collect_param_items(elems)
            self._all_items = items
            self._set_list(self.lstLeft,  items)
            self._set_list(self.lstRight, items)

            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  [{2}]".format(
                len(elems), len(items), label)

            self.lstLeft.SelectedItem  = None
            self.lstRight.SelectedItem = None
            self._src_info = None
            self._tgt_info = None
            self._clear_meta(u"left")
            self._clear_meta(u"right")
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  \u2014  {2}".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), label))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Load failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Error"

    def _set_list(self, listbox, items, scope=None):
        """Populate a ListBox using display strings from ParamListItem list."""
        try:
            elems = _all_in_active_view()
            if not elems:
                self._set_status(u"No elements found in the active view.")
                self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                return

            elif scope == u"Whole Model":
                elems = _all_in_model()
                if not elems:
                    self._set_status(u"No elements found in the model.")
                    self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                    return
                if len(elems) > 5000:
                    self._set_status(
                        u"Large scope: {0} elements — parameter scan may take "
                        u"several seconds.".format(len(elems)))
            else:
                elems = []

            self._elements = elems
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  [{2}]".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), scope)

            items = collect_param_items(elems)
            self._all_items = items
            self._set_list(self.lstLeft,  items)
            self._set_list(self.lstRight, items)

            # Reset both sides
            self.lstLeft.SelectedItem  = None
            self.lstRight.SelectedItem = None
            self._src_info = None
            self._tgt_info = None
            self._clear_meta(u"left")
            self._clear_meta(u"right")
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"\u2713  {0:,} elements loaded \u00b7  {1:,} unique parameters  \u2014  scope: {2}".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), scope))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Load failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Error"

    # ── List helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _set_list(self, listbox, items):
        """Populate a ListBox using display strings from ParamListItem list."""
        col = List[String]()
        for item in items:
            col.Add(str(item))  # Python str() calls __str__ — avoids IronPython type-name bug
        listbox.ItemsSource = col

    def _filter_and_refresh(self, listbox, query):
        if query:
            q = query.lower()
            filtered = [item for item in self._all_items if q in item.Name.lower()]
        else:
            filtered = self._all_items
        self._set_list(listbox, filtered)

    # ── Event handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_left_filter(self, sender, e):
        self._filter_and_refresh(self.lstLeft, self.txtLeftFilter.Text)

    def _on_right_filter(self, sender, e):
        self._filter_and_refresh(self.lstRight, self.txtRightFilter.Text)

    def _on_format_changed(self, sender, e):
        """Re-render preview when prefix/suffix/unit options change."""
        self._refresh_preview()

    def _on_left_select(self, sender, e):
        try:
            selected = self.lstLeft.SelectedItem
            if not selected:
                self._src_info = None
                self._clear_meta("left")
                self._refresh_preview()
                return
            info = get_param_info(self._elements, _name_from_display(self.lstLeft.SelectedItem))
            self._src_info = info
            self._paint_meta("left", info)
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"Source: {name}  |  {available_count} elements have this param, "
                u"{set_count} have a value.".format(**info)
            )
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Error loading source parameter: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _on_right_select(self, sender, e):
        try:
            selected = self.lstRight.SelectedItem
            if not selected:
                self._tgt_info = None
                self._clear_meta("right")
                self._refresh_preview()
                return
            info = get_param_info(self._elements, _name_from_display(self.lstRight.SelectedItem))
            self._tgt_info = info
            self._paint_meta("right", info)
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"Target: {name}  |  {available_count} elements have this param, "
                u"{set_count} have a value.".format(**info)
            )
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Error loading target parameter: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _on_copy(self, sender, e):
        try:
            if not self._src_info or not self._tgt_info:
                return
            src_name = self._src_info["name"]
            tgt_name = self._tgt_info["name"]
            # Show indeterminate bar for the duration of the copy
            self.pbarCopy.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = False
            self._set_status(u"Copying {0} elements...".format(len(self._elements)))
            copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat = execute_copy(
                self._elements, src_name, tgt_name,
                prefix=self.txtPrefix.Text or u"",
                suffix=self.txtSuffix.Text or u"",
                include_unit=bool(self.chkIncludeUnit.IsChecked))
            self.copy_result = (copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat)

            # Populate Results tab and switch to it
            self._build_results(src_name, tgt_name, copied, skipped,
                                errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat)
            self.tabResults.IsEnabled = True
            self.tabMain.SelectedItem = self.tabResults

            self._set_status(u"Done: {0} copied, {1} skipped, {2} error(s).".format(
                copied, skipped, len(errors)))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Copy operation failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
        finally:
            self.pbarCopy.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            # Re-enable Copy if both params are still chosen
            try:
                self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = bool(
                    self._src_info and self._tgt_info
                    and not self._tgt_info.get('is_read_only'))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, e):
        self.Close()

    def _build_results(self, src_name, tgt_name, copied, skipped,
                        errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat):
        """Populate the Results tab with structured copy outcome data."""

        def _brush(hex_str):
            h = hex_str.lstrip('#')
            r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
            return SolidColorBrush(WpfColor.FromArgb(255, r, g, b))

        def _tb(text, size=12, color="#D4D4D4", bold=False, margin=(0,0,0,0)):
            t = TextBlock()
            t.Text = text
            t.FontSize = size
            t.Foreground = _brush(color)
            if bold:
                t.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            t.Margin = Thickness(margin[0], margin[1], margin[2], margin[3])
            return t

        def _sep():
            b = WpfBorder()
            b.Height = 1
            b.Background = _brush("#2A2A2A")
            b.Margin = Thickness(0, 8, 0, 8)
            return b

        def _make_exp(label, count, color, expanded=False):
            exp = Expander()
            exp.IsExpanded = expanded
            exp.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0)
            hdr = StackPanel()
            hdr.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            lbl = TextBlock()
            lbl.Text = label
            lbl.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            lbl.Foreground = _brush(color)
            lbl.FontSize = 12
            cnt = TextBlock()
            cnt.Text = u"  \u2014  {0:,}".format(count)
            cnt.Foreground = _brush("#555")
            cnt.FontSize = 12
            hdr.Children.Add(lbl)
            hdr.Children.Add(cnt)
            exp.Header = hdr
            return exp

        def _cat_row(cat_name, count, color):
            row = StackPanel()
            row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            row.Margin = Thickness(16, 2, 0, 0)
            lbl = TextBlock()
            lbl.Text = cat_name
            lbl.Width = 300
            lbl.Foreground = _brush("#777")
            lbl.FontSize = 11
            cnt = TextBlock()
            cnt.Text = u"{0:,}".format(count)
            cnt.Foreground = _brush(color)
            cnt.FontSize = 11
            cnt.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            row.Children.Add(lbl)
            row.Children.Add(cnt)
            return row

        total       = len(self._elements)
        error_count = len(errors)

        # Summary banner
        self.pnlSummary.Children.Clear()
        self.pnlSummary.Children.Add(
            _tb(u"{0}  \u2192  {1}".format(src_name, tgt_name),
                14, "#E0E0E0", True, (0, 0, 0, 10)))
        for label, value, clr in [
            (u"Total Elements", u"{0:,}".format(total),        "#888"),
            (u"Copied",         u"{0:,}".format(copied),       "#4EC9B0"),
            (u"Skipped",        u"{0:,}".format(skipped),      "#CE9178"),
            (u"Errors",         u"{0:,}".format(error_count),  "#F44747" if errors else "#444"),
        ]:
            row = StackPanel()
            row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            row.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 2)
            lbl_tb = TextBlock()
            lbl_tb.Text = label
            lbl_tb.Width = 110
            lbl_tb.Foreground = _brush("#666")
            lbl_tb.FontSize = 12
            val_tb = TextBlock()
            val_tb.Text = value
            val_tb.Foreground = _brush(clr)
            val_tb.FontSize = 13
            val_tb.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            row.Children.Add(lbl_tb)
            row.Children.Add(val_tb)
            self.pnlSummary.Children.Add(row)

        # Detail breakdown
        self.pnlResults.Children.Clear()

        # COPIED
        if copy_by_cat:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u2713  Copied", 13, "#4EC9B0", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for cat in sorted(copy_by_cat.keys()):
                entry   = copy_by_cat[cat]
                count   = entry["count"]
                samples = entry["samples"]
                cat_exp = _make_exp(cat, count, "#4EC9B0")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(16, 4, 0, 6)
                for src_val, tgt_val in samples:
                    s_row = StackPanel()
                    s_row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
                    s_row.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0)
                    s_src = TextBlock()
                    s_src.Text = src_val
                    s_src.Foreground = _brush("#AAAAAA")
                    s_src.FontSize = 11
                    s_src.MaxWidth = 240
                    s_arr = TextBlock()
                    s_arr.Text = u"  \u2192  "
                    s_arr.Foreground = _brush("#4EC9B0")
                    s_arr.FontSize = 11
                    s_tgt = TextBlock()
                    s_tgt.Text = tgt_val
                    s_tgt.Foreground = _brush("#D4D4D4")
                    s_tgt.FontSize = 11
                    s_tgt.MaxWidth = 240
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_src)
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_arr)
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_tgt)
                    content.Children.Add(s_row)
                if count > len(samples):
                    content.Children.Add(
                        _tb(u"  + {0:,} more...".format(count - len(samples)),
                            10, "#444", margin=(0, 3, 0, 0)))
                cat_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(cat_exp)
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(_sep())

        # SKIPPED
        if skip_log:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u26a0  Skipped", 13, "#CE9178", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for reason in sorted(skip_log.keys()):
                cats    = skip_log[reason]
                total_r = sum(cats.values())
                r_exp = _make_exp(reason, total_r, "#CE9178")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(0, 4, 0, 6)
                for cat in sorted(cats.keys()):
                    content.Children.Add(_cat_row(cat, cats[cat], "#CE9178"))
                r_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(r_exp)
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(_sep())

        # ERRORS
        if error_log or errors:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u2717  Errors", 13, "#F44747", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for reason_type in sorted(error_log.keys()):
                cats    = error_log[reason_type]
                total_r = sum(cats.values())
                r_exp = _make_exp(reason_type, total_r, "#F44747")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(0, 4, 0, 6)
                for cat in sorted(cats.keys()):
                    content.Children.Add(_cat_row(cat, cats[cat], "#F44747"))
                r_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(r_exp)
            for err in errors[:20]:
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                    _tb(u"  \u2022  {0}".format(err), 10, "#CE9178", margin=(0, 2, 0, 0)))
    def _paint_meta(self, side, info):
        def ctrl(suffix):
            return getattr(self, "txt{0}{1}".format(
                "Left" if side == "left" else "Right", suffix))

        ctrl("DataType").Text = info.get("data_type_label") or u"—"
        ctrl("StorageType").Text = info.get("storage_type_str") or u"—"
        ctrl("Unit").Text = info.get("unit_label") or u"—"
        ctrl("ReadOnly").Text = u"Yes" if info.get("is_read_only") else u"No"
        samples = info.get("sample_values", [])
        ctrl("Samples").Text = u"\n".join(samples) if samples else u"(no values set)"

    def _clear_meta(self, side):
        for suffix in ("DataType", "StorageType", "Unit", "ReadOnly", "Samples"):
            try:
                getattr(self, "txt{0}{1}".format(
                    "Left" if side == "left" else "Right", suffix)).Text = u"—"
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _refresh_preview(self):
        try:
            can_copy = bool(self._src_info and self._tgt_info)
            self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = can_copy

            if not can_copy:
                self.txtPreview.Text = u"(select both parameters to see preview)"
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
                return

            # Disable copy if target is read-only
            if self._tgt_info.get("is_read_only"):
                self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = False
                self._set_status(
                    u"\u26a0 Target '{0}' is read-only. Copy is disabled.".format(
                        self._tgt_info["name"]))

            preview, warning = build_preview(
                self._src_info, self._tgt_info,
                prefix=self.txtPrefix.Text or u"",
                suffix=self.txtSuffix.Text or u"",
                include_unit=bool(self.chkIncludeUnit.IsChecked))
            self.txtPreview.Text = preview or u"(no preview available)"
            if warning:
                self.txtWarning.Text = warning
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            else:
                self.txtWarning.Text = u""
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Preview error: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _set_status(self, msg):
        try:
            self.txtStatus.Text = str(msg)
        except Exception:
            pass


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Entry point
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

try:
    win = ParamCopierWindow()
    win.ShowDialog()
except Exception as _launch_ex:
    forms.alert(
        u"Failed to open Parameter Copier window:\n\n{0}".format(str(_launch_ex)),
        exitscript=True
    )
# Results are displayed in the window's Results tab.
```

<Window
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    Title="Transaction Logger"
    Width="360" Height="430"
    ResizeMode="CanMinimize"
    WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
    Topmost="True"
    ShowInTaskbar="False">
    <Grid Margin="14,12,14,12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Capture mode -->
        <GroupBox Grid.Row="0" Header="Capture Mode" Padding="8,4,8,8" Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <StackPanel>
                <RadioButton x:Name="rbFull" Content="Full model + annotations" IsChecked="True" Margin="0,4,0,2"/>
                <RadioButton x:Name="rbTargeted" Content="Targeted categories" Margin="0,2"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </GroupBox>

        <!-- Category list — enabled only in Targeted mode -->
        <GroupBox x:Name="gbCategories" Grid.Row="1" Header="Categories" IsEnabled="False"
                  Padding="8,4,8,8" Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <ListBox x:Name="lstCategories" SelectionMode="Multiple" Height="110"
                     ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"/>
        </GroupBox>

        <!-- Snapshot mode -->
        <GroupBox Grid.Row="2" Header="Snapshot Mode" Padding="8,4,8,8" Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <StackPanel>
                <RadioButton x:Name="rbSnapNone" Content="Off  —  fast, no before/after diff" IsChecked="True" Margin="0,4,0,2"/>
                <RadioButton x:Name="rbSnapLazy" Content="Lazy  —  capture element state (enables diff)" Margin="0,2"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </GroupBox>

        <!-- Buttons -->
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="4" Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,4,0,0">
            <Button x:Name="btnCancel" Content="Cancel" Width="80" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
            <Button x:Name="btnStart" Content="Start Logging" Width="120"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = 'Transaction Logger'
__doc__ = 'Log all transactions in the current Revit session to a CSV file.'

import os

from pyrevit import forms, script, HOST_APP

ENV_ACTIVE = 'TXN_LOGGER_ACTIVE'
ENV_MODE = 'TXN_LOGGER_MODE'
ENV_CATEGORIES = 'TXN_LOGGER_CATEGORIES'
ENV_OUTPUT = 'TXN_LOGGER_OUTPUT'
ENV_READY = 'TXN_LOGGER_READY'
ENV_SNAPSHOT = 'TXN_LOGGER_SNAPSHOT'


def default_output_dir():
    return os.path.join(
        os.environ.get('APPDATA', ''),
        'pyRevit',
        'TransactionLogs'
    )


def get_category_names(doc):
    names = []
    if not doc:
        return names
    try:
        for category in doc.Settings.Categories:
            try:
                if not category or not category.Name:
                    continue
                cat_type = category.CategoryType.ToString()
                if cat_type not in ('Model', 'Annotation'):
                    continue
                names.append(category.Name)
            except:
                pass
    except:
        pass
    return sorted(list(set(names)))


class LauncherWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
    def __init__(self, xaml_path, doc):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)
        self._result = None

        self.rbTargeted.Checked += self._on_mode_change
        self.rbFull.Checked += self._on_mode_change
        self.btnStart.Click += self._on_start
        self.btnCancel.Click += self._on_cancel

        for name in get_category_names(doc):
            self.lstCategories.Items.Add(name)

    def _on_mode_change(self, sender, args):
        self.gbCategories.IsEnabled = (self.rbTargeted.IsChecked == True)

    def _on_start(self, sender, args):
        mode = 'targeted' if self.rbTargeted.IsChecked == True else 'full'
        snapshot_mode = 'lazy' if self.rbSnapLazy.IsChecked == True else 'none'

        categories = []
        if mode == 'targeted':
            categories = [str(item) for item in self.lstCategories.SelectedItems]
            if not categories:
                forms.alert('Select at least one category.', title='Transaction Logger')
                return

        self._result = {
            'mode': mode,
            'categories': categories,
            'snapshot_mode': snapshot_mode
        }
        self.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.Close()


# --- Entry point ---

ready = bool(script.get_envvar(ENV_READY))
if not ready:
    forms.alert(
        'Logger startup is not active.\nReload pyRevit or restart Revit.',
        title='Transaction Logger',
        exitscript=True
    )

active = bool(script.get_envvar(ENV_ACTIVE))
if active:
    stop = forms.alert(
        'Transaction Logger is currently running.\n\nStop logging and save the current log?',
        title='Transaction Logger — Running',
        yes=True, no=True
    )
    if stop:
        script.set_envvar(ENV_ACTIVE, False)
    script.exit()

doc = HOST_APP.doc
if not doc:
    forms.alert('Open a document first.', title='Transaction Logger', exitscript=True)

launcher_xaml = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'launcher.xaml')
window = LauncherWindow(launcher_xaml, doc)
window.ShowDialog()

if not window._result:
    script.exit()

config = window._result
script.set_envvar(ENV_MODE, config['mode'])
script.set_envvar(ENV_CATEGORIES, ';'.join(config['categories']))
script.set_envvar(ENV_OUTPUT, default_output_dir())
script.set_envvar(ENV_SNAPSHOT, config['snapshot_mode'])
script.set_envvar(ENV_ACTIVE, True)
```

# Transaction Logger

## Purpose
Configure and toggle transaction logging for the active Revit session, either across the full model or targeted categories.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local environment-variable orchestration in `script.py`
- Startup logger support referenced through pyRevit environment state

## Critical Constraints
- Preserve the environment variable contract used by the logger startup flow.
- Keep readiness checks explicit so the tool fails clearly when startup support is not active.
- Distinguish full-model logging from targeted-category logging without mutating the underlying capture pipeline unexpectedly.

```

<Window
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    Title="Tool Dashboard"
    Height="700"
    Width="1260"
    WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
    ResizeMode="CanResize"
    MinHeight="540"
    MinWidth="920"
    Background="#FFF3F4F6">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Card ListBoxItem: selection/hover highlight applied directly to card border -->
        <Style x:Key="CardItemStyle" TargetType="ListBoxItem">
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="4"/>
            <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                        <Border x:Name="CardBorder"
                                Width="202"
                                Height="86"
                                CornerRadius="8"
                                Background="White"
                                BorderBrush="#FFE1E4E8"
                                BorderThickness="1"
                                Padding="10,8"
                                Cursor="Hand">
                            <ContentPresenter/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="CardBorder" Property="Background" Value="#FFF0F2F5"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CardBorder" Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FFBBC3CD"/>
                            </Trigger>
                            <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="CardBorder" Property="Background" Value="#FFF0F7FF"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CardBorder" Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FF2D89EF"/>
                                <Setter TargetName="CardBorder" Property="BorderThickness" Value="2"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- Tool card inner content template -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="ToolCardTemplate">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="40"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <Border Width="32"
                        Height="32"
                        CornerRadius="7"
                        Background="{Binding accent}"
                        VerticalAlignment="Top"
                        Margin="0,2,0,0">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding icon}"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               Foreground="White"
                               FontSize="14"
                               FontWeight="Bold"/>
                </Border>

                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1">
                    <DockPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding favorite_glyph}"
                                   DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                   Foreground="#FFE3A21A"
                                   FontSize="11"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Margin="3,0,0,0"/>
                        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                Background="{Binding source_badge_accent}"
                                CornerRadius="4"
                                Padding="4,1"
                                Margin="5,0,0,0"
                                VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding source_badge}"
                                       Foreground="White"
                                       FontSize="9"
                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                        </Border>
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding title}"
                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                   FontSize="12"
                                   Foreground="#FF1A1A1A"
                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                    </DockPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding group}"
                               FontSize="10"
                               Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                               Margin="0,2,0,0"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding short_description}"
                               FontSize="11"
                               Foreground="#FF4D5965"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               MaxHeight="28"
                               Margin="0,3,0,0"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </DataTemplate>

        <!-- Favourites quick-launch button template -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="FavButtonTemplate">
            <Button Click="fav_quick_launch"
                    Height="34"
                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                    Padding="10,0"
                    Background="White"
                    BorderBrush="#FFD0D7DE"
                    Cursor="Hand">
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                    <Border Width="20"
                            Height="20"
                            CornerRadius="5"
                            Background="{Binding accent}"
                            Margin="0,0,7,0"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <TextBlock Text="{Binding icon}"
                                   HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Foreground="White"
                                   FontSize="10"
                                   FontWeight="Bold"/>
                    </Border>
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding title}"
                               FontSize="12"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               MaxWidth="130"
                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Button>
        </DataTemplate>

    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Margin="12">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Row 0: Search and filter bar -->
        <Border Grid.Row="0"
                Background="White"
                BorderBrush="#FFD8DDE3"
                BorderThickness="1"
                CornerRadius="8"
                Padding="10,7"
                Margin="0,0,0,8">
            <DockPanel>
                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" DockPanel.Dock="Right" Margin="12,0,0,0">
                    <Button x:Name="AllFilterButton"
                            Content="All"
                            Width="50"
                            Height="28"
                            Margin="0,0,4,0"
                            Click="show_all_click"/>
                    <Button x:Name="FavoritesFilterButton"
                            Content="Starred"
                            Width="62"
                            Height="28"
                            Margin="0,0,4,0"
                            Click="show_favorites_click"/>
                    <Button x:Name="RecentFilterButton"
                            Content="Recent"
                            Width="62"
                            Height="28"
                            Margin="0,0,14,0"
                            Click="show_recent_click"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="SummaryText"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                               FontSize="12"/>
                </StackPanel>
                <DockPanel>
                    <Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                            Content="✕"
                            Width="28"
                            Height="28"
                            Margin="6,0,0,0"
                            Click="clear_search_click"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="SearchBox"
                             Height="28"
                             VerticalContentAlignment="Center"
                             Padding="6,0"
                             FontSize="13"
                             Background="#FFF9FAFB"
                             BorderBrush="#FFD0D7DE"
                             TextChanged="search_changed"/>
                </DockPanel>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- Row 1: Favourites quick-launch bar (collapsed when no favourites) -->
        <Border x:Name="FavoritesSection"
                Grid.Row="1"
                Background="#FFFEFDF0"
                BorderBrush="#FFFDE8A0"
                BorderThickness="1"
                CornerRadius="8"
                Padding="10,5"
                Margin="0,0,0,8"
                Visibility="Collapsed">
            <DockPanel>
                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                           Text="★  Quick launch:"
                           Foreground="#FFBF9000"
                           FontSize="12"
                           FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                           Margin="0,0,12,0"/>
                <ScrollViewer HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                              VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Hidden"
                              Height="40">
                    <ItemsControl x:Name="FavoritesBar"
                                  ItemTemplate="{StaticResource FavButtonTemplate}"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                            <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                            </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                        </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                    </ItemsControl>
                </ScrollViewer>
            </DockPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- Row 2: Groups sidebar + card grid + details panel -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="2">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="220"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="280"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Groups sidebar -->
            <Border Grid.Column="0"
                    Background="White"
                    BorderBrush="#FFD8DDE3"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Padding="8"
                    Margin="0,0,8,0">
                <DockPanel>
                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top"
                               Text="Groups"
                               FontSize="13"
                               FontWeight="Bold"
                               Margin="4,0,4,8"/>
                    <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Margin="0,6,0,0">
                        <Button Content="New Group"
                                Height="26"
                                Margin="0,0,0,3"
                                FontSize="11"
                                Click="new_group_click"/>
                        <Button Content="Delete Group"
                                Height="26"
                                Margin="0,0,0,3"
                                FontSize="11"
                                Click="delete_group_click"/>
                        <Button Content="Add to Group"
                                Height="26"
                                Margin="0,0,0,3"
                                FontSize="11"
                                Click="add_tool_to_group_click"/>
                        <Button Content="Remove from Group"
                                Height="26"
                                FontSize="11"
                                Click="remove_tool_from_group_click"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                    <TreeView x:Name="GroupTree"
                             SelectedItemChanged="group_changed"
                             FontSize="12"
                             Background="#FFF9FAFB"
                             BorderBrush="#FFE1E4E8">
                        <TreeView.ItemContainerStyle>
                            <Style TargetType="TreeViewItem">
                                <Setter Property="IsExpanded" Value="True"/>
                                <Setter Property="Padding" Value="2,3"/>
                                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
                            </Style>
                        </TreeView.ItemContainerStyle>
                    </TreeView>
                </DockPanel>
            </Border>

            <!-- Card grid -->
            <Border Grid.Column="1"
                    Background="White"
                    BorderBrush="#FFD8DDE3"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Padding="6">
                <ListBox x:Name="CardGrid"
                         SelectionChanged="tool_changed"
                         MouseDoubleClick="tool_double_click"
                         ItemTemplate="{StaticResource ToolCardTemplate}"
                         ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource CardItemStyle}"
                         Background="Transparent"
                         BorderThickness="0"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                    <ListBox.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                            <WrapPanel Orientation="Horizontal"/>
                        </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                    </ListBox.ItemsPanel>
                </ListBox>
            </Border>

            <!-- Details panel -->
            <Border Grid.Column="2"
                    Background="White"
                    BorderBrush="#FFD8DDE3"
                    BorderThickness="1"
                    CornerRadius="8"
                    Padding="12"
                    Margin="8,0,0,0">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Icon + title + category -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <Border x:Name="DetailIconBadge"
                                Width="44"
                                Height="44"
                                CornerRadius="10"
                                Background="#FF66727D">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="DetailIconText"
                                       Text="&#183;"
                                       HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       FontSize="20"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Foreground="White"/>
                        </Border>
                        <StackPanel Margin="10,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TitleText"
                                       FontSize="14"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Text="Select a tool"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       MaxWidth="192"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="CategoryText"
                                       FontSize="11"
                                       Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                                       Margin="0,3,0,0"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       MaxWidth="192"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Tags + status -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TagsText"
                                   FontSize="11"
                                   Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText"
                                   FontSize="11"
                                   Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                                   Margin="0,3,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="SourceText"
                                   FontSize="10"
                                   Foreground="#FF6B7280"
                                   Margin="0,3,0,0"
                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Description + docstring (scrollable) -->
                    <ScrollViewer Grid.Row="2" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="DescriptionText"
                                       FontSize="12"
                                       Foreground="#FF4D5965"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="DocstringLabel"
                                       Text="Script Documentation"
                                       FontSize="11"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Foreground="#FF8C97A3"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,4"
                                       Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="DocstringText"
                                       FontSize="11"
                                       Foreground="#FF5E6A75"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                </Grid>
            </Border>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Row 3: Action buttons footer -->
        <Border Grid.Row="3"
                Background="White"
                BorderBrush="#FFD8DDE3"
                BorderThickness="1"
                CornerRadius="8"
                Padding="10,7"
                Margin="0,8,0,0">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                <Button x:Name="FavoriteButton"
                        Content="&#9734;"
                        Width="34"
                        Height="30"
                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                        FontSize="15"
                        ToolTip="Toggle favourite"
                        Click="toggle_favorite_click"/>
                <Button Content="Run Tool"
                        Width="90"
                        Height="30"
                        Margin="0,0,6,0"
                        Click="run_selected_click"/>
                <Button Content="Close"
                        Width="72"
                        Height="30"
                        Click="close_click"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

    </Grid>
</Window>
```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import os
import json
import time
import codecs
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
_CACHE_MAX_AGE = 8 * 3600   # 8 hours — covers a full working day


def _safe_text(value, default=''):
    if value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return unicode(value).strip()
    except NameError:
        return str(value).strip()
    except Exception:
        return default


def _safe_int(value, default=999):
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return default


def _safe_bool(value, default=True):
    if value is None:
        return default
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    text = _safe_text(value).lower()
    if text in ('1', 'true', 'yes', 'y', 'on'):
        return True
    if text in ('0', 'false', 'no', 'n', 'off'):
        return False
    return default


def _get_revit_version_key():
    """Return a stable per-Revit-version key for storage segregation."""
    try:
        from pyrevit import HOST_APP
        value = _safe_text(getattr(HOST_APP, 'version', None))
        if value:
            return value
        app = getattr(HOST_APP, 'app', None)
        value = _safe_text(getattr(app, 'VersionNumber', None))
        if value:
            return value
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 'unknown'


def _derive_extension_root(path):
    """Walk up to the owning *.extension folder, or return None."""
    current = path
    while current:
        if current.lower().endswith('.extension'):
            return current
        parent = os.path.dirname(current)
        if parent == current:
            break
        current = parent
    return None


def _get_cache_path(bundle_dir):
    appdata_dir = os.environ.get('APPDATA', '')
    revit_key = _get_revit_version_key()
    root = _derive_extension_root(bundle_dir)
    ext_name = 'dashboard'
    if root:
        ext_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(root))[0] or 'dashboard'
    safe_ext = ''.join(ch if ch.isalnum() else '_' for ch in ext_name).strip('_').lower() or 'dashboard'
    folder = os.path.join(appdata_dir, 'pyRevitToolDashboard', 'v{0}'.format(revit_key))
    return os.path.join(folder, 'catalog_cache_{0}.json'.format(safe_ext))


def _default_icon_for_group(group_name):
    value = _safe_text(group_name).lower()
    if value == 'data':
        return u'▦'
    if value == 'views':
        return u'◫'
    if value == 'elements':
        return u'⬢'
    if value == 'qa':
        return u'✔'
    if value == 'sheets':
        return u'▤'
    return u'•'


def _default_accent_for_group(group_name):
    value = _safe_text(group_name).lower()
    mapping = {
        'data':      '#FF2D89EF',
        'views':     '#FF00A300',
        'elements':  '#FFE3A21A',
        'qa':        '#FFA20025',
        'sheets':    '#FF9F00A7',
        'bluebeam':  '#FF0060DF',
        'explorer':  '#FF6B4C9A',
        'tracking':  '#FF5C7A99',
        'tools':     '#FF28A745',
        'wip':       '#FF6B7280',
    }
    return mapping.get(value, '#FF666666')


def _clean_name(raw):
    """'RBG_SYD_Tools_Working' -> 'RBG SYD Working'  (strips generic words)"""
    import re
    name = raw.replace('_', ' ').replace('-', ' ').strip()
    # Remove standalone generic words that add noise
    _noise = {'Tools', 'Tool', 'Panel', 'Tab', 'Extension', 'Ext', 'Dev'}
    parts = [p for p in name.split() if p not in _noise]
    return ' '.join(parts) if parts else name


def _clean_panel_name(raw):
    """'RBG Tools_Data' -> 'Data',  'WIP' -> 'WIP'"""
    if '_' in raw:
        return raw.rsplit('_', 1)[-1].strip()
    return raw.strip()


def _derive_tab_panel(data):
    """Derive tab and panel from script or source_path fields."""
    path = _safe_text(data.get('script')) or _safe_text(data.get('source_path'))
    if not path:
        group = _safe_text(data.get('group') or data.get('category'))
        return '', group or 'Other'
    parts = path.replace('\\', '/').split('/')
    tab = ''
    panel = ''
    for part in parts:
        if part.endswith('.tab') and not tab:
            tab = _clean_name(part[:-4])
        elif part.endswith('.panel') and not panel:
            panel = _clean_panel_name(part[:-6])
    return tab or '', panel or ''


class ToolItem(object):
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.tool_id = _safe_text(data.get('tool_id'))
        self.title = _safe_text(data.get('title'))
        self.description = _safe_text(data.get('description'))
        self.group = _safe_text(data.get('group') or data.get('category') or 'Ungrouped')
        self.tags = data.get('tags') or []
        self.icon = _safe_text(data.get('icon')) or _default_icon_for_group(self.group)
        self.accent = _safe_text(data.get('accent')) or _default_accent_for_group(self.group)
        self.handler = _safe_text(data.get('handler'))
        self.script = _safe_text(data.get('script'))
        self.status = _safe_text(data.get('status') or 'production').lower()
        self.order = _safe_int(
            data.get('order', data.get('default_order', 999)),
            default=999
        )
        self.enabled = self._resolve_enabled(data)
        self.source_path = _safe_text(data.get('source_path'))
        self.command_id = _safe_text(data.get('command_id'))
        self.vendor = _safe_text(data.get('vendor'))
        self.addin_name = _safe_text(data.get('addin_name'))
        self.manifest_path = _safe_text(data.get('manifest_path'))
        # Tab/panel for hierarchy grouping
        _tab, _panel = _derive_tab_panel(data)
        self.tab = _safe_text(data.get('tab')) or _tab
        self.panel = _safe_text(data.get('panel')) or _panel or self.group

    def _resolve_enabled(self, data):
        if 'enabled' in data:
            return _safe_bool(data.get('enabled'), True)
        if 'default_visible' in data:
            return _safe_bool(data.get('default_visible'), True)
        if self.status in ('disabled', 'hidden', 'retired', 'deprecated'):
            return False
        return True

    @property
    def tags_text(self):
        if not self.tags:
            return ''
        try:
            return ', '.join([_safe_text(x) for x in self.tags if _safe_text(x)])
        except Exception:
            return ''

    @property
    def short_description(self):
        value = self.description or ''
        if len(value) <= 90:
            return value
        return value[:87] + '...'

    @property
    def search_blob(self):
        values = [
            self.title,
            self.description,
            self.group,
            self.tab,
            self.panel,
            self.status,
            self.command_id,
            self.vendor,
            self.addin_name,
            self.source_path,
            self.tags_text
        ]
        return ' '.join(v for v in values if v).lower()


def _tool_to_dict(tool):
    return {
        'tool_id': tool.tool_id, 'title': tool.title,
        'description': tool.description,
        'group': tool.group, 'tab': tool.tab, 'panel': tool.panel,
        'tags': tool.tags, 'icon': tool.icon, 'accent': tool.accent,
        'handler': tool.handler, 'script': tool.script,
        'status': tool.status, 'order': tool.order,
        'source_path': tool.source_path,
        'command_id': tool.command_id,
        'vendor': tool.vendor,
        'addin_name': tool.addin_name,
        'manifest_path': tool.manifest_path,
        'enabled': tool.enabled,
    }


def _resolve_possible_script_path(path_value, bundle_dir):
    """Resolve absolute and bundle-relative script references."""
    path_text = _safe_text(path_value)
    if not path_text:
        return None
    if os.path.isabs(path_text):
        return os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(path_text))
    abs_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(bundle_dir, path_text.replace('/', os.sep)))
    return os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(abs_path))


def _save_cache(bundle_dir, tools):
    try:
        cache_path = _get_cache_path(bundle_dir)
        folder = os.path.dirname(cache_path)
        if not os.path.isdir(folder):
            os.makedirs(folder)
        payload = {
            'created_at': time.time(),
            'bundle_dir': bundle_dir,
            'revit_version': _get_revit_version_key(),
            'tools': [_tool_to_dict(t) for t in tools],
        }
        tmp = cache_path + '.tmp'
        with codecs.open(tmp, 'w', 'utf-8') as fh:
            json.dump(payload, fh, ensure_ascii=False)
        if os.path.exists(cache_path):
            os.remove(cache_path)
        os.rename(tmp, cache_path)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _load_from_cache(bundle_dir):
    """Return a list of ToolItems from cache if fresh, else None."""
    try:
        cache_path = _get_cache_path(bundle_dir)
        if not os.path.exists(cache_path):
            return None
        with codecs.open(cache_path, 'r', 'utf-8') as fh:
            payload = json.load(fh)
        if payload.get('revit_version') != _get_revit_version_key():
            return None
        if time.time() - payload.get('created_at', 0) > _CACHE_MAX_AGE:
            return None
        tools = []
        for raw in payload.get('tools', []):
            tool = ToolItem(raw)
            if tool.tool_id and tool.title and tool.handler:
                tools.append(tool)
        return tools if tools else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def _read_json(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    with codecs.open(path, 'r', 'utf-8') as stream:
        return json.load(stream)


def _collect_existing_script_paths(tools, bundle_dir):
    paths = set()
    for tool in tools:
        resolved_script = _resolve_possible_script_path(getattr(tool, 'script', None), bundle_dir)
        if resolved_script:
            paths.add(resolved_script)
        resolved_source = _resolve_possible_script_path(getattr(tool, 'source_path', None), bundle_dir)
        if resolved_source:
            paths.add(resolved_source)
    return paths


def _collect_existing_command_ids(tools):
    command_ids = set()
    for tool in tools:
        command_id = _safe_text(getattr(tool, 'command_id', None)).lower()
        if command_id:
            command_ids.add(command_id)
    return command_ids


def _get_revit_addins_dirs():
    revit_year = _get_revit_version_key()
    appdata = os.environ.get('APPDATA', '')
    programdata = os.environ.get('PROGRAMDATA', '')
    dirs = []
    if appdata:
        dirs.append(os.path.join(appdata, 'Autodesk', 'Revit', 'Addins', revit_year))
    if programdata:
        dirs.append(os.path.join(programdata, 'Autodesk', 'Revit', 'Addins', revit_year))
    return [d for d in dirs if d and os.path.isdir(d)]


def _manifest_command_entries():
    """Return manifest command metadata keyed by add-in identity."""
    entries = {}
    for addins_dir in _get_revit_addins_dirs():
        try:
            files = sorted(os.listdir(addins_dir))
        except Exception:
            continue
        for name in files:
            if not name.lower().endswith('.addin'):
                continue
            path = os.path.join(addins_dir, name)
            try:
                root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
            except Exception:
                continue
            for node in root.findall('.//AddIn'):
                addin_type = _safe_text(node.attrib.get('Type')).lower()
                if addin_type != 'command':
                    continue
                addin_id = _safe_text((node.findtext('AddInId') or ''))
                full_class = _safe_text((node.findtext('FullClassName') or ''))
                if not addin_id and not full_class:
                    continue
                key = '{0}|{1}'.format(addin_id.lower(), full_class.lower())
                entries[key] = {
                    'addin_name': _safe_text(node.findtext('Name') or os.path.splitext(name)[0]),
                    'text': _safe_text(node.findtext('Text')),
                    'description': _safe_text(node.findtext('Description') or node.findtext('LongDescription')),
                    'vendor': _safe_text(node.findtext('VendorId') or node.findtext('VendorDescription')),
                    'assembly': _safe_text(node.findtext('Assembly')),
                    'addin_id': addin_id,
                    'full_class': full_class,
                    'manifest_path': path,
                }
    return entries


def _iter_ribbon_items(items):
    for item in items or []:
        yield item
        source = getattr(item, 'Source', None)
        subitems = getattr(source, 'Items', None) if source is not None else None
        if subitems:
            for child in _iter_ribbon_items(subitems):
                yield child


def _scan_ribbon_commands(include_builtin=True):
    """Inspect ribbon for command ids from add-ins and optional built-ins."""
    commands = []
    try:
        import clr
        clr.AddReference('AdWindows')
        import Autodesk.Windows as adwin
        ribbon = adwin.ComponentManager.Ribbon
    except Exception:
        return commands

    if ribbon is None:
        return commands

    for tab in getattr(ribbon, 'Tabs', []) or []:
        tab_title = _safe_text(getattr(tab, 'Title', None) or getattr(tab, 'Id', None) or 'Add-Ins')
        for panel in getattr(tab, 'Panels', []) or []:
            panel_source = getattr(panel, 'Source', None)
            panel_title = _safe_text(getattr(panel_source, 'Title', None) or 'General')
            panel_items = getattr(panel_source, 'Items', None) if panel_source is not None else None
            for item in _iter_ribbon_items(panel_items):
                command_id = _safe_text(getattr(item, 'Id', None))
                if not command_id:
                    continue
                cmd_lc = command_id.lower()
                is_custom = 'customctrl_' in cmd_lc
                is_builtin = command_id.startswith('ID_')
                if not is_custom and not (include_builtin and is_builtin):
                    continue
                title = _safe_text(getattr(item, 'Text', None) or getattr(item, 'Title', None) or command_id)
                description = _safe_text(
                    getattr(item, 'ToolTip', None)
                    or getattr(item, 'Description', None)
                    or getattr(item, 'LongDescription', None)
                )
                commands.append({
                    'command_id': command_id,
                    'title': title,
                    'description': description,
                    'tab': tab_title,
                    'panel': panel_title,
                    'source_kind': 'addin' if is_custom else 'builtin',
                })
    return commands


def discover_non_pyrevit_commands(existing_command_ids=None):
    """Discover third-party and built-in Revit commands available for this user + version."""
    import re

    existing_command_ids = set((c or '').lower() for c in (existing_command_ids or []))
    discovered = []
    seen = set(existing_command_ids)
    order_base = 3000

    manifest_entries = _manifest_command_entries()
    for command in _scan_ribbon_commands(include_builtin=True):
        command_id = _safe_text(command.get('command_id'))
        command_key = command_id.lower()
        if not command_id or command_key in seen:
            continue

        entry = manifest_entries.get(command_key) or {}
        source_kind = _safe_text(command.get('source_kind')).lower() or 'addin'
        title = _safe_text(command.get('title')) or _safe_text(entry.get('text')) or command_id
        description = _safe_text(command.get('description')) or _safe_text(entry.get('description'))
        addin_name = _safe_text(entry.get('addin_name'))
        vendor = _safe_text(entry.get('vendor'))
        tab = _safe_text(command.get('tab')) or 'Add-Ins'
        panel = _safe_text(command.get('panel')) or addin_name or 'External'

        if source_kind == 'builtin':
            if not addin_name:
                addin_name = 'Revit Built-in'
            if not vendor:
                vendor = 'Autodesk'
            # Force a dedicated top-level group in the Dashboard tree.
            tab = 'Built-in'

        safe_id = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '_', command_key).strip('_')[:80]
        prefix = 'builtin' if source_kind == 'builtin' else 'addin'
        tool_id = '{0}_{1}'.format(prefix, safe_id or str(order_base))

        tags = ['external', 'revit']
        if source_kind == 'builtin':
            tags.append('builtin')
            tags.append('autodesk')
        else:
            tags.append('addin')
        if addin_name:
            tags.append(addin_name.lower())
        if vendor:
            tags.append(vendor.lower())

        data = {
            'tool_id': tool_id,
            'title': title,
            'description': description,
            'group': panel,
            'tab': tab,
            'panel': panel,
            'tags': tags,
            'icon': u'◈' if source_kind != 'builtin' else u'◧',
            'accent': '#FF1F6FEB' if source_kind != 'builtin' else '#FF2563EB',
            'handler': '_revit_command',
            'command_id': command_id,
            'vendor': vendor,
            'addin_name': addin_name,
            'source_path': _safe_text(entry.get('assembly')),
            'manifest_path': _safe_text(entry.get('manifest_path')),
            'status': 'production',
            'default_visible': True,
            'default_order': order_base,
        }
        tool = ToolItem(data)
        if tool.tool_id and tool.title and tool.command_id:
            discovered.append(tool)
            seen.add(command_key)
            order_base += 1

    return discovered


def load_catalog(bundle_dir, force_rebuild=False):
    # Fast path: return cached result if it was written this session
    if not force_rebuild:
        cached = _load_from_cache(bundle_dir)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

    path = os.path.join(bundle_dir, 'data', 'tool_catalog.json')
    raw_items = _read_json(path)
    tools = []

    for raw_item in raw_items:
        tool = ToolItem(raw_item)
        if not tool.tool_id:
            continue
        if not tool.title:
            continue
        if not tool.handler:
            continue
        if tool.handler == '_script' and not tool.script:
            continue
        if not tool.enabled:
            continue
        tools.append(tool)

    # Derive extension root from bundle_dir (walk up to *.extension folder)
    ext_root = _derive_extension_root(bundle_dir)

    if ext_root:
        try:
            existing_script_paths = _collect_existing_script_paths(tools, bundle_dir)
            discovered = discover_pyrevit_tools(ext_root, existing_script_paths=existing_script_paths)
            existing_ids = set(t.tool_id for t in tools)
            for t in discovered:
                if t.tool_id not in existing_ids:
                    tools.append(t)
                    existing_ids.add(t.tool_id)
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        existing_command_ids = _collect_existing_command_ids(tools)
        discovered_addins = discover_non_pyrevit_commands(existing_command_ids=existing_command_ids)
        existing_ids = set(t.tool_id for t in tools)
        for tool in discovered_addins:
            if tool.tool_id not in existing_ids:
                tools.append(tool)
                existing_ids.add(tool.tool_id)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Safety pass: protect the UI from duplicate IDs even if upstream data collides.
    unique_tools = []
    seen_ids = set()
    for tool in tools:
        key = _safe_text(getattr(tool, 'tool_id', None))
        if not key or key in seen_ids:
            continue
        unique_tools.append(tool)
        seen_ids.add(key)
    tools = unique_tools

    tools.sort(key=lambda x: (x.order, x.title.lower()))

    # Persist to cache so next open (and startup pre-warm) is instant
    _save_cache(bundle_dir, tools)

    return tools


def _ext_display_name(ext_folder):
    """Convert 'RBG_SYD.extension' to 'RBG SYD'."""
    import re
    name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(ext_folder))[0]
    return re.sub(r'[_-]+', ' ', name).strip()


def _read_yaml_field(path, key):
    """Extract a single field from a bundle.yaml without a YAML parser."""
    try:
        with codecs.open(path, 'r', 'utf-8') as fh:
            for line in fh:
                line = line.strip()
                if line.startswith(key + ':'):
                    return line[len(key) + 1:].strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def discover_pyrevit_tools(current_ext_root, existing_script_paths=None):
    """Scan all pyRevit extensions grouped by tab/panel."""
    import re

    current_norm = os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(current_ext_root))
    existing_script_paths = set(existing_script_paths or [])
    _skip_dirs = {'__pycache__', '.git', '.github', '.venv', 'node_modules',
                  'bin', 'obj', 'lib', 'Lib', 'hooks', 'hooks-wrappers'}

    # Collect all extension directories from every source
    ext_dirs = {}  # normcase_path -> (abs_path, display_name)

    # 1. pyRevit extensionmgr API (covers installed + core extensions)
    try:
        from pyrevit.extensions import extensionmgr
        for ext in extensionmgr.get_installed_ui_extensions():
            d = getattr(ext, 'directory', None)
            if d and os.path.isdir(d):
                norm = os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(d))
                name = getattr(ext, 'name', None) or _ext_display_name(d)
                ext_dirs[norm] = (d, _safe_text(name))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2. APPDATA\pyRevit\Extensions fallback / supplement
    appdata = os.environ.get('APPDATA', '')
    for ext_dir in [
        os.path.join(appdata, 'pyRevit', 'Extensions'),
        os.path.join(appdata, 'pyRevit', 'pyRevit', 'extensions'),
    ]:
        if not os.path.isdir(ext_dir):
            continue
        for entry in sorted(os.listdir(ext_dir)):
            if not entry.endswith('.extension'):
                continue
            path = os.path.join(ext_dir, entry)
            if not os.path.isdir(path):
                continue
            norm = os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(path))
            if norm not in ext_dirs:
                ext_dirs[norm] = (path, _ext_display_name(entry))

    # Ensure the current extension is discovered even when extensionmgr fallback misses it.
    if current_norm not in ext_dirs and os.path.isdir(current_ext_root):
        ext_dirs[current_norm] = (current_ext_root, _ext_display_name(current_ext_root))

    if not ext_dirs:
        return []

    discovered = []
    order_base = 1000

    for norm, (ext_path, ext_name) in sorted(ext_dirs.items(), key=lambda x: x[1][1]):
        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(ext_path):
            dirs[:] = [
                d for d in dirs
                if d not in _skip_dirs and not d.startswith('.')
                and not d.endswith('.pushbutton')
            ]
            pushbuttons = [
                d for d in os.listdir(root)
                if d.endswith('.pushbutton') and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root, d))
            ]

            for pb in sorted(pushbuttons):
                pb_path = os.path.join(root, pb)
                script_path = os.path.join(pb_path, 'script.py')
                if not os.path.exists(script_path):
                    continue
                script_norm = os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(script_path))
                if script_norm in existing_script_paths:
                    continue

                bundle_yaml = os.path.join(pb_path, 'bundle.yaml')
                title = (_read_yaml_field(bundle_yaml, 'title')
                         if os.path.exists(bundle_yaml) else None)
                tooltip = (_read_yaml_field(bundle_yaml, 'tooltip')
                           if os.path.exists(bundle_yaml) else None)

                if not title:
                    title = pb.replace('.pushbutton', '').strip()

                # Derive tab and panel from folder position within extension
                rel_root = root[len(ext_path):].strip('/\\')
                tab = ''
                panel = ''
                for part in rel_root.replace('\\', '/').split('/'):
                    if part.endswith('.tab') and not tab:
                        tab = _clean_name(part[:-4])
                    elif part.endswith('.panel') and not panel:
                        panel = _clean_panel_name(part[:-6])

                if not tab:
                    tab = ext_name
                if not panel:
                    panel = 'General'

                safe_ext = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '_', ext_name.lower()).strip('_')
                rel_script = os.path.relpath(script_path, ext_path).replace('\\', '/').lower()
                safe_rel = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '_', rel_script).strip('_')
                tool_id = 'ext_{0}_{1}'.format(safe_ext[:15], safe_rel[:64]).rstrip('_')

                data = {
                    'tool_id': tool_id,
                    'title': title,
                    'description': tooltip or '',
                    'group': panel,
                    'tab': tab,
                    'panel': panel,
                    'tags': [ext_name.lower(), tab.lower(), panel.lower()],
                    'handler': '_script',
                    'script': script_path,
                    'status': 'production',
                    'default_visible': True,
                    'default_order': order_base,
                }
                tool = ToolItem(data)
                if tool.tool_id and tool.title:
                    discovered.append(tool)
                    existing_script_paths.add(script_norm)
                    order_base += 1

    return discovered


def get_builtin_groups(tools):
    group_names = sorted(set([tool.group for tool in tools if tool.group]))
    return ['All Tools'] + group_names


def get_tab_panel_map(tools):
    """Return {tab_name: sorted_list_of_panel_names} for the groups TreeView."""
    mapping = {}
    for tool in tools:
        tab = tool.tab or 'Other'
        panel = tool.panel or 'General'
        if tab not in mapping:
            mapping[tab] = set()
        mapping[tab].add(panel)
    return dict((tab, sorted(panels)) for tab, panels in mapping.items())


def get_tool_map(tools):
    return dict((tool.tool_id, tool) for tool in tools)


def filter_tools(tools, selected_group, personal_groups, search_text):
    filtered_tools = list(tools)

    if isinstance(selected_group, (list, tuple)) and len(selected_group) == 2:
        kind, value = selected_group[0], selected_group[1]
        if kind == '__personal__':
            tool_ids = set(personal_groups.get(value, []))
            filtered_tools = [t for t in filtered_tools if t.tool_id in tool_ids]
        elif kind != '*':  # tab filter
            tab_filter = kind
            panel_filter = value
            filtered_tools = [
                t for t in filtered_tools
                if t.tab == tab_filter and (panel_filter == '*' or t.panel == panel_filter)
            ]
        # else ('*', '*') = All Tools, no filtering
    elif isinstance(selected_group, str) and selected_group != 'All Tools':
        # Legacy string path kept for backward compat
        if selected_group in personal_groups:
            tool_ids = set(personal_groups.get(selected_group, []))
            filtered_tools = [t for t in filtered_tools if t.tool_id in tool_ids]
        else:
            filtered_tools = [t for t in filtered_tools if t.group == selected_group]

    search_value = (search_text or '').strip().lower()
    if search_value:
        filtered_tools = [t for t in filtered_tools if search_value in t.search_blob]

    filtered_tools.sort(key=lambda x: (x.order, x.title.lower()))
    return filtered_tools
