def get_name(element):
    if not element:
        return ""
    try:
        return Element.Name.GetValue(element)
    except:
        pass
    try:
        return element.Name
    except:
        return ""


def mm_to_ft(value_mm):
    return UnitUtils.ConvertToInternalUnits(float(value_mm), UnitTypeId.Millimeters)


def ft_to_mm(value_ft):
    return UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(float(value_ft), UnitTypeId.Millimeters)


def try_parse_positive_int(value, default_value=None):
    try:
        parsed = int(str(value).strip())
        return parsed if parsed > 0 else default_value
    except:
        return default_value


def try_parse_positive_float(value, default_value=None):
    try:
        parsed = float(str(value).strip())
        return parsed if parsed > 0 else default_value
    except:
        return default_value


def try_parse_non_negative_float(value, default_value=None):
    try:
        parsed = float(str(value).strip())
        return parsed if parsed >= 0 else default_value
    except:
        return default_value


def try_parse_float(value, default_value=None):
    try:
        return float(str(value).strip())
    except:
        return default_value


def safe_int(value, default_value=0):
    try:
        return int(value)
    except:
        try:
            return int(str(value).strip())
        except:
            return default_value


def add_xyz(a, b):
    return XYZ(a.X + b.X, a.Y + b.Y, a.Z + b.Z)


def sub_xyz(a, b):
    return XYZ(a.X - b.X, a.Y - b.Y, a.Z - b.Z)


def mul_xyz(v, scale):
    return XYZ(v.X * scale, v.Y * scale, v.Z * scale)


def dot_xyz(a, b):
    return (a.X * b.X) + (a.Y * b.Y) + (a.Z * b.Z)


def cross_xyz(a, b):
    return XYZ(
        a.Y * b.Z - a.Z * b.Y,
        a.Z * b.X - a.X * b.Z,
        a.X * b.Y - a.Y * b.X
    )


def vec_length(v):
    return math.sqrt((v.X * v.X) + (v.Y * v.Y) + (v.Z * v.Z))


def normalize(v):
    length = vec_length(v)
    if length < EPS:
        return None
    return XYZ(v.X / length, v.Y / length, v.Z / length)


def normalize_xy(v):
    return normalize(XYZ(v.X, v.Y, 0.0))


def canonical_xy_direction(v):
    direction = normalize_xy(v)
    if not direction:
        return None
    if direction.X < 0 or (abs(direction.X) < EPS and direction.Y < 0):
        direction = mul_xyz(direction, -1.0)
    return direction


def combine_warning_text(existing_text, new_values):
    parts = []

    def _append(value):
        if value is None:
            return
        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
            for sub_value in value:
                _append(sub_value)
            return
        try:
            text = str(value).strip()
        except:
            text = ""
        if text and text not in parts:
            parts.append(text)

    _append(existing_text)
    _append(new_values)
    return " | ".join(parts)


def chunk_list(items, chunk_size):
    if chunk_size < 1:
        return [items]
    return [items[index:index + chunk_size] for index in range(0, len(items), chunk_size)]


def estimate_layout_capacity(layout_request):
    if layout_request.LayoutType == "Vertical Stack":
        return 8
    if layout_request.LayoutType == "Plan Top + Sections Below":
        return max(5, 1 + (max(1, int(layout_request.GridColumns)) * 2))
    return max(6, max(1, int(layout_request.GridColumns)) * 3)

def validate_scope_frame(scope_frame):
    messages = []

    if not scope_frame:
        return False, ["Invalid scope frame"]

    axis_x = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisX)
    axis_y = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisY)

    if not axis_x or not axis_y:
        messages.append("Scope frame axes are invalid")
    elif abs(dot_xyz(axis_x, axis_y)) > 0.05:
        messages.append("Scope frame axes are not orthogonal")

    try:
        if float(scope_frame.SizeX) <= EPS or float(scope_frame.SizeY) <= EPS:
            messages.append("Scope frame extents are invalid")
    except:
        messages.append("Scope frame extents are invalid")

    try:
        if float(scope_frame.ZMax) <= float(scope_frame.ZMin):
            messages.append("Scope frame elevations are invalid")
    except:
        messages.append("Scope frame elevations are invalid")

    return len(messages) == 0, messages


def _build_section_basis(view_dir):
    z_axis = normalize_xy(view_dir)
    if not z_axis:
        return None, None, None

    up_axis = XYZ.BasisZ
    right_axis = normalize(cross_xyz(up_axis, z_axis))
    if not right_axis:
        return None, None, None

    up_axis = normalize(cross_xyz(z_axis, right_axis))
    if not up_axis:
        return None, None, None

    z_axis = normalize(cross_xyz(right_axis, up_axis))
    if not z_axis:
        return None, None, None

    return right_axis, up_axis, z_axis


def validate_section_direction(scope_frame, side_label, aligned_angle_deg=None):
    frame_ok, frame_messages = validate_scope_frame(scope_frame)
    if not frame_ok:
        return False, list(frame_messages)

    if side_label not in SECTION_DIRECTIONS:
        return False, ["Section direction is invalid"]

    axis_x = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisX)
    axis_y = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisY)

    if side_label == "Front":
        view_dir = axis_y
    elif side_label == "Back":
        view_dir = mul_xyz(axis_y, -1.0)
    elif side_label == "Left":
        view_dir = axis_x
    elif side_label == "Aligned":
        if aligned_angle_deg is None:
            return False, ["Aligned section side requires a picked alignment line/edge"]
        try:
            angle_rad = math.radians(float(aligned_angle_deg))
            right_dir = normalize_xy(XYZ(math.cos(angle_rad), math.sin(angle_rad), 0.0))
        except Exception:
            right_dir = None

        if not right_dir:
            return False, ["Aligned section direction is invalid"]

        up_axis = XYZ.BasisZ
        final_view_dir = normalize(cross_xyz(right_dir, up_axis))
        if not final_view_dir:
            return False, ["Aligned section transform basis is invalid"]

        return True, []
    else:
        view_dir = mul_xyz(axis_x, -1.0)

    right_dir, up_dir, final_view_dir = _build_section_basis(view_dir)
    if not right_dir or not up_dir or not final_view_dir:
        return False, ["Section transform basis is invalid"]

    return True, []


def get_view_associated_level_id(view):
    if not view:
        return None

    try:
        if hasattr(view, "GenLevel") and view.GenLevel:
            return view.GenLevel.Id
    except:
        pass

    for bip_name in ["VIEW_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "VIEWER_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "PLAN_VIEW_LEVEL"]:
        try:
            bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, bip_name)
            param = view.get_Parameter(bip)
            if param and param.HasValue:
                return param.AsElementId()
        except:
            pass

    for param_name in ["Associated Level", "Level"]:
        try:
            param = view.LookupParameter(param_name)
            if param and param.HasValue:
                return param.AsElementId()
        except:
            pass

    return None


def view_matches_level(view, level):
    if not view or not level:
        return False
    level_id = get_view_associated_level_id(view)
    if not level_id:
        return False
    try:
        return level_id.IntegerValue == level.Id.IntegerValue
    except:
        return False


def view_supports_associated_level(view):
    if not view:
        return False

    try:
        if hasattr(view, "GenLevel") and view.GenLevel:
            return True
    except:
        pass

    for bip_name in ["VIEW_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "VIEWER_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "PLAN_VIEW_LEVEL"]:
        try:
            bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, bip_name)
            if view.get_Parameter(bip):
                return True
        except:
            pass

    for param_name in ["Associated Level", "Level"]:
        try:
            if view.LookupParameter(param_name):
                return True
        except:
            pass

    return False


def force_view_associated_level(view, level):
    if not view or not level:
        return False

    if view_matches_level(view, level):
        return True

    for bip_name in ["VIEW_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "VIEWER_ASSOCIATED_LEVEL", "PLAN_VIEW_LEVEL"]:
        try:
            bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, bip_name)
            param = view.get_Parameter(bip)
            if param and not param.IsReadOnly:
                param.Set(level.Id)
                return True
        except:
            pass

    for param_name in ["Associated Level", "Level"]:
        try:
            param = view.LookupParameter(param_name)
            if param and not param.IsReadOnly:
                param.Set(level.Id)
                return True
        except:
            pass

    return view_matches_level(view, level)


def get_view_range_signature(view):
    sig = {}
    try:
        view_range = view.GetViewRange()
    except Exception:
        return sig

    for plane in [
        PlanViewPlane.TopClipPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.CutPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.BottomClipPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.ViewDepthPlane
    ]:
        try:
            level_id = view_range.GetLevelId(plane)
        except Exception:
            level_id = None

        try:
            offset = view_range.GetOffset(plane)
        except Exception:
            offset = 0.0

        sig[plane] = (level_id, offset)

    return sig


def build_remapped_view_range_signature(view, target_level_id):
    source_sig = get_view_range_signature(view)
    current_level_id = get_view_associated_level_id(view)
    result = {}

    for plane, data in source_sig.items():
        level_id, offset = data
        new_level_id = level_id

        try:
            if current_level_id and level_id and level_id == current_level_id:
                new_level_id = target_level_id
        except Exception:
            pass

        result[plane] = (new_level_id, offset)

    return result


def apply_view_range_signature(view, sig):
    try:
        view_range = view.GetViewRange()
    except Exception as ex:
        return False, str(ex)

    try:
        for plane, data in sig.items():
            level_id, offset = data
            try:
                if level_id is not None:
                    view_range.SetLevelId(plane, level_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                view_range.SetOffset(plane, offset)
            except Exception:
                pass

        view.SetViewRange(view_range)
        return True, None
    except Exception as ex:
        return False, str(ex)


def view_range_matches(view, sig, tol=0.0001):
    actual_sig = get_view_range_signature(view)
    for plane, expected in sig.items():
        exp_level, exp_offset = expected
        act_level, act_offset = actual_sig.get(plane, (None, None))

        if exp_level != act_level:
            return False

        if act_offset is None:
            return False

        try:
            if abs(float(act_offset) - float(exp_offset)) > tol:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False

    return True


def enforce_associated_level_and_view_range(view, target_level, remap_view_range):
    if not view or not target_level:
        return False, False, 'View or target level missing'

    changed = False
    current_level_id = get_view_associated_level_id(view)

    try:
        current_matches = bool(current_level_id and current_level_id == target_level.Id)
    except Exception:
        current_matches = False

    if not current_matches:
        if not force_view_associated_level(view, target_level):
            return False, False, 'Associated level set failed'
        changed = True

    range_changed = False
    if remap_view_range:
        sig = build_remapped_view_range_signature(view, target_level.Id)
        if sig:
            ok, error = apply_view_range_signature(view, sig)
            if not ok:
                return changed, False, 'View range remap failed: {0}'.format(error)
            if not view_range_matches(view, sig):
                return changed, False, 'View range remap did not persist'
            range_changed = True

    return changed, range_changed, None

def get_scope_boxes():
    items = []
    collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_VolumeOfInterest).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
    for scope_box in collector:
        name = get_name(scope_box)
        if name:
            items.append(ChoiceItem(name, scope_box))
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x.Label.lower())
    return items

def _get_param_by_builtin_names(element, builtin_names):
    if not element:
        return None
    for name in builtin_names:
        try:
            bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, name)
            param = element.get_Parameter(bip)
            if param:
                return param
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None


def _get_param_by_lookup_names(element, lookup_names):
    if not element:
        return None
    for name in lookup_names:
        try:
            param = element.LookupParameter(name)
            if param:
                return param
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None


def _get_param(element, builtin_names=None, lookup_names=None):
    builtin_names = builtin_names or []
    lookup_names = lookup_names or []

    param = _get_param_by_builtin_names(element, builtin_names)
    if param:
        return param

    return _get_param_by_lookup_names(element, lookup_names)


def _param_to_text(param):
    if not param:
        return ""

    try:
        text = param.AsValueString()
        if text:
            return text
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        text = param.AsString()
        if text:
            return text
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        element_id = param.AsElementId()
        if element_id and element_id.IntegerValue > 0:
            element = doc.GetElement(element_id)
            text = get_name(element)
            if text:
                return text
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        return str(param.AsInteger())
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        return "{0:.1f}".format(float(param.AsDouble()))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return ""


def _param_to_level_name(param):
    if not param:
        return ""
    try:
        level_id = param.AsElementId()
        if level_id and level_id.IntegerValue > 0:
            level = doc.GetElement(level_id)
            return get_name(level)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return _param_to_text(param)


def _param_to_offset_mm_text(param):
    if not param:
        return ""
    try:
        return "{0:.1f}".format(round(ft_to_mm(param.AsDouble()), 1))
    except Exception:
        return _param_to_text(param)


def _get_type_name(element):
    if not element:
        return ""
    try:
        type_id = element.GetTypeId()
        if type_id and type_id.IntegerValue > 0:
            type_element = doc.GetElement(type_id)
            return get_name(type_element)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return get_name(element)


def _get_category_id_value(element):
    try:
        return element.Category.Id.IntegerValue
    except Exception:
        return None


def _first_non_empty_param_text(element, lookup_names):
    for name in lookup_names:
        text = _param_to_text(_get_param(element, lookup_names=[name]))
        if text:
            return text
    return ""


def _build_creator_element_row(element):
    row = CreatorElementRow(element)

    try:
        row.ElementId = element.Id.IntegerValue
    except Exception:
        row.ElementId = 0

    try:
        row.CategoryName = element.Category.Name or ""
    except Exception:
        row.CategoryName = ""

    row.TypeName = _get_type_name(element) or "Element"

    category_id = _get_category_id_value(element)
    wall_id = int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls)
    column_id = int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns)
    framing_id = int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming)
    floor_id = int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors)
    generic_id = int(BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericModel)

    if category_id == wall_id:
        row.BaseConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["WALL_BASE_CONSTRAINT"], ["Base Constraint"]))
        row.BaseOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["WALL_BASE_OFFSET"], ["Base Offset"]))
        row.TopConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["WALL_HEIGHT_TYPE"], ["Top Constraint"]))
        row.TopOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["WALL_TOP_OFFSET"], ["Top Offset"]))
        row.RbgMark = _first_non_empty_param_text(element, ["RBG_WL_Number", "RBG_WL_No", "RBG_WL_MarkNo"])
    elif category_id == column_id:
        row.BaseConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["FAMILY_BASE_LEVEL_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_BASE_LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Base Level"]))
        row.BaseOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["FAMILY_BASE_LEVEL_OFFSET_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_BASE_LEVEL_OFFSET_PARAM"], ["Base Offset"]))
        row.TopConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["FAMILY_TOP_LEVEL_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_TOP_LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Top Level"]))
        row.TopOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["FAMILY_TOP_LEVEL_OFFSET_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_TOP_LEVEL_OFFSET_PARAM"], ["Top Offset"]))
        row.RbgMark = _first_non_empty_param_text(element, ["RBG_CO_MarkNo", "RBG_CO_Number", "RBG_CO_No"])
    elif category_id == framing_id:
        row.BaseConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["INSTANCE_REFERENCE_LEVEL_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Reference Level", "Level"]))
        row.BaseOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["START_Z_OFFSET_VALUE", "Z_OFFSET_VALUE"], ["Start Level Offset", "z Offset Value"]))
        row.TopConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["INSTANCE_REFERENCE_LEVEL_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Reference Level", "Level"]))
        row.TopOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["END_Z_OFFSET_VALUE", "Z_OFFSET_VALUE"], ["End Level Offset", "z Offset Value"]))
        row.RbgMark = _first_non_empty_param_text(element, ["RBG_FR_MarkNo", "RBG_FR_Number", "RBG_FR_No"])
    elif category_id == floor_id:
        row.BaseConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Level"]))
        row.BaseOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["FLOOR_HEIGHTABOVELEVEL_PARAM"], ["Height Offset From Level"]))
        row.TopConstraint = ""
        row.TopOffset = ""
        row.RbgMark = _first_non_empty_param_text(element, ["RBG_FL_Number", "RBG_FL_MarkNo", "RBG_FL_No"])
    elif category_id == generic_id:
        row.BaseConstraint = _param_to_level_name(_get_param(element, ["FAMILY_LEVEL_PARAM", "SCHEDULE_LEVEL_PARAM", "INSTANCE_SCHEDULE_ONLY_LEVEL_PARAM"], ["Level", "Reference Level"]))
        row.BaseOffset = _param_to_offset_mm_text(_get_param(element, ["INSTANCE_ELEVATION_PARAM"], ["Offset", "Elevation from Level"]))
        row.TopConstraint = ""
        row.TopOffset = ""
        row.RbgMark = _first_non_empty_param_text(element, ["RBG_GM_Number", "RBG_GM_MarkNo", "Mark"])

    row.InstanceLabel = (row.RbgMark or row.TypeName or "Element").strip()
    row.GroupNumber = (row.RbgMark or row.TypeName or "Element").strip() or "Element"
    row.GroupBaseLevel = (row.BaseConstraint or "").strip() or "(No Base Level)"
    row.GroupTypeName = (row.TypeName or "Element").strip() or "Element"
    row.GroupKey = u"{0}|{1}|{2}|{3}".format(
        (row.CategoryName or "Element").strip(),
        row.GroupNumber,
        row.GroupBaseLevel,
        row.GroupTypeName
    )
    row.Label = u"{0} | {1} [{2}]".format(row.CategoryName or "Element", row.TypeName or "Element", row.ElementId)
    return row


def get_creator_elements_for_categories(category_values):
    result = []
    seen_ids = set()

    for category_value in category_values:
        try:
            collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(category_value).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
        except Exception:
            continue

        for element in collector:
            try:
                element_id = element.Id.IntegerValue
                if element_id in seen_ids:
                    continue
                seen_ids.add(element_id)
            except Exception:
                continue

            try:
                bbox = element.get_BoundingBox(None)
                if not bbox:
                    continue
            except Exception:
                continue

            result.append(_build_creator_element_row(element))

    result.sort(key=lambda x: ((x.CategoryName or "").lower(), (x.TypeName or "").lower(), x.ElementId))
    return result

            FilteredElementCollector(doc, active_view.Id)

def get_most_used_titleblock_type_id():
    counts = {}

    try:
        titleblocks = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
    except Exception:
        return None

    for tb in titleblocks:
        try:
            type_id = tb.GetTypeId()
            key = type_id.IntegerValue if type_id else None
            if not key or key <= 0:
                continue
            counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not counts:
        return None

    try:
        best_key = max(counts.keys(), key=lambda k: counts[k])
        return ElementId(int(best_key))
    except Exception:
        return None

def get_viewport_type_candidates():
    items = []
    seen_ids = set()

    # Primary: element types in OST_Viewports category
    try:
        collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Viewports).WhereElementIsElementType()
        for element_type in collector:
            try:
                element_id = element_type.Id.IntegerValue
                if element_id in seen_ids:
                    continue
                seen_ids.add(element_id)
                label = get_name(element_type)
                if label:
                    items.append(ChoiceItem(label, element_type, label))
            except:
                pass
    except:
        pass

    # Fallback 1: scan all ElementType objects filtered by OST_Viewports category id.
    if not items:
        try:
            fallback = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ElementType).WhereElementIsElementType()
            for element_type in fallback:
                try:
                    cat = element_type.Category
                    if not cat or cat.Id.IntegerValue != int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Viewports):
                        continue
                    element_id = element_type.Id.IntegerValue
                    if element_id in seen_ids:
                        continue
                    seen_ids.add(element_id)
                    label = get_name(element_type)
                    if label:
                        items.append(ChoiceItem(label, element_type, label))
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass

    # Fallback 2: harvest types from viewport instances already placed in the model.
    # This works in any project regardless of category/class collection behaviour.
    if not items:
        try:
            for vp in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Viewport):
                try:
                    type_id = vp.GetTypeId()
                    if not type_id or type_id.IntegerValue in seen_ids:
                        continue
                    element_type = doc.GetElement(type_id)
                    if not element_type:
                        continue
                    seen_ids.add(type_id.IntegerValue)
                    label = get_name(element_type)
                    if label:
                        items.append(ChoiceItem(label, element_type, label))
                except:
                    pass
        except:
            pass

    items.sort(key=lambda x: x.Label.lower())
    return items

            continue

        name = get_name(view)

        existing_names.add(name)
        existing_views.setdefault(name, []).append(view)

    return existing_names, existing_views


def build_existing_view_map_for_creator(progress_callback=None):
    existing_names = set()
    existing_views = {}

    def _consume_views(view_iterable, phase_label):
        processed = 0
        for view in view_iterable:
            processed += 1
            try:
                if view.IsTemplate:
                    continue
            except Exception:
                continue

            name = get_name(view)
            if not name:
                continue

            existing_names.add(name)
            existing_views.setdefault(name, []).append(view)

            if progress_callback and (processed % 200 == 0):
                try:
                    progress_callback(phase_label, processed)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        if progress_callback:
            try:
                progress_callback(phase_label, processed)
            except Exception:
                pass

    _consume_views(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewPlan).WhereElementIsNotElementType(), "plans")
    _consume_views(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSection).WhereElementIsNotElementType(), "sections")

    return existing_names, existing_views

def get_view_outline_size_ft(view):
    # Prefer view outline because it reflects viewport paper-space extents at current scale.
    try:
        outline = view.Outline
        if outline:
            width = abs(float(outline.Max.U) - float(outline.Min.U))
            height = abs(float(outline.Max.V) - float(outline.Min.V))
            if width > EPS and height > EPS:
                return width, height
    except:
        pass

    try:
        crop = view.CropBox
        if crop:
            scale = max(1.0, float(getattr(view, "Scale", 100) or 100))
            width = abs(float(crop.Max.X) - float(crop.Min.X)) / scale
            height = abs(float(crop.Max.Y) - float(crop.Min.Y)) / scale
            if width > EPS and height > EPS:
                return width, height
    except:
        pass

    return None, None


def get_existing_selectable_views():
    result = []
    viewport_index = build_viewport_index_by_view_id()
    collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(View).WhereElementIsNotElementType()

    for view in collector:
        try:
            if view.IsTemplate:
                continue
        except:
            continue

        try:
            view_type = str(view.ViewType)
        except:
            continue

        if view_type not in ["EngineeringPlan", "FloorPlan", "Section", "Detail", "Elevation"]:
            continue

        name = get_name(view)
        if not name:
            continue

        level_name = ""
        level_elev = 0.0
        try:
            if view.GenLevel:
                level_name = get_name(view.GenLevel)
                level_elev = float(view.GenLevel.Elevation)
        except:
            pass

        placements = viewport_index.get(view.Id.IntegerValue, [])
        placed = len(placements) > 0
        sheet_number = ""
        sheet_name = ""
        sheet_id = None
        if placements:
            first = placements[0]
            sheet_number = first.get("SheetNumber", "") or ""
            sheet_name = first.get("SheetName", "") or ""
            sheet_id = first.get("SheetId", None)

        current_sheet_label = ""
        if placed:
            if sheet_number and sheet_name:
                current_sheet_label = u"{0} - {1}".format(sheet_number, sheet_name)
            elif sheet_number:
                current_sheet_label = sheet_number
            elif sheet_name:
                current_sheet_label = sheet_name
            else:
                current_sheet_label = "Placed"

        if view_type in ["EngineeringPlan", "FloorPlan"]:
            type_label = "Structural Plan"
        elif view_type == "Detail":
            type_label = "Section Detail"
        else:
            type_label = view_type

        label = u"{0} | {1} | {2} | {3}{4}".format(
            name,
            type_label,
            level_name or "-",
            "Placed" if placed else "Unplaced",
            u" | {0}".format(current_sheet_label) if current_sheet_label else ""
        )

        result.append({
            "View": view,
            "Label": label,
            "TypeLabel": type_label,
            "LevelName": level_name or "",
            "LevelElevation": level_elev,
            "Placed": placed,
            "CurrentSheetNumber": sheet_number,
            "CurrentSheetName": sheet_name,
            "CurrentSheetLabel": current_sheet_label,
            "CurrentSheetId": sheet_id
        })

    result.sort(key=lambda x: (x["LevelElevation"], x["Label"].lower()))
    return result


def make_unique_name(base_name, existing_names):
    if base_name not in existing_names:
        existing_names.add(base_name)
        return base_name

    index = 1
    while True:
        test_name = u"{0} ({1})".format(base_name, index)
        if test_name not in existing_names:
            existing_names.add(test_name)
            return test_name
        index += 1


def make_unique_sheet_number(base_number, existing_numbers):
    if base_number not in existing_numbers:
        existing_numbers.add(base_number)
        return base_number

    index = 1
    while True:
        test_number = u"{0}-{1}".format(base_number, index)
        if test_number not in existing_numbers:
            existing_numbers.add(test_number)
            return test_number
        index += 1


def _is_reuse_candidate_compatible(view, expected_level, expected_role, expected_type_id):
    if not view:
        return False

    try:
        if view.IsTemplate:
            return False
    except Exception:
        return False

    if expected_role == 'Plan':
        try:
            if not isinstance(view, ViewPlan):
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False
    elif expected_role == 'Section':
        try:
            if not isinstance(view, ViewSection):
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False

        try:
            if view.ViewType != ViewType.Section:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False

    if expected_type_id is not None:
        try:
            if view.GetTypeId().IntegerValue != expected_type_id.IntegerValue:
                return False
        except Exception:
            return False

    return view_matches_level(view, expected_level)


def get_or_create_view(base_name, creator_func, existing_names, existing_views, duplicate_mode, expected_level, expected_role, expected_type_id):
    if duplicate_mode == "Reuse Matching":
        for existing_view in existing_views.get(base_name, []):
            if _is_reuse_candidate_compatible(existing_view, expected_level, expected_role, expected_type_id):
                return existing_view, True

    final_name = make_unique_name(base_name, existing_names)
    view = creator_func(final_name)
    if view:
        existing_views.setdefault(final_name, []).append(view)
    return view, False


def build_scope_frame(scope_box):
    try:
        bbox = scope_box.get_BoundingBox(None)
    except:
        bbox = None

    if not bbox:
        return None

    transform = bbox.Transform if bbox.Transform else Transform.Identity
    local_min = bbox.Min
    local_max = bbox.Max

    center_local = XYZ(
        (local_min.X + local_max.X) * 0.5,
        (local_min.Y + local_max.Y) * 0.5,
        (local_min.Z + local_max.Z) * 0.5
    )

    center_world = transform.OfPoint(center_local)
    axis_x = canonical_xy_direction(transform.BasisX) or XYZ.BasisX
    axis_y = canonical_xy_direction(transform.BasisY) or XYZ.BasisY

    point0 = transform.OfPoint(local_min)
    point1 = transform.OfPoint(local_max)

    z_min = min(point0.Z, point1.Z)
    z_max = max(point0.Z, point1.Z)

    return ScopeFrame(
        center_world,
        axis_x,
        axis_y,
        z_min,
        z_max,
        abs(local_max.X - local_min.X),
        abs(local_max.Y - local_min.Y),
        "BBox",
        []
    )


def is_scope_box_element(element):
    try:
        return element.Category and element.Category.Id.IntegerValue == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_VolumeOfInterest)
    except Exception:
        return False


def get_levels_in_scope(scope_frame, all_levels):
    levels = []
    if not scope_frame:
        return levels

    tol = mm_to_ft(50.0)
    for level in all_levels:
        try:
            elev = float(level.Elevation)
            if (scope_frame.ZMin - tol) <= elev <= (scope_frame.ZMax + tol):
                levels.append(level)
        except:
            pass

    levels.sort(key=lambda x: float(x.Elevation))
    return levels


def get_section_top_elevation(base_level, selected_levels_sorted, min_height_mm):
    base_elev = float(base_level.Elevation)
    min_top = base_elev + mm_to_ft(min_height_mm)

    for level in selected_levels_sorted:
        try:
            elev = float(level.Elevation)
            if elev > (base_elev + EPS):
                return max(elev, min_top)
        except:
            pass

    return min_top


def create_plan_view(plan_type_id, level, scope_box, plan_template, view_name):
    view = ViewPlan.Create(doc, plan_type_id, level.Id)
    if plan_template:
        try:
            view.ViewTemplateId = plan_template.Id
        except:
            pass
    try:
        if scope_box and is_scope_box_element(scope_box):
            set_scope_box(view, scope_box.Id)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        view.Name = view_name
    except:
        pass
    return view


def apply_plan_crop_from_frame(view, scope_frame, margin_mm=1200.0):
    if not view or not scope_frame:
        return False

    try:
        crop = view.CropBox
        if not crop:
            return False
    except Exception:
        return False

    margin = mm_to_ft(margin_mm)
    half_x = max(EPS, float(scope_frame.SizeX) * 0.5 + margin)
    half_y = max(EPS, float(scope_frame.SizeY) * 0.5 + margin)

    try:
        crop.Min = XYZ(scope_frame.Center.X - half_x, scope_frame.Center.Y - half_y, crop.Min.Z)
        crop.Max = XYZ(scope_frame.Center.X + half_x, scope_frame.Center.Y + half_y, crop.Max.Z)
        view.CropBoxActive = True
        view.CropBoxVisible = False
        view.CropBox = crop
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def build_section_box(scope_frame, bottom_elev, top_elev, side_label, depth_mm, aligned_angle_deg=None):
    frame_ok, frame_messages = validate_scope_frame(scope_frame)
    if not frame_ok:
        return None, combine_warning_text("", frame_messages)

    dir_ok, dir_messages = validate_section_direction(scope_frame, side_label, aligned_angle_deg)
    if not dir_ok:
        return None, combine_warning_text("", dir_messages)

    z0 = float(bottom_elev)
    z1 = float(top_elev)
    if z1 <= z0:
        return None, "Top elevation must be above base elevation"

    axis_x = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisX) or XYZ.BasisX
    axis_y = normalize_xy(scope_frame.AxisY) or XYZ.BasisY

    half_x = max(scope_frame.SizeX * 0.5, mm_to_ft(500.0))
    half_y = max(scope_frame.SizeY * 0.5, mm_to_ft(500.0))
    depth_ft = max(mm_to_ft(depth_mm), mm_to_ft(500.0))
    half_h = max((z1 - z0) * 0.5, mm_to_ft(500.0))
    origin_z = (z0 + z1) * 0.5

    if side_label == "Front":
        view_dir = axis_y
        face_offset = half_y
        half_width = half_x
    elif side_label == "Back":
        view_dir = mul_xyz(axis_y, -1.0)
        face_offset = half_y
        half_width = half_x
    elif side_label == "Left":
        view_dir = axis_x
        face_offset = half_x
        half_width = half_y
    elif side_label == "Aligned":
        angle_rad = math.radians(float(aligned_angle_deg or 0.0))
        right_dir = normalize_xy(XYZ(math.cos(angle_rad), math.sin(angle_rad), 0.0))
        if not right_dir:
            return None, "Aligned section direction is invalid"

        up_dir = XYZ.BasisZ
        final_view_dir = normalize(cross_xyz(right_dir, up_dir))
        if not final_view_dir:
            return None, "Aligned section transform basis is invalid"

        face_offset = abs(dot_xyz(final_view_dir, axis_x)) * half_x + abs(dot_xyz(final_view_dir, axis_y)) * half_y
        half_width = abs(dot_xyz(right_dir, axis_x)) * half_x + abs(dot_xyz(right_dir, axis_y)) * half_y
    else:
        view_dir = mul_xyz(axis_x, -1.0)
        face_offset = half_x
        half_width = half_y

    if side_label != "Aligned":
        right_dir, up_dir, final_view_dir = _build_section_basis(view_dir)
        if not right_dir or not up_dir or not final_view_dir:
            return None, "Section transform basis is invalid"

    origin_xy = add_xyz(scope_frame.Center, mul_xyz(final_view_dir, -face_offset))
    origin = XYZ(origin_xy.X, origin_xy.Y, origin_z)

    box = BoundingBoxXYZ()
    trf = Transform.Identity
    trf.Origin = origin
    trf.BasisX = right_dir
    trf.BasisY = up_dir
    trf.BasisZ = final_view_dir

    try:
        box.Transform = trf
    except Exception as ex:
        return None, "Section transform invalid: {0}".format(str(ex))

    box.Min = XYZ(-half_width, -half_h, 0.0)
    box.Max = XYZ(half_width, half_h, depth_ft)
    return box, None


def create_section_view(section_type_id, scope_frame, bottom_elev, top_elev, section_template, side_label, view_name, depth_mm, aligned_angle_deg=None):
    frame_ok, frame_messages = validate_scope_frame(scope_frame)
    if not frame_ok:
        return None, combine_warning_text("", frame_messages)

    dir_ok, dir_messages = validate_section_direction(scope_frame, side_label, aligned_angle_deg)
    if not dir_ok:
        return None, combine_warning_text("", dir_messages)

    box, error = build_section_box(scope_frame, bottom_elev, top_elev, side_label, depth_mm, aligned_angle_deg)
    if not box:
        return None, error

    view = ViewSection.CreateSection(doc, section_type_id, box)
    if section_template:
        try:
            view.ViewTemplateId = section_template.Id
        except:
            pass

    try:
        view.Name = view_name
    except:
        pass

    return view, None


def activate_symbol_if_needed(symbol):
    if not symbol:
        return
    try:
        if not symbol.IsActive:
            symbol.Activate()
            doc.Regenerate()
    except:
        pass


def create_scope_sheet(titleblock_type, sheet_name, sheet_number):
    activate_symbol_if_needed(titleblock_type)
    sheet = ViewSheet.Create(doc, titleblock_type.Id)
    sheet.SheetNumber = sheet_number
    try:
        sheet.Name = sheet_name
    except:
        pass
    return sheet


def can_add_view_to_sheet(sheet, view):
    try:
        return Viewport.CanAddViewToSheet(doc, sheet.Id, view.Id)
    except:
        return False


def get_sheet_rect_bounds(sheet):
    outline = sheet.Outline
    return (
        float(outline.Min.U),
        float(outline.Min.V),
        float(outline.Max.U),
        float(outline.Max.V)
    )


def build_grid_positions(bounds, count, columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft):
    positions = []
    if count <= 0:
        return positions

    min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
    columns = max(1, int(columns))
    rows = int(math.ceil(float(count) / float(columns)))

    usable_w = max(0.0, (max_x - min_x) - ((columns - 1) * hgap_ft))
    usable_h = max(0.0, (max_y - min_y) - ((rows - 1) * vgap_ft))

    if usable_w <= 0 or usable_h <= 0:
        return positions

    cell_w = usable_w / float(columns)
    cell_h = usable_h / float(rows)

    for index in range(count):
        row_index = int(index / columns)
        col_index = int(index % columns)
        center_x = min_x + (col_index * (cell_w + hgap_ft)) + (cell_w * 0.5)
        center_y = max_y - (row_index * (cell_h + vgap_ft)) - (cell_h * 0.5)
        positions.append(XYZ(center_x, center_y, 0.0))

    return positions


def build_grid_positions_with_rows(bounds, count, columns, rows, hgap_ft, vgap_ft):
    if rows is None or int(rows) <= 0:
        return build_grid_positions(bounds, count, columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft)

    positions = []
    if count <= 0:
        return positions

    min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
    columns = max(1, int(columns))
    rows = max(1, int(rows))

    if columns * rows < count:
        rows = int(math.ceil(float(count) / float(columns)))

    usable_w = max(0.0, (max_x - min_x) - ((columns - 1) * hgap_ft))
    usable_h = max(0.0, (max_y - min_y) - ((rows - 1) * vgap_ft))

    if usable_w <= 0 or usable_h <= 0:
        return positions

    cell_w = usable_w / float(columns)
    cell_h = usable_h / float(rows)

    for index in range(count):
        row_index = int(index / columns)
        col_index = int(index % columns)
        center_x = min_x + (col_index * (cell_w + hgap_ft)) + (cell_w * 0.5)
        center_y = max_y - (row_index * (cell_h + vgap_ft)) - (cell_h * 0.5)
        positions.append(XYZ(center_x, center_y, 0.0))

    return positions


def build_vertical_stack_positions(bounds, count, vgap_ft):
    positions = []
    if count <= 0:
        return positions

    min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
    usable_h = max(0.0, (max_y - min_y) - ((count - 1) * vgap_ft))
    if usable_h <= 0:
        return positions

    cell_h = usable_h / float(count)
    center_x = (min_x + max_x) * 0.5

    for index in range(count):
        center_y = max_y - (index * (cell_h + vgap_ft)) - (cell_h * 0.5)
        positions.append(XYZ(center_x, center_y, 0.0))

    return positions


def build_plan_top_sections_positions(bounds, plan_count, section_count, section_columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft, plan_position):
    positions = []
    min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
    total_h = max_y - min_y
    if total_h <= 0:
        return positions

    if plan_count > 0 and section_count > 0:
        plan_band_h = max(total_h * 0.34, mm_to_ft(120.0))
        plan_bounds = (min_x, max_y - plan_band_h, max_x, max_y)
        section_bounds = (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y - plan_band_h - vgap_ft)
    else:
        plan_bounds = bounds
        section_bounds = bounds

    if plan_count > 0:
        plan_columns = max(1, min(plan_count, 2)) if plan_position == "Top Left" else max(1, plan_count)
        positions.extend(build_grid_positions(plan_bounds, plan_count, plan_columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft))

    if section_count > 0:
        positions.extend(build_grid_positions(section_bounds, section_count, max(1, section_columns), hgap_ft, vgap_ft))

    return positions

class ViewCreatorWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
    def __init__(self, xaml_path):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)

        self.state = UiState()
        self.scope_frames = {}
        self.scope_items_all = []
        self.sheet_items_all = []
        self.suspend_events = True

        self.viewport_type_items = get_viewport_type_candidates()
        self.viewport_type_by_label = {}
        self.viewport_type_labels = [item.Label for item in self.viewport_type_items]
        for item in self.viewport_type_items:
            self.viewport_type_by_label[item.Label] = item.Element

        self.creator_rows_dirty = False
        self.last_creator_signature = None
        self._last_ui_pump_at = 0.0
        self._last_summary_refresh_at = 0.0
        self._freeform_drag_state = None
        self._freeform_preview_items = {}
        self._freeform_selected_view_keys = set()
        self._freeform_selected_title_keys = set()
        self._stage2_staged_view_mode = False
        self._snapshot_image_cache = {}
        self._stage1_creator_view_map = {}
        self._selected_element_line_keys = set()
        self._stage1_last_diagnostics = {}
        self._skip_stage2_snapshot_render_once = False
        self._scope_level_visible_pairs = []
        self._scope_level_checkbox_map = {}
        self._stage1_transition_diag = {}
        self._stage2_lazy_needs_init = False
        self._stage2_switch_diag = {}
        self._stage2_last_render_signature = None
        self._stage2_render_inflight = False
        self._selector_cache_loaded = False
        self._sheet_cache_loaded = False
        self._titleblock_default_applied = False

        self._setup_ui()

        self.suspend_events = False
        self.refresh_scope_and_levels()
        self.refresh_summary(True)

    def pump_ui(self, force=False):
        try:
            now = time.time()
            if (not force) and (now - float(self._last_ui_pump_at) < PREVIEW_PROGRESS_UI_INTERVAL_SEC):
                return
            self._last_ui_pump_at = now
            self.Dispatcher.Invoke(DispatcherPriority.Background, Action(lambda: None))
        except:
            pass

    def begin_progress(self, total_steps, status_text):
        try:
            self.bdrProgress.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.pbRunProgress.Minimum = 0
            self.pbRunProgress.Maximum = max(1, total_steps)
            self.pbRunProgress.Value = 0
            self.txtRunProgressStatus.Text = status_text
            self._set_stage1_inline_status(status_text, 0, max(1, total_steps), True)
            self.btnPreview.IsEnabled = False
            self.btnCreate.IsEnabled = False
            self.btnCancel.IsEnabled = False
            self.Topmost = True
            self.pump_ui(True)
        except:
            pass

    def update_progress(self, step_value, status_text, force_ui=False):
        try:
            self.pbRunProgress.Value = min(step_value, self.pbRunProgress.Maximum)
            self.txtRunProgressStatus.Text = status_text
            self._set_stage1_inline_status(status_text, step_value, self.pbRunProgress.Maximum, True)
            self.pump_ui(force_ui)
        except:
            pass

    def set_progress_total(self, total_steps):
        try:
            self.pbRunProgress.Maximum = max(1, total_steps)
            if self.pbRunProgress.Value > self.pbRunProgress.Maximum:
                self.pbRunProgress.Value = self.pbRunProgress.Maximum
            self._set_stage1_inline_status(self.txtRunProgressStatus.Text, self.pbRunProgress.Value, self.pbRunProgress.Maximum, True)
            self.pump_ui(True)
        except:
            pass

    def end_progress(self):
        try:
            self.bdrProgress.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            self._set_stage1_inline_status("Stage 1 status: idle.", 0, 1, False)
            self.btnPreview.IsEnabled = True
            self.btnCreate.IsEnabled = True
            self.btnCancel.IsEnabled = True
            self.Topmost = False
            self.pump_ui(True)
        except:
            pass

    def _set_stage1_inline_status(self, text_value, current_value=0, total_value=1, show_progress=False):
        try:
            self.txtStage1InlineStatus.Text = text_value or ""
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            self.pbStage1InlineProgress.Minimum = 0
            self.pbStage1InlineProgress.Maximum = max(1, int(total_value))
            self.pbStage1InlineProgress.Value = min(max(0, int(current_value)), self.pbStage1InlineProgress.Maximum)
            self.pbStage1InlineProgress.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if show_progress else Visibility.Collapsed
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _record_stage2_diag(self, step_text):
        now = round(time.time(), 3)
        items = list(self._stage2_switch_diag.get("steps", []))
        items.append({"t": now, "step": step_text})
        self._stage2_switch_diag["steps"] = items

    def _trim_preview_name(self, text_value, max_len=PREVIEW_NAME_TRIM):
        try:
            text_value = str(text_value or "")
        except:
            text_value = ""
        if len(text_value) <= max_len:
            return text_value
        return text_value[:max_len - 3] + "..."

    def plans_enabled(self):
        try:
            return bool(self.chkCreatePlans.IsChecked)
        except:
            return True

    def sections_enabled(self):
        try:
            return bool(self.chkCreateSections.IsChecked)
        except:
            return True

    def _set_combo(self, combo, items, display_member=True):
        try:
            combo.ItemsSource = None
        except:
            pass
        try:
            combo.Items.Clear()
        except:
            pass
        combo.ItemsSource = items
        if display_member:
            try:
                combo.DisplayMemberPath = "Label"
            except:
                pass

    def _select_combo_index(self, combo, index_value):
        try:
            combo.SelectedIndex = index_value
        except:
            pass

    def _select_combo_value(self, combo, value):
        try:
            for item in combo.ItemsSource:
                item_value = getattr(item, "Value", None)
                item_label = getattr(item, "Label", None)
                if item_value == value or item_label == value:
                    combo.SelectedItem = item
                    return
        except:
            pass

    def _selected_choice(self, combo):
        item = combo.SelectedItem
        return item if item else None

    def _selected_element(self, combo):
        item = self._selected_choice(combo)
        return getattr(item, "Element", None) if item else None

    def _selected_value(self, combo, default_value=None):
        item = self._selected_choice(combo)
        return getattr(item, "Value", default_value) if item else default_value

    def _set_required_control_state(self, control, is_required, is_valid, note=None):
        try:
            if is_required and (not is_valid):
                control.Background = Brushes.MistyRose
                if note:
                    control.ToolTip = note
            else:
                control.Background = Brushes.White
                control.ToolTip = None
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _update_required_field_highlights(self):
        is_creator = (self.get_source_mode() == "Creator")
        plan_required = is_creator and self.plans_enabled()
        section_required = is_creator and self.sections_enabled()

        plan_type_ok = bool(self._selected_element(self.cbPlanType))
        plan_template_ok = bool(self._selected_element(self.cbPlanTemplate))
        section_type_ok = bool(self._selected_element(self.cbSectionType))
        section_template_ok = bool(self._selected_element(self.cbSectionTemplate))

        self._set_required_control_state(
            self.cbPlanType,
            plan_required,
            plan_type_ok,
            "Required when Create Plans is enabled."
        )
        self._set_required_control_state(
            self.cbPlanTemplate,
            plan_required,
            plan_template_ok,
            "Required when Create Plans is enabled."
        )
        self._set_required_control_state(
            self.cbSectionType,
            section_required,
            section_type_ok,
            "Required when Create Sections is enabled."
        )
        self._set_required_control_state(
            self.cbSectionTemplate,
            section_required,
            section_template_ok,
            "Required when Create Sections is enabled."
        )

        # Stage 2 visual cue: Aligned side needs a picked edge/line first.
        try:
            aligned_selected = (self._selected_value(self.cbStage2SectionSide, "Front") == "Aligned")
            rows = self._get_stage2_target_rows() if aligned_selected else []
            aligned_ok = (not aligned_selected) or all(getattr(r, "SectionAlignmentAngleDeg", None) is not None for r in rows)
            self._set_required_control_state(
                self.cbStage2SectionSide,
                aligned_selected,
                aligned_ok,
                "Aligned requires Pick Section Alignment before Apply/Run."
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _normalize_selected_items(self, listbox):
        result = []
        try:
            for item in listbox.SelectedItems:
                result.append(item)
        except:
            pass
        return result

    def _set_listbox_items_with_preserve(self, listbox, items, selected_id_set):
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            listbox.ItemsSource = None
            listbox.ItemsSource = items
            for item in items:
                try:
                    element = getattr(item, "Element", None)
                    if element and element.Id.IntegerValue in selected_id_set:
                        listbox.SelectedItems.Add(item)
                except:
                    pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _set_choice_items_with_preserve(self, listbox, items, selected_values):
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            listbox.ItemsSource = None
            listbox.ItemsSource = items
            selected_values = set([str(x) for x in (selected_values or [])])
            for item in items:
                try:
                    value = str(getattr(item, "Value", ""))
                    if value in selected_values:
                        listbox.SelectedItems.Add(item)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _reload_creator_grid(self):
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.ItemsSource = None
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.ItemsSource = self.state.CreatorRows
            self._reload_section_snapshot_grid()
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _reload_section_snapshot_grid(self):
        try:
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.ItemsSource = None
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.ItemsSource = self.state.CreatorRows
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _reload_stage1_view_name_grid(self):
        try:
            self.dgStage1ViewNames.ItemsSource = None
            self.dgStage1ViewNames.ItemsSource = self.state.Stage1ViewNameItems
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _reload_selector_grid(self):
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.ItemsSource = None
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.ItemsSource = self.state.SelectorRows
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _ensure_selector_cache_loaded(self, force=False):
        if self._selector_cache_loaded and (not force):
            return
        self.state.SelectorAllViewItems = get_existing_selectable_views()
        self._selector_cache_loaded = True

    def _ensure_sheet_cache_loaded(self, force=False):
        if self._sheet_cache_loaded and (not force):
            return
        self.sheet_items_all = get_existing_sheet_candidates()
        try:
            self.lbExistingSheets.ItemsSource = self.sheet_items_all
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._sheet_cache_loaded = True

    def _ensure_preferred_titleblock_default(self, force=False):
        if self._titleblock_default_applied and (not force):
            return

        try:
            if self.cbTitleBlock.Items.Count <= 0:
                self._titleblock_default_applied = True
                return
        except Exception:
            self._titleblock_default_applied = True
            return

        preferred_tb_id = get_most_used_titleblock_type_id()
        if preferred_tb_id and getattr(self.cbTitleBlock, "Items", None):
            for item in self.cbTitleBlock.Items:
                try:
                    symbol = getattr(item, "Element", None)
                    if symbol and symbol.Id.IntegerValue == preferred_tb_id.IntegerValue:
                        self.cbTitleBlock.SelectedItem = item
                        self._titleblock_default_applied = True
                        return
                except Exception:
                    pass

        try:
            if self.cbTitleBlock.SelectedItem is None and self.cbTitleBlock.Items.Count > 0:
                self.cbTitleBlock.SelectedIndex = 0
        except Exception:
            pass

        self._titleblock_default_applied = True

        self._set_combo(self.cbPostSectionMoveMode, [ChoiceItem(x, None, x) for x in POST_SECTION_MOVE_MODES])
