    def update_source_mode_panels(self):
        is_creator = (self.get_effective_source_mode() == "Creator")
        self.pnlCreatorMode.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_creator else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.pnlSelectorMode.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if not is_creator else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.grpCreatorAssignments.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_creator else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.grpSelectorAssignments.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if not is_creator else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.update_creator_source_panels()
        if not is_creator:
            self._ensure_selector_cache_loaded()
            self.refresh_selector_views_only()
            self.refresh_selector_only()
        self.update_workflow_stage_panels()
        self.update_post_stage_controls()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(True)

    def update_plan_section_visibility(self):
        self.pnlPlanSettings.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if self.plans_enabled() else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.pnlSectionSettings.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if self.sections_enabled() else Visibility.Collapsed
        try:
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
        except:
            pass
        try:
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
        except:
            pass

    def _place_sheet_plan(self, sheet_plan, view_map, progress_step):
        placed_count = 0
        skipped_place_count = 0
        placed_viewports = []
        moved_existing_count = 0
        relocated_existing_count = 0
        viewport_index = self._build_viewport_index_by_view_id()
        selector_relayout_enabled = (self.get_source_mode() == "Selector")
        layout_request = self.get_layout_request()

        t_place = Transaction(doc, "Place Views on Sheets")
        t_place.Start()

        try:
            for sheet_index, item in enumerate(sheet_plan):
                sheet = item["sheet"]
                if not sheet:
                    continue

                bounds = self.get_usable_sheet_bounds(sheet)
                preset_placements = list(item.get("placements", []) or [])
                if preset_placements:
                    placements = self._layout_existing_placements(preset_placements, bounds, layout_request)
                else:
                    placements = self.build_layout_for_rows(item["rows"], bounds)

                for placement in placements:
                    row = placement.SourceRow

                    if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
                        key = (row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue, placement.Role)
                        placement.View = view_map.get(key)
                    else:
                        key = (row.View.Id.IntegerValue, row.Role)
                        placement.View = view_map.get(key)

                    if placement.View:
                        placement.ViewName = get_name(placement.View)

                    if not placement.View or not placement.TargetCenter:
                        skipped_place_count += 1
                        continue

                    existing_entries = viewport_index.get(placement.View.Id.IntegerValue, [])
                    existing_entry = existing_entries[0] if existing_entries else None

                    if existing_entry and selector_relayout_enabled:
                        existing_viewport = existing_entry.get("Viewport", None)
                        existing_sheet = existing_entry.get("Sheet", None)

                        if existing_viewport and existing_sheet and existing_sheet.Id.IntegerValue == sheet.Id.IntegerValue:
                            try:
                                existing_viewport.SetBoxCenter(placement.TargetCenter)
                                self._apply_viewport_type_only(existing_viewport, row)
                                placed_viewports.append((existing_viewport, row, placement.Role))
                                placed_count += 1
                                moved_existing_count += 1
                                continue
                            except:
                                row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Move on current sheet failed: {0}".format(placement.ViewName))

                        if existing_viewport:
                            try:
                                doc.Delete(existing_viewport.Id)
                            except:
                                row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Existing viewport delete failed: {0}".format(placement.ViewName))
                                skipped_place_count += 1
                                continue
                            viewport_index[placement.View.Id.IntegerValue] = []

                        try:
                            viewport = Viewport.Create(doc, sheet.Id, placement.View.Id, placement.TargetCenter)
                            self._apply_viewport_type_only(viewport, row)
                            placed_viewports.append((viewport, row, placement.Role))
                            placed_count += 1
                            relocated_existing_count += 1
                            viewport_index[placement.View.Id.IntegerValue] = [{
                                "Viewport": viewport,
                                "Sheet": sheet,
                                "SheetId": sheet.Id,
                                "SheetNumber": item["sheet_number"],
                                "SheetName": get_name(sheet)
                            }]
                            continue
                        except:
                            row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Relocation failed: {0}".format(placement.ViewName))
                            skipped_place_count += 1
                            continue

                    if not can_add_view_to_sheet(sheet, placement.View):
                        row.Warning = combine_warning_text(
                            row.Warning,
                            "Cannot add {0} to sheet {1}".format(placement.ViewName, item["sheet_number"])
                        )
                        skipped_place_count += 1
                        continue

                    try:
                        viewport = Viewport.Create(doc, sheet.Id, placement.View.Id, placement.TargetCenter)
                        self._apply_viewport_type_only(viewport, row)
                        placed_viewports.append((viewport, row, placement.Role))
                        placed_count += 1
                        viewport_index[placement.View.Id.IntegerValue] = [{
                            "Viewport": viewport,
                            "Sheet": sheet,
                            "SheetId": sheet.Id,
                            "SheetNumber": item["sheet_number"],
                            "SheetName": get_name(sheet)
                        }]
                    except:
                        row.Warning = combine_warning_text(
                            row.Warning,
                            "Placement failed: {0}".format(placement.ViewName)
                        )
                        skipped_place_count += 1

                progress_step += 1
                if (sheet_index + 1) % 2 == 0 or sheet_index == len(sheet_plan) - 1:
                    self.update_progress(
                        progress_step,
                        "Placing views... {0}/{1}".format(sheet_index + 1, len(sheet_plan))
                    )

            doc.Regenerate()

            for viewport, row, role in placed_viewports:
                self._apply_viewport_title_only(viewport, row, role)

            t_place.Commit()
            return placed_count, skipped_place_count, moved_existing_count, relocated_existing_count, progress_step

        except:
            t_place.RollBack()
            raise

    def create_views_and_optionally_place(self):
        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()

        source_mode = self.get_effective_source_mode()
        create_mode = self.get_create_mode()
        sheet_mode = self.get_sheet_mode()

        active_groups = self.get_active_groups()
        active_rows = self.get_active_rows()
        existing_sheet_numbers = build_existing_sheet_numbers()
        capacity = estimate_layout_capacity(self.get_layout_request())

        created_plan_count = 0
        created_section_count = 0
        reused_count = 0
        created_sheet_count = 0
        placed_count = 0
        skipped_place_count = 0
        moved_existing_count = 0
        relocated_existing_count = 0
        mismatch_count = 0
        assoc_level_changed_count = 0
        assoc_range_changed_count = 0
        assoc_stage_failed_count = 0
        sectionmove_success_count = 0
        sectionmove_failed_count = 0

        total_rows = len(active_rows)
        create_ops_total = self._estimate_stage1_create_operations() if source_mode == "Creator" else total_rows
        total_sheet_est = max(1, self.state.CachedRequiredSheets)
        total_steps = max(1, create_ops_total + total_sheet_est + total_sheet_est)
        progress_step = 0

        self.begin_progress(total_steps, "Preparing run...")

        tg = TransactionGroup(doc, "View Creator / Selector")
        tg.Start()

        try:
            view_map = {}

            if source_mode == "Creator":
                t_create = Transaction(doc, "Create Views")
                t_create.Start()
                view_map, created_plan_count, created_section_count, reused_count, mismatch_count, progress_step = self._build_creator_view_map(
                    total_rows,
                    progress_step,
                    create_ops_total
                )
                t_create.Commit()
            else:
                view_map, mismatch_count = self._build_selector_view_map()
                progress_step = max(progress_step, total_rows)
                self.update_progress(progress_step, "Preparing selected views...")

            if source_mode == 'Creator' and bool(self.chkEnforceAssocLevel.IsChecked):
                t_assoc = Transaction(doc, 'Post Stage - Enforce Associated Levels')
                t_assoc.Start()
                assoc_level_changed_count, assoc_range_changed_count, assoc_stage_failed_count = self._run_associated_level_stage(view_map)
                t_assoc.Commit()

            if source_mode == 'Creator' and bool(self.chkRunSectionMoveStage.IsChecked):
                sectionmove_success_count, sectionmove_failed_count = self._run_post_sectionmove_stage(view_map)

            if create_mode == "Views Only":
                tg.Assimilate()
                self.end_progress()
                return (
                    "Done.\n\n"
                    "Plans created: {0}\n"
                    "Sections created: {1}\n"
                    "Reused views: {2}\n"
                    "Associated level updates: {3}\n"
                    "View range remaps: {4}\n"
                    "Associated level stage failures: {5}\n"
                    "SectionMove post-stage success: {6}\n"
                    "SectionMove post-stage failures: {7}\n"
                    "Sheets created: 0\n"
                    "Views placed: 0\n"
                    "Placement skipped: 0{8}"
                ).format(
                    created_plan_count,
                    created_section_count,
                    reused_count,
                    assoc_level_changed_count,
                    assoc_range_changed_count,
                    assoc_stage_failed_count,
                    sectionmove_success_count,
                    sectionmove_failed_count,
                    "\nAssociated level mismatches: {0}".format(mismatch_count) if mismatch_count > 0 else ""
                )

            sheet_plan = []
            layout_request = self.get_layout_request()

            if sheet_mode == "New Sheets":
                titleblock_type = self._selected_element(self.cbTitleBlock)
                prefix = (self.tbSheetPrefix.Text or "").strip() or "SB"
                start_no = try_parse_positive_int(self.tbSheetStart.Text, 1)
                number_counter = start_no
                planning_bounds = self._get_preview_sheet_bounds()

                for group in active_groups:
                    layouts = self._build_sheet_layouts_for_rows(group["rows"], planning_bounds, layout_request, capacity)
                    for index, layout in enumerate(layouts):
                        sheet_number = make_unique_sheet_number(
                            "{0}{1:03d}".format(prefix, number_counter),
                            existing_sheet_numbers
                        )
                        number_counter += 1

                        sheet_name = "{0} - Layout {1}".format(group["name"], index + 1)
                        sheet_plan.append({
                            "sheet": None,
                            "sheet_number": sheet_number,
                            "sheet_name": sheet_name,
                            "rows": [placement.SourceRow for placement in layout],
                            "placements": list(layout)
                        })

                t_sheet = Transaction(doc, "Create Sheets")
                t_sheet.Start()
                for item in sheet_plan:
                    item["sheet"] = create_scope_sheet(titleblock_type, item["sheet_name"], item["sheet_number"])
                    created_sheet_count += 1
                    progress_step += 1
                    if created_sheet_count % 5 == 0 or created_sheet_count == len(sheet_plan):
                        self.update_progress(
                            progress_step,
                            "Creating sheets... {0}/{1}".format(created_sheet_count, len(sheet_plan))
                        )
                t_sheet.Commit()

            else:
                selected_sheets = self.get_selected_existing_sheets()
                selected_sheets.sort(key=lambda x: (x.SheetNumber or "").lower())
                if selected_sheets:
                    planning_bounds = self.get_usable_sheet_bounds(selected_sheets[0])
                else:
                    planning_bounds = self._get_preview_sheet_bounds()

                placement_groups = []
                for group in active_groups:
                    layouts = self._build_sheet_layouts_for_rows(group["rows"], planning_bounds, layout_request, capacity)
                    for layout in layouts:
                        placement_groups.append((group["name"], list(layout)))

                for index, packed in enumerate(placement_groups):
                    if index >= len(selected_sheets):
                        break
                    group_name, chunk_layout = packed
                    sheet_plan.append({
                        "sheet": selected_sheets[index],
                        "sheet_number": selected_sheets[index].SheetNumber,
                        "sheet_name": get_name(selected_sheets[index]),
                        "rows": [placement.SourceRow for placement in chunk_layout],
                        "placements": list(chunk_layout),
                        "group_name": group_name
                    })

            placed_count, skipped_place_count, moved_existing_count, relocated_existing_count, progress_step = self._place_sheet_plan(sheet_plan, view_map, progress_step)

            tg.Assimilate()
            self.end_progress()

            try:
                self.dgCreatorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
            except:
                pass
            try:
                self.dgSelectorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
            except:
                pass

            message = (
                "Done.\n\n"
                "Plans created: {0}\n"
                "Sections created: {1}\n"
                "Reused views: {2}\n"
                "Associated level updates: {3}\n"
                "View range remaps: {4}\n"
                "Associated level stage failures: {5}\n"
                "SectionMove post-stage success: {6}\n"
                "SectionMove post-stage failures: {7}\n"
                "Sheets created: {8}\n"
                "Views placed: {9}\n"
                "Placement skipped: {10}\n"
                "Existing viewports moved: {11}\n"
                "Existing viewports relocated: {12}"
            ).format(
                created_plan_count,
                created_section_count,
                reused_count,
                assoc_level_changed_count,
                assoc_range_changed_count,
                assoc_stage_failed_count,
                sectionmove_success_count,
                sectionmove_failed_count,
                created_sheet_count,
                placed_count,
                skipped_place_count,
                moved_existing_count,
                relocated_existing_count
            )

            if mismatch_count > 0:
                message += "\nAssociated level mismatches: {0}".format(mismatch_count)

            return message

        except Exception:
            try:
                tg.RollBack()
            except:
                pass
            self.end_progress()
            raise

    def apply_bulk_to_creator_rows(self, rows):
        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()

        direction_item = self.cbBulkSectionDirectionCreator.SelectedItem
        direction_value = None

        if direction_item:
            try:
                direction_value = str(direction_item.Content)
            except:
                try:
                    direction_value = str(direction_item)
                except:
                    pass

        bulk_plan_order = None
        bulk_section_order = None
        bulk_viewport_type = self._selected_value(self.cbBulkViewportTypeCreator, None)
        bulk_title_position = self._selected_value(self.cbBulkTitlePositionCreator, None)

        if (self.tbBulkPlanOrderCreator.Text or "").strip():
            bulk_plan_order = safe_int(self.tbBulkPlanOrderCreator.Text, None)
        if (self.tbBulkSectionOrderCreator.Text or "").strip():
            bulk_section_order = safe_int(self.tbBulkSectionOrderCreator.Text, None)

        for row in rows:
            if direction_value in SECTION_DIRECTIONS:
                row.SectionDirection = direction_value
            if bulk_plan_order is not None:
                row.PlanOrder = bulk_plan_order
            if bulk_section_order is not None:
                row.SectionOrder = bulk_section_order
            if bulk_viewport_type:
                row.ViewportTypeName = bulk_viewport_type
            if bulk_title_position:
                row.ViewportTitlePosition = bulk_title_position

        self._refresh_creator_warnings()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def apply_bulk_to_selector_rows(self, rows):
        bulk_order = None
        bulk_viewport_type = self._selected_value(self.cbBulkViewportTypeSelector, None)
        bulk_title_position = self._selected_value(self.cbBulkTitlePositionSelector, None)

        if (self.tbBulkOrderSelector.Text or "").strip():
            bulk_order = safe_int(self.tbBulkOrderSelector.Text, None)

        for row in rows:
            if bulk_order is not None:
                row.Order = bulk_order
            if bulk_viewport_type:
                row.ViewportTypeName = bulk_viewport_type
            if bulk_title_position:
                row.ViewportTitlePosition = bulk_title_position

        try:
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
        except:
            pass
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def auto_plan_order(self):
        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        rows = sorted(self.state.CreatorRows, key=lambda x: (x.ScopeBoxName.lower(), float(x.Level.Elevation)))

    def select_placed_sheets_click(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return

        if self.get_source_mode() != "Selector":
            forms.alert("This action is available in View Selector mode.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        target_sheet_ids = set()
        for row in self.state.SelectorRows:
            try:
                if row.CurrentSheetId:
                    target_sheet_ids.add(row.CurrentSheetId.IntegerValue)
            except:
                pass

        if not target_sheet_ids:
            forms.alert("No placed sheets found for selected selector views.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        selected_count = 0
        try:
            self.lbExistingSheets.SelectedItems.Clear()
            for item in self.lbExistingSheets.ItemsSource:
                try:
                    sheet = item.Element
                    if sheet and sheet.Id.IntegerValue in target_sheet_ids:
                        self.lbExistingSheets.SelectedItems.Add(item)
                        selected_count += 1
                except:
                    pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

        self.refresh_summary(True)
        self.mark_preview_dirty()

        if selected_count == 0:
            forms.alert("Placed sheets were found but are not in the current filtered existing sheet pool.", warn_icon=True)

    def proceed_to_sheet_layout_click(self, sender, args):
        run_started = time.time()
        transition_steps = []

        def _mark(step_text):
            try:
                transition_steps.append((step_text, round(time.time() - run_started, 3)))
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._set_stage1_inline_status(step_text, 0, 1, False)
            self.pump_ui(True)

        source_mode = self.get_source_mode()
        _mark("Stage 1: preparing run...")
        if self.get_source_mode() == "Creator":
            stage2_views = self._run_stage1_creator()
        else:
            self.refresh_selector_only()
            stage2_views = self._run_stage1_selector()

        if not stage2_views:
            return

        try:
            _mark("Stage 1 complete. Preparing Stage 2 data cache...")
            self._skip_stage2_snapshot_render_once = True
            self._stage2_lazy_needs_init = True
            if source_mode == "Creator":
                self._stage2_staged_view_mode = False
            else:
                self._set_stage2_views(stage2_views)

            _mark("Stage 1 handoff: refreshing summary...")
            self.mark_preview_dirty()
            self.refresh_summary(True)

            elapsed = time.time() - run_started
            self._stage1_transition_diag = {
                "source_mode": source_mode,
                "views_ready": len(stage2_views),
                "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed, 3),
                "steps": list(transition_steps),
                "stage2_lazy_needs_init": True
            }

            self._set_stage1_inline_status(
                "Stage 1 complete in {0:.1f}s. Stage 2 data ready for {1} views. Open '2. Section Snapshot' tab to continue.".format(
                    float(elapsed),
                    int(len(stage2_views))
                ),
                0,
                1,
                False
            )
            self.pump_ui(True)
        except Exception as ex:
            self._stage1_transition_diag = {
                "source_mode": source_mode,
                "views_ready": len(stage2_views),
                "elapsed_sec": round(time.time() - run_started, 3),
                "steps": list(transition_steps),
                "error": str(ex)
            }
            self._set_stage1_inline_status("Stage 1 handoff failed: {0}".format(str(ex)), 0, 1, False)
            raise

    def stage1_apply_view_names_click(self, sender, args):
        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            forms.alert("Stage 1 view name editing is available in View Creator mode.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()

        target_items = []
        try:
            for item in self.dgStage1ViewNames.SelectedItems:
                if isinstance(item, Stage1ViewNameItem):
                    target_items.append(item)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not target_items:
            target_items = list(self.state.Stage1ViewNameItems or [])

        if not target_items:
            forms.alert("No Stage 1 views available to rename.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        changed = 0
        failed = 0

        t_rename = Transaction(doc, "Stage 2 - Apply Stage 1 View Names")
        t_rename.Start()
        try:
            for item in target_items:
                item.Status = ""
                item_changed = False

                plan_view = getattr(item, "PlanView", None)
                section_view = getattr(item, "SectionView", None)
                plan_name = (item.PlanName or "").strip()
                section_name = (item.SectionName or "").strip()

                try:
                    if plan_view and plan_name and plan_name != get_name(plan_view):
                        plan_view.Name = plan_name
                        item_changed = True
                except Exception as ex:
                    failed += 1
                    item.Status = combine_warning_text(item.Status, "Plan rename failed: {0}".format(str(ex)))

                try:
                    if section_view and section_name and section_name != get_name(section_view):
                        section_view.Name = section_name
                        item_changed = True
                except Exception as ex:
                    failed += 1
                    item.Status = combine_warning_text(item.Status, "Section rename failed: {0}".format(str(ex)))

                if item_changed:
                    changed += 1
                    if not item.Status:
                        item.Status = "Applied"
                elif not item.Status:
                    item.Status = "No change"

            t_rename.Commit()
        except Exception:
            try:
                t_rename.RollBack()
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise

        self._snapshot_image_cache = {}
        self.refresh_stage2_snapshot_list(True)
        self.refresh_stage1_view_name_editor(True)

        try:
            self.dgStage1ViewNames.Items.Refresh()
        except Exception:
            pass

        if failed > 0:
            forms.alert(
                "View name apply completed with issues. Updated {0}, failures {1}. Review Status column.".format(changed, failed),
                warn_icon=True
            )

    def apply_section_snapshot_settings_click(self, sender, args):
        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            forms.alert("Section snapshot adjustments are available in View Creator mode.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        side = self._selected_value(self.cbStage2SectionSide, "Front")
        lower_level_name = self._selected_value(self.cbStage2LowerLevel, "")
        upper_level_name = self._selected_value(self.cbStage2UpperLevel, "")
        bottom_offset = try_parse_float(getattr(self.tbSectionBottomOffset, "Text", "0"), 0.0)
        top_offset = try_parse_float(getattr(self.tbSectionTopOffset, "Text", "0"), 0.0)

        target_rows = []
        try:
            for row in self.dgSectionSnapshot.SelectedItems:
                if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
                    target_rows.append(row)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not target_rows:
            target_rows = [row for row in self.state.CreatorRows if getattr(row, "CreateSection", False)]

        if not target_rows:
            forms.alert("No section rows available to update.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        if side == "Aligned":
            missing = [row for row in target_rows if getattr(row, "SectionAlignmentAngleDeg", None) is None]
            if missing:
                forms.alert("Pick section alignment first when using Section Cut Side = Aligned.", warn_icon=True)
                return

        changed = 0

        for row in target_rows:
            if not row.CreateSection:
                continue
            if side in SECTION_DIRECTIONS:
                row.SectionDirection = side
            if lower_level_name:
                row.SectionLowerLevelName = lower_level_name
            if upper_level_name:
                row.SectionUpperLevelName = upper_level_name
            row.SectionBottomOffsetMm = bottom_offset
            row.SectionTopOffsetMm = top_offset
            changed += 1

        if changed:
            self._refresh_creator_warnings()
            try:
                self.dgCreatorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.dgSectionSnapshot.Items.Refresh()
            except Exception:
                pass

        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

        # Apply vertical mapping directly to existing section views without rerunning Stage 1.
        success_count, failed_count = self._apply_vertical_mapping_rows(target_rows)
        if failed_count > 0:
            forms.alert(
                "Stage 2 vertical crop mapping updated {0} rows and failed on {1}. Review row warnings.".format(success_count, failed_count),
                warn_icon=True
            )

        self.refresh_stage2_snapshot_list(True)

    def clear_freeform_selection_click(self, sender, args):
        self._freeform_selected_view_keys = set()
        self._freeform_selected_title_keys = set()
        self._refresh_freeform_selection_visuals()

    def align_selected_views_bottom_click(self, sender, args):
        self._align_selected_freeform_views("bottom")

    def align_selected_views_left_click(self, sender, args):
        self._align_selected_freeform_views("left")

    def align_selected_titles_bottom_click(self, sender, args):
        self._align_selected_freeform_titles("bottom")

    def align_selected_titles_left_click(self, sender, args):
        self._align_selected_freeform_titles("left")

    def advanced_mode_changed(self, sender, args):
        self.update_advanced_mode()

    def select_creator_rows_click(self, sender, args):
        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        try:
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.SelectAll()
        except:
            pass

    def clear_creator_rows_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.UnselectAll()
        except:
            pass

    def select_selector_rows_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.SelectAll()
        except:
            pass

    def clear_selector_rows_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            self.dgSelectorAssignments.UnselectAll()
        except:
            pass

    def apply_bulk_creator_click(self, sender, args):
        rows = []
        try:
            for row in self.dgCreatorAssignments.SelectedItems:
                rows.append(row)
        except:
            pass
        if not rows:
            forms.alert("Select one or more creator rows.", warn_icon=True)
            return
        self.apply_bulk_to_creator_rows(rows)

    def apply_bulk_selector_click(self, sender, args):
        rows = []
        try:
            for row in self.dgSelectorAssignments.SelectedItems:
                rows.append(row)
        except:
            pass
        if not rows:
            forms.alert("Select one or more selector rows.", warn_icon=True)
            return
        self.apply_bulk_to_selector_rows(rows)

    def auto_plan_order_click(self, sender, args):
        self.auto_plan_order()

    def auto_section_order_click(self, sender, args):
        self.auto_section_order()

    def auto_selector_order_click(self, sender, args):
        self.auto_selector_order()

    def assignment_direction_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        # Ignore binding-initialisation fires (container creation sets SelectedItem from null
        # to a value; only an actual user change has a non-empty RemovedItems list).
        try:
            if args.RemovedItems.Count == 0:
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        self._refresh_creator_warnings()
        self._update_required_field_highlights()
        if self._is_stage2_snapshot():
            self.render_stage2_snapshot_selected(True)
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def assignment_viewport_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        try:
            if args.RemovedItems.Count == 0:
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def selector_assignment_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        try:
            if args.RemovedItems.Count == 0:
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def creator_grid_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        if not self.creator_rows_dirty:
            self._refresh_creator_warnings()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def selector_grid_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def section_snapshot_grid_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return
        if not self.creator_rows_dirty:
            self._refresh_creator_warnings()
        self._update_required_field_highlights()
        self.render_stage2_snapshot_selected(True)
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def preview_click(self, sender, args):
        # Preview button is for sheet layout preview (Stage 3 right pane),
        # while Stage 2 image refresh is handled by the dedicated Refresh button.
        self._show_stage2_preview_tab()
        self.state.PreviewDirty = True
        self.render_preview()

    def create_click(self, sender, args):
        if not self.validate_before_create():
            return

        try:
            self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
            result_message = self.create_views_and_optionally_place()
            self.refresh_summary(True)
            self.mark_preview_dirty()
            if result_message:
                forms.alert(result_message)
            self.Close()
        except Exception:
            self.end_progress()
            raise

    def cancel_click(self, sender, args):
        self.Close()


def build_window():
    xaml_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "ViewCreator.xaml")
    if not os.path.exists(xaml_path):
        forms.alert("Missing ViewCreator.xaml next to script.py", exitscript=True)
    return ViewCreatorWindow(xaml_path)


def run():
    window = build_window()
    window.ShowDialog()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import traceback
    try:
        run()
    except Exception as ex:
        forms.alert(
            "Unhandled error:\n\n{0}\n\n{1}".format(str(ex), traceback.format_exc()),
            warn_icon=True
        )

# Scope Box View Creation

## Purpose
Create and lay out views on sheets from a scope-box driven workflow with a WPF creator and selector interface.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`
- `ViewCreator.xaml`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local workflow logic in `script.py`
- Optional shared detail-move behavior imported from `lib/detailmove_engine.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Do not mix static `ComboBoxItem` children with dynamic `ItemsSource` population.
- Keep view collection, preview, and creation/layout logic clearly separated.
- Protect transaction boundaries around any view or sheet mutation.

## Working Notes
- Read the XAML first, then trace event handlers and execution paths in `script.py`.
- If the workflow grows further, prefer extracting reusable creation logic into `lib` rather than adding more monolithic script code.

                                    <CheckBox x:Name="chkCreateSections"

                                              Unchecked="toggle_sections"/>

                                    <TextBlock x:Name="txtSectionViewCount"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,4"
                                               Foreground="DimGray"
                                               Text="Section views: 0"/>

                                    <StackPanel x:Name="pnlSectionSettings">
                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Name Pattern"/>
                                            <TextBox x:Name="tbSectionNamePattern" Grid.Column="1" TextChanged="stage1_name_pattern_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>

                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtSectionNameExample"
                                                   Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                   Foreground="DimGray"
                                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                   Text="Section example: automatic"/>

                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Side"/>
                                            <ComboBox x:Name="cbSectionDefaultDirection" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>

                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Create Mode"/>
                                            <ComboBox x:Name="cbSectionCreateMode" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>

                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Type"/>
                                            <ComboBox x:Name="cbSectionType" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>

                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Template"/>
                                            <ComboBox x:Name="cbSectionTemplate" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>

                                        <Grid>
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Min Height (mm)"/>
                                            <TextBox x:Name="tbMinSectionHeight" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                        </Grid>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </GroupBox>

                            <Button x:Name="btnProceedToSheetStage"
                                    Width="240"
                                    Height="30"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Content="Run Stage 1: Create/Collect Views"
                                    Click="proceed_to_sheet_layout_click"/>

                            <Border x:Name="bdrStage1InlineStatus"
                                    Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Padding="8"
                                    Background="#FFF7FAFD"
                                    BorderBrush="#FFD0DCE8"
                                    BorderThickness="1">
                                <StackPanel>
                                    <TextBlock x:Name="txtStage1InlineStatus"
                                               Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                               Foreground="DimGray"
                                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                               Text="Stage 1 status: idle."/>
                                    <ProgressBar x:Name="pbStage1InlineProgress"
                                                 Height="14"
                                                 Minimum="0"
                                                 Maximum="100"
                                                 Value="0"
                                                 Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Border>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </Grid>

                        <StackPanel x:Name="pnlSelectorMode" Visibility="Collapsed">

                            <GroupBox Header="1. View Selector Filters" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <StackPanel Margin="10">

                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="View Name Filter"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbViewFilter" Grid.Column="1" TextChanged="selector_filter_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>

                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="View Type"/>
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="cbSelectorViewType" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="selector_filter_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>

                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Associated Level"/>
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="cbSelectorLevelFilter" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="selector_filter_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>

                                    <Grid>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Sheet Status"/>
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="cbSelectorPlacedFilter" Grid.Column="1" SelectionChanged="selector_filter_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </GroupBox>

                            <GroupBox Header="2. Existing Views" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                <Grid Margin="10">
                                    <ListBox x:Name="lbSelectedViews"
                                             Height="290"
                                             SelectionMode="Extended"
                                             SelectionChanged="selector_views_changed"
                                             VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                             VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                                             ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </GroupBox>

                            <Button x:Name="btnProceedSelectorStage"
                                    Width="260"
                                    Height="30"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Margin="0,0,0,10"
                                    Content="Run Stage 1: Collect Selected Views"
                                    Click="proceed_to_sheet_layout_click"/>
                        </StackPanel>

                                </StackPanel>
                            </TabItem>

                            <TabItem x:Name="tabSectionStage" Header="2. Section Snapshot">
                                <StackPanel Margin="0,8,0,0">
                                    <GroupBox Header="Section Snapshot Controls" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                        <StackPanel Margin="10">
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                       Foreground="DimGray"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Text="Preview plan/section snapshots, then adjust section cut side and level-based vertical offsets before Sheet Layout."/>

                                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Section Cut Side"/>
                                                <ComboBox x:Name="cbStage2SectionSide"
                                                          Grid.Column="1"
                                                          SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                            </Grid>

                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Button x:Name="btnStage2PickPlanRotation"
                                                        Width="220"
                                                        Height="26"
                                                        Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                        Content="Pick Plan Rotation"
                                                        Click="stage2_pick_plan_rotation_click"/>

                                                <Button x:Name="btnStage2PickSectionAlignment"
                                                        Width="250"
                                                        Height="26"
                                                        Content="Pick Section Alignment (Aligned)"
                                                        Click="stage2_pick_section_alignment_click"/>
                                            </StackPanel>

                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                       Foreground="DimGray"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Text="Pick an edge first (preferred). If cancelled or unavailable, pick two points. Use Section Side = Aligned to apply custom section orientation."/>

                                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Target Lower Level"/>
                                                <ComboBox x:Name="cbStage2LowerLevel"
                                                          Grid.Column="1"
                                                          SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                            </Grid>

                                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Target Upper Level"/>
                                                <ComboBox x:Name="cbStage2UpperLevel"
                                                          Grid.Column="1"
                                                          SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                            </Grid>

                                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Lower Offset (mm)"/>
                                                <TextBox x:Name="tbSectionBottomOffset"
                                                         Grid.Column="1"
                                                         LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                            </Grid>

                                            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Upper Offset (mm)"/>
                                                <TextBox x:Name="tbSectionTopOffset"
                                                         Grid.Column="1"
                                                         LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                            </Grid>

                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                <Button x:Name="btnApplySectionSnapshotSettings"
                                                        Width="220"
                                                        Height="28"
                                                        Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                                        Content="Apply To Selected Rows"
                                                        Click="apply_section_snapshot_settings_click"/>

                                                <Button x:Name="btnReadSectionSnapshotMapping"
                                                    Width="220"
                                                    Height="28"
                                                    Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                                    Content="Read Current Extents"
                                                    Click="stage2_read_vertical_from_sections_click"/>

                                                <Button x:Name="btnProceedToStage3"
                                                        Width="220"
                                                        Height="28"
                                                        Content="Proceed to Stage 3: Sheet Layout"
                                                        Click="proceed_to_stage3_click"/>
                                            </StackPanel>

                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,8,0,0"
                                                       Foreground="DimGray"
                                                       Text="Tip: select rows below, then Apply. If no rows are selected, Apply targets all section rows."/>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </GroupBox>

                                    <GroupBox Header="Section Snapshot Row Manager" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                        <Grid Margin="8">
                                            <DataGrid x:Name="dgSectionSnapshot"
                                                      AutoGenerateColumns="False"
                                                      CanUserAddRows="False"
                                                      CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                                                      CanUserReorderColumns="False"
                                                      SelectionMode="Extended"
                                                      SelectionUnit="FullRow"
                                                      HeadersVisibility="Column"
                                                      IsReadOnly="False"
                                                      EnableRowVirtualization="True"
                                                      EnableColumnVirtualization="True"
                                                      VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                                      VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                                                      ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"
                                                      SelectionChanged="section_snapshot_selection_changed"
                                                      CellEditEnding="section_snapshot_grid_changed">

                                                <DataGrid.Columns>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Source" Binding="{Binding ScopeBoxName}" Width="220" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Level" Binding="{Binding LevelName}" Width="180" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                    <DataGridCheckBoxColumn Header="Create Section" Binding="{Binding CreateSection, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="100"/>

                                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Section Side" Width="120">
                                                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                            <DataTemplate>
                                                                <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding DirectionChoices}"
                                                                          SelectedItem="{Binding SectionDirection, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                                          SelectionChanged="assignment_direction_changed"/>
                                                            </DataTemplate>
                                                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Target Lower" Width="130">
                                                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                            <DataTemplate>
                                                                <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding LevelNameChoices}"
                                                                          SelectedItem="{Binding SectionLowerLevelName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                                          SelectionChanged="section_snapshot_grid_changed"/>
                                                            </DataTemplate>
                                                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Lower Off (mm)" Binding="{Binding SectionBottomOffsetMm, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="105"/>

                                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Target Upper" Width="130">
                                                        <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                            <DataTemplate>
                                                                <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding LevelNameChoices}"
                                                                          SelectedItem="{Binding SectionUpperLevelName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                                          SelectionChanged="section_snapshot_grid_changed"/>
                                                            </DataTemplate>
                                                        </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Upper Off (mm)" Binding="{Binding SectionTopOffsetMm, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="105"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Warning" Binding="{Binding Warning}" Width="260" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                </DataGrid.Columns>
                                            </DataGrid>
                                        </Grid>
                                    </GroupBox>

                                    <GroupBox Header="Stage 1 View Name Editor" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                                        <StackPanel Margin="8">
                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                       Foreground="DimGray"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Text="Review and edit Plan/Section names produced by Stage 1 before continuing to Sheet Layout."/>

                                            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                <Button x:Name="btnStage1RefreshViewNames"
                                                        Width="190"
                                                        Height="26"
                                                        Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                        Content="Refresh Stage 1 Names"
                                                        Click="stage1_refresh_view_names_click"/>

                                                <Button x:Name="btnStage1ApplyViewNames"
                                                        Width="220"
                                                        Height="26"
                                                        Content="Apply Edited View Names"
                                                        Click="stage1_apply_view_names_click"/>
                                            </StackPanel>

                                            <DataGrid x:Name="dgStage1ViewNames"
                                                      Height="210"
                                                      AutoGenerateColumns="False"
                                                      CanUserAddRows="False"
                                                      CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                                                      CanUserReorderColumns="False"
                                                      SelectionMode="Extended"
                                                      SelectionUnit="FullRow"
                                                      HeadersVisibility="Column"
                                                      IsReadOnly="False"
                                                      EnableRowVirtualization="True"
                                                      EnableColumnVirtualization="True"
                                                      VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                                      VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                                                      ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"
                                                      CellEditEnding="stage1_view_name_grid_changed">
                                                <DataGrid.Columns>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Source" Binding="{Binding SourceLabel}" Width="200" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Level" Binding="{Binding LevelName}" Width="120" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Plan Name" Binding="{Binding PlanName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="300"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Section Name" Binding="{Binding SectionName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="340"/>
                                                    <DataGridTextColumn Header="Status" Binding="{Binding Status}" Width="230" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                                </DataGrid.Columns>
                                            </DataGrid>
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </GroupBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </TabItem>

                            <TabItem x:Name="tabSheetStage" Header="3. Sheet Layout">
                                <StackPanel Margin="0,8,0,0">

                        <GroupBox Header="5. Layout Type" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                            <StackPanel Margin="10">

                                <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Layout Preset"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbLayoutPreset"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              SelectionChanged="layout_preset_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Layout Type"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbLayoutType"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              SelectionChanged="layout_type_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <StackPanel x:Name="pnlGridOptions">
                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Grid Columns"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbGridColumns" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>

                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Grid Rows"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbGridRows" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>

                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Unequal Rows"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbUnequalRowPattern"
                                                 Grid.Column="1"
                                                 ToolTip="Comma-separated columns per row, e.g. 4,5,3"
                                                 LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Horizontal Gap (mm)"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbHorizontalGap" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Vertical Gap (mm)"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbVerticalGap" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Sheet Margin (mm)"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbSheetMargin" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <StackPanel x:Name="pnlPlanLayoutOptions">
                                    <Grid Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Plan Position"/>
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="cbPlanPosition"
                                                  Grid.Column="1"
                                                  SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Flow Direction"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbFlowDirection"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                </Grid>

                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkWrapSheetOverflow"
                                          Margin="0,8,0,0"
                                          Content="Wrap overflow to next sheet"
                                          ToolTip="When enabled, if computed view extents exceed the usable titleblock region, remaining views are moved to the next sheet automatically."
                                          Checked="setup_changed"
                                          Unchecked="setup_changed"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="6. Create Mode" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                            <StackPanel Margin="10">
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                    <RadioButton x:Name="rbViewsOnly"
                                                 Margin="0,0,14,0"
                                                 Content="Views Only"
                                                 GroupName="CreateMode"
                                                 Checked="create_mode_changed"/>
                                    <RadioButton x:Name="rbViewsAndSheets"
                                                 Content="Views + Sheets"
                                                 GroupName="CreateMode"
                                                 Checked="create_mode_changed"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="7. Sheet Settings" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                            <StackPanel Margin="10">

                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkCreateSheets"
                                          Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                          Content="Create / Place on Sheets"
                                          Checked="toggle_sheets"
                                          Unchecked="toggle_sheets"/>

                                <StackPanel x:Name="pnlSheetMode" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,6" FontWeight="Bold" Text="Sheet Mode"/>
                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                        <RadioButton x:Name="rbNewSheets"
                                                     Margin="0,0,14,0"
                                                     Content="Create New Sheets"
                                                     GroupName="SheetMode"
                                                     Checked="sheet_mode_changed"/>
                                        <RadioButton x:Name="rbExistingSheets"
                                                     Content="Add to Existing Sheets"
                                                     GroupName="SheetMode"
                                                     Checked="sheet_mode_changed"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkKeepScopeGroups"
                                          Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                          Content="Keep scope boxes on separate sheet groups"
                                          ToolTip="When off, selected scope box rows are packed together across sheets based on layout capacity."
                                          Checked="setup_changed"
                                          Unchecked="setup_changed"/>

                                <GroupBox x:Name="grpNewSheets" Header="New Sheet Options" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid Margin="10">
                                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,8" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Title Block"/>
                                        <ComboBox x:Name="cbTitleBlock"
                                                  Grid.Row="0"
                                                  Grid.Column="1"
                                                  Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                  SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,8" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Sheet Prefix"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbSheetPrefix"
                                                 Grid.Row="1"
                                                 Grid.Column="1"
                                                 Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                 LostFocus="setup_changed"/>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Start Number"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbSheetStart"
                                                 Grid.Row="2"
                                                 Grid.Column="1"
                                                 LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </GroupBox>

                                <GroupBox x:Name="grpExistingSheets" Header="Existing Sheet Pool" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                    <Grid Margin="10">
                                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="170"/>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbSheetFilter"
                                                 Grid.Row="0"
                                                 Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                                 TextChanged="sheet_filter_changed"/>

                                        <ListBox x:Name="lbExistingSheets"
                                                 Grid.Row="1"
                                                 SelectionMode="Extended"
                                                 SelectionChanged="existing_sheets_changed"
                                                 VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                                 VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
