                                                 ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"/>

                                        <Button x:Name="btnSelectPlacedSheets"
                                            Grid.Row="2"
                                            Margin="0,8,0,0"
                                            Width="220"
                                            Height="24"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            Content="Select Sheets Of Selected Views"
                                            Click="select_placed_sheets_click"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </GroupBox>

                                <GroupBox x:Name="grpUsableRegion" Header="Usable Sheet Region Offsets (mm)">
                                    <Grid Margin="10">
                                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="12"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,8" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Reserved Left"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbReservedLeft" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,0,0,8" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="3" Margin="0,0,8,8" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Reserved Right"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbReservedRight" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="4" Margin="0,0,0,8" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Reserved Top"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbReservedTop" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>

                                        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="3" Margin="0,0,8,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Reserved Bottom"/>
                                        <TextBox x:Name="tbReservedBottom" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="4" LostFocus="setup_changed"/>
                                    </Grid>
                                </GroupBox>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </GroupBox>

                        <GroupBox Header="8. Post-Create Stages" Margin="0,0,0,10" Visibility="Collapsed" IsEnabled="False">
                            <StackPanel Margin="10">
                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkEnforceAssocLevel"
                                          Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                          Content="Enforce Associated Level on created/reused views"
                                          IsChecked="True"
                                          Checked="setup_changed"
                                          Unchecked="setup_changed"/>

                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkRemapViewRange"
                                          Margin="20,0,0,8"
                                          Content="Remap View Range when associated level changes"
                                          IsChecked="True"
                                          Checked="setup_changed"
                                          Unchecked="setup_changed"/>

                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkRunSectionMoveStage"
                                          Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                          Content="Run SectionMove stage after create/reuse"
                                          Checked="setup_changed"
                                          Unchecked="setup_changed"/>

                                <Grid>
                                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="145"/>
                                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="SectionMove Mode"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbPostSectionMoveMode"
                                              Grid.Row="0"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                              SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>

                                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Plan View"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbPostSectionMovePlan"
                                              Grid.Row="1"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                              SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>

                                    <TextBlock Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Text="Scope Side"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbPostSectionMoveSide"
                                              Grid.Row="2"
                                              Grid.Column="1"
                                              SelectionChanged="setup_changed"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </GroupBox>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </TabItem>
                        </TabControl>
                    </StackPanel>
                </ScrollViewer>

                <Button x:Name="btnPreview"
                        Grid.Row="1"
                        Width="120"
                        Height="30"
                        Margin="0,10,0,8"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                    Click="preview_click">Preview</Button>

                <Border x:Name="bdrProgress"
                        Grid.Row="2"
                        Padding="8"
                        Background="#FFF3F7FB"
                        BorderBrush="#FF9EB6CE"
                        BorderThickness="1"
                        Visibility="Collapsed">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRunProgressStatus"
                                   Margin="0,0,0,6"
                                   FontWeight="Bold"
                                   Text="Running..."/>
                        <ProgressBar x:Name="pbRunProgress"
                                     Height="18"
                                     Minimum="0"
                                     Maximum="100"
                                     Value="0"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>
            </Grid>

            <Grid x:Name="stageSnapshotPane" Grid.Column="2" Visibility="Collapsed">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <DockPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                    <Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                            x:Name="btnStage2RefreshSnapshots"
                            Height="24"
                            Width="120"
                            Margin="8,0,0,0"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                            Content="Refresh"
                            Click="stage2_refresh_snapshots_click"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="txtStage2SnapshotHint"
                               Margin="0,0,0,0"
                               FontWeight="Bold"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Text="Stage 2 snapshot: rendered rows with Plan View (left) and Section View (right)."/>
                </DockPanel>

                <Border Grid.Row="1" BorderBrush="#FFD0D0D0" BorderThickness="1" Background="WhiteSmoke">
                    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="spStage2SnapshotRows" Margin="8"/>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                </Border>
            </Grid>

            <Grid x:Name="stageLayoutPane" Grid.Column="2">
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                    <TextBlock x:Name="txtSummary"
                               Margin="0,0,0,8"
                               FontWeight="Bold"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"/>

                    <Border x:Name="bdrWarnings"
                            Padding="8"
                            Background="#FFF8E7C2"
                            BorderBrush="#FFD1A84A"
                            BorderThickness="1"
                            Visibility="Collapsed">
                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtWarnings" TextWrapping="Wrap"/>
                    </Border>
                </StackPanel>

                <TabControl x:Name="tabStage2Pane" Grid.Row="1" SelectionChanged="stage2_tab_changed">
                    <TabItem x:Name="tabStage2Assignments" Header="Assignments">
                        <Grid Margin="0,8,0,0">
                            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <GroupBox x:Name="grpCreatorAssignments" Grid.Row="0" Header="Creator Assignment Manager" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                    <Grid Margin="8">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="16"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="16"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                            <CheckBox x:Name="chkAdvancedMode"
                                      Grid.Column="0"
                                      VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                      Content="Advanced Mode"
                                      Checked="advanced_mode_changed"
                                      Unchecked="advanced_mode_changed"/>

                            <Button Grid.Column="2"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="26"
                                    Content="Select All"
                                    Click="select_creator_rows_click"/>

                            <Button Grid.Column="4"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="26"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Content="Clear Selection"
                                    Click="clear_creator_rows_click"/>
                        </Grid>

                        <Border Grid.Row="1"
                                Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                Padding="8"
                                Background="#FFF3F3F3"
                                BorderBrush="#FFD0D0D0"
                                BorderThickness="1">
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="110"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="150"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0"
                                           VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           FontWeight="Bold"
                                           Text="Apply to Selected"/>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Direction"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbBulkSectionDirectionCreator">
                                        <ComboBoxItem>Front</ComboBoxItem>
                                        <ComboBoxItem>Back</ComboBoxItem>
                                        <ComboBoxItem>Left</ComboBoxItem>
                                        <ComboBoxItem>Right</ComboBoxItem>
                                    </ComboBox>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Plan Order"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbBulkPlanOrderCreator"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="3" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Section Order"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbBulkSectionOrderCreator"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="4" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Viewport Type"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbBulkViewportTypeCreator"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="5" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Title Position"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbBulkTitlePositionCreator"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <Button Grid.Column="6"
                                        Width="120"
                                        Height="26"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                        Content="Apply Selected"
                                        Click="apply_bulk_creator_click"/>

                                <Button Grid.Column="7"
                                        Width="120"
                                        Height="26"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                        Content="Auto Plan Order"
                                        Click="auto_plan_order_click"/>

                                <Button Grid.Column="8"
                                        Width="120"
                                        Height="26"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                        Content="Auto Section Order"
                                        Click="auto_section_order_click"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="dgCreatorAssignments"
                                  Grid.Row="2"
                                  AutoGenerateColumns="False"
                                  CanUserAddRows="False"
                                  CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                                  CanUserReorderColumns="False"
                                  SelectionMode="Extended"
                                  SelectionUnit="FullRow"
                                  HeadersVisibility="Column"
                                  IsReadOnly="False"
                                  EnableRowVirtualization="True"
                                  EnableColumnVirtualization="True"
                                  VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                  VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                                  ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"
                                  CellEditEnding="creator_grid_changed">

                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Source" Binding="{Binding ScopeBoxName}" Width="210" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Level" Binding="{Binding LevelName}" Width="180" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridCheckBoxColumn Header="Plan" Binding="{Binding CreatePlan, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="70"/>
                                <DataGridCheckBoxColumn Header="Section" Binding="{Binding CreateSection, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="80"/>

                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Direction" Width="110">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding DirectionChoices}"
                                                      SelectedItem="{Binding SectionDirection, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      SelectionChanged="assignment_direction_changed"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Viewport Type" Width="170">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding ViewportTypeChoices}"
                                                      SelectedItem="{Binding ViewportTypeName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      SelectionChanged="assignment_viewport_changed"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Title Position" Width="140">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding ViewportTitlePositionChoices}"
                                                      SelectedItem="{Binding ViewportTitlePosition, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      SelectionChanged="assignment_viewport_changed"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                <DataGridTextColumn x:Name="colCreatorPlanOrder" Header="Plan Order" Binding="{Binding PlanOrder, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="90"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn x:Name="colCreatorSectionOrder" Header="Section Order" Binding="{Binding SectionOrder, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Plan Tag" Binding="{Binding PlanTag}" Width="80" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Section Tag" Binding="{Binding SectionTag}" Width="90" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn x:Name="colCreatorWarning" Header="Warning" Binding="{Binding Warning}" Width="280" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                            </DataGrid.Columns>
                        </DataGrid>
                    </Grid>
                </GroupBox>

                <GroupBox x:Name="grpSelectorAssignments" Grid.Row="1" Header="Selector Layout Manager" Margin="0,0,0,8" Visibility="Collapsed">
                    <Grid Margin="8">
                        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                        <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="16"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="16"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       FontWeight="Bold"
                                       Text="Selected Views"/>

                            <Button Grid.Column="2"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="26"
                                    Content="Select All"
                                    Click="select_selector_rows_click"/>

                            <Button Grid.Column="4"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="26"
                                    HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                    Content="Clear Selection"
                                    Click="clear_selector_rows_click"/>
                        </Grid>

                        <Border Grid.Row="1"
                                Margin="0,0,0,8"
                                Padding="8"
                                Background="#FFF3F3F3"
                                BorderBrush="#FFD0D0D0"
                                BorderThickness="1">
                            <Grid>
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="160"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="150"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Order"/>
                                    <TextBox x:Name="tbBulkOrderSelector"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Viewport Type"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbBulkViewportTypeSelector"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2" Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                    <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Title Position"/>
                                    <ComboBox x:Name="cbBulkTitlePositionSelector"/>
                                </StackPanel>

                                <Button Grid.Column="3"
                                        Width="120"
                                        Height="26"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                        Content="Apply Selected"
                                        Click="apply_bulk_selector_click"/>

                                <Button Grid.Column="4"
                                        Width="120"
                                        Height="26"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Bottom"
                                        Content="Auto Order"
                                        Click="auto_selector_order_click"/>
                            </Grid>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="dgSelectorAssignments"
                                  Grid.Row="2"
                                  AutoGenerateColumns="False"
                                  CanUserAddRows="False"
                                  CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                                  CanUserReorderColumns="False"
                                  SelectionMode="Extended"
                                  SelectionUnit="FullRow"
                                  HeadersVisibility="Column"
                                  IsReadOnly="False"
                                  EnableRowVirtualization="True"
                                  EnableColumnVirtualization="True"
                                  VirtualizingPanel.IsVirtualizing="True"
                                  VirtualizingPanel.VirtualizationMode="Recycling"
                                  ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll="True"
                                  CellEditEnding="selector_grid_changed">

                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="View Name" Binding="{Binding ViewName}" Width="260" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="View Type" Binding="{Binding ViewTypeName}" Width="120" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Associated Level" Binding="{Binding LevelName}" Width="160" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Placed" Binding="{Binding PlacedText}" Width="80" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Current Sheet" Binding="{Binding CurrentSheetLabel}" Width="240" IsReadOnly="True"/>

                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Viewport Type" Width="170">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding ViewportTypeChoices}"
                                                      SelectedItem="{Binding ViewportTypeName, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      SelectionChanged="selector_assignment_changed"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="Title Position" Width="140">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <ComboBox ItemsSource="{Binding ViewportTitlePositionChoices}"
                                                      SelectedItem="{Binding ViewportTitlePosition, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}"
                                                      SelectionChanged="selector_assignment_changed"/>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>

                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Order" Binding="{Binding Order, Mode=TwoWay, UpdateSourceTrigger=PropertyChanged}" Width="80"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Warning" Binding="{Binding Warning}" Width="240" IsReadOnly="True"/>
                            </DataGrid.Columns>
                        </DataGrid>
                    </Grid>
                </GroupBox>

                        </Grid>
                    </TabItem>

                    <TabItem x:Name="tabStage2Preview" Header="Sheet Preview">
                <GroupBox Header="Preview" Margin="0,8,0,0">
                    <DockPanel Margin="8">
                        <Grid DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                            <TextBlock x:Name="txtPreviewHint"
                                       Grid.Column="0"
                                       Margin="0,0,12,0"
                                       Foreground="DimGray"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Text="Select source data, then click Preview."/>

                                                                <CheckBox x:Name="chkSummaryPreviewMode"
                                                                  Grid.Column="1"
                                                                  Margin="0,0,12,0"
                                                                  VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                  IsChecked="False"
                                                                  Content="Summary-only for very large sets"
                                                                  ToolTip="When off, detailed preview sheets stay available (truncated by sheet limit)."
                                                                  Checked="setup_changed"
                                                                  Unchecked="setup_changed"/>

                                                                <StackPanel Grid.Column="2"
                                                                Margin="0,0,12,0"
                                                                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                            <TextBlock Margin="0,0,6,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="DimGray" Text="Sheet Limit"/>
                                                            <ComboBox x:Name="cbPreviewCardLimit" Width="74" SelectionChanged="setup_changed">
                                                                <ComboBoxItem Content="4"/>
                                                                <ComboBoxItem Content="8"/>
                                                                <ComboBoxItem Content="12"/>
                                                                <ComboBoxItem Content="20"/>
                                                                <ComboBoxItem Content="All"/>
                                                            </ComboBox>
                                                            </StackPanel>

                            <Button x:Name="btnResetFreeFormPositions"
                                    Grid.Column="3"
                                    Width="180"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Visibility="Collapsed"
                                    Content="Reset Free-Form Positions"
                                    Click="clear_freeform_positions_click"/>
                        </Grid>

                            <WrapPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                <TextBlock Margin="0,4,10,0" FontWeight="Bold" Text="Free-Form Align"/>
                                <Button x:Name="btnAlignViewsBottom"
                                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                    Width="120"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Content="Views Bottom"
                                    Click="align_selected_views_bottom_click"/>
                                <Button x:Name="btnAlignViewsLeft"
                                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Content="Views Left"
                                    Click="align_selected_views_left_click"/>
                                <Button x:Name="btnAlignTitlesBottom"
                                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                    Width="120"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Content="Titles Baseline"
                                    Click="align_selected_titles_bottom_click"/>
                                <Button x:Name="btnAlignTitlesLeft"
                                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                    Width="110"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Content="Titles Left"
                                    Click="align_selected_titles_left_click"/>
                                <Button x:Name="btnClearFreeFormSelection"
                                    Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                    Width="120"
                                    Height="24"
                                    Content="Clear Selection"
                                    Click="clear_freeform_selection_click"/>
                            </WrapPanel>
                        <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                                      CanContentScroll="True">
                            <StackPanel x:Name="spPreviewCards"/>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </DockPanel>
                </GroupBox>
                    </TabItem>
                </TabControl>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>

        <StackPanel Grid.Row="2"
                    Orientation="Horizontal"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                    Margin="0,12,0,0">
            <Button x:Name="btnCreate"
                    Width="100"
                    Height="28"
                    Margin="0,0,8,0"
                    Click="create_click">Create</Button>
            <Button x:Name="btnCancel"
                    Width="100"
                    Height="28"
                    Click="cancel_click">Cancel</Button>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>
```

## FILE_START: RBG_SYD_Tools_Working.tab/RBG Tools_Views.panel/ViewStack2.stack/SectionUpdater.pushbutton/DetailMoveWindow.xaml
## META: sha1=a11245d0fb5d46abbcb5e619a2605b97df86ff17 size=12618
## TYPE: text
```
<Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Section/Detail Vertical Extension Updater"
        Height="960"
        Width="1360"
    MinHeight="860"
    MinWidth="1180"
        ResizeMode="CanResize"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
    Topmost="False">

    <DockPanel Margin="12">

        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <TextBlock FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Text="Section/Detail Vertical Extension Updater"/>
            <TextBlock Margin="0,4,0,0" Text="Stage-based tool with per-view explicit vertical mapping"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <Grid DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,10">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="420"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="340"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <GroupBox Header="Targets" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,10,0">
                <Grid Margin="10">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0">
                        <TextBlock Name="TxtActiveView" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                        <TextBlock Name="TxtScopeBox" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

                        <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,4" FontWeight="Bold">Name filter</TextBlock>
                        <TextBox Name="TxtNameFilter" Width="280" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>

                        <TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,4" FontWeight="Bold">Sort</TextBlock>
                        <ComboBox Name="CmbSortTargets" Width="180" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                            <ComboBoxItem Content="Name A-Z"/>
                            <ComboBoxItem Content="Name Z-A"/>
                            <ComboBoxItem Content="View Id"/>
                        </ComboBox>

                        <CheckBox Name="ChkVisibleInPlanOnly" Margin="0,0,0,8">Visible in selected plan only</CheckBox>

                        <WrapPanel Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Button Name="BtnRefreshTargets" Width="140" Height="28" Margin="0,0,8,0">Refresh</Button>
                            <Button Name="BtnPickScopeBox" Width="120" Height="28">Pick Scope Box</Button>
                        </WrapPanel>
                        <WrapPanel Margin="0,0,0,8">
                            <Button Name="BtnSelectAll" Width="100" Height="26" Margin="0,0,8,0">Select All</Button>
                            <Button Name="BtnSelectNone" Width="100" Height="26">Select None</Button>
                        </WrapPanel>
                        <CheckBox Name="ChkSelectionOnly">Selection only / no updates</CheckBox>
                        <TextBlock Name="TxtTargetCount" Margin="0,8,0,4"/>

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = 'Section/Detail Updater'
__doc____ = 'Update section and detail views to match the view template of the parent view.'

import os
import sys

from pyrevit import forms

bundle_dir = os.path.dirname(__file__)
lib_dir = os.path.join(bundle_dir, 'lib')

if lib_dir not in sys.path:
    sys.path.append(lib_dir)

from detailmove_ui import DetailMoveWindow
from detailmove_engine import run_detailmove


def main():
    xaml_path = os.path.join(bundle_dir, 'DetailMoveWindow.xaml')

    if not os.path.exists(xaml_path):
        forms.alert('Missing XAML:\n{}'.format(xaml_path), exitscript=True)

    window = DetailMoveWindow(xaml_path)
    payload = window.show()

    if payload:
        run_detailmove(payload)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Section Move

## Purpose
Drive the DetailMove workflow for staging, previewing, and executing section or detail relocation tasks through a dedicated WPF window.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`
- `DetailMoveWindow.xaml`

## Owning Dependencies
- `lib/detailmove_ui.py`
- `lib/detailmove_engine.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Keep `script.py` as a thin launcher only.
- Preserve `StageMapRows` as the single vertical mapping panel model used by the UI.
- Keep UI-side execution aligned with the current in-window full run pattern and structured result payloads.

## Working Notes
- Start in `lib/detailmove_ui.py` for WPF behavior and `lib/detailmove_engine.py` for execution logic.
- UI changes should continue to surface run summaries without depending on pyRevit console-only output.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

try:
	telemetry = __import__("telemetry")
	telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
	pass

__title__ = "Sheet # of #"
__doc__ = "Analyze active titleblock parameters and update Sheet # of # values by sheet scope."

import os
import sys
import importlib

from pyrevit import revit, forms, script


def _find_extension_root(start_path):
	current = os.path.abspath(start_path)
	if os.path.isfile(current):
		current = os.path.dirname(current)
	while True:
		base = os.path.basename(current)
		if base.lower().endswith(".extension"):
			return current
		parent = os.path.dirname(current)
		if parent == current:
			return None
		current = parent


_ext_root = _find_extension_root(__file__)
if _ext_root is None:
	forms.alert("Could not locate extension root from this script path.", exitscript=True)

_lib_dir = os.path.join(_ext_root, "lib")
if _lib_dir not in sys.path:
	sys.path.insert(0, _lib_dir)

_engine = importlib.import_module("sheet_no_of_no_engine")
apply_sheet_no_of_no = _engine.apply_sheet_no_of_no
analyze_titleblock_parameters = _engine.analyze_titleblock_parameters
filter_sheets = _engine.filter_sheets
get_all_sheets = _engine.get_all_sheets
get_sheet_set_names = _engine.get_sheet_set_names
get_sheets_from_sheet_set = _engine.get_sheets_from_sheet_set
format_candidate_label = _engine.format_candidate_label
parse_candidate_key = _engine.parse_candidate_key
collect_titleblocks = _engine.collect_titleblocks


doc = revit.doc
output = script.get_output()


class SheetRow(object):
	def __init__(self, sheet):
		self.Sheet = sheet
		self.SheetNumber = sheet.SheetNumber or ""
		self.SheetName = sheet.Name or ""
		self._num_l = self.SheetNumber.lower()
		self._name_l = self.SheetName.lower()


class PreviewRow(object):
	def __init__(self, sheet_name, current_no, expected_no, current_total, expected_total):
		self.SheetName = sheet_name
		self.CurrentSheetNo = str(current_no)
		self.ExpectedSheetNo = str(expected_no)
		self.CurrentOfNo = str(current_total)
		self.ExpectedOfNo = str(expected_total)


class SheetNoOfNoWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
	def __init__(self, xaml_path):
		forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)

		self._all_sheets = get_all_sheets(doc)
		self._sheet_sets = get_sheet_set_names(doc)
		self._scope_sheet_rows = []
		self._visible_rows = []
		self._param_key_by_label = {}
		self._label_by_param_key = {}
		self._analysis = None
		self._suspend_preview_refresh = False
		self._tb_by_sheet = {}

		self.TxtModelSummary = self.FindName("TxtModelSummary")
		self.CmbScope = self.FindName("CmbScope")
		self.TxtSheetSetLabel = self.FindName("TxtSheetSetLabel")
		self.CmbSheetSet = self.FindName("CmbSheetSet")
		self.CmbSheetNoParam = self.FindName("CmbSheetNoParam")
		self.CmbOfParam = self.FindName("CmbOfParam")

		self.TxtFilter = self.FindName("TxtFilter")
		self.BtnSelectAllVisible = self.FindName("BtnSelectAllVisible")
		self.BtnClearSelection = self.FindName("BtnClearSelection")
		self.GridSheets = self.FindName("GridSheets")

		self.TxtSelectionSummary = self.FindName("TxtSelectionSummary")
		self.GridPreview = self.FindName("GridPreview")
		self.TxtStatus = self.FindName("TxtStatus")
		self.BtnApply = self.FindName("BtnApply")
		self.BtnClose = self.FindName("BtnClose")

		if self.TxtModelSummary:
			self.TxtModelSummary.Text = "Model sheets: {0}".format(len(self._all_sheets))

		self.CmbScope.ItemsSource = ["All Sheets", "Selected Sheets (Filtered)", "Sheet Set"]
		self.CmbScope.SelectedIndex = 0

		self.CmbSheetSet.ItemsSource = self._sheet_sets
		if self._sheet_sets:
			self.CmbSheetSet.SelectedIndex = 0

		self.CmbScope.SelectionChanged += self._scope_changed
		self.CmbSheetSet.SelectionChanged += self._sheet_set_changed
		self.TxtFilter.TextChanged += self._filter_changed
		self.CmbSheetNoParam.SelectionChanged += self._param_changed
		self.CmbOfParam.SelectionChanged += self._param_changed
		self.BtnSelectAllVisible.Click += self._select_all_visible_click
		self.BtnClearSelection.Click += self._clear_selection_click
		self.BtnApply.Click += self._apply_click
		self.BtnClose.Click += self._close_click

		self._update_scope_controls()
		self._load_scope_rows(select_all=True)
		self._refresh_analysis_and_params()
		self._refresh_preview()

	def OnSheetSelectionChanged(self, sender, args):
		if self._suspend_preview_refresh:
			return
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _status(self, text):
		if self.TxtStatus:
			self.TxtStatus.Text = text

	def _scope_changed(self, sender, args):
		self._update_scope_controls()
		self._load_scope_rows(select_all=True)
		self._refresh_analysis_and_params()
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _sheet_set_changed(self, sender, args):
		if self._scope_value() != "Sheet Set":
			return
		self._load_scope_rows(select_all=True)
		self._refresh_analysis_and_params()
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _filter_changed(self, sender, args):
		auto_select = self._scope_value() == "All Sheets"
		self._apply_filter_to_rows(preserve_selection=(not auto_select), auto_select_visible=auto_select)
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _param_changed(self, sender, args):
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _select_all_visible_click(self, sender, args):
		self._set_selected_rows(self._visible_rows)
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _clear_selection_click(self, sender, args):
		self._set_selected_rows([])
		self._refresh_preview()

	def _close_click(self, sender, args):
		self.Close()

	def _scope_value(self):
		value = self.CmbScope.SelectedItem
		return str(value) if value else "All Sheets"

	def _current_scope_sheets(self):
		scope = self._scope_value()
		if scope == "Sheet Set":
			set_name = self.CmbSheetSet.SelectedItem
			if not set_name:
				return []
			return get_sheets_from_sheet_set(doc, str(set_name))
		return list(self._all_sheets)

	def _update_scope_controls(self):
		is_set = self._scope_value() == "Sheet Set"
		self.CmbSheetSet.IsEnabled = is_set
		self.TxtSheetSetLabel.Opacity = 1.0 if is_set else 0.45
		self.CmbSheetSet.Opacity = 1.0 if is_set else 0.45

	def _load_scope_rows(self, select_all=False):
		sheets = self._current_scope_sheets()
		self._scope_sheet_rows = [SheetRow(sheet) for sheet in sheets]
		self._scope_sheet_rows.sort(key=lambda row: (row.SheetNumber, row.SheetName))
		self._apply_filter_to_rows(preserve_selection=False, auto_select_visible=False)
		if select_all:
			self._set_selected_rows(self._visible_rows)

	def _set_selected_rows(self, rows):
		self._suspend_preview_refresh = True
		try:
			self.GridSheets.SelectedItems.Clear()
			for row in rows:
				self.GridSheets.SelectedItems.Add(row)
		finally:
			self._suspend_preview_refresh = False

	def _apply_filter_to_rows(self, preserve_selection=True, auto_select_visible=False):
		selected_ids = set()
		if preserve_selection:
			for row in list(self.GridSheets.SelectedItems):
				try:
					selected_ids.add(row.Sheet.Id.IntegerValue)
				except Exception:
					pass

		query = (self.TxtFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
		if query:
			visible = []
			for row in self._scope_sheet_rows:
				if query in row._num_l or query in row._name_l:
					visible.append(row)
			self._visible_rows = visible
		else:
			self._visible_rows = list(self._scope_sheet_rows)

		self.GridSheets.ItemsSource = None
		self.GridSheets.ItemsSource = self._visible_rows

		if auto_select_visible:
			self._set_selected_rows(self._visible_rows)
		elif preserve_selection and selected_ids:
			rows_to_select = []
			for row in self._visible_rows:
				if row.Sheet.Id.IntegerValue in selected_ids:
					rows_to_select.append(row)
			self._set_selected_rows(rows_to_select)

	def _analysis_sheets(self):
		return [row.Sheet for row in self._scope_sheet_rows]

	def _current_param_value(self, sheet, candidate_key):
		if not candidate_key:
			return ""
		source, pname = parse_candidate_key(candidate_key)

		if source == "sheet":
			param = sheet.LookupParameter(pname)
			return self._param_as_text(param)

		tbs = self._tb_by_sheet.get(sheet.Id.IntegerValue, [])
		if not tbs:
			return ""

		first_value = None
		mixed = False
		for tb in tbs:
			value = self._param_as_text(tb.LookupParameter(pname))
			if first_value is None:
				first_value = value
			elif value != first_value:
				mixed = True
				break

		if mixed:
			return "<mixed>"
		return "" if first_value is None else first_value

	def _param_as_text(self, param):
		if param is None:
			return ""
		try:
			storage = param.StorageType
			if storage.ToString() == "String":
				return param.AsString() or ""
			if storage.ToString() == "Integer":
				return str(param.AsInteger())
			if storage.ToString() == "Double":
				value = param.AsDouble()
				if abs(value - round(value)) < 1e-9:
					return str(int(round(value)))
				return "{0:.6f}".format(value)
		except Exception:
			return ""
		return ""

	def _selected_sheets(self):
		selected = []
		for row in list(self.GridSheets.SelectedItems):
			selected.append(row.Sheet)
		selected.sort(key=lambda s: ((s.SheetNumber or ""), (s.Name or "")))
		return selected

	def _refresh_analysis_and_params(self):
		scope_sheets = self._analysis_sheets()
		self._analysis = analyze_titleblock_parameters(doc, scope_sheets)
		_, self._tb_by_sheet = collect_titleblocks(doc)

		param_keys = self._analysis.get("parameter_keys") or []
		self._param_key_by_label = {}
		self._label_by_param_key = {}
		for key in param_keys:
			label = format_candidate_label(key)
			self._param_key_by_label[label] = key
			self._label_by_param_key[key] = label

		labels = sorted(self._param_key_by_label.keys())
		self.CmbSheetNoParam.ItemsSource = labels
		self.CmbOfParam.ItemsSource = labels

		default_index, default_total = self._resolve_default_param_keys(param_keys, self._analysis)
		if default_index and default_index in self._label_by_param_key:
			self.CmbSheetNoParam.SelectedItem = self._label_by_param_key[default_index]
		elif labels:
			self.CmbSheetNoParam.SelectedIndex = 0

		if default_total and default_total in self._label_by_param_key:
			self.CmbOfParam.SelectedItem = self._label_by_param_key[default_total]
		elif labels:
			self.CmbOfParam.SelectedIndex = 0 if len(labels) == 1 else 1

		auto_idx = self._analysis.get("index_param")
		auto_total = self._analysis.get("total_param")
		if auto_idx and auto_total:
			self._status(
				"Analysis ready. Default parameters: {0} and {1}".format(
					format_candidate_label(auto_idx),
					format_candidate_label(auto_total)
				)
			)
		else:
			self._status("Analysis ready. Pick parameters, then select sheets and apply.")

	def _resolve_default_param_keys(self, param_keys, analysis):
		def norm(value):
			text = "" if value is None else str(value)
			return "".join(ch for ch in text.lower() if ch.isalnum())

		index_pref = None
		total_pref = None
		for key in param_keys:
			parts = key.split("|", 1)
			if len(parts) != 2:
				continue
			source = parts[0]
			name = norm(parts[1])

			if index_pref is None and source == "sheet" and name == "tbsheetno":
				index_pref = key
			if total_pref is None and source == "sheet" and name == "tbofsheets":
				total_pref = key

		if index_pref is None:
			index_pref = analysis.get("index_param")
		if total_pref is None:
			total_pref = analysis.get("total_param")

		if index_pref and total_pref and index_pref == total_pref:
			for key in param_keys:
				if key != index_pref:
					total_pref = key
					break

		return index_pref, total_pref

	def _selected_param_keys(self):
		label_index = self.CmbSheetNoParam.SelectedItem
		label_total = self.CmbOfParam.SelectedItem
		index_key = self._param_key_by_label.get(str(label_index)) if label_index else None
		total_key = self._param_key_by_label.get(str(label_total)) if label_total else None
		return index_key, total_key

	def _refresh_preview(self):
		selected_sheets = self._selected_sheets()
		count = len(selected_sheets)
		index_key, total_key = self._selected_param_keys()

		self.TxtSelectionSummary.Text = "Selected sheets: {0}".format(count)

		rows = []
		for seq, sheet in enumerate(selected_sheets, start=1):
			current_no = self._current_param_value(sheet, index_key)
			current_total = self._current_param_value(sheet, total_key)
			rows.append(PreviewRow(sheet.Name or "", current_no, seq, current_total, count))

		self.GridPreview.ItemsSource = None
		self.GridPreview.ItemsSource = rows

		if not index_key or not total_key:
			self.BtnApply.IsEnabled = False
			self._status("Select both parameters before applying.")
			return

		if index_key == total_key:
			self.BtnApply.IsEnabled = False
			self._status("Sheet # and Total # parameters must be different.")
			return

		self.BtnApply.IsEnabled = count > 0
		if count == 0:
			self._status("No sheets selected.")

	def _apply_click(self, sender, args):
		selected_sheets = self._selected_sheets()
		if not selected_sheets:
			self._status("No sheets selected.")
			return

		index_key, total_key = self._selected_param_keys()
		if not index_key or not total_key:
			self._status("Select both parameters before applying.")
			return

		if index_key == total_key:
			self._status("Sheet # and Total # parameters must be different.")
			return

		try:
			result = apply_sheet_no_of_no(doc, selected_sheets, index_key, total_key)
		except Exception as exc:
			self._status("Update failed: {0}".format(exc))
			forms.alert("Sheet # of # update failed:\n{0}".format(exc), exitscript=False)
			return

		updated = result.get("updated", 0)
		failed = result.get("failed", 0)
		total = result.get("total", len(selected_sheets))

		self._status("Success. Updated {0}/{1} sheets. Failures: {2}".format(updated, total, failed))
		output.print_md("## Sheet # of # Update")
		output.print_md("- Updated: {0}/{1}".format(updated, total))
		output.print_md("- Failures: {0}".format(failed))

		failures = result.get("failures") or []
		if failures:
			output.print_md("### Failures")
			for item in failures:
				output.print_md("- {0}".format(item))

		self._refresh_analysis_and_params()
		self._refresh_preview()

def main():
	if not get_all_sheets(doc):
		forms.alert("No sheets found in this model.", exitscript=True)

	xaml_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "SheetNoOfNoWindow.xaml")
	if not os.path.exists(xaml_path):
		forms.alert("Missing XAML:\n{0}".format(xaml_path), exitscript=True)

	window = SheetNoOfNoWindow(xaml_path)
	window.ShowDialog()


if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = 'Recreate Plan Views\non New Level'
__doc__ = 'Recreates plan views on selected levels. Optionally deletes originals.'

from pyrevit import forms, script
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    FilteredElementCollector,
    ViewPlan,
    Viewport,
    Level,
    ViewFamilyType,
    BuiltInParameter,
    ElementId,
    Transaction,
    ViewDuplicateOption,
    PlanViewPlane
)

from System.Windows.Controls import CheckBox
from System.Windows import RoutedEventHandler

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
output = script.get_output()


def is_dependent(view):
    try:
        return view.GetPrimaryViewId() != ElementId.InvalidElementId
    except:
        return False


def get_primary_id(view):
    try:
        return view.GetPrimaryViewId()
    except:
        return ElementId.InvalidElementId


def view_type_label(view):
    try:
        return view.ViewType.ToString()
    except:
        return 'Unknown'


def get_current_level_id(view):
    try:
        if view.GenLevel:
            return view.GenLevel.Id
    except:
        pass

    for bip_name in ['PLAN_VIEW_LEVEL', 'VIEW_GEN_LEVEL']:
        bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, bip_name, None)
        if not bip:
            continue
        try:
            param = view.get_Parameter(bip)
            if param:
                return param.AsElementId()
        except:
            pass

    return ElementId.InvalidElementId


def get_level_name(level_id):
    if not level_id or level_id == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
        return '-'
    level = doc.GetElement(level_id)
    return level.Name if isinstance(level, Level) else '-'


def sort_levels(levels, mode):
    if mode == 'Name':
        return sorted(levels, key=lambda x: x.Name.lower())
    if mode == 'Elevation Low to High':
        return sorted(levels, key=lambda x: (x.Elevation, x.Name.lower()))
    if mode == 'Elevation High to Low':
        return sorted(levels, key=lambda x: (-x.Elevation, x.Name.lower()))
    return levels


def safe_param(view, bip_name):
    bip = getattr(BuiltInParameter, bip_name, None)
    if not bip:
        return None
    try:
        return view.get_Parameter(bip)
    except:
        return None


def copy_param(src_view, dst_view, bip_name):
    src_param = safe_param(src_view, bip_name)
    dst_param = safe_param(dst_view, bip_name)
    if not src_param or not dst_param or dst_param.IsReadOnly:
        return

    try:
        dst_param.Set(src_param.AsInteger())
        return
    except:
        pass

    try:
        dst_param.Set(src_param.AsDouble())
        return
    except:
        pass

    try:
        dst_param.Set(src_param.AsString() or '')
        return
    except:
        pass

    try:
        dst_param.Set(src_param.AsElementId())
    except:
        pass


def build_name(source_name, mode, value_a, value_b):
    if mode == 'Suffix':
        return source_name + value_a
    if mode == 'Prefix':
        return value_a + source_name
    if mode == 'Replace Text':
        return source_name.replace(value_a, value_b)
    return source_name


def unique_name(base_name, reserved_names):
    if base_name not in reserved_names:
        reserved_names.add(base_name)
        return base_name

    index = 1
    while True:
        candidate = '{} ({})'.format(base_name, index)
        if candidate not in reserved_names:
            reserved_names.add(candidate)
            return candidate
        index += 1


def get_temp_old_name(original_name, old_suffix, reserved_names):
    if original_name in reserved_names:
        reserved_names.remove(original_name)
    return unique_name(original_name + old_suffix, reserved_names)


def normalize_text(value):
    if not value:
        return ''

    chars = []
    for ch in value.lower():
        if ch.isalnum():
            chars.append(ch)
        else:
            chars.append(' ')
    return ' '.join(''.join(chars).split())


def level_match_score(view_name, level_name):
    vn = normalize_text(view_name)
    ln = normalize_text(level_name)

    if not vn or not ln:
        return -1

    if ln in vn:
        return 10000 + len(ln)

    view_tokens = set(vn.split())
    level_tokens = [x for x in ln.split() if len(x) > 1]
    if not level_tokens:
        return -1

    overlap = 0
    joined = ' '.join(level_tokens)
    for token in level_tokens:
        if token in view_tokens:
            overlap += 1

    if overlap:
        seq_bonus = 100 if joined in vn else 0
        return overlap * 10 + seq_bonus + len(joined)

    return -1


def get_best_level_from_name(view_name, level_rows):
    best = None
    best_score = -1
    for level_row in level_rows:
        score = level_match_score(view_name, level_row.Name)
        if score > best_score:
            best = level_row
            best_score = score
    return best if best_score > 0 else None


def is_creatable(view):
    if view.IsTemplate:
        return False, 'Template'
    try:
        if not isinstance(doc.GetElement(view.GetTypeId()), ViewFamilyType):
            return False, 'Invalid type'
    except:
        return False, 'Invalid type'
    if get_current_level_id(view) == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
        return False, 'No valid level'
    return True, '-'


def get_view_range_signature(view):
    sig = {}
    try:
        view_range = view.GetViewRange()
    except:
        return sig

    for plane in [
        PlanViewPlane.TopClipPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.CutPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.BottomClipPlane,
        PlanViewPlane.ViewDepthPlane
    ]:
        try:
            level_id = view_range.GetLevelId(plane)
        except:
            level_id = ElementId.InvalidElementId

        try:
            offset = view_range.GetOffset(plane)
        except:
            offset = 0.0

        sig[plane] = (level_id, offset)

    return sig


def build_remapped_view_range_signature(src_view, target_level_id):
    src_sig = get_view_range_signature(src_view)
    src_assoc_level_id = get_current_level_id(src_view)
    new_sig = {}

    for plane, data in src_sig.items():
        level_id, offset = data
        new_level_id = level_id
        try:
            if level_id == src_assoc_level_id:
                new_level_id = target_level_id
        except:
            pass
        new_sig[plane] = (new_level_id, offset)

    return new_sig


def apply_view_range_signature(dst_view, sig):
    try:
        view_range = dst_view.GetViewRange()
        for plane, data in sig.items():
            level_id, offset = data
            try:
                if level_id != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                    view_range.SetLevelId(plane, level_id)
            except:
                pass

            try:
                view_range.SetOffset(plane, offset)
            except:
                pass

        dst_view.SetViewRange(view_range)
        return True, '-'
    except Exception as ex:
        return False, str(ex)


def view_range_matches(dst_view, sig, tol=0.0001):
    actual_sig = get_view_range_signature(dst_view)
    for plane, expected in sig.items():
        exp_level, exp_offset = expected
        act_level, act_offset = actual_sig.get(plane, (ElementId.InvalidElementId, None))

        if act_level != exp_level:
            return False

        if act_offset is None:
            return False

        try:
            if abs(act_offset - exp_offset) > tol:
                return False
        except:
            return False

    return True


def collect_sheet_info():
    data = {}
    for viewport in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Viewport):
        try:
            view_id = viewport.ViewId.IntegerValue
            sheet = doc.GetElement(viewport.SheetId)
            ref = '{} - {}'.format(sheet.SheetNumber, sheet.Name)
            data.setdefault(view_id, []).append({
                'viewport_id': viewport.Id,
                'sheet_id': viewport.SheetId,
                'sheet_ref': ref,
                'center': viewport.GetBoxCenter()
            })
        except:
            pass
    return data


class LevelRow(object):
    def __init__(self, level):
        self.Level = level
        self.Name = level.Name
        self.Id = level.Id.IntegerValue
        self.Display = u'{} | Elev: {}'.format(level.Name, round(level.Elevation, 3))


class ViewRow(object):
    def __init__(self, cache_item, level_rows):
        self.View = cache_item['view']
        self.Process = False
        self.Name = cache_item['name']
        self.PreviewName = ''
        self.ViewType = cache_item['view_type']
        self.CurrentLevel = cache_item['current_level']
        self.CurrentLevelId = cache_item['current_level_id']
        self.Template = 'Yes' if cache_item['has_template'] else 'No'
        self.TemplateName = cache_item['template_name']
        self.Dependent = 'Yes' if cache_item['dependent'] else 'No'
        self.OnSheet = 'Yes' if cache_item['on_sheet'] else 'No'
        self.SheetRefs = cache_item['sheet_refs']
        self.Creatable = 'Yes' if cache_item['creatable'] else 'No'
        self.CanCreate = cache_item['creatable']
        self.Warning = cache_item['warning']
        self.Status = cache_item['status']
        self.ElementId = cache_item['id']
        self.PrimaryId = cache_item['primary_id']
        self.LevelOptions = level_rows
        self.NewLevel = None

        for level_row in level_rows:
            if level_row.Id == cache_item['current_level_id_int']:
                self.NewLevel = level_row
                break

        if not self.NewLevel and level_rows:
            self.NewLevel = level_rows[0]


XAML = """

                    <TextBlock TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,6">
Template Range Action does not edit the template globally. It can keep the template, remove the template from the recreated view if it overrides View Range, or always clear the template on the recreated view.

                       Text="Select rows with Shift/Ctrl. Clicking one checkbox on a selected set checks or unchecks the whole selection."/>
            <Button Grid.Column="1" x:Name="run_btn" Content="Run" Width="110" Height="32" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>

</Window>
