```python
        number_val = p['digits'][-width:]
        number_int = int(number_val)
        for c in text_cols:
            v = p['db'].get(c)
            t = to_text(v)
            if t == p['prefix']:
                prefix_scores[c] += 1
            if t == series_val:
                series_scores[c] += 1

            dtype = column_types.get(c, '')
            if dtype in ['int', 'bigint', 'smallint', 'tinyint']:
                try:
                    if int(v) == number_int:
                        number_scores[c] += 1
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                if t == number_val or t.zfill(width) == number_val:
                    number_scores[c] += 1

    best_prefix = max(prefix_scores, key=lambda c: prefix_scores[c])
    best_series = max(series_scores, key=lambda c: series_scores[c])
    best_number = max(number_scores, key=lambda c: number_scores[c])
    score = prefix_scores[best_prefix] + series_scores[best_series] + number_scores[best_number]

    candidate = {{
        'numeric_width': width,
        'eligible_count': len(eligible),
        'prefix_column': best_prefix,
        'series_column': best_series,
        'number_column': best_number,
        'prefix_score': prefix_scores[best_prefix],
        'series_score': series_scores[best_series],
        'number_score': number_scores[best_number],
        'total_score': score
    }}
    if not best or candidate['total_score'] > best['total_score']:
        best = candidate

if not best:
    print(json.dumps({{'status': 'error', 'message': 'Could not infer mapping from available rows'}}))
    raise SystemExit(0)

sheetnumtb_cols = [c for c in columns if re.match(r'^SheetNumTb\\d+$', c)]
sheetnumtb_cols = sorted(sheetnumtb_cols, key=lambda name: int(re.findall(r'\\d+', name)[0]))
component_columns = list(sheetnumtb_cols)
if best['number_column'] not in component_columns:
    component_columns.append(best['number_column'])

result = {{
    'status': 'ok',
    'matched_rows': len(parsed),
    'mapping': {{
        'sheet_number_column': None,
        'sheet_number_prefix_column': best['prefix_column'],
        'sheet_number_series_column': best['series_column'],
        'sheet_number_numeric_column': best['number_column'],
        'sheet_number_numeric_width': best['numeric_width'],
        'sheet_number_component_columns': component_columns,
        'discovery_score': best['total_score'],
        'discovery_eligible_count': best['eligible_count'],
        'discovery_prefix_score': best['prefix_score'],
        'discovery_series_score': best['series_score'],
        'discovery_number_score': best['number_score']
    }}
}
print(json.dumps(result))
"""
    code_text = code_text.replace("{{", "{").replace("}}", "}")
    code_text = code_text.replace("__PAYLOAD_B64__", payload_b64)

    exit_code, stdout, stderr = run_python_inline(helper_python, code_text)
    if exit_code != 0:
        details = stderr.strip() or stdout.strip() or "Unknown discovery error"
        return None, details

    try:
        payload_out = json.loads((stdout or "").strip())
    except Exception:
        return None, "Discovery did not return valid JSON. Output: {0}".format((stdout or "").strip()[:500])

    if payload_out.get("status") != "ok":
        return None, payload_out.get("message") or "Mapping discovery failed."

    return payload_out.get("mapping") or {}, None


def write_discovered_mapping_to_config(config_path, project_identity, mapping):
    config = read_json(config_path, default_value={}) or {}
    projects = config.get("projects", [])
    changed = False

    for project in projects:
        if project.get("project_identity") != project_identity:
            continue
        table_map = project.get("table_map", {}) or {}
        for key, value in (mapping or {}).items():
            table_map[key] = value
        project["table_map"] = table_map
        changed = True
        break

    if not changed:
        return False

    write_json(config_path, config)
    return True


def build_sheet_record(sheet, previous_state, project_config=None):
    unique_id = sheet.UniqueId
    project_config = project_config or {}
    value_sources = get_revit_value_sources(project_config)

    sheet_number = resolve_sheet_source_value(sheet, value_sources.get("sheet_number"), {}, project_config) or sheet.SheetNumber or ""
    sheet_name = resolve_sheet_source_value(sheet, value_sources.get("sheet_name"), {"sheet_number": sheet_number}, project_config) or sheet.Name or ""

    record = {
        "element_id": sheet.Id.IntegerValue,
        "unique_id": unique_id,
        "sheet_number": sheet_number,
        "sheet_name": sheet_name,
        "rtv_sheet_title": None,
        "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list": None,
        "rtv_sheet_number_full": None,
        "rtv_scale": None,
        "issue_stamp": None,
        "rev_amendment": None,
        "previous_sheet_number": None,
        "previous_sheet_name": None,
        "hash": None
    }

    for field_name in [
        "rtv_sheet_title",
        "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list",
        "rtv_sheet_number_full",
        "rtv_scale",
        "issue_stamp",
        "rev_amendment"
    ]:
        value = resolve_sheet_source_value(sheet, value_sources.get(field_name), record, project_config)
        if value is not None:
            record[field_name] = value

    if record.get("rtv_sheet_title") is None:
        record["rtv_sheet_title"] = record.get("sheet_name")
    if record.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list") is None:
        record["rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"] = record.get("sheet_name")

    prior = previous_state.get(unique_id, {})
    record["previous_sheet_number"] = prior.get("sheet_number")
    record["previous_sheet_name"] = prior.get("sheet_name")
    record["hash"] = compute_sheet_hash(record)

    return record


def collect_all_sheets(document, exclude_names):
    collector = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document).OfClass(DB.ViewSheet)
    sheets = []
    for sheet in collector:
        try:
            if sheet.IsPlaceholder:
                continue
        except:
            pass
        if sheet.Name in exclude_names or sheet.SheetNumber in exclude_names:
            continue
        sheets.append(sheet)
    return sheets


def collect_selected_sheets(document):
    selected_ids = list(uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds())
    sheets = []
    for element_id in selected_ids:
        element = document.GetElement(element_id)
        if isinstance(element, DB.ViewSheet):
            sheets.append(element)
    return sheets


def choose_sync_mode(default_mode):
    option_map = [
        ("changed", "Changed sheets only"),
        ("selected", "Selected sheets only"),
        ("filtered", "Filterable sheet selector"),
        ("all", "All sheets")
    ]
    default_mode = (default_mode or "changed").lower()
    sorted_options = sorted(option_map, key=lambda item: 0 if item[0] == default_mode else 1)
    labels = [item[1] for item in sorted_options]

    selection = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        labels,
        title="RTV DB Sync",
        button_name="Continue",
        multiselect=False
    )
    selection = normalize_single_selection(selection)
    if not selection:
        script.exit()

    for code, label in option_map:
        if label == selection:
            return code
    return default_mode


class SheetChoice(object):
    def __init__(self, sheet):
        self.sheet = sheet
        number = sheet.SheetNumber or ""
        name = sheet.Name or ""
        self.name = u"{0} | {1}".format(number, name)


def choose_filterable_sheets(sheets):
    choices = [SheetChoice(s) for s in sorted(sheets, key=lambda x: ((x.SheetNumber or ""), (x.Name or "")))]
    selection = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        choices,
        title="RTV DB Sync - Filter Sheets",
        button_name="Use Selected Sheets",
        multiselect=True,
        name_attr="name"
    )

    if not selection:
        script.exit()
    if not isinstance(selection, list):
        selection = [selection]

    return [item.sheet for item in selection]


def choose_sync_action(default_action):
    option_map = [
        ("push", "Push Revit to RTV"),
        ("compare", "Compare Revit vs RTV (no writes)"),
        ("pull_preview", "Pull RTV to Revit (preview only)"),
        ("pull", "Pull RTV to Revit (live update)"),
        ("discover_mapping", "Discover/Update RTV Number Mapping")
    ]
    default_action = (default_action or "push").lower()
    sorted_options = sorted(option_map, key=lambda item: 0 if item[0] == default_action else 1)
    labels = [item[1] for item in sorted_options]

    selection = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        labels,
        title="RTV DB Sync Action",
        button_name="Continue",
        multiselect=False
    )
    selection = normalize_single_selection(selection)
    if not selection:
        script.exit()

    for code, label in option_map:
        if label == selection:
            return code
    return default_action


def choose_dry_run():
    result = forms.alert(
        "Run RTV DB Sync in dry-run mode?\n\nYes = dry-run\nNo = live update",
        yes=True,
        no=True,
        cancel=True
    )
    if result is None:
        script.exit()
    return bool(result)

def choose_conflict_policy(default_policy, action_mode):
    if action_mode == "push":
        return "revit_wins"
    if action_mode in ["compare", "pull_preview"]:
        return "report_only"

    option_map = [
        ("rtv_wins", "RTV wins (apply pull changes)"),
        ("revit_wins", "Revit wins (do not overwrite Revit)"),
        ("report_only", "Report only (no writes)")
    ]
    default_policy = (default_policy or "ask").lower()
    if default_policy != "ask":
        for code, _label in option_map:
            if default_policy == code:
                return code

    labels = [item[1] for item in option_map]
    selection = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        labels,
        title="RTV Sync Conflict Policy",
        button_name="Continue",
        multiselect=False
    )
    selection = normalize_single_selection(selection)
    if not selection:
        script.exit()

    for code, label in option_map:
        if label == selection:
            return code
    return "report_only"

def update_revit_mirror_parameters(sheet_records, result_rows, project_config):
    if not sheet_records:
        return []

    by_number = {}
    for row in result_rows or []:
        key = row.get("sheet_number") or row.get("lookup_value")
        if key and key not in by_number:
            by_number[key] = row

    mirror_params = get_revit_mirror_params(project_config)
    full_number_format = (project_config.get("table_map", {}) or {}).get("full_number_format")
    update_notes = []
    transaction = DB.Transaction(doc, "RTV Sync Mirror Parameters")
    transaction.Start()
    try:
        for item in sheet_records:
            sheet = doc.GetElement(DB.ElementId(item["element_id"]))
            if not sheet:
                continue

            helper_row = by_number.get(item.get("sheet_number")) or by_number.get(item.get("previous_sheet_number")) or {}
            verify_db_values = ((helper_row.get("verification") or {}).get("db_values")) or helper_row.get("db_values") or {}
            composed_full_number = compose_configured_value(full_number_format, item, column_values=verify_db_values)

            note = {
                "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                "sheet_name": item.get("sheet_name")
            }
            changed_any = False

            for field_name, param_name in mirror_params.items():
                if not param_name:
                    continue
                value = item.get(field_name)
                if field_name == "rtv_sheet_number_full" and composed_full_number:
                    value = composed_full_number
                elif field_name in verify_db_values and verify_db_values.get(field_name) is not None:
                    value = verify_db_values.get(field_name)

                changed, reason = set_param_string_if_needed(sheet, param_name, value)
                note[field_name] = reason
                if changed:
                    changed_any = True

            if changed_any:
                update_notes.append(note)

        transaction.Commit()
    except:
        transaction.RollBack()
        raise
    return update_notes


def build_current_state(sheet_records):
    state = {}
    for item in sheet_records:
        state[item["unique_id"]] = {
            "sheet_number": item["sheet_number"],
            "sheet_name": item["sheet_name"],
            "rtv_sheet_title": item.get("rtv_sheet_title"),
            "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list": item.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"),
            "rtv_sheet_number_full": item.get("rtv_sheet_number_full"),
            "rtv_scale": item.get("rtv_scale"),
            "issue_stamp": item.get("issue_stamp"),
            "rev_amendment": item.get("rev_amendment"),
            "hash": item["hash"]
        }
    return state


def detect_local_changes(record, prior):
    # No prior snapshot means there is nothing meaningful to diff against yet.
    if not prior:
        return []

    field_pairs = [
        ("sheet_number", "Sheet Number"),
        ("sheet_name", "Sheet Name"),
        ("rtv_sheet_title", "RTVSheet Title"),
        ("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list", "RTVSheet Title Sheet List"),
        ("rtv_sheet_number_full", "RTVSheet Number Full"),
        ("rtv_scale", "RTVScale"),
        ("issue_stamp", "RTVIssueStamp"),
        ("rev_amendment", "RTVRev Amendment")
    ]

    changes = []
    for key, label in field_pairs:
        before = (prior or {}).get(key)
        after = record.get(key)
        if (before or "") != (after or ""):
            changes.append({
                "field": key,
                "label": label,
                "before": before,
                "after": after,
                "reason": "value_mismatch"
            })

    if not changes and (prior or {}).get("hash") and (prior or {}).get("hash") != record.get("hash"):
        changes.append({
            "field": "hash",
            "label": "Unknown Field",
            "before": (prior or {}).get("hash"),
            "after": record.get("hash"),
            "reason": "hash_changed"
        })

    return changes


def find_helper_row(item, by_number):
    return by_number.get(item.get("sheet_number")) or by_number.get(item.get("previous_sheet_number")) or {}


def index_pull_outcomes(pull_outcomes):
    indexed = {}
    for row in pull_outcomes or []:
        key = row.get("sheet_number")
        if key and key not in indexed:
            indexed[key] = row
    return indexed


def increment_counter(counter, key):
    if not key:
        return
    counter[key] = counter.get(key, 0) + 1


def build_reason_counts(report_rows, pull_outcomes, warnings):
    counts = {}

    for row in report_rows or []:
        increment_counter(counts, "row_reason:{0}".format(row.get("reason") or "unknown"))
        for diff in row.get("diffs", []):
            increment_counter(counts, "diff_reason:{0}".format(diff.get("reason") or "unknown"))
        for verify_diff in row.get("verification_diffs", []):
            increment_counter(counts, "verify_diff:{0}".format(verify_diff.get("reason") or "unknown"))

    for outcome in pull_outcomes or []:
        increment_counter(counts, "pull_reason:{0}".format(outcome.get("reason") or "unknown"))
        for change in outcome.get("changes", []):
            increment_counter(counts, "pull_change:{0}".format(change.get("result") or "unknown"))

    for warning in warnings or []:
        if "no lookup value" in (warning or "").lower():
            increment_counter(counts, "warning:no_lookup_value")
        else:
            increment_counter(counts, "warning:other")

    return counts


def format_reason_counts(reason_counts, top_n=12):
    if not reason_counts:
        return []

    ordered = sorted(reason_counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    lines = ["Reason counts:"]
    for key, count in ordered[:top_n]:
        lines.append("- {0}: {1}".format(key, count))
    return lines


def build_revit_vs_db_diffs(item, db_values, table_map):
    number_mapped = (
        table_map.get("sheet_number_column")
        or table_map.get("sheet_number_prefix_column")
        or table_map.get("sheet_number_series_column")
        or table_map.get("sheet_number_numeric_column")
    )
    field_pairs = [
        ("sheet_number", "Sheet Number", number_mapped),
        ("sheet_name", "Sheet Name", table_map.get("sheet_name_column")),
        ("rtv_sheet_title", "RTVSheet Title", table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_column")),
        ("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list", "RTVSheet Title Sheet List", table_map.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list_column")),
        ("rtv_sheet_number_full", "RTVSheet Number Full", table_map.get("full_number_column")),
        ("rtv_scale", "RTVScale", table_map.get("scale_column")),
        ("issue_stamp", "RTVIssueStamp", table_map.get("issue_stamp_column")),
        ("rev_amendment", "RTVRev Amendment", table_map.get("rev_amendment_column"))
    ]

    diffs = []
    for key, label, mapped_column in field_pairs:
        if not mapped_column:
            continue
        revit_value = normalize_text(item.get(key))
        db_value = normalize_text((db_values or {}).get(key))
        if revit_value != db_value:
            reason = "value_mismatch"
            if revit_value and not db_value:
                reason = "db_blank"
            elif db_value and not revit_value:
                reason = "revit_blank"
            diffs.append({
                "field": key,
                "label": label,
                "revit_value": revit_value,
                "rtv_value": db_value,
                "reason": reason
            })
    return diffs


def build_report_rows(sheet_records, result_rows, previous_state, table_map, action_mode, dry_run, pull_outcomes=None):
    by_number = {}
    for row in result_rows or []:
        key = row.get("sheet_number") or row.get("lookup_value")
        if key and key not in by_number:
            by_number[key] = row
    pull_by_sheet = index_pull_outcomes(pull_outcomes)

    output_rows = []
    for item in sheet_records:
        prior = previous_state.get(item["unique_id"], {})
        local_changes = detect_local_changes(item, prior)
        helper_row = find_helper_row(item, by_number)
        status = helper_row.get("status", "unknown")
        db_values = helper_row.get("db_values", {})
        diffs = build_revit_vs_db_diffs(item, db_values, table_map) if status != "missing" else []
        pull_row = pull_by_sheet.get(item.get("sheet_number"), {})
        verification = helper_row.get("verification") or {}
        verification_status = verification.get("status")
        verification_diffs = verification.get("diffs") or []

        if status == "missing":
            reason = "missing_in_rtv"
        elif action_mode == "push" and not dry_run and status == "updated" and verification_status == "mismatch":
            reason = "post_push_mismatch"
        elif action_mode == "push" and status == "updated":
            reason = "updated"
        elif action_mode == "push" and status == "dry-run":
            reason = "would_update"
        elif status == "compared" and not diffs:
            reason = "matched"
        elif diffs:
            reason = "mismatch"
        elif status == "skipped":
            reason = "no_mapped_fields"
        elif status == "dry-run":
            reason = "would_update"
        elif status == "updated":
            reason = "updated"
        else:
            reason = "unknown"

        output_rows.append({
            "unique_id": item.get("unique_id"),
            "element_id": item.get("element_id"),
            "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
            "sheet_name": item.get("sheet_name"),
            "previous_sheet_number": item.get("previous_sheet_number"),
            "revit_values": {
                "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                "sheet_name": item.get("sheet_name"),
                "rtv_sheet_title": item.get("rtv_sheet_title"),
                "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list": item.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"),
                "rtv_sheet_number_full": item.get("rtv_sheet_number_full"),
                "rtv_scale": item.get("rtv_scale"),
                "issue_stamp": item.get("issue_stamp"),
                "rev_amendment": item.get("rev_amendment")
            },
            "status": status,
            "reason": reason,
            "action_mode": action_mode,
            "dry_run": dry_run,
            "local_changes": local_changes,
            "diffs": diffs,
            "db_values": db_values,
            "verification_status": verification_status,
            "verification_diffs": verification_diffs,
            "pull_status": pull_row.get("status"),
            "pull_reason": pull_row.get("reason"),
            "helper_row": helper_row
        })

    return output_rows


def write_report(runtime_root, project_identity, report):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    report_name = "{0}_{1}_report.json".format(sanitize_filename(project_identity), stamp)
    path = os.path.join(runtime_root, "reports", report_name)
    write_json(path, report)
    return path


def write_report_csv(runtime_root, project_identity, report_rows):
    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    report_name = "{0}_{1}_report.csv".format(sanitize_filename(project_identity), stamp)
    path = os.path.join(runtime_root, "reports", report_name)

    with io.open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow([
            "sheet_number",
            "sheet_name",
            "status",
            "reason",
            "pull_status",
            "pull_reason",
            "diff_count",
            "diff_summary"
        ])

        for row in report_rows:
            diff_summary = "; ".join([
                "{0}: Revit='{1}' RTV='{2}' ({3})".format(
                    d.get("label"),
                    d.get("revit_value"),
                    d.get("rtv_value"),
                    d.get("reason")
                ) for d in row.get("diffs", [])
            ])
            writer.writerow([
                row.get("sheet_number") or "",
                row.get("sheet_name") or "",
                row.get("status") or "",
                row.get("reason") or "",
                row.get("pull_status") or "",
                row.get("pull_reason") or "",
                len(row.get("diffs", [])),
                diff_summary
            ])

    return path

def apply_pull_updates(sheet_records, result_rows, conflict_policy):
    if conflict_policy != "rtv_wins":
        return []

    by_number = {}
    for row in result_rows or []:
        key = row.get("sheet_number") or row.get("lookup_value")
        if key and key not in by_number:
            by_number[key] = row

    # Preflight: detect duplicate/occupied target sheet numbers before opening transaction.
    plan_by_uid = {}
    desired_by_number = {}
    for item in sheet_records:
        helper_row = find_helper_row(item, by_number)
        if not helper_row or helper_row.get("status") == "missing":
            continue
        desired_number = normalize_text((helper_row.get("db_values") or {}).get("sheet_number"))
        if not desired_number:
            continue
        uid = item.get("unique_id")
        plan_by_uid[uid] = desired_number
        desired_by_number.setdefault(desired_number, set()).add(uid)

    duplicate_targets = set([
        number for number, uids in desired_by_number.items() if len(uids) > 1
    ])

    existing_owner_by_number = {}
    sheet_by_uid = {}
    for sheet in DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(DB.ViewSheet):
        try:
            if sheet.IsPlaceholder:
                continue
        except Exception:
            pass
        current_number = normalize_text(sheet.SheetNumber)
        if current_number:
            existing_owner_by_number[current_number] = sheet.UniqueId
        sheet_by_uid[sheet.UniqueId] = sheet

    def next_available_sheet_number(base_number):
        base = normalize_text(base_number) or "SHEET"
        for index in range(1, 100):
            candidate = "{0}-{1:02d}".format(base, index)
            if candidate not in existing_owner_by_number:
                return candidate
        return None

    outcomes = []
    transaction = DB.Transaction(doc, "RTV Sync Pull Updates")
    transaction.Start()
    try:
        for item in sheet_records:
            helper_row = find_helper_row(item, by_number)
            status = helper_row.get("status")
            if status == "missing" or not helper_row:
                outcomes.append({
                    "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                    "status": "skipped",
                    "reason": "missing_in_rtv"
                })
                continue

            db_values = helper_row.get("db_values", {})
            desired_number = normalize_text(db_values.get("sheet_number"))
            if desired_number in duplicate_targets:
                outcomes.append({
                    "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                    "status": "skipped",
                    "reason": "duplicate_target_sheet_number",
                    "target_sheet_number": desired_number
                })
                continue

            owner_uid = existing_owner_by_number.get(desired_number)
            if desired_number and owner_uid and owner_uid != item.get("unique_id"):
                occupying_sheet = sheet_by_uid.get(owner_uid)
                if not occupying_sheet:
                    outcomes.append({
                        "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                        "status": "skipped",
                        "reason": "target_sheet_number_occupied",
                        "target_sheet_number": desired_number,
                        "occupied_by_uid": owner_uid
                    })
                    continue

                occupying_current_number = normalize_text(occupying_sheet.SheetNumber)
                fallback_number = next_available_sheet_number(occupying_current_number or desired_number)
                if not fallback_number:
                    outcomes.append({
                        "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                        "status": "skipped",
                        "reason": "target_sheet_number_occupied_no_fallback",
                        "target_sheet_number": desired_number,
                        "occupied_by_uid": owner_uid
                    })
                    continue

                changed_occ, occ_reason = set_builtin_string_if_needed(
                    occupying_sheet,
                    DB.BuiltInParameter.SHEET_NUMBER,
                    fallback_number
                )
                if not changed_occ:
                    outcomes.append({
                        "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                        "status": "skipped",
                        "reason": "target_sheet_number_occupied_renumber_failed",
                        "target_sheet_number": desired_number,
                        "occupied_by_uid": owner_uid,
                        "renumber_result": occ_reason
                    })
                    continue

                if desired_number in existing_owner_by_number:
                    del existing_owner_by_number[desired_number]
                existing_owner_by_number[fallback_number] = owner_uid

            sheet = doc.GetElement(DB.ElementId(item["element_id"]))
            if not sheet:
                outcomes.append({
                    "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                    "status": "failed",
                    "reason": "sheet_not_found"
                })
                continue

            item_changes = []

            original_number = normalize_text(sheet.SheetNumber)

            changed_number, reason_number = set_builtin_string_if_needed(
                sheet,
                DB.BuiltInParameter.SHEET_NUMBER,
                db_values.get("sheet_number")
            )
            if changed_number or reason_number != "same":
                item_changes.append({"field": "sheet_number", "result": reason_number})
                if changed_number:
                    if original_number in existing_owner_by_number and existing_owner_by_number.get(original_number) == item.get("unique_id"):
                        del existing_owner_by_number[original_number]
                    existing_owner_by_number[desired_number] = item.get("unique_id")

            changed_name, reason_name = set_builtin_string_if_needed(
                sheet,
                DB.BuiltInParameter.SHEET_NAME,
                db_values.get("sheet_name")
            )
            if changed_name or reason_name != "same":
                item_changes.append({"field": "sheet_name", "result": reason_name})

            for field_name, param_name in [
                ("rtv_sheet_title", "RTVSheet Title"),
                ("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list", "RTVSheet Title Sheet List"),
                ("rtv_sheet_number_full", "RTVSheet Number Full"),
                ("rtv_scale", "RTVScale"),
                ("issue_stamp", "RTVIssueStamp"),
                ("rev_amendment", "RTVRev Amendment")
            ]:
                changed, reason = set_param_string_if_needed(sheet, param_name, db_values.get(field_name))
                if changed or reason != "same":
                    item_changes.append({"field": field_name, "result": reason})

            status_value = "updated" if [c for c in item_changes if c.get("result") == "updated"] else "skipped"
            outcomes.append({
                "sheet_number": item.get("sheet_number"),
                "status": status_value,
                "reason": "pull_applied" if status_value == "updated" else "no_change",
                "changes": item_changes
            })

        transaction.Commit()
    except Exception:
        transaction.RollBack()
        raise

    return outcomes

class RTVSyncStatusWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
    def __init__(self, xaml_path, title_text, summary_text, details_text):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)
        self.txtTitle.Text = title_text
        self.txtSummary.Text = summary_text
        self.txtDetails.Text = details_text
        self.btnClose.Click += self.close_click

    def close_click(self, sender, args):
        self.Close()


def resolve_helper_environment(config, config_path):
    return get_sync_orchestrator().resolve_helper_environment(config, config_path)


def validate_helper_environment(helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script):
    return get_sync_orchestrator().validate_helper_environment(helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script)


def execute_mapping_discovery(config, config_path, project_identity, project_config, previous_state):
    return get_sync_orchestrator().execute_mapping_discovery(
        config,
        config_path,
        project_identity,
        project_config,
        previous_state
    )


def execute_sync_run(config, config_path, project_identity, project_config, action_mode, sync_mode, conflict_policy, dry_run, selected_unique_ids=None):
    return get_sync_orchestrator().execute_sync_run(
        config,
        config_path,
        project_identity,
        project_config,
        action_mode,
        sync_mode,
        conflict_policy,
        dry_run,
        selected_unique_ids=selected_unique_ids
    )


def build_sync_orchestrator_context():
    return {
        "doc": doc,
        "collect_all_sheets": collect_all_sheets,
        "build_sheet_record": build_sheet_record,
        "build_current_state": build_current_state,
        "build_report_rows": build_report_rows,
        "build_reason_counts": build_reason_counts,
        "discover_sheet_number_mapping": discover_sheet_number_mapping,
        "ensure_sql_credentials_for_session": ensure_sql_credentials_for_session,
        "ensure_helper_dependency": ensure_helper_dependency,
        "format_reason_counts": format_reason_counts,
        "format_report_stamp": format_report_stamp,
        "get_document_key": get_document_key,
        "get_runtime_root": get_runtime_root,
        "get_state_path": get_state_path,
        "has_sheet_number_mapping": has_sheet_number_mapping,
        "parse_helper_error": parse_helper_error,
        "read_json": read_json,
        "resolve_helper_python": resolve_helper_python,
        "resolve_project_config": resolve_project_config,
        "run_helper": run_helper,
        "sanitize_filename": sanitize_filename,
        "write_discovered_mapping_to_config": write_discovered_mapping_to_config,
        "write_json": write_json,
        "write_report": write_report,
        "write_report_csv": write_report_csv,
        "update_revit_mirror_parameters": update_revit_mirror_parameters,
        "apply_pull_updates": apply_pull_updates,
        "os_path_join": os.path.join,
        "os_path_dirname": os.path.dirname,
        "os_path_exists": os.path.exists,
        "os_path_normpath": os.path.normpath,
        "os_path_isabs": os.path.isabs
    }


def get_sync_orchestrator():
    try:
        module = __import__("rtv_sync_orchestrator", fromlist=["RTVSyncOrchestrator"])
    except Exception:
        lib_dir = find_file_upwards(os.path.dirname(__file__), ["lib"])
        if lib_dir and lib_dir not in sys.path:
            sys.path.append(lib_dir)
        module = __import__("rtv_sync_orchestrator", fromlist=["RTVSyncOrchestrator"])

    RTVSyncOrchestrator = module.RTVSyncOrchestrator

    return RTVSyncOrchestrator(build_sync_orchestrator_context())


class RTVSyncDashboard(forms.WPFWindow):
    FIELD_SPECS = [
        ("Sheet Number", "sheet_number"),
        ("Sheet Name", "sheet_name"),
        ("RTVSheet Title", "rtv_sheet_title"),
        ("RTVSheet Title Sheet List", "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"),
        ("RTVSheet Number Full", "rtv_sheet_number_full"),
        ("RTVScale", "rtv_scale"),
        ("RTVIssueStamp", "issue_stamp"),
        ("RTVRev Amendment", "rev_amendment")
    ]

    ACTION_LABELS = {
        "compare": "Prepare / Compare",
        "push": "Push Revit -> RTV",
        "pull_preview": "Prepare Pull",
        "pull": "Pull RTV -> Revit"
    }

    def __init__(self, xaml_path, config, config_path, project_identity, project_config):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)
        self.config = config
        self.config_path = config_path
        self.project_identity = project_identity
        self.project_config = project_config
        self.current_report = None
        self.sheet_records_all = []
        self.sheet_record_by_uid = {}
        self.report_row_by_uid = {}
        self.active_scope_uids = set()

        self._bind_controls()
        self._load_options()
        self.refresh_dashboard()

    def _bind_controls(self):
        self.btnDiscover.Click += self.discover_click
        self.btnCompare.Click += self.compare_click
        self.btnPush.Click += self.push_click
        self.btnPullPreview.Click += self.pull_preview_click
        self.btnPull.Click += self.pull_click
        self.btnRefresh.Click += self.refresh_click
        self.btnClose.Click += self.close_click
        self.btnUseSelected.Click += self.use_selected_click
        self.btnClearSelected.Click += self.clear_selected_click
        self.btnApplyFilter.Click += self.apply_filter_click
        self.btnClearFilter.Click += self.clear_filter_click
        self.lstSheets.SelectionChanged += self.sheet_selection_changed

    def _load_options(self):
        for item in ["changed", "selected", "all"]:
            self.cmbSyncMode.Items.Add(item)
        self.cmbSyncMode.SelectedIndex = 0

        for item in ["rtv_wins", "revit_wins", "report_only"]:
            self.cmbConflictPolicy.Items.Add(item)
        self.cmbConflictPolicy.SelectedItem = "revit_wins"
        self.chkDryRun.IsChecked = True

    def close_click(self, sender, args):
        self.Close()

    def refresh_click(self, sender, args):
        self.config = read_json(self.config_path, default_value={}) or {}
        self.project_config = resolve_project_config(self.config, doc.Title, get_document_key(doc), self.project_identity)
        self.refresh_dashboard()

    def refresh_dashboard(self):
        db_config = self.project_config.get("database", {}) if self.project_config else {}
        self.txtProject.Text = "Project: {0}".format(self.project_identity)
        self.txtDatabase.Text = "Database: {0} @ {1}".format(db_config.get("database") or "(unmapped)", db_config.get("server") or "(unknown)")
        self.txtMapping.Text = "Mapping: {0}".format(format_mapping_summary(self.project_config or {}))

        helper_python, checked_python_paths, helper_script = resolve_helper_environment(self.config, self.config_path)
        connection_state = "Ready" if helper_python and helper_script and os.path.exists(helper_script) else "Configuration incomplete"
        self.txtConnection.Text = "Connection: {0}".format(connection_state)

        latest_report = get_latest_report_info(self.project_identity)
        self.reload_sheet_inventory()
        if latest_report:
            self.txtLastSync.Text = "Last Sync: {0} | Action={1} | Updated={2}".format(
                latest_report.get("report_stamp") or "unknown",
                latest_report.get("action") or "unknown",
                latest_report.get("updated_count", 0)
            )
            self.current_report = latest_report
            self.populate_report(latest_report)
        else:
            self.txtLastSync.Text = "Last Sync: none recorded locally"
            self.txtSummary.Text = ""
            self.txtDetails.Text = "No sync report found yet. Run Compare or Push to populate this dashboard."
            self.report_row_by_uid = {}
            self.render_sheet_list()
            self.lstRevitValues.Items.Clear()
            self.lstRtvValues.Items.Clear()

        self.update_selected_scope_text()

    def reload_sheet_inventory(self):
        sync_options = (self.project_config or {}).get("sync_options", {})
        exclude_names = sync_options.get("exclude_sheet_names", ["_RTVDM"])
        previous_state = read_json(get_state_path(self.project_identity), default_value={}) or {}
        sheets = collect_all_sheets(doc, exclude_names)
        self.sheet_records_all = [build_sheet_record(s, previous_state, self.project_config) for s in sheets]
        self.sheet_record_by_uid = {}
        for row in self.sheet_records_all:
            uid = row.get("unique_id")
            if uid:
                self.sheet_record_by_uid[uid] = row
        if self.active_scope_uids:
            self.active_scope_uids = set([uid for uid in self.active_scope_uids if uid in self.sheet_record_by_uid])

    def get_filtered_sheet_records(self):
        filter_text = (self.txtNameFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
        if not filter_text:
            return self.sheet_records_all

        filtered = []
        for row in self.sheet_records_all:
            number = (row.get("sheet_number") or "").lower()
            name = (row.get("sheet_name") or "").lower()
            if filter_text in number or filter_text in name:
                filtered.append(row)
        return filtered

    def render_sheet_list(self):
        prev_selected_uids = set(self.get_listbox_selected_uids())
        filtered_rows = self.get_filtered_sheet_records()
        self.lstSheets.Items.Clear()

        for row in filtered_rows:
            uid = row.get("unique_id")
            report_row = self.report_row_by_uid.get(uid, {})
            reason = report_row.get("reason") or "not-synced"

            item = ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = "[{0}] {1} | {2}".format(
                reason,
                row.get("sheet_number") or "(no sheet number)",
                row.get("sheet_name") or "(no sheet name)"
            )
            item.Tag = uid
            item.Background = self.get_row_brush(report_row) if report_row else Brushes.White
            self.lstSheets.Items.Add(item)

        for item in self.lstSheets.Items:
            uid = item.Tag
            if uid in prev_selected_uids:
                item.IsSelected = True

        selected_count = len(self.get_listbox_selected_uids())
        self.txtSheetCount.Text = "Sheets: {0} | Filtered: {1} | Selected: {2}".format(
            len(self.sheet_records_all),
            len(filtered_rows),
            selected_count
        )

    def update_selected_scope_text(self):
        if self.active_scope_uids:
            self.txtSelectedScope.Text = "{0} sheets".format(len(self.active_scope_uids))
        else:
            self.txtSelectedScope.Text = "All sheets"

    def get_listbox_selected_uids(self):
        selected = []
        for item in self.lstSheets.SelectedItems:
            uid = item.Tag
            if uid:
                selected.append(uid)
        return selected

    def use_selected_click(self, sender, args):
        selected_uids = self.get_listbox_selected_uids()
        if not selected_uids:
            self.txtDetails.Text = "No sheets selected in the left list."
            return
        self.active_scope_uids = set(selected_uids)

        try:
            element_ids = List[DB.ElementId]()
            for uid in selected_uids:
                record = self.sheet_record_by_uid.get(uid) or {}
                element_id = record.get("element_id")
                if element_id is None:
                    continue
                element_ids.Add(DB.ElementId(int(element_id)))
            uidoc.Selection.SetElementIds(element_ids)
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.update_selected_scope_text()
        self.txtDetails.Text = "Selected scope updated to {0} sheets and applied to Revit selection. Run Compare or Push to apply only this set.".format(len(self.active_scope_uids))

    def clear_selected_click(self, sender, args):
        self.active_scope_uids = set()
        self.update_selected_scope_text()
        self.txtDetails.Text = "Selected scope cleared. Actions will run on full scope based on Scope mode."

    def apply_filter_click(self, sender, args):
        self.render_sheet_list()

    def clear_filter_click(self, sender, args):
        self.txtNameFilter.Text = ""
        self.render_sheet_list()

    def discover_click(self, sender, args):
        try:
            previous_state = read_json(get_state_path(self.project_identity), default_value={}) or {}
            self.project_config, info = execute_mapping_discovery(
                self.config,
                self.config_path,
                self.project_identity,
                self.project_config,
                previous_state
            )
            self.config = read_json(self.config_path, default_value={}) or {}
            self.txtDetails.Text = "Mapping discovery complete.\n\nPrefix: {0}\nSeries: {1}\nNumber: {2}\nWidth: {3}\nConfig updated: {4}".format(
                info["mapping"].get("sheet_number_prefix_column") or "",
                info["mapping"].get("sheet_number_series_column") or "",
                info["mapping"].get("sheet_number_numeric_column") or "",
                info["mapping"].get("sheet_number_numeric_width") or "",
                self.config_path
            )
            self.refresh_dashboard()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.txtDetails.Text = str(exc)

    def compare_click(self, sender, args):
        self.run_action("compare")

    def push_click(self, sender, args):
        self.run_action("push")

    def pull_preview_click(self, sender, args):
        self.run_action("pull_preview")

    def pull_click(self, sender, args):
        self.run_action("pull")

    def _timestamp(self, value=None):
        dt = value or datetime.datetime.now()
        return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

    def _build_workflow_intro(self, action_mode, sync_mode, conflict_policy, dry_run):
        action_label = self.ACTION_LABELS.get(action_mode, action_mode)
        mode_label = "DRY-RUN PREVIEW" if dry_run else "LIVE WRITE"

        lines = [
            "Run Status: IN PROGRESS",
            "Action: {0}".format(action_label),
            "Mode: {0}".format(mode_label),
            "Scope: {0}".format(sync_mode),
            "Conflict Policy: {0}".format(conflict_policy),
            "",
            "Workflow Stages:",
            "1. Build scope from dashboard + Revit sheet state.",
            "2. Execute helper compare/sync against RTV database.",
            "3. Apply mode-specific writes (push/pull) if live mode.",
            "4. Capture verification counts and reason diagnostics.",
            "5. Write report artifacts and refresh dashboard lists."
        ]
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_completion_lines(self, report, started_at, finished_at):
        duration = finished_at - started_at
        seconds = duration.total_seconds()
        status_line = "Run Status: COMPLETED"
        if report.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0) > 0:
            status_line = "Run Status: COMPLETED WITH WARNINGS"

        lines = [
            status_line,
            "Started: {0}".format(self._timestamp(started_at)),
            "Finished: {0}".format(self._timestamp(finished_at)),
            "Duration: {0:.1f}s".format(seconds),
            "Rows Sent: {0}".format(report.get("sheet_count", 0)),
            "Updated Rows: {0}".format(report.get("updated_count", 0)),
            "Verified Rows: {0}".format(report.get("verified_count", 0)),
            "Post-Push Mismatches: {0}".format(report.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0)),
            "Missing Rows: {0}".format(report.get("missing_count", 0)),
            "Warnings: {0}".format(len(report.get("warnings", []) or []))
        ]
        return lines

    def _show_completion_confirmation(self, report):
        action_mode = report.get("action") or "unknown"
        dry_run = bool(report.get("dry_run"))
        action_label = self.ACTION_LABELS.get(action_mode, action_mode)

        run_type = "PREVIEW" if dry_run else "LIVE"
        status_word = "completed"
        if report.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0) > 0:
            status_word = "completed with verification warnings"

        lines = [
            "{0} ({1}) {2}.".format(action_label, run_type, status_word),
            "",
            "Rows sent: {0}".format(report.get("sheet_count", 0)),
            "Updated rows: {0}".format(report.get("updated_count", 0)),
            "Verified rows: {0}".format(report.get("verified_count", 0)),
            "Post-push mismatches: {0}".format(report.get("verify_mismatch_count", 0)),
            "Missing rows: {0}".format(report.get("missing_count", 0)),
            "",
            "Report: {0}".format(report.get("report_path") or "(not written)")
        ]

        if dry_run:
            lines.insert(1, "No RTV/Revit write was performed in this run.")
        elif action_mode == "push":
            lines.insert(1, "RTV write path executed.")
        elif action_mode == "pull":
            lines.insert(1, "Revit write path executed.")

        forms.alert("\n".join(lines), title="RTV Sync Completion")

    def run_action(self, action_mode):
        sync_mode = str(self.cmbSyncMode.SelectedItem or "changed")
        conflict_policy = str(self.cmbConflictPolicy.SelectedItem or "revit_wins")
        dry_run = bool(self.chkDryRun.IsChecked)
        if action_mode in ["compare", "pull_preview"]:
            dry_run = True
        if action_mode == "push":
            conflict_policy = "revit_wins"

            if dry_run:
                proceed = forms.alert(
                    "Push is currently in DRY-RUN mode.\n\n"
                    "No RTV database write will occur.\n"
                    "This run only previews the changes.\n\n"
                    "Continue with preview push?",
                    yes=True,
                    no=True,
                    cancel=True
                )
                if proceed is not True:
                    self.txtDetails.Text = "Push cancelled. Dry-run preview was not executed."
                    return
            else:
                proceed = forms.alert(
                    "Push is in LIVE mode and will write changes to RTV now.\n\n"
                    "Continue with live push?",
                    yes=True,
                    no=True,
                    cancel=True
                )
                if proceed is not True:
                    self.txtDetails.Text = "Push cancelled before live RTV write."
                    return

        started_at = datetime.datetime.now()
        self.txtDetails.Text = self._build_workflow_intro(action_mode, sync_mode, conflict_policy, dry_run)
        self.txtFooter.Text = "Sync running. Waiting for helper + verification to complete..."

        try:
            report = execute_sync_run(
                self.config,
                self.config_path,
                self.project_identity,
                self.project_config,
                action_mode,
                sync_mode,
                conflict_policy,
                dry_run,
                selected_unique_ids=list(self.active_scope_uids) if self.active_scope_uids else None
            )
            finished_at = datetime.datetime.now()
            report["started_at"] = self._timestamp(started_at)
            report["finished_at"] = self._timestamp(finished_at)
            report["duration_seconds"] = round((finished_at - started_at).total_seconds(), 3)
            report["completion_lines"] = self._build_completion_lines(report, started_at, finished_at)

            self.current_report = report
            self.populate_report(report)
            self.txtLastSync.Text = "Last Sync: {0} | Action={1} | Updated={2}".format(
                report.get("report_stamp") or "unknown",
                report.get("action") or action_mode,
                report.get("updated_count", 0)
            )
            self.txtFooter.Text = "Sync complete. Review Run Summary + Activity/Details + report file for audit trace."
            self._show_completion_confirmation(report)
        except SystemExit:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            self.txtFooter.Text = "Sync failed. Review Activity/Details for diagnostics."
            self.txtDetails.Text = str(exc)

    def populate_report(self, report):
        rows = report.get("rows", []) or []
        self.txtSummary.Text = "\n".join(report.get("summary_lines", []))
        mode_line = "Run Mode: DRY-RUN PREVIEW ONLY (NO RTV WRITE)" if report.get("dry_run") else "Run Mode: LIVE WRITE (RTV UPDATED)"
        completion_lines = report.get("completion_lines") or []
        if not completion_lines:
            completion_lines = ["Run Status: COMPLETED"]

        self.txtDetails.Text = "{0}\n\n{1}\n\nReport: {2}\n\nReason counts:\n{3}".format(
            mode_line,
            "\n".join(completion_lines),
            report.get("report_path") or "(not written)",
            "\n".join(format_reason_counts(report.get("reason_counts", {}), top_n=12))
        )
        self.report_row_by_uid = {}
        for row in rows:
            uid = row.get("unique_id")
            if uid and uid not in self.report_row_by_uid:
                self.report_row_by_uid[uid] = row

        self.render_sheet_list()
        if self.lstSheets.Items.Count == 0:
            self.lstRevitValues.Items.Clear()
            self.lstRtvValues.Items.Clear()

    def get_row_brush(self, row):
        reason = row.get("reason")
        if reason == "updated" or reason == "matched":
            return Brushes.Honeydew
        if reason == "post_push_mismatch":
            return Brushes.MistyRose
        if reason in ["mismatch", "would_update"]:
            return Brushes.LemonChiffon
        if reason == "missing_in_rtv":
            return Brushes.Gainsboro
        return Brushes.White

    def sheet_selection_changed(self, sender, args):
        selected_uids = self.get_listbox_selected_uids()
        if not selected_uids:
            return
        uid = selected_uids[0]
        self.populate_parameter_lists(uid)

    def populate_parameter_lists(self, uid):
        self.lstRevitValues.Items.Clear()
        self.lstRtvValues.Items.Clear()

        base_record = self.sheet_record_by_uid.get(uid, {}) or {}
        row = self.report_row_by_uid.get(uid, {}) or {}

        revit_values = (row.get("revit_values") or {
            "sheet_number": base_record.get("sheet_number"),
            "sheet_name": base_record.get("sheet_name"),
            "rtv_sheet_title": base_record.get("rtv_sheet_title"),
            "rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list": base_record.get("rtv_sheet_title_sheet_list"),
            "rtv_sheet_number_full": base_record.get("rtv_sheet_number_full"),
            "rtv_scale": base_record.get("rtv_scale"),
            "issue_stamp": base_record.get("issue_stamp"),
            "rev_amendment": base_record.get("rev_amendment")
        })
        rtv_values = row.get("db_values", {}) or {}
        diff_map = {}
        for diff in row.get("verification_diffs", []) or row.get("diffs", []):
            diff_map[diff.get("field")] = diff

        is_push_preview = row.get("action_mode") == "push" and row.get("status") in ["dry-run", "updated"]
        if is_push_preview:
            self.txtDetails.Text = "Push preparation view: RTV panel shows current value -> planned value after push for changed fields.\n\n" + (self.txtDetails.Text or "")

        for label, key in self.FIELD_SPECS:
            diff = diff_map.get(key)
            left_value = revit_values.get(key)
            right_value = rtv_values.get(key)

            left_item = ListBoxItem()
            right_item = ListBoxItem()
            left_item.Content = "{0}: {1}{2}".format(label, left_value if left_value not in [None, ""] else "(blank)", " [DIFF]" if diff else "")
            right_display = right_value if right_value not in [None, ""] else "(blank)"
            if is_push_preview and diff:
                planned = left_value if left_value not in [None, ""] else "(blank)"
                right_display = "{0} -> {1}".format(right_display, planned)
            right_item.Content = "{0}: {1}{2}".format(label, right_display, " [DIFF]" if diff else "")

            brush = Brushes.Honeydew if not diff else Brushes.LemonChiffon
            if row.get("reason") == "post_push_mismatch" and diff:
                brush = Brushes.MistyRose
            if row.get("reason") == "missing_in_rtv":
                brush = Brushes.Gainsboro

            left_item.Background = brush
            right_item.Background = brush
            self.lstRevitValues.Items.Add(left_item)
            self.lstRtvValues.Items.Add(right_item)


def show_status_window(project_identity, action_mode, dry_run, report_rows, warnings, report_path, reason_counts):
    title_text = "RTV Sync Status ({0})".format("DRY-RUN" if dry_run else "LIVE")
    summary_lines = [
        "Project: {0}".format(project_identity),
        "Action: {0}".format(action_mode),
        "Rows evaluated: {0}".format(len(report_rows)),
        "Missing in RTV: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("reason") == "missing_in_rtv"])),
        "Mismatches: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("reason") == "mismatch"])),
        "Post-push mismatches: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("reason") == "post_push_mismatch"])),
        "Would Update: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("reason") == "would_update"])),
        "Updated: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("reason") == "updated"])),
        "Verified: {0}".format(len([r for r in report_rows if r.get("verification_status") == "verified"])),
        "Warnings: {0}".format(len(warnings or [])),
        "Report: {0}".format(report_path)
    ]
    summary_lines.extend(format_reason_counts(reason_counts))

    detail_lines = []
    for row in report_rows[:120]:
        detail_lines.append("[{0}] {1} | {2}".format(
            row.get("reason", "unknown"),
            row.get("sheet_number") or "(no sheet number)",
            row.get("sheet_name") or "(no sheet name)"
        ))
        for change in row.get("local_changes", []):
            detail_lines.append("  - {0}: '{1}' -> '{2}' ({3})".format(
                change.get("label"),
                change.get("before") if change.get("before") is not None else "",
                change.get("after") if change.get("after") is not None else "",
                change.get("reason")
            ))
        for diff in row.get("diffs", []):
            diff_prefix = "MISMATCH"
            if row.get("action_mode") == "push" and row.get("status") in ["updated", "dry-run"]:
                diff_prefix = "PRE-UPDATE DIFF"
            detail_lines.append("  - {0} {1}: Revit='{2}' | RTV='{3}' ({4})".format(
                diff_prefix,
                diff.get("label"),
                diff.get("revit_value"),
                diff.get("rtv_value"),
                diff.get("reason")
            ))
        for verify_diff in row.get("verification_diffs", []):
            detail_lines.append("  - POST-PUSH VERIFY {0}: Revit='{1}' | RTV='{2}' ({3})".format(
                verify_diff.get("label"),
                verify_diff.get("revit_value"),
                verify_diff.get("rtv_value"),
                verify_diff.get("reason")
            ))

        conflict_resolution = (row.get("helper_row") or {}).get("conflict_resolution") or {}
        if conflict_resolution.get("status"):
            detail_lines.append("  - NUMBER CLASH: {0} target='{1}' moved_to='{2}'"
                                .format(
                                    conflict_resolution.get("status"),
                                    conflict_resolution.get("desired_number") or "",
                                    conflict_resolution.get("renumber_to") or ""
                                ))
        if row.get("pull_status") or row.get("pull_reason"):
            detail_lines.append("  - PULL RESULT: {0} ({1})".format(
                row.get("pull_status") or "n/a",
                row.get("pull_reason") or "n/a"
            ))

    if warnings:
        detail_lines.append("")
        detail_lines.append("Warnings:")
        for warning in warnings[:40]:
            detail_lines.append("- {0}".format(warning))

    xaml_path = get_status_xaml_path()
    if os.path.exists(xaml_path):
        try:
            window = RTVSyncStatusWindow(xaml_path, title_text, "\n".join(summary_lines), "\n".join(detail_lines))
            window.ShowDialog()
            return
        except Exception:
            pass

    forms.alert("\n".join(summary_lines + [""] + detail_lines[:30]), title="RTV DB Sync")


def run_helper(helper_python, helper_script, payload_path):
    args = '"{0}" --payload "{1}"'.format(helper_script, payload_path)

    process_info = ProcessStartInfo()
    process_info.FileName = helper_python
    process_info.Arguments = args
    process_info.UseShellExecute = False
    process_info.RedirectStandardOutput = True
    process_info.RedirectStandardError = True
    process_info.CreateNoWindow = True

    process = Process()
    process.StartInfo = process_info
    process.Start()

    stdout = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
    stderr = process.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
    process.WaitForExit()

    return process.ExitCode, stdout, stderr


def parse_helper_error(stdout_text, stderr_text):
    stderr_text = stderr_text or ""
    stdout_text = stdout_text or ""

    if stderr_text.strip():
        return stderr_text.strip()

    try:
        payload = json.loads(stdout_text)
        if isinstance(payload, dict):
            status = payload.get("status")
            message = payload.get("message")
            if message:
                return "Helper status: {0}\n{1}".format(status or "error", message)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return stdout_text.strip() or "Unknown helper error"


def run_python_inline(helper_python, code_text):
    args = '-c "{0}"'.format(code_text.replace('"', '\\"'))

    process_info = ProcessStartInfo()
    process_info.FileName = helper_python
    process_info.Arguments = args
    process_info.UseShellExecute = False
    process_info.RedirectStandardOutput = True
    process_info.RedirectStandardError = True
    process_info.CreateNoWindow = True

    process = Process()
    process.StartInfo = process_info
    process.Start()

    stdout = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd()
    stderr = process.StandardError.ReadToEnd()
    process.WaitForExit()
    return process.ExitCode, stdout, stderr


def ensure_helper_dependency(helper_python, module_name):
    check_code = "import {0}; print('ok')".format(module_name)
    exit_code, _stdout, _stderr = run_python_inline(helper_python, check_code)
    if exit_code == 0:
        return True, ""

    install_code = (
        "import subprocess, sys; "
        "rc=subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '{0}']); "
        "print(rc)"
    ).format(module_name)
    install_exit, install_out, install_err = run_python_inline(helper_python, install_code)

    verify_exit, _verify_out, verify_err = run_python_inline(helper_python, check_code)
    if install_exit == 0 and verify_exit == 0:
        return True, ""

    details = []
    details.append("Python: {0}".format(helper_python))
    details.append("Attempted module install: {0}".format(module_name))
    if install_out:
        details.append("Install output:")
        details.append(install_out.strip())
    if install_err:
        details.append("Install stderr:")
        details.append(install_err.strip())
    if verify_err:
        details.append("Verify stderr:")
        details.append(verify_err.strip())

    return False, "\n".join([x for x in details if x])


def main():
    config, config_path = load_config()

    document_title = doc.Title
    document_key = get_document_key(doc)
    project_identity = get_project_identity(doc)

    project_config = resolve_project_config(config, document_title, document_key, project_identity)
    if not project_config:
        forms.alert(
            "No RTV project config matched:\n\nTitle: {0}\nKey: {1}".format(document_title, document_key),
            exitscript=True
        )

    xaml_path = get_dashboard_xaml_path()
    if not os.path.exists(xaml_path):
        forms.alert("dashboard.xaml not found next to script.py", exitscript=True)

    window = RTVSyncDashboard(xaml_path, config, config_path, project_identity, project_config)
    window.ShowDialog()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    except:
        forms.alert(traceback.format_exc(), title="RTV DB Sync Error", exitscript=True)
```

```
# RTV DB Sync

## Purpose
Synchronize Revit sheet data with the configured RTV SQL database through compare, push, pull preview, live pull, and mapping discovery workflows.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`
- `dashboard.xaml`
- `status.xaml`

## Owning Dependencies
- `lib/rtv_db_sync_helper.py`
- `lib/rtv_sync_config.json`

## Critical Constraints
- Treat helper/database success as the gate before any Revit mirror parameter writes.
- Preserve the distinction between compare, push, pull preview, and live pull paths.
- Keep the validated project mapping keyed by `RevitID` unless a confirmed schema change requires otherwise.
- Maintain structured per-sheet results and summary counts for audit output.

## Working Notes
- Start at `script.py` for orchestration, then step into the helper for database and mapping behavior.
- Changes to status or dashboard UX should preserve actionable diagnostics and reportability.
```

```python
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

from pyrevit import revit, DB

doc = revit.doc

# ----------------------------
# COLLECT (ONE PASS)
# ----------------------------

sheets = list(
    DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc)
    .OfClass(DB.ViewSheet)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

titleblocks = list(
    DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc)
    .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

tb_by_sheet = {}
for tb in titleblocks:
    owner_id = tb.OwnerViewId
    if owner_id and owner_id.IntegerValue > 0:
        tb_by_sheet[owner_id] = tb

rev_settings = DB.RevisionSettings.GetRevisionSettings(doc)
rev_numbering = rev_settings.RevisionNumbering

# ----------------------------
# HELPERS (LEAN)
# ----------------------------

def get_param(elem, name):
    if not elem:
        return None
    p = elem.LookupParameter(name)
    if p and p.HasValue:
        return p.AsString()
    return None

def get_latest_revision_data(sheet):
    rev_ids = sheet.GetAllRevisionIds()
    if not rev_ids:
        return None, None, None

    revs = [doc.GetElement(rid) for rid in rev_ids if doc.GetElement(rid)]
    if not revs:
        return None, None, None

    latest = revs[-1]

    if rev_numbering == DB.RevisionNumbering.PerSheet:
        rev_number = sheet.GetRevisionNumberOnSheet(latest.Id)
    else:
        rev_number = latest.RevisionNumber

    return rev_number, latest.RevisionDate, latest.Description

# ----------------------------
# ANALYSIS (FAST)
# ----------------------------

results = []

for sheet in sheets:
    tb = tb_by_sheet.get(sheet.Id)

    sheet_no = sheet.SheetNumber
    tb_sheet_no = get_param(tb, "SHEET_NUMBER")

    rev_no, rev_date, rev_desc = get_latest_revision_data(sheet)
    tb_rev_no = get_param(tb, "REVISION")
    tb_rev_date = get_param(tb, "REVISION_DATE")

    row = {
        "sheet_id": sheet.Id,
        "sheet_name": sheet.Name,
        "sheet_number": sheet_no,

        "fields": {
            "sheet_number": {
                "sheet": sheet_no,
                "titleblock": tb_sheet_no,
                "status": "ok" if sheet_no == tb_sheet_no else "mismatch"
            },
            "revision": {
                "revision_table": rev_no,
                "titleblock": tb_rev_no,
                "status": "ok" if rev_no == tb_rev_no else "mismatch"
            },
            "revision_date": {
                "revision_table": rev_date,
                "titleblock": tb_rev_date,
                "status": "ok" if rev_date == tb_rev_date else "mismatch"
            }
        }
    }

    row["overall_status"] = (
        "FAIL"
        if any(f["status"] != "ok" for f in row["fields"].values())
        else "OK"
    )

    results.append(row)

# results now contains the full verifier dataset
```

```
# Titleblock Checker

## Purpose
Audit sheet and titleblock data consistency, especially sheet number and revision values derived from revision tables.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local collection and comparison logic in `script.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Keep collection and comparison fast and deterministic.
- Preserve per-field status output so mismatches remain easy to diagnose.
- Treat missing titleblocks or revisions as explicit data states rather than silent failures.

## Working Notes
- This tool is a good candidate for richer user-facing reporting if it expands beyond raw dataset generation.
- If you add writes or fixes later, split analysis from mutation first.
```

```
<Window
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    Title="View Renamer — Live Preview"
    Height="560" Width="920"
    WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner"
    Background="#1e1e1e" Foreground="#ddd"
    FontFamily="Segoe UI" FontSize="12">
    <DockPanel LastChildFill="True" Margin="10">

        <!-- Top: Inputs -->
        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Orientation="Vertical" Margin="0,0,0,8">

            <!-- Text inputs (Replace before Suffix; consistent margins) -->
            <UniformGrid Columns="8" Rows="2" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                <TextBlock Text="Prefix:"  VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                <TextBox x:Name="PrefixBox"   Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Margin="0,0,14,0" />

                <TextBlock Text="Find:"    VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                <TextBox x:Name="FindBox"     Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Margin="0,0,14,0" />

                <TextBlock Text="Replace:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                <TextBox x:Name="ReplaceBox"  Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Margin="0,0,14,0" />

                <TextBlock Text="Suffix:"  VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                <TextBox x:Name="SuffixBox"   Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Margin="0,0,14,0" />
            </UniformGrid>

            <!-- Numbering -->
            <GroupBox Header="Numbering" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                <Grid Margin="8,6,8,6">
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Enable -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="16"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Mode -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="120"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="12"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Start -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="12"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Incr -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="12"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Pad -->
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Row 0 -->
                    <!-- High-contrast Enable -->
                    <Border Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                            Background="#2D6CDF" CornerRadius="4" Padding="8,2,8,2"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center">
                        <CheckBox x:Name="EnableNumbering"
                                  Content="Enable"
                                  Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    </Border>

                    <TextBlock Text="Mode:" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="2" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <ComboBox x:Name="InsertModeBox" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="3" Height="22" SelectedIndex="0">
                        <!-- 0 = Insert, 1 = Replace length -->

                        <ComboBoxItem Content="Replace length" />
                    </ComboBox>

                    <TextBlock Text="Start:" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="5" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="NumStartBox" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="6" Height="22" Text="1"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="Incr.:" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="8" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>

                    <TextBlock Text="Pad:" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="NumPadBox" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="12" Height="22" Text="0"/>

                    <!-- Row 1: Separator placement -->
                    <TextBlock Text="Separator:" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,6,6,0"/>
                    <TextBox x:Name="NumSepBox" Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="3" Grid.ColumnSpan="3" Margin="0,6,0,0" Height="22"/>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="6" Grid.ColumnSpan="7" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="12,6,0,0">
                        <CheckBox x:Name="SepBefore" Content="Before" IsChecked="True" Margin="0,0,12,0"/>
                        <CheckBox x:Name="SepAfter"  Content="After"  Margin="0,0,12,0"/>
                        <!-- both = both ticked; none ticked => separator omitted -->
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Row 2: Insert at slider + replace length box -->
                    <TextBlock Text="Insert at:" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,6,6,0"/>
                    <Slider x:Name="NumberInsertSlider" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="3" Grid.ColumnSpan="6"
                            Margin="0,6,0,0" Minimum="0" Maximum="0" TickFrequency="1" IsSnapToTickEnabled="True"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="InsertIndexLabel" Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="9" Margin="6,6,0,0"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>
```
