```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__   = "RevitWarnings"
__doc__     = """Version = 1.0
Date    = 01.01.2026
________________________________________________________________
Description:
This detects and reports Revit Warnings in the active document.
"""

# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║║║║╠═╝║ ║╠╦╝ ║ ╚═╗
# ╩╩ ╩╩  ╚═╝╩╚═ ╩ ╚═╝
#░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

#.NET Imports
import clr
clr.AddReference('System')
from System.Collections.Generic import List
from pyrevit import revit, DB, UI, forms
from pyrevit import script


# ╦  ╦╔═╗╦═╗╦╔═╗╔╗ ╦  ╔═╗╔═╗
# ╚╗╔╝╠═╣╠╦╝║╠═╣╠╩╗║  ║╣ ╚═╗
#  ╚╝ ╩ ╩╩╚═╩╩ ╩╚═╝╩═╝╚═╝╚═╝
#░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
doc    = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document #type:Document
uidoc  = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
app    = __revit__.Application


output = script.get_output()

# Accordion styling (from lib Examples/StyleFormatting)
GROUP_LINK_CHUNK = 180
START_EXPANDED = False

output.add_style("""
.acc      { border:1px solid #444; border-radius:6px; margin:8px 0; background:#161616; }
.acc .hdr { cursor:pointer; padding:8px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.acc .hdr .arrow { width:0; height:0; border-left:6px solid #bbb; border-top:6px solid transparent; border-bottom:6px solid transparent; margin-right:8px; transform:rotate(90deg); transition:transform .12s ease-out; }
.acc .hdr .meta  { margin-left:auto; color:#bbb; font-weight:400; }
.acc .body { display:none; padding:8px 12px 10px; color:#ddd; }
.acc.open .body { display:block; }
.acc.open .hdr .arrow { transform:rotate(0deg); }
.acc hr.sep { border:none; border-top:1px solid #333; margin:8px 0 12px; }
.acc ul { margin:6px 0 10px 18px; }
.acc li { margin:2px 0; }
""")

output.inject_script("""
(function(){
  function hasClass(el, cls){
    if (!el) return false;
    var cn = el.className;
    if (typeof cn !== 'string') return false;
    return (' ' + cn + ' ').indexOf(' ' + cls + ' ') > -1;
  }
  function toggleClass(el, cls){
    if (!el) return;
    var cn = ' ' + (el.className || '') + ' ';
    if (cn.indexOf(' ' + cls + ' ') > -1) {
      cn = cn.replace(' ' + cls + ' ', ' ');
    } else {
      cn = cn + cls + ' ';
    }
    el.className = cn.replace(/^\\s+|\\s+$/g, '').replace(/\\s{2,}/g, ' ');
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var t = e.target;
    while (t && !hasClass(t, 'hdr')) { t = t.parentNode; }
    if (t && hasClass(t, 'hdr') && t.parentNode) {
      toggleClass(t.parentNode, 'open');
    }
  });
})();
""")

# ╔╦╗╔═╗╦╔╗╔
# ║║║╠═╣║║║║
# ╩ ╩╩ ╩╩╝╚╝
#░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░
# no f strings in this script
# Get All Warnings
all_warnings = doc.GetWarnings()

# Sort in dict by Warning Name
from collections import defaultdict
sorted_warnings = defaultdict(list)
for warning in all_warnings:
    description = warning.GetDescriptionText()
    sorted_warnings[description].append(warning)

def _chunk_ids(ids, base_label):
    """Chunk element IDs for linkify to avoid URL length limits."""
    if len(ids) <= GROUP_LINK_CHUNK:
        return [(base_label, list(ids))]
    parts = []
    total = (len(ids) + GROUP_LINK_CHUNK - 1) // GROUP_LINK_CHUNK
    for i in range(0, len(ids), GROUP_LINK_CHUNK):
        sub = ids[i:i + GROUP_LINK_CHUNK]
        label = "{} (part {} of {})".format(base_label, (i // GROUP_LINK_CHUNK) + 1, total)
        parts.append((label, sub))
    return parts


def _get_element_type_name(doc, el_id):
    """Return Type Name for element, or Category name, or 'Element' as fallback."""
    el = doc.GetElement(el_id)
    if el is None:
        return "Element"
    try:
        type_id = el.GetTypeId()
        if type_id and type_id.IntegerValue != -1:
            typ = doc.GetElement(type_id)
            if typ is not None and hasattr(typ, "Name"):
                return typ.Name or "Element"
    except Exception:
        pass
    if el.Category is not None and el.Category.Name:
        return el.Category.Name
    return "Element"


# Create Report (accordion style) — all warning types
if not sorted_warnings:
    output.print_md("### No warnings in the active document.")
else:
    for w_type, list_warnings in sorted_warnings.items():
        # Build body: one list item per warning instance; each failing element on its own line by type name
        body_lines = []
        body_lines.append(u"<ul>")
        for idx, warning in enumerate(list_warnings, 1):
            elem_ids = list(warning.GetFailingElements())
            if len(elem_ids) == 0:
                body_lines.append(u"  <li>Instance {}: (no elements)</li>".format(idx))
                continue
            if len(elem_ids) == 1:
                eid = elem_ids[0]
                type_name = _get_element_type_name(doc, eid)
                label = "{} (ID {})".format(type_name, eid.IntegerValue)
                el_link = output.linkify(eid, label)
                body_lines.append(u"  <li>Instance {}: {} &#8212; {}</li>".format(idx, type_name, el_link))
            else:
                body_lines.append(u"  <li>Instance {} ({} elements):".format(idx, len(elem_ids)))
                body_lines.append(u"    <ul>")
                for el_num, eid in enumerate(elem_ids, 1):
                    type_name = _get_element_type_name(doc, eid)
                    label = "{} (ID {})".format(type_name, eid.IntegerValue)
                    el_link = output.linkify(eid, label)
                    body_lines.append(u"      <li>Element {}: {} &#8212; {}</li>".format(el_num, type_name, el_link))
                body_lines.append(u"    </ul>")
                body_lines.append(u"  </li>")
        body_lines.append(u"</ul>")
        body_html = u"\n".join(body_lines)

        open_cls = " open" if START_EXPANDED else ""
        count = len(list_warnings)
        acc_html = []
        acc_html.append(u"<div class='acc{}'>".format(open_cls))
        acc_html.append(u"  <div class='hdr'><div class='arrow'></div>"
                        u"Warning Type: <b>{}</b>"
                        u"<span class='meta'>{} instance(s)</span></div>"
                        .format(w_type, count))
        acc_html.append(u"  <div class='body'>")
        acc_html.append(body_html)
        acc_html.append(u"  </div>")
        acc_html.append(u"</div>")
        output.print_html(u"".join(acc_html))
```

```
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,0,8"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>

    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel Margin="10">

        <!-- Top controls -->
        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Orientation="Vertical" Margin="0,0,0,8">

            <!-- Row 0: Tolerance, Baseline, Similar, Mode -->
            <Grid Margin="0,0,0,6">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>   <!-- Tol lbl -->
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="80"/>    <!-- Tol box -->

                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                <TextBlock Text="Tolerance (mm):" VerticalAlignment="Center" Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                <TextBox x:Name="TolBox" Width="60" Grid.Column="1" Text="2"/>

                <TextBlock Text="" Grid.Column="2"/>

                <ComboBox x:Name="BaselineBox" Grid.Column="4" Height="22" SelectedIndex="0">
                    <ComboBoxItem Content="Both"/>
                    <ComboBoxItem Content="X only"/>
                    <ComboBoxItem Content="Y only"/>
                </ComboBox>

                <TextBlock Text="" Grid.Column="5"/>
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "Sheet Title Align"
__doc__   = "Reference viewport defines the bucket (Plans/Sections/Legends/Other). Fast cache, pixel overlay, and auto-align (2022+)."

import clr, os, re, glob, json, hashlib, traceback
# .NET
clr.AddReference('System')
clr.AddReference('System.Drawing')
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('WindowsBase')
from System import Array
from System.IO import Path
from System.Drawing import Bitmap, Graphics, Pen, Color, Rectangle, GraphicsUnit
from System.Windows import Thickness, Visibility, GridLength, GridUnitType, VerticalAlignment
from System.Windows.Media import Brushes
from System.Windows.Threading import DispatcherPriority
from System.Collections.Generic import List  # for ImageExportOptions.SetViewsAndSheets

# Revit API
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    FilteredElementCollector, Transaction, XYZ, ViewSheet, Viewport, ViewType,
    BuiltInParameter, ElementId, ImageExportOptions, ImageFileType, ImageResolution,
    ExportRange, FitDirectionType, ZoomFitType, BuiltInCategory
)

# pyRevit
from pyrevit.forms import WPFWindow, alert
from pyrevit import script, UI

# ---------- Paths & context ----------
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(__file__)
XAML_PATH  = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, 'LivePreview.xaml')
TMP_DIR    = Path.GetTempPath()
uidoc      = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
doc        = uidoc.Document

# ---------- Units ----------
FT_TO_MM = 304.8
MM_TO_FT = 1.0 / FT_TO_MM
def mm_to_ft(mm): return float(mm) * MM_TO_FT if mm not in (None, "") else 0.0
def ft_to_mm(ft): return float(ft) * FT_TO_MM if ft is not None else 0.0

# ---------- API feature check ----------
def is_2022_or_newer():
    # Viewport.LabelOffset (get/set) is available starting Revit 2022+
    return hasattr(Viewport, "LabelOffset")

# ---------- Normalization ----------
def normalize_view_key(name):
    s = (name or u"").lower()
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s).strip()

def tokenize_sheet_name(name):
    s = (name or u"").lower()
    s = re.sub(r'\d+', ' ', s)
    return set(re.findall(r'[a-z]+', s))

def sheet_name_similarity(a_tokens, b_tokens):
    """Plain-English set similarity: |A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|."""
    if not a_tokens or not b_tokens:
        return 0.0
    inter = float(len(a_tokens & b_tokens))
    union = float(len(a_tokens | b_tokens))
    return inter / union if union > 0 else 0.0

# ---------- Buckets ----------
PLANS_SET    = set([ViewType.FloorPlan, ViewType.CeilingPlan, ViewType.EngineeringPlan, ViewType.AreaPlan])
SECTIONS_SET = set([ViewType.Section, ViewType.Elevation, ViewType.Detail])
LEGENDS_SET  = set([ViewType.Legend])

def bucket_of(vt):
    if vt in PLANS_SET:    return "PLANS"
    if vt in SECTIONS_SET: return "SECTIONS"
    if vt in LEGENDS_SET:  return "LEGENDS"
    return "OTHER"

def bucket_match(vt, ref_bucket, ref_vt):
    if ref_bucket == "PLANS":    return vt in PLANS_SET
    if ref_bucket == "SECTIONS": return vt in SECTIONS_SET
    if ref_bucket == "LEGENDS":  return vt in LEGENDS_SET
    return vt == ref_vt

# ---------- Sheet + viewport utilities ----------
def all_view_sheets():
    return [vs for vs in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSheet).ToElements()
            if not getattr(vs, "IsPlaceholder", False)]

def viewports_on_sheet(sheet):
    sid = sheet.Id
    vpts = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Viewport).ToElements()
    return [v for v in vpts if v.SheetId == sid]

def is_title_hidden(vpt):
    # Uses Viewport Type parameter and outline fallback
    try:
        vpt_type = doc.GetElement(vpt.GetTypeId())
        if vpt_type:
            p = vpt_type.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.VIEWPORT_ATTR_SHOW_LABEL)
            if p and p.HasValue and p.AsInteger() == 0:
                return True
    except:
        pass
    try:
        ol = vpt.GetLabelOutline()
        if ol is None: return True
    except:
        return True
    return False

def get_abs_title_anchor(vpt):
    # 2022+: viewport box min + LabelOffset; ≤2021: label outline min
    if is_2022_or_newer():
        try:
            vmin = vpt.GetBoxOutline().MinimumPoint
            lo   = vpt.LabelOffset
            return XYZ(vmin.X + lo.X, vmin.Y + lo.Y, 0.0)
        except:
            return None
    try:
        ol = vpt.GetLabelOutline()
        return ol.MinimumPoint if ol else None
    except:
        return None

# ---------- Sheet size and export ----------
def get_sheet_size_ft(sheet):
    tbs = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc, sheet.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks))
    if not tbs: return None, None
    tb = tbs[0]
    pw = tb.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SHEET_WIDTH)
    ph = tb.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SHEET_HEIGHT)
    if pw and ph and pw.HasValue and ph.HasValue:
        return pw.AsDouble(), ph.AsDouble()
    return None, None

def export_sheet_png(sheet, pixel_size=2800):
    """Export a single sheet to image; return (path, Bitmap) or (None, None)."""
    opts = ImageExportOptions()
    opts.ExportRange           = ExportRange.SetOfViews
    opts.HLRandWFViewsFileType = ImageFileType.PNG
    opts.ShadowViewsFileType   = ImageFileType.PNG
    opts.ImageResolution       = ImageResolution.DPI_300
    opts.FitDirection          = FitDirectionType.Horizontal
    opts.ZoomType              = ZoomFitType.FitToPage
    opts.PixelSize             = pixel_size

    base = os.path.join(TMP_DIR, "sheet_export_" + str(sheet.Id.IntegerValue))
    opts.FilePath = base

    try:
        ids = ListElementId         # Correct way to provide view/sheet ids
        ids.Add(sheet.Id)
        opts.SetViewsAndSheets(ids)
        doc.ExportImage(opts)
    except:
        return None, None

    # Accept both PNG and JPG (some versions emit JPG unexpectedly)
    candidates = glob.glob(base + "*.png")
    if not candidates:
        candidates = glob.glob(base + "*.jpg")
    if not candidates:
        # last-chance wildcard by id anywhere in the name
        sid = str(sheet.Id.IntegerValue)
        candidates = glob.glob(os.path.join(TMP_DIR, "*{}*.png".format(sid))) or \
                     glob.glob(os.path.join(TMP_DIR, "*{}*.jpg".format(sid)))
        if not candidates:
            return None, None

    img_path = candidates[0]
    try:
        bmp = Bitmap(img_path); return img_path, bmp
    except:
        return None, None

def make_sheet_to_pixel_mapper(sheet, bmp_w, bmp_h):
    w_ft, h_ft = get_sheet_size_ft(sheet)
    if not w_ft or not h_ft: w_ft, h_ft = 1.0, 1.0
    def map_point(pt):
        x = int(((pt.X / w_ft) + 0.5) * bmp_w)
        y = int((0.5 - (pt.Y / h_ft)) * bmp_h)
        return x, y
    return map_point

# ---------- Persistent JSON Cache ----------
def _doc_cache_path():
    base = (doc.PathName or doc.Title or "unsaved_doc").encode('utf-8')
    h = hashlib.md5(base).hexdigest()[:10]
    return os.path.join(TMP_DIR, "viewtitlecache_{}.json".format(h))

class Cache(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.sheets = []
        self.sheet_records = {}  # sid -> [ {viewid, vptid, viewname, viewtype, hidden}, ... ]
        self._path = _doc_cache_path()

    def load_or_build(self, progress_cb=None):
        if os.path.exists(self._path):
            try:
                with open(self._path, 'r') as f: data = json.load(f)
                self._from_json(data); return True
            except:
                pass
        self.build(progress_cb=progress_cb); self.save(); return False

    def save(self):
        try:
            with open(self._path, 'w') as f: json.dump(self._to_json(), f)
        except:
            pass

    def build(self, progress_cb=None):
        self.sheets = [dict(id=s.Id.IntegerValue, number=s.SheetNumber, name=s.Name)
                       for s in all_view_sheets()]
        by_sid = dict((s['id'], []) for s in self.sheets)
        vpts = list(FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Viewport).ToElements())
        total = max(1, len(vpts)); i = 0
        for vpt in vpts:
            sid = vpt.SheetId
            if sid == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                i += 1
                if progress_cb: progress_cb(i, total)
                continue
            try:
                view = doc.GetElement(vpt.ViewId)
                rec = dict(
                    viewid=view.Id.IntegerValue,
                    vptid=vpt.Id.IntegerValue,
                    viewname=view.Name,
                    viewtype=int(view.ViewType),
                    hidden=bool(is_title_hidden(vpt))
                )
                by_sid[sid.IntegerValue].append(rec)
            except:
                pass
            i += 1
            if progress_cb: progress_cb(i, total)
        self.sheet_records = by_sid

    def _to_json(self):
        return dict(sheets=self.sheets, records=self.sheet_records)

    def _from_json(self, data):
        self.sheets = data.get('sheets', [])
        self.sheet_records = data.get('records', {})

    def get_sheet_by_id(self, sid_int):
        for s in self.sheets:
            if s['id'] == sid_int: return s
        return None

    def get_viewports_on_sheet(self, sid_int):
        return self.sheet_records.get(sid_int, [])

# ---------- Window ----------
class AlignWindow(WPFWindow):
    SIMILAR_THRESH = 0.20  # Option A

    def __init__(self):
        if not os.path.exists(XAML_PATH):
            alert("Missing LivePreview.xaml next to script.", exitscript=True)
        WPFWindow.__init__(self, XAML_PATH)

        self._rows            = []
        self._baseline        = "Both"
        self._tol_mm          = 2.0
        self._compare_similar = True
        self._export_cache    = {}
        self._export_errors   = []
        self._quick_load      = True

        # reference selection
        self._ref_sheet_sid   = None
        self._ref_viewport_id = None
        self._ref_bucket      = None
        self._ref_vt          = None

        self.ModeLabel.Text = u"{} mode".format("Fixable (2022+)" if is_2022_or_newer() else "Report-only (≤2021)")

        # events
        self.ConfirmBtn.Click                += self._on_confirm
        self.CancelBtn.Click                 += self._on_cancel
        self.ReportBtn.Click                 += self._on_report
        self.OverlayBtn.Click                += self._on_overlay
        self.TolBox.TextChanged              += self._on_tol
        self.BaselineBox.SelectionChanged    += self._on_baseline
        self.SameTitleToggle.Checked         += self._on_similar_toggle
        self.SameTitleToggle.Unchecked       += self._on_similar_toggle
        self.RefSheetBox.SelectionChanged    += self._on_ref_sheet_changed
        self.RefViewportBox.SelectionChanged += self._on_ref_viewport_changed
        self.QuickLoadToggle.Checked         += self._on_quickload
        self.QuickLoadToggle.Unchecked       += self._on_quickload
        self.RefreshCacheBtn.Click           += self._on_refresh_cache

        # cache load
        self._cache = Cache()
        self._busy_start(100, "Loading cache...")
        def _cb(i, total):
            self.BusyBar.Value = int((float(i)/max(1,total))*100.0); self._ui_pump()
        try:
            self._cache.load_or_build(progress_cb=_cb)
        finally:
            self._busy_end()

        # populate reference sheet combo
        from System.Windows.Controls import ComboBoxItem
        self.RefSheetBox.Items.Clear()
        sheets_sorted = sorted(self._cache.sheets, key=lambda x: (x['number'] or "", x['name'] or ""))
        for s in sheets_sorted:
            item = ComboBoxItem()
            item.Content = u"{} — {}".format(s['number'], s['name'])
            item.Tag     = s['id']  # SelectedValuePath="Tag" in XAML
            self.RefSheetBox.Items.Add(item)
        if self.RefSheetBox.Items.Count > 0:
            self.RefSheetBox.SelectedIndex = 0  # triggers _on_ref_sheet_changed

        self._rebuild(show_progress=False)

    # ---- Busy helpers ----
    def _ui_pump(self):
        try: self.Dispatcher.Invoke(lambda: None, DispatcherPriority.Background)
        except: pass
    def _busy_start(self, max_count, label="Loading..."):
        self.BusyBar.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
        self.BusyBar.Minimum = 0; self.BusyBar.Maximum = max_count
        self.BusyBar.Value = 0; self.BusyText.Text = label; self._ui_pump()
    def _busy_step(self, inc=1):
        try: self.BusyBar.Value = min(self.BusyBar.Value + inc, self.BusyBar.Maximum)
        except: pass
        self._ui_pump()
    def _busy_end(self):
        self.BusyBar.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
        self.BusyText.Text = ""; self._ui_pump()

    # ---- Events ----
    def _on_cancel(self, s=None, e=None): self.Close()
    def _on_quickload(self, s=None, e=None):
        self._quick_load = bool(self.QuickLoadToggle.IsChecked); self._rebuild(show_progress=False)
    def _on_refresh_cache(self, s=None, e=None):
        self._busy_start(100, "Refreshing cache...")
        def _cb(i, total):
            self.BusyBar.Value = int((float(i)/max(1,total))*100.0); self._ui_pump()
        try:
            self._cache.build(progress_cb=_cb); self._cache.save()
        except Exception:
            alert("Cache build failed:\n\n{}".format(traceback.format_exc()))
        finally:
            self._busy_end()
        from System.Windows.Controls import ComboBoxItem
        self.RefSheetBox.Items.Clear()
        for s in sorted(self._cache.sheets, key=lambda x: (x['number'] or "", x['name'] or "")):
            item = ComboBoxItem(); item.Content = u"{} — {}".format(s['number'], s['name']); item.Tag = s['id']
            self.RefSheetBox.Items.Add(item)
        if self.RefSheetBox.Items.Count > 0: self.RefSheetBox.SelectedIndex = 0

    def _on_report(self, s=None, e=None):
        out = script.get_output(); out.set_height(520)
        out.print_html("<h3>Pick a Reference Viewport; list shows only its bucket (Plans/Sections/Legends/Other) across similar sheets.</h3>")

    def _on_overlay(self, s=None, e=None):
        out = script.get_output(); out.set_height(820)
        if not self._rows: out.print_html("<h3>No rows to show.</h3>"); return
        per_sheet = {}
        for r in self._rows: per_sheet[r['sheet'].Id.IntegerValue] = r['sheet']
        self._busy_start(len(per_sheet), "Exporting sheets & building crops...")
        self._export_errors[:] = []
        out.print_html("<h3>Per‑Title Crops</h3><p><small>Orange crosshair marks the left‑justified anchor.</small></p>")
        for sid, sh in per_sheet.items():
            try:
                if sid not in self._export_cache:
                    pth, bmp = export_sheet_png(sh, pixel_size=2800)
                    if not bmp:
                        self._export_errors.append((u"{} — {}".format(sh.SheetNumber, sh.Name), "No image returned from export."))
                        self._busy_step(1); continue
                    map_fn = make_sheet_to_pixel_mapper(sh, bmp.Width, bmp.Height)
                    self._export_cache[sid] = (pth, bmp, map_fn)
            except Exception as ex:
                self._export_errors.append((u"{} — {}".format(sh.SheetNumber, sh.Name), str(ex)))
            self._busy_step(1)

        idx = 0
        for row in self._rows:
            sid = row['sheet'].Id.IntegerValue
            if sid not in self._export_cache: continue
            _, sheet_bmp, map_px = self._export_cache[sid]
            vpt = row['vpt']
            try: lbl_ol = vpt.GetLabelOutline()
            except: lbl_ol = None

            if lbl_ol:
                minp = lbl_ol.MinimumPoint; maxp = lbl_ol.MaximumPoint
                x0, y0 = map_px(minp); x1, y1 = map_px(maxp)
                left, right = min(x0,x1), max(x0,x1)
                top, bottom = min(y0,y1), max(y0,y1)
                pad = 20
                left  = max(0, left - pad); right  = min(sheet_bmp.Width - 1,  right + pad)
                top   = max(0, top  - pad); bottom = min(sheet_bmp.Height - 1, bottom + pad)
                crop  = self._crop_from(sheet_bmp, left, top, right-left+1, bottom-top+1)
                if is_2022_or_newer() and row['this_pt'] is not None:
                    ax, ay = map_px(row['this_pt'])
                else:
                    ax, ay = map_px(minp)
                cx, cy = ax - left, ay - top
            else:
                anchor = row['ref_pt'] if row['ref_pt'] else row['this_pt']
                if not anchor: continue
                ax, ay = map_px(anchor)
                crop   = self._crop_square(sheet_bmp, ax, ay, pad=60)
                cx, cy = int(crop.Width/2), int(crop.Height/2)

            g = Graphics.FromImage(crop)
            self._draw_crosshair(g, cx, cy, size=12, thickness=4)
            tmp = os.path.join(TMP_DIR, "title_crop_{:04d}.png".format(idx)); idx += 1
            crop.Save(tmp)
            cap = u"{} — {} — {}".format(row['sheet'].SheetNumber, row['sheet'].Name, row['view'].Name)
            out.print_html(u"<p><b>{}</b></p>".format(cap))
            out.print_image(tmp)

        self._busy_end()
        if self._export_errors:
            html = ["<h4>Overlay export issues</h4><ul>"]
            for (nm, reason) in self._export_errors:
                html.append("<li><b>{}</b>: {}</li>".format(nm, reason))
            html.append("</ul>")
            out.print_html("".join(html))

    def _on_tol(self, s=None, e=None):
        try:
            self._tol_mm = float(self.TolBox.Text or "2")
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            self._rebuild(show_progress=False)
        except:
            self.Banner.Text = u"Tolerance must be a number"
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible

    def _on_baseline(self, s=None, e=None):
        idx = int(self.BaselineBox.SelectedIndex)
        self._baseline = ["Both", "X only", "Y only"][idx]
        self._rebuild(show_progress=False)

    def _on_similar_toggle(self, s=None, e=None):
        try: self._compare_similar = bool(self.SameTitleToggle.IsChecked)
        except: self._compare_similar = True
        self._rebuild(show_progress=False)

    # ---- Reference selection handlers ----
    def _on_ref_sheet_changed(self, s=None, e=None):
        # Prefer SelectedValue (when XAML sets SelectedValuePath="Tag"); fallback to SelectedItem.Tag
        sel = getattr(self.RefSheetBox, 'SelectedValue', None)
        if not sel:
            item = getattr(self.RefSheetBox, 'SelectedItem', None)
            sel  = getattr(item, 'Tag', None) if item is not None else None

        self._ref_sheet_sid   = int(sel) if sel else None
        self._ref_viewport_id = None
        self._ref_bucket      = None
        self._ref_vt          = None

        self._populate_ref_viewport_box()
        self._rebuild(show_progress=False)

    def _populate_ref_viewport_box(self):
        """Populate Reference Viewport list for the selected sheet (all VPs on that sheet)."""
        from System.Windows.Controls import ComboBoxItem
        self.RefViewportBox.Items.Clear()
        if not self._ref_sheet_sid:
            return

        recs = self._cache.get_viewports_on_sheet(self._ref_sheet_sid) or []
        # Fallback live query if cache missed
        if not recs:
            try:
                sh_elem = doc.GetElement(ElementId(self._ref_sheet_sid))
                vpts = viewports_on_sheet(sh_elem)
                for vpt in vpts:
                    view = doc.GetElement(vpt.ViewId)
                    recs.append(dict(
                        viewid   = view.Id.IntegerValue,
                        vptid    = vpt.Id.IntegerValue,
                        viewname = view.Name,
                        viewtype = int(view.ViewType),
                        hidden   = bool(is_title_hidden(vpt))
                    ))
            except:
                recs = []

        # Placeholder
        ph = ComboBoxItem(); ph.Content = u"— Select —"; ph.Tag = None
        self.RefViewportBox.Items.Add(ph)

        for r in sorted(recs, key=lambda x: (x['viewname'] or "", x['vptid'])):
            item = ComboBoxItem()
            item.Content = u"{} (vpt #{})".format(r['viewname'], r['vptid'])
            # store both viewport id and viewtype for quicker bucket resolution
            item.Tag = (r['vptid'], r['viewtype'])  # SelectedValuePath="Tag" in XAML
            self.RefViewportBox.Items.Add(item)

        self.RefViewportBox.SelectedIndex = 0

    def _on_ref_viewport_changed(self, s=None, e=None):
        self._ref_viewport_id = None
        self._ref_bucket = None
        self._ref_vt = None

        # Prefer SelectedValue; fallback to SelectedItem.Tag
        sel = getattr(self.RefViewportBox, 'SelectedValue', None)
        if not sel:
            item = getattr(self.RefViewportBox, 'SelectedItem', None)
            sel  = getattr(item, 'Tag', None) if item is not None else None

        if sel is None:
            self._rebuild(show_progress=False); return

        try:
            if hasattr(sel, '__len__') and len(sel) == 2:
                vptid, vt_int = sel
                self._ref_viewport_id = int(vptid)
                self._ref_vt          = ViewType(int(vt_int))
                self._ref_bucket      = bucket_of(self._ref_vt)
            else:
                self._ref_viewport_id = int(sel)
                vpt = doc.GetElement(ElementId(self._ref_viewport_id))
                if vpt:
                    view = doc.GetElement(vpt.ViewId)
                    self._ref_vt     = view.ViewType
                    self._ref_bucket = bucket_of(self._ref_vt)
        except:
            self._ref_viewport_id = None
            self._ref_bucket = None
            self._ref_vt = None

        self._rebuild(show_progress=True)

    # ---- Rebuild grid ----
    def _rebuild(self, show_progress=False):
        from System.Windows.Controls import Grid, ColumnDefinition, TextBlock, CheckBox
        from System.Windows import GridLength as GL, GridUnitType as GUT

        self.RowsHost.Children.Clear()
        self._rows[:] = []

        if not self._ref_sheet_sid or not self._ref_bucket:
            self.Banner.Text = u"Pick a Reference Sheet, then a Reference Viewport to start."
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = False
            return

        self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed

        refsheet_info = self._cache.get_sheet_by_id(self._ref_sheet_sid)
        if not refsheet_info:
            self.Banner.Text = u"Reference sheet not found in cache."
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = False
            return

        if self._compare_similar:
            tokens_ref = tokenize_sheet_name(refsheet_info['name'])
            target_sheet_ids = []
            for s in self._cache.sheets:
                if s['id'] == self._ref_sheet_sid: continue
                if sheet_name_similarity(tokens_ref, tokenize_sheet_name(s['name'])) >= self.SIMILAR_THRESH:
                    target_sheet_ids.append(s['id'])
        else:
            target_sheet_ids = [s['id'] for s in self._cache.sheets]

        tol_ft = mm_to_ft(self._tol_mm)

        # exact reference anchor (from selected ref viewport)
        ref_anchor = None
        if self._ref_viewport_id:
            try:
                ref_vpt = doc.GetElement(ElementId(self._ref_viewport_id))
                ref_hidden = is_title_hidden(ref_vpt)
                if not ref_hidden:
                    ref_anchor = get_abs_title_anchor(ref_vpt)
            except:
                ref_anchor = None

        if show_progress:
            self._busy_start(max_count=len(target_sheet_ids), label="Building rows...")

        for sid in sorted(target_sheet_ids):
            sh_elem = doc.GetElement(ElementId(sid))
            if not sh_elem:
                if show_progress: self._busy_step(1)
                continue

            vpt_recs = self._cache.get_viewports_on_sheet(sid)
            sheet_rows = 0  # only add header when we add first row

            for r in vpt_recs:
                vt = ViewType(r['viewtype'])
                if not bucket_match(vt, self._ref_bucket, self._ref_vt):
                    continue

                vpt  = doc.GetElement(ElementId(r['vptid']))
                view = doc.GetElement(ElementId(r['viewid']))

                this_hidden = is_title_hidden(vpt)
                this_anchor = None if this_hidden else get_abs_title_anchor(vpt)

                hidden_state = u"No"
                if this_hidden and (ref_anchor is None): hidden_state = u"Both"
                elif this_hidden:                       hidden_state = u"This"
                elif ref_anchor is None:                hidden_state = u"Ref"

                dx_mm = dy_mm = None; preselect = False
                if (ref_anchor is not None) and (this_anchor is not None):
                    dx = this_anchor.X - ref_anchor.X
                    dy = this_anchor.Y - ref_anchor.Y
                    if self._baseline in ("Both", "X only"): dx_mm = ft_to_mm(abs(dx))
                    if self._baseline in ("Both", "Y only"): dy_mm = ft_to_mm(abs(dy))
                    over_x = (self._baseline in ("Both", "X only")) and (abs(dx) > tol_ft)
                    over_y = (self._baseline in ("Both", "Y only")) and (abs(dy) > tol_ft)
                    preselect = (over_x or over_y)

                # Only add rows where at least one anchor exists
                if (ref_anchor is not None) or (this_anchor is not None):
                    if sheet_rows == 0:
                        self._add_sheet_header(u"{} — {}".format(sh_elem.SheetNumber, sh_elem.Name))

                    # Row grid: 0 Select (80), 1 View (*), then 7 fixed numeric columns
                    g = Grid(); g.Margin = Thickness(0,1,0,1)
                    # 0: Select fixed
                    cd = ColumnDefinition(); cd.Width = GL(80); g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(cd)
                    # 1: View *
                    cd = ColumnDefinition(); cd.Width = GL(3, GridUnitType.Star); g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(cd)
                    # 2..8: fixed numeric-style
                    for w in (120,120,120,120,120,120,120):
                        cd = ColumnDefinition(); cd.Width = GL(w); g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(cd)

                    from System.Windows.Controls import TextBlock, CheckBox
                    chk = CheckBox(); chk.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
                    chk.IsChecked = bool(preselect); chk.IsEnabled = True; chk.IsHitTestVisible = True
                    g.Children.Add(chk); Grid.SetColumn(chk, 0)

                    def add_tb(txt, col, brush=None):
                        tb = TextBlock(); tb.Text = txt
                        if brush is not None: tb.Foreground = brush
                        g.Children.Add(tb); Grid.SetColumn(tb, col)

                    # No "Sheet" column anymore; sheet is shown in the header above each group
                    add_tb(view.Name, 1)
                    add_tb(hidden_state, 2)
                    add_tb("-" if ref_anchor  is None else "{:.3f}".format(ref_anchor.X), 3)
                    add_tb("-" if this_anchor is None else "{:.3f}".format(this_anchor.X), 4)
                    add_tb("-" if ref_anchor  is None else "{:.3f}".format(ref_anchor.Y), 5)
                    add_tb("-" if this_anchor is None else "{:.3f}".format(this_anchor.Y), 6)
                    add_tb("-" if dx_mm is None else "{:.1f}".format(dx_mm), 7,
                           Brushes.Gainsboro if (dx_mm is None or abs(dx_mm) < 0.1) else Brushes.Orange)
                    add_tb("-" if dy_mm is None else "{:.1f}".format(dy_mm), 8,
                           Brushes.Gainsboro if (dy_mm is None or abs(dy_mm) < 0.1) else Brushes.Orange)

                    self.RowsHost.Children.Add(g)
                    self._rows.append(dict(
                        chk=chk, sheet=sh_elem, view=view, vpt=vpt,
                        ref_pt=ref_anchor, this_pt=this_anchor
                    ))
                    sheet_rows += 1

            if show_progress: self._busy_step(1)

        if show_progress: self._busy_end()
        self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = is_2022_or_newer() and (len(self._rows) > 0)

        if len(self._rows) == 0:
            self.Banner.Text = u"No comparable views found. Try another reference viewport or disable similar sheet names."
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
        else:
            self.Banner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed

    def _add_sheet_header(self, title):
        from System.Windows.Controls import Grid, ColumnDefinition, TextBlock
        g = Grid(); g.Margin = Thickness(0,8,0,4)
        cd = ColumnDefinition(); cd.Width = GridLength(1280)
        g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(cd)
        tb = TextBlock(); tb.Text = title; tb.Foreground = Brushes.LightBlue
        g.Children.Add(tb); self.RowsHost.Children.Add(g)

    # ---- Align Selected (2022+) ----
    def _on_confirm(self, s=None, e=None):
        if not is_2022_or_newer():
            alert("Revit ≤2021: report-only; no LabelOffset setter."); return
        to_fix = [r for r in self._rows if bool(getattr(r['chk'], 'IsChecked', False))]
        if not to_fix: alert("Nothing selected."); return

        t = Transaction(doc, "Align View Titles")
        t.Start()
        fixed = failed = 0
        try:
            for row in to_fix:
                vpt = row['vpt']; ref_pt = row['ref_pt']; this_pt = row['this_pt']
                if not (vpt and ref_pt and this_pt):
                    failed += 1; continue
                try:
                    vmin    = vpt.GetBoxOutline().MinimumPoint
                    cur_abs = XYZ(vmin.X + vpt.LabelOffset.X, vmin.Y + vpt.LabelOffset.Y, 0.0)
                    delta   = ref_pt - cur_abs
                    new_off = vpt.LabelOffset
                    if self._baseline in ("Both", "X only"): new_off = XYZ(new_off.X + delta.X, new_off.Y, 0.0)
                    if self._baseline in ("Both", "Y only"): new_off = XYZ(new_off.X, new_off.Y + delta.Y, 0.0)
                    vpt.LabelOffset = new_off
                    fixed += 1
                except:
                    failed += 1
        finally:
            t.Commit()
        UI.TaskDialog.Show("Align Titles", "Aligned: {}\nFailed: {}".format(fixed, failed))
        self.Close()

    # ---- Overlay helpers ----
    def _crop_from(self, full_bmp, x, y, w, h):
        w = max(1, min(w, full_bmp.Width  - x))
        h = max(1, min(h, full_bmp.Height - y))
        target = Bitmap(w, h)
        g = Graphics.FromImage(target)
        g.DrawImage(full_bmp, 0, 0, Rectangle(x, y, w, h), GraphicsUnit.Pixel)
        return target

    def _crop_square(self, full_bmp, cx, cy, pad=60):
        left  = max(0, cx - pad); top    = max(0, cy - pad)
        right = min(full_bmp.Width-1,  cx + pad); bottom = min(full_bmp.Height-1, cy + pad)
        return self._crop_from(full_bmp, left, top, right-left+1, bottom-top+1)

    def _draw_crosshair(self, g, x, y, size=12, thickness=4):
        pen = Pen(Color.FromArgb(255, 255, 128, 0), thickness)
        g.DrawLine(pen, x - size, y, x + size, y)
        g.DrawLine(pen, x, y - size, x, y + size)

# ---- Run ----
AlignWindow().ShowDialog()
```

```
# Sheet Title Align

## Purpose
Preview and align viewport title positions on sheets using a reference viewport and bucketed view-type matching.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`
- `LivePreview.xaml`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local WPF preview, image export, caching, and alignment logic in `script.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Preserve the current bucket model for plans, sections, legends, and other view types.
- Keep preview and apply behavior aligned, especially where Revit 2022+ API differences affect label offsets.
- Treat cached image export and auto-align behavior as performance-sensitive surfaces.
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "Coordinator (Modeless, Hardened)"
__doc__   = "Modeless WPF: diagnostics + safer 3D highlights + adopt with preview/apply, including fail-safes and cleanup."

# ----------------- WPF assemblies -----------------
import clr, os, math, tempfile, time
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')

# ----------------- Revit API ----------------------
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    FilteredElementCollector, BuiltInCategory, ElementId, Transaction,
    RevitLinkInstance, LocationCurve, LocationPoint,
    OverrideGraphicSettings, Color, FillPatternElement, FillPatternTarget,
    ImageExportOptions, ExportRange, ImageFileType, ZoomFitType, ImageResolution,
    TemporaryViewMode, View3D
)
from Autodesk.Revit.UI import IExternalEventHandler, ExternalEvent
from Autodesk.Revit.UI.Selection import ObjectType
from pyrevit import script, forms, HOST_APP

# ----------------- WPF types ----------------------
from System import Uri
from System.Windows import Style, Setter, Trigger
from System.Windows.Media import Imaging, BrushConverter
from System.Windows.Controls import DataGrid, DataGridRow
from System.Windows.Controls.Primitives import DataGridColumnHeader

# ----------------- Context ------------------------
uidoc = HOST_APP.uidoc
doc   = HOST_APP.doc
app   = HOST_APP.app
log   = script.get_logger()
out   = script.get_output()

# ----------------- Feature toggles ----------------
# Keep modeless to allow Revit interaction; DB actions run via ExternalEvent
MODAL_MODE            = False
ENABLE_MODEL_EVENT    = True

# Safer default: use temporary isolate for highlights (no heavy per-element overrides)
USE_TRANSIENT_PREVIEW_DEFAULT = True

# When using persistent overrides, apply in batches and regenerate
OVERRIDE_BATCH_SIZE   = 250

# Hard cap to avoid stressing graphics cache (if over, force transient)
MAX_PERSISTENT_OVERRIDES = 1200

# ----------------- Dark theme helpers -------------
_bc = BrushConverter()
def _b(hexstr): return _bc.ConvertFromString(hexstr)

def apply_dark_theme_to_grid(grid):
    try:
        grid.Background = _b("#1e1e1e")
        grid.Foreground = _b("#f1f1f1")
        grid.RowBackground = _b("#252526")
        grid.AlternatingRowBackground = _b("#2d2d30")
        grid.BorderBrush = _b("#3f3f46")
        grid.HorizontalGridLinesBrush = _b("#3f3f46")
        grid.VerticalGridLinesBrush = _b("#3f3f46")

        hdr_style = Style(DataGridColumnHeader)
        hdr_style.Setters.Add(Setter(DataGridColumnHeader.BackgroundProperty, _b("#2a2d2e")))
        hdr_style.Setters.Add(Setter(DataGridColumnHeader.ForegroundProperty, _b("#cccccc")))
        hdr_style.Setters.Add(Setter(DataGridColumnHeader.BorderBrushProperty, _b("#3f3f46")))
        grid.ColumnHeaderStyle = hdr_style

        row_style = Style(DataGridRow)
        trg = Trigger()
        trg.Property = DataGridRow.IsSelectedProperty
        trg.Value = True
        trg.Setters.Add(Setter(DataGridRow.BackgroundProperty, _b("#094771")))
        trg.Setters.Add(Setter(DataGridRow.ForegroundProperty, _b("#ffffff")))
        row_style.Triggers.Add(trg)
        grid.RowStyle = row_style
    except:
        pass

# ----------------- Diagnostics --------------------
def _report_env(win=None):
    try:
        ver = getattr(app, 'VersionNumber', '')
        sub = getattr(app, 'SubVersionNumber', '')
        pj  = doc.PathName or "<unsaved>"
        cnt = FilteredElementCollector(doc).GetElementCount()
        msg = "Revit {} ({}), Doc: {}, Elements: {}".format(ver, sub, pj, cnt)
        out.print_md("**Environment**: " + msg)
        if win: win._status(msg)
    except:
        pass

# ----------------- Small geometry helpers --------
def _loc_curve(e):
    try:
        lc = e.Location
        return lc.Curve if isinstance(lc, LocationCurve) else None
    except: return None

def _loc_point(e):
    try:
        lp = e.Location
        return lp.Point if isinstance(lp, LocationPoint) else None
    except: return None

def _get_links():
    out=[]
    try:
        for li in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(RevitLinkInstance):
            try:
                ldoc = li.GetLinkDocument()
                if ldoc:
                    trf = li.GetTotalTransform() or li.GetTransform()
                    out.append((li, ldoc, trf))
            except:
                continue
    except:
        pass
    return out

# ----------------- Safer override helpers --------
def _solid_drafting_fill(doc):
    """Return a solid FILL PATTERN (drafting) or None."""
    try:
        for fpe in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(FillPatternElement):
            fp = fpe.GetFillPattern()
            if fp and fp.IsSolidFill and fp.Target == FillPatternTarget.Drafting:
                return fpe
    except:
        pass
    return None

def _apply_overrides_batched(view, eid_ints, rgb=(255,0,0), batch=250, trackset=None):
    """
    Apply per-element overrides in batches with periodic regenerate.
    Track overridden ids for cleanup if trackset is provided.
    """
    if not isinstance(view, View3D):
        return 0

    ids = []
    for e in eid_ints:
        try:
            ids.append(e if isinstance(e, ElementId) else ElementId(int(e)))
        except:
            pass
    if not ids:
        return 0

    ogs = OverrideGraphicSettings()
    try:
        ogs.SetProjectionLineColor(Color(rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]))
    except:
        pass
    sf = _solid_drafting_fill(doc)
    if sf:
        try:
            ogs.SetSurfaceForegroundPatternId(sf.Id)
            ogs.SetSurfaceForegroundPatternColor(Color(255,200,200))
        except:
            pass

    t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Apply Highlights (batched)")
    t.Start()
    applied = 0
    try:
        for i, eid in enumerate(ids, 1):
            try:
                el  = doc.GetElement(eid)
                if (not el) or (hasattr(el, 'IsValidObject') and not el.IsValidObject):
                    continue
                if hasattr(el, 'Document') and el.Document is not doc:
                    continue
                view.SetElementOverrides(eid, ogs)   # View.SetElementOverrides rules apply  
                applied += 1
                if trackset is not None:
                    trackset.add(eid.IntegerValue)
            except:
                continue

            if (i % batch) == 0:
                try: doc.Regenerate()
                except: pass

        try: doc.Regenerate()
        except: pass
    finally:
        try: t.Commit()
        except:
            try: t.RollBack()
            except: pass
    return applied

def _clear_overrides(view, overridden_ids):
    if not overridden_ids:
        return 0
    ogs = OverrideGraphicSettings()  # empty clears overrides
    t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Clear Overrides")
    t.Start()
    cleared = 0
    try:
        for eid_int in list(overridden_ids):
            try:
                view.SetElementOverrides(ElementId(int(eid_int)), ogs)
                cleared += 1
            except:
                pass
    finally:
        try: t.Commit()
        except:
            try: t.RollBack()
            except: pass
    overridden_ids.clear()
    return cleared

def _isolate_transient(view, eid_ints):
    """
    Safer 'preview' – isolate mismatched elements in the active 3D view using
    Temporary Hide/Isolate. It’s lightweight and reversible.
    """
    if not isinstance(view, View3D):
        return 0
    ids = []
    for e in eid_ints:
        try:
            ids.append(e if isinstance(e, ElementId) else ElementId(int(e)))
        except:
            pass
    if not ids:
        return 0

    t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Transient Isolate")
    t.Start()
    try:
        view.IsolateElementsTemporary(ids)
    finally:
        try: t.Commit()
        except:
            try: t.RollBack()
            except: pass
    return len(ids)

def _clear_transient_isolate(view):
    if not isinstance(view, View3D):
        return
    t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Clear Transient Isolate")
    t.Start()
    try:
        view.TemporaryViewModes.DeactivateMode(TemporaryViewMode.TemporaryHideIsolate)
    finally:
        try: t.Commit()
        except:
            try: t.RollBack()
            except: pass

# ----------------- ExternalEvent handler ---------
class _ModelHandler(IExternalEventHandler):
    def __init__(self, window):
        self._w = window
        self._payload = None
    def set_payload(self, func, args):
        self._payload = (func, args)
    def Execute(self, app_ui):
        # serialize DB executions to avoid re-entrancy
        if self._w._evt_busy:
            return
        self._w._evt_busy = True
        try:
            if self._payload:
                func, args = self._payload
                func(*args)              # Valid API context for modeless DB edits  
        except Exception as ex:
            try: self._w._status("Error: {}: {}".format(type(ex).__name__, ex))
            except: pass
        finally:
            self._payload = None
            self._w._evt_busy = False
    def GetName(self): return "Coordinator - ModelHandler"

# ----------------- Window ------------------------
class CoordinatorWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
    def __init__(self):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, script.get_bundle_file('UI.xaml'))
        self._view = doc.ActiveView

        # storage for discrepancy results -> feeds Adopt list
        self._mismatch_ids_by_cat = {'Walls':set(), 'Floors':set(), 'Columns':set(), 'Framing':set()}

        # track persistent overrides for cleanup
        self._overridden_ids = set()

        # ExternalEvent + reentrancy flag
        self._model_handler = _ModelHandler(self)
        self._model_event   = ExternalEvent.Create(self._model_handler)
        self._evt_busy      = False

        # runtime options
        self._use_transient = USE_TRANSIENT_PREVIEW_DEFAULT

        self._wire()
        self._load_grid_all()  # initial list from active view
        _report_env(self)      # diagnostics
        self.Closed += self._on_closed  # ensure cleanup on window close

    # ----- UI wiring & helpers -----
    def _wire(self):
        # sliders -> labels
        self.sldDist.ValueChanged += self._on_dist_changed
        self.sldAng.ValueChanged  += self._on_ang_changed

        # category checkboxes update Adopt list
        for cb in (self.chkWalls, self.chkFloors, self.chkCols, self.chkFraming):
            cb.Checked   += self._on_cats_changed
            cb.Unchecked += self._on_cats_changed

        # optional toggle (if you add <CheckBox x:Name="chkTransient" .../> later)
        try:
            if getattr(self, 'chkTransient', None):
                self._use_transient = bool(self.chkTransient.IsChecked)
                def _on_t(_s,_e): self._use_transient = bool(self.chkTransient.IsChecked)
                self.chkTransient.Checked += _on_t
                self.chkTransient.Unchecked += _on_t
        except: pass

        # buttons
        self.btnRun.Click     += self._on_run_highlights
        self.btnPick.Click    += self._on_pick_current
        self.btnPreview.Click += self._on_preview
        self.btnApply.Click   += self._on_apply
        self.btnLoadSel.Click += self._on_load_from_selection

        # optional cleanup buttons (add them to XAML if desired)
        try:
            if getattr(self, 'btnClearTransient', None):
                self.btnClearTransient.Click += lambda s,e: self._clear_transient()
        except: pass
        try:
            if getattr(self, 'btnClearOverrides', None):
                self.btnClearOverrides.Click += lambda s,e: self._clear_overrides_clicked()
        except: pass

        # filter box
        self.txtFilter.TextChanged += self._on_filter_changed

        # theme
        apply_dark_theme_to_grid(self.dgElems)

        # initial status
        self._status("Ready. Modeless; DB ops via ExternalEvent.")

    def _on_closed(self, s, e):
        # Cleanup transient isolate so user never gets stuck in isolated view
        try: _clear_transient_isolate(doc.ActiveView)
        except: pass

    def _status(self, msg):
        try: self.StatusText.Text = msg
        except: pass
        try: out.print_msg(msg)
        except: pass

    # ----- data/grid helpers -----
    def _rows_from_ids(self, ids):
        rows=[]
        for idlike in ids:
            try:
                eid = idlike if isinstance(idlike, ElementId) else ElementId(int(idlike))
                el = doc.GetElement(eid)
                if not el: continue
                cat = el.Category.Name if el.Category else ''
                typ = doc.GetElement(el.GetTypeId()).Name if el.GetTypeId()!=ElementId.InvalidElementId else ''
                lvl = doc.GetElement(el.LevelId).Name if hasattr(el,'LevelId') and el.LevelId!=ElementId.InvalidElementId else ''
                rows.append({'_e':el,'Category':cat,'Id':el.Id.IntegerValue,'Type':typ,'Level':lvl})
            except:
                pass
        return rows

    def _rows_from_view(self, view):
        rows=[]
        cats = [BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls, BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors,
                BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns, BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming]
        for bic in cats:
            for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfCategory(bic).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                try:
                    cat = e.Category.Name if e.Category else ''
                    typ = doc.GetElement(e.GetTypeId()).Name if e.GetTypeId()!=ElementId.InvalidElementId else ''
                    lvl = doc.GetElement(e.LevelId).Name if hasattr(e,'LevelId') and e.LevelId!=ElementId.InvalidElementId else ''
                    rows.append({'_e':e,'Category':cat,'Id':e.Id.IntegerValue,'Type':typ,'Level':lvl})
                except: pass
        return rows

    def _load_grid_all(self):
        self._rows = self._rows_from_view(self._view)
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = self._rows

    def _rebuild_adopt_list_from_mismatches(self):
        include = set()
        if self.chkWalls.IsChecked:   include |= self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Walls']
        if self.chkFloors.IsChecked:  include |= self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Floors']
        if self.chkCols.IsChecked:    include |= self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Columns']
        if self.chkFraming.IsChecked: include |= self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Framing']
        self._rows = self._rows_from_ids(include)
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = self._rows

    # ----- UI events -----
    def _on_dist_changed(self, s, e): self.lblDist.Text = str(int(self.sldDist.Value))
    def _on_ang_changed(self,  s, e): self.lblAng.Text  = str(round(self.sldAng.Value,1))
    def _on_cats_changed(self, s, e): self._rebuild_adopt_list_from_mismatches()

    def _on_filter_changed(self, s, e):
        t = (self.txtFilter.Text or '').lower().strip()
        src = self._rows
        if not t:
            self.dgElems.ItemsSource = src; return
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = [r for r in src if
                                    t in str(r['Id']).lower() or
                                    t in (r['Category'] or '').lower() or
                                    t in (r['Type'] or '').lower() or
                                    t in (r['Level'] or '').lower()]

    # ----- HIGHLIGHTS (Left) -----
    def _on_run_highlights(self, s, e):
        if self._evt_busy:
            self._status("Busy. Please wait…")
            return
        self._status("Running highlights...")
        if ENABLE_MODEL_EVENT and not MODAL_MODE:
            self._model_handler.set_payload(self._run_highlights_core, tuple())
            self._model_event.Raise()
        else:
            self._run_highlights_core()

    def _compute_discrepancies(self, do_walls, do_floors, do_cols, do_framing, dist_tol, ang_tol):
        v = doc.ActiveView
        # host elements in current view
        host_walls   = [w for w in FilteredElementCollector(doc, v.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls).WhereElementIsNotElementType() if _loc_curve(w)]
        host_floors  = [f for f in FilteredElementCollector(doc, v.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors).WhereElementIsNotElementType()]
        host_cols    = [c for c in FilteredElementCollector(doc, v.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns).WhereElementIsNotElementType() if _loc_point(c)]
        host_frames  = [b for b in FilteredElementCollector(doc, v.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming).WhereElementIsNotElementType() if _loc_curve(b)]

        bad_walls=set(); bad_floors=set(); bad_cols=set(); bad_frames=set()

        def _nearest_curve(anchor_curve, candidates):
            best=None; best_d=1e9
            for e in candidates:
                try:
                    c = _loc_curve(e); mid = c.Evaluate(0.5, True)
                    d = mid.DistanceTo(anchor_curve.Evaluate(0.5, True))
                    if d<best_d: best=e; best_d=d
                except: pass
            return best, best_d

        def _nearest_point(anchor_pt, candidates):
            best=None; best_d=1e9
            for e in candidates:
                try:
                    p = _loc_point(e); d = anchor_pt.DistanceTo(p)
                    if d<best_d: best=e; best_d=d
                except: pass
            return best, best_d

        for li, ldoc, trf in _get_links():
            # Walls
            if do_walls:
                for aw in FilteredElementCollector(ldoc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                    try:
                        ac = _loc_curve(aw)
                        if not ac: continue
                        ac = ac.CreateTransformed(trf)                  # compare in host coords  
                        sw, d = _nearest_curve(ac, host_walls)
                        if not sw: continue
                        ac_dir = ac.ComputeDerivatives(0.5, True).BasisX.Normalize()
                        sw_dir = _loc_curve(sw).ComputeDerivatives(0.5, True).BasisX.Normalize()
                        ang = ac_dir.AngleTo(sw_dir)
                        if d > dist_tol or ang > ang_tol:
                            bad_walls.add(sw.Id.IntegerValue)
                    except: pass
            # Floors
            if do_floors:
                for af in FilteredElementCollector(ldoc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                    try:
                        bb = af.get_BoundingBox(None); a_ct = trf.OfPoint((bb.Min + bb.Max)*0.5)
                        sf, d = _nearest_point(a_ct, host_floors)
                        if sf and d > dist_tol:
                            bad_floors.add(sf.Id.IntegerValue)
                    except: pass
            # Columns
            if do_cols:
                for ac in FilteredElementCollector(ldoc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Columns).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                    try:
                        ap = trf.OfPoint(_loc_point(ac))
                        sc, d = _nearest_point(ap, host_cols)
                        if sc and d > dist_tol:
                            bad_cols.add(sc.Id.IntegerValue)
                    except: pass
            # Framing
            if do_framing:
                for ab in FilteredElementCollector(ldoc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                    try:
                        ac = _loc_curve(ab)
                        if not ac: continue
                        ac = ac.CreateTransformed(trf)
                        sb, d = _nearest_curve(ac, host_frames)
                        if not sb: continue
                        ac_dir = ac.ComputeDerivatives(0.5, True).BasisX.Normalize()
                        sb_dir = _loc_curve(sb).ComputeDerivatives(0.5, True).BasisX.Normalize()
                        ang = ac_dir.AngleTo(sb_dir)
                        if d > dist_tol or ang > ang_tol:
                            bad_frames.add(sb.Id.IntegerValue)
                    except: pass

        return bad_walls, bad_floors, bad_cols, bad_frames

    def _run_highlights_core(self):
        v = doc.ActiveView
        if not isinstance(v, View3D):
            forms.alert("Run highlights on a 3D view.", exitscript=False)
            return

        # clear previous temporary isolate if present
        _clear_transient_isolate(v)

        do_walls   = bool(self.chkWalls.IsChecked)
        do_floors  = bool(self.chkFloors.IsChecked)
        do_cols    = bool(self.chkCols.IsChecked)
        do_framing = bool(self.chkFraming.IsChecked)
        dist_tol   = float(self.sldDist.Value)/304.8
        ang_tol    = math.radians(float(self.sldAng.Value))

        # 1) compute mismatches
        ts0 = time.time()
        bad_walls, bad_floors, bad_cols, bad_frames = \
            self._compute_discrepancies(do_walls, do_floors, do_cols, do_framing, dist_tol, ang_tol)
        calc_ms = int((time.time()-ts0)*1000)

        # 2) preview (transient) OR persistent overrides (batched & capped)
        all_ids = list(bad_walls | bad_floors | bad_cols | bad_frames)

        # auto-fallback to transient if too many elements for persistent overrides
        too_many = len(all_ids) > MAX_PERSISTENT_OVERRIDES

        if self._use_transient or too_many:
            flagged = _isolate_transient(v, all_ids)  # reversible preview
            mode = "Transient isolate"
            if too_many:
                mode += " (auto; exceeded cap of {})".format(MAX_PERSISTENT_OVERRIDES)
            self._status("{}: {} element(s). [calc={} ms]".format(mode, flagged, calc_ms))
        else:
            applied = _apply_overrides_batched(v, all_ids, rgb=(255,0,0),
                                               batch=OVERRIDE_BATCH_SIZE,
                                               trackset=self._overridden_ids)    # View.SetElementOverrides  
            self._status("Overrides applied to {} element(s). [calc={} ms]".format(applied, calc_ms))

        # 3) persist IDs for right pane
        self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Walls']   = bad_walls
        self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Floors']  = bad_floors
        self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Columns'] = bad_cols
        self._mismatch_ids_by_cat['Framing'] = bad_frames
        self._rebuild_adopt_list_from_mismatches()

    # ----- Cleanup buttons (optional) -----
    def _clear_transient(self):
        try:
            _clear_transient_isolate(doc.ActiveView)
            self._status("Transient isolate cleared.")
        except:
            self._status("Could not clear transient isolate.")

    def _clear_overrides_clicked(self):
        try:
            cleared = _clear_overrides(doc.ActiveView, self._overridden_ids)
            self._status("Cleared overrides for {} element(s).".format(cleared))
        except:
            self._status("Could not clear overrides.")

    # ----- ADOPT (Right) -----
    def _nearest_arch_counterpart(self, e_host):
        catInt = e_host.Category.Id.IntegerValue
        if catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls):
            bic = BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls
            anchor = _loc_curve(e_host).Evaluate(0.5, True);  is_curve=True
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors):
            bic = BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors
            bb = e_host.get_BoundingBox(None); anchor = (bb.Min + bb.Max)*0.5; is_curve=False
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns):
            bic = BuiltInCategory.OST_Columns
            anchor = _loc_point(e_host); is_curve=False
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming):
            bic = BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming
            anchor = _loc_curve(e_host).Evaluate(0.5, True); is_curve=True
        else:
            return None, None

        best=None; best_d=1e9; best_trf=None
        for li, ldoc, trf in _get_links():
            for ae in FilteredElementCollector(ldoc).OfCategory(bic).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
                try:
                    if is_curve:
                        ac = _loc_curve(ae)
                        if not ac: continue
                        d = anchor.DistanceTo(ac.CreateTransformed(trf).Evaluate(0.5, True))
                    else:
                        if bic == BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors:
                            bb = ae.get_BoundingBox(None); ap = trf.OfPoint((bb.Min + bb.Max)*0.5)
                        else:
                            p = _loc_point(ae)
                            if not p: continue
                            ap = trf.OfPoint(p)
                        d = anchor.DistanceTo(ap)
                    if d<best_d:
                        best, best_d, best_trf = ae, d, trf
                except: pass
        return best, best_trf

    def _adopt_once(self, e_host, arch_elem, trf):
        # Minimal geometry adoption; extend with openings & type mapping as needed
        catInt = e_host.Category.Id.IntegerValue
        if catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls):
            lc = e_host.Location
            lc.Curve = arch_elem.Location.Curve.CreateTransformed(trf)
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming):
            lc = e_host.Location
            lc.Curve = arch_elem.Location.Curve.CreateTransformed(trf)
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns):
            lp = e_host.Location
            lp.Point = trf.OfPoint(arch_elem.Location.Point)
        elif catInt == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors):
            # TODO: Rebuild from Arch loops & adopt openings
            pass

    def _resolve_selected_row(self):
        row = self.dgElems.SelectedItem
        if row: return row
        forms.alert("Select an item (or use Pick Current / Load From Selection).", exitscript=False)
        return None

    def _on_pick_current(self, s, e):
        try:
            r = uidoc.Selection.PickObject(ObjectType.Element, "Pick a structural element")
        except:
            return
        if not r: return
        eid = r.ElementId.IntegerValue
        for i, row in enumerate(self._rows):
            if row['Id']==eid:
                self.dgElems.SelectedIndex=i
                self.dgElems.ScrollIntoView(row)
                return
        # add if not present
        el = doc.GetElement(r.ElementId)
        if not el: return
        add = self._rows_from_ids([el.Id])
        self._rows.extend(add)
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = None
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = self._rows
        self._status("Added picked element to Adopt list.")

    def _on_load_from_selection(self, s, e):
        ids = uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds()
        rows = self._rows_from_ids(ids)
        if not rows:
            self._status("No elements in current selection.")
            return
        self._rows = rows
        self.dgElems.ItemsSource = self._rows
        self._status("Loaded {} element(s) from current selection.".format(len(self._rows)))

    # ---- PREVIEW Adopt (temp TX + rollback) ----
    def _export_view_png(self, view, file_noext):
        try:
            opts = ImageExportOptions()
            opts.ExportRange = ExportRange.CurrentView
            opts.HLRandWFViewsFileType = ImageFileType.PNG
            opts.FilePath = file_noext
            opts.ZoomType = ZoomFitType.FitToPage
            opts.ImageResolution = ImageResolution.DPI_150
            doc.ExportImage(opts)
            p0 = file_noext + '0000.png'
            p1 = file_noext + '0001.png'
            if os.path.exists(p0): return p0
            if os.path.exists(p1): return p1
        except:
            pass
        return None

    def _img_from_path(self, path):
        if not path or not os.path.exists(path): return None
        bi = Imaging.BitmapImage()
        bi.BeginInit(); bi.UriSource = Uri(path); bi.CacheOption = Imaging.BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad; bi.EndInit()
        return bi

    def _on_preview(self, s, e):
        row = self._resolve_selected_row()
        if not row: return
        if self._evt_busy:
            self._status("Busy. Please wait…")
            return
        if ENABLE_MODEL_EVENT and not MODAL_MODE:
            self._model_handler.set_payload(self._preview_core, (row,))
            self._model_event.Raise()
        else:
            self._preview_core(row)

    def _preview_core(self, row):
        e = row['_e']
        arch, trf = self._nearest_arch_counterpart(e)
        if not arch:
            self._status("No Arch counterpart found.")
            return

        tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        before = self._export_view_png(doc.ActiveView, os.path.join(tmp, "before"))
        self.imgBefore.Source = self._img_from_path(before)

        t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Preview Adopt")
        t.Start()
        try:
            self._adopt_once(e, arch, trf)
            after = self._export_view_png(doc.ActiveView, os.path.join(tmp, "after"))
        finally:
            t.RollBack()
        self.imgAfter.Source = self._img_from_path(after)
        self._status("Preview generated (no changes committed).")

    # ---- APPLY Adopt ----
    def _on_apply(self, s, e):
        row = self._resolve_selected_row()
        if not row: return
        if self._evt_busy:
            self._status("Busy. Please wait…")
            return
        if ENABLE_MODEL_EVENT and not MODAL_MODE:
            self._model_handler.set_payload(self._apply_core, (row,))
            self._model_event.Raise()
        else:
            self._apply_core(row)

    def _apply_core(self, row):
        e = row['_e']
        arch, trf = self._nearest_arch_counterpart(e)
        if not arch:
            self._status("No Arch counterpart found.")
            return
        t = Transaction(doc, "Coordinator: Apply Adopt")
        t.Start()
        try:
            # extend here with openings + type mapping
            self._adopt_once(e, arch, trf)
        finally:
            t.Commit()
        self._status("Adopt applied.")
        self._rebuild_adopt_list_from_mismatches()

# ----------------- Entrypoint ---------------------
CoordinatorWindow().show(modal=MODAL_MODE)
```

```
# Coordinator

## Purpose
Provide a hardened modeless coordination workflow with diagnostics, 3D highlighting, preview, and apply actions.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local WPF, diagnostics, preview, and external-event mutation logic in `script.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Preserve the separation between transient preview and persistent override behavior.
- Keep modeless DB actions routed through external events.
- Treat highlight scale limits, cleanup, and fail-safes as stability-critical behavior.

```

```
<!-- UI.xaml -->
<Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Arch↔Struct Coordinator"
        Height="720" Width="1120"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        ResizeMode="CanResize">
  <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">

    <!-- Status Bar -->
    <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Height="28" Background="#1e1e1e"
            BorderBrush="#333" BorderThickness="1,1,1,0">
      <TextBlock x:Name="StatusText" Foreground="#f1f1f1"
                 VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="8,0,0,0"
                 Text="Ready."/>
    </Border>

    <Grid>
      <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
        <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
        <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
      </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

      <!-- LEFT: DISCREPANCY HIGHLIGHTS -->
      <Border Grid.Column="0" Margin="10" Padding="10"
              BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4">
        <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
          <TextBlock Text="Discrepancy Highlights (3D)"
                     FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold"
                     DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
          <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical" DockPanel.Dock="Top">
            <TextBlock Text="Categories" FontWeight="Bold"/>
            <WrapPanel Margin="0,4,0,10">
              <CheckBox x:Name="chkWalls"   Content="Walls"             Margin="0,0,10,0" IsChecked="True"/>
              <CheckBox x:Name="chkFloors"  Content="Floors/Slabs"      Margin="0,0,10,0" IsChecked="True"/>
              <CheckBox x:Name="chkCols"    Content="Struct Columns"    Margin="0,0,10,0" IsChecked="True"/>
              <CheckBox x:Name="chkFraming" Content="Struct Framing"    Margin="0,0,10,0" IsChecked="True"/>
            </WrapPanel>

            <TextBlock Text="Tolerances" FontWeight="Bold"/>
            <Grid Margin="0,4,0,10">
              <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
              </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
              <TextBlock Text="Distance (mm):" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
              <Slider x:Name="sldDist" Grid.Column="1" Minimum="1" Maximum="100"
                      Value="10" TickFrequency="1" IsSnapToTickEnabled="True"/>
              <TextBlock x:Name="lblDist" Grid.Column="2" Text="10"
                         VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
            </Grid>

            <Grid>
              <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
              </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
              <TextBlock Text="Angle (deg):" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
              <Slider x:Name="sldAng" Grid.Column="1" Minimum="0" Maximum="5"
                      Value="1" TickFrequency="0.5" IsSnapToTickEnabled="True"/>
              <TextBlock x:Name="lblAng" Grid.Column="2" Text="1.0"
                         VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
            </Grid>
          </StackPanel>

          <Button x:Name="btnRun" Content="Run Highlights in Active 3D View"
                  Height="34" Margin="0,10,0,0" DockPanel.Dock="Bottom"
                  Background="#0078D4" Foreground="White"/>
        </DockPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- RIGHT: ADOPTION -->
      <Border Grid.Column="1" Margin="10" Padding="10"
              BorderBrush="#DDDDDD" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4">
        <DockPanel LastChildFill="True">
          <TextBlock Text="Adopt From Arch"
                     FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold"
                     DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>

          <StackPanel Orientation="Vertical" DockPanel.Dock="Top">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
              <TextBlock Text="Filter (type / id / level / category)"
```

```python
# coding: utf-8
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

from pyrevit import revit, DB, script

__title__ = 'Sync BB Sheet Info'
__author__ = 'pyRevit Agent'

doc = revit.doc
output = script.get_output()

ISSUE_FAMILY_NAME = 'ZZ_IssueTag'        # adjust to your family name
PARAM_SHEETNUM = 'BB_SheetNumber'
PARAM_SHEETNAME = 'BB_SheetName'


def build_view_to_sheet_map(document):
    view_to_sheet = {}
    vp_col = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document).OfClass(DB.Viewport)
    for vp in vp_col:
        sheet = document.GetElement(vp.SheetId)
        if sheet:
            view_to_sheet[vp.ViewId] = sheet
    return view_to_sheet


def get_issue_tags(document):
    anns = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
             .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericAnnotation) \
             .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
             .ToElements()
    issue_tags = []
    for a in anns:
        symbol = a.Symbol
        if not symbol:
            continue
        fam = symbol.Family
        if fam and fam.Name == ISSUE_FAMILY_NAME:
            issue_tags.append(a)
    return issue_tags


view_to_sheet = build_view_to_sheet_map(doc)
issue_tags = get_issue_tags(doc)

if not issue_tags:
    output.print_md('No issue tags of family `{}` found.'.format(ISSUE_FAMILY_NAME))
else:
    updated_count = 0

    with revit.Transaction('Sync Bluebeam Issue Sheet Info'):
        for tag in issue_tags:
            owner_view = doc.GetElement(tag.OwnerViewId)
            if not owner_view:
                continue

            sheet = None

            # Case 1: tag lives directly on a sheet
            if isinstance(owner_view, DB.ViewSheet):
                sheet = owner_view
            # Case 2: tag lives in a view that is placed on a sheet
            else:
                sheet = view_to_sheet.get(owner_view.Id)

            if not sheet:
                continue

            p_num = tag.LookupParameter(PARAM_SHEETNUM)
            p_name = tag.LookupParameter(PARAM_SHEETNAME)

            if p_num and p_num.StorageType == DB.StorageType.String:
                p_num.Set(sheet.SheetNumber)
            if p_name and p_name.StorageType == DB.StorageType.String:
                p_name.Set(sheet.Name)

            updated_count += 1

    output.print_md('Updated **{}** Bluebeam issue tags with sheet info.'.format(updated_count))
```

```
# Sync BB Sheet Info

## Purpose
Synchronize Bluebeam issue-tag sheet number and sheet name parameters from the owning Revit sheet context.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local viewport-to-sheet mapping and issue-tag update logic in `script.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Preserve both direct-on-sheet and placed-in-view ownership cases.
- Keep family-name and parameter-name assumptions aligned with the Bluebeam setup and import tools.
- Limit writes to valid string parameters on the target issue tags.

```
