## FILE_START: RBG_SYD_Tools_Working.tab/WIP.panel/WIPDrop3.pulldown/QA_Checker.pushbutton/script.py
## META: sha1=126415b3cf7b708a44819dd27a1f8e4b05f795a0 size=12601
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ['Autodesk.Revit.DB', 'System.Collections.Generic', 'clr', 'os', 'pyrevit', 'sys', 'telemetry']
## FUNCTIONS: ['bb_intersects', 'dimensions_with_overrides_in_view', 'element_link', 'ensure_drafting_report', 'get_all_views', 'get_dimensions_with_overrides', 'get_loose_views', 'get_revision_clouds', 'get_sheeted_views', 'get_tags_without_hosts', 'get_text_notes', 'grids_inconsistent_extents', 'levels_duplicates', 'revision_clouds_without_tags', 'sheet_link', 'structural_elements_non_rbg_types', 'textnote_collisions_in_view', 'titleblock_inconsistencies', 'unreferenced_tags_in_view', 'view_has_template', 'view_link', 'view_overrides_exist', 'views_with_wrong_crop_state', 'views_without_template_or_with_overrides', 'write_report_text']
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "RBG – QA Model & Sheets"
__doc__ = """Version = 1.0
Date    = 01.03.2026
Checks model & sheet consistency and writes a compact report.
Author  = M365 Copilot for Harley TRAPPITT
"""
__min_revit_ver__ = 2019
__max_revit_ver = 2026

import os, sys
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Transaction, FilteredElementCollector, BuiltInCategory, BuiltInParameter, XYZ
from pyrevit import revit, forms
import clr
clr.AddReference("System")
from System.Collections.Generic import List

doc   = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
uidoc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
app   = __revit__.Application
PATH_SCRIPT = os.path.dirname(__file__)

def get_all_views(doc):
    return [v for v in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(View) if not v.IsTemplate]

def get_sheeted_views(doc):
    views = []
    for vs in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSheet):
        for vp_id in vs.GetAllViewports():
            vp = doc.GetElement(vp_id)
            v = doc.GetElement(vp.ViewId)
            if v and not v.IsTemplate:
                views.append((vs, v, vp))
    return views

def get_loose_views(doc):
    placed_view_ids = set()
    for vs in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSheet):
        for vp_id in vs.GetAllViewports():
            vp = doc.GetElement(vp_id)
            placed_view_ids.add(vp.ViewId)
        # schedules
        for sid in vs.GetAllPlacedViews():
            placed_view_ids.add(sid)
    return [v for v in get_all_views(doc) if v.Id not in placed_view_ids and not isinstance(v, ViewSchedule)]

def ensure_drafting_report(doc, name="_QA_Report"):
    dv = None
    for v in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewDrafting):
        if v.Name == name:
            dv = v
            break
    if not dv:
        dv = ViewDrafting.Create(doc, ElementId.InvalidElementId)
        dv.Name = name
    # purge existing text notes
    note_ids = ListElementId
    for el in FilteredElementCollector(doc, dv.Id).OfClass(TextNote):
        note_ids.Add(el.Id)
    if note_ids.Count:
        doc.Delete(note_ids)
    return dv

def bb_intersects(bb1, bb2, tol=0.15):
    if not bb1 or not bb2: return False
    min1, max1 = bb1.Min, bb1.Max
    min2, max2 = bb2.Min, bb2.Max
    return not (max1.X < min2.X - tol or min1.X > max2.X + tol or
                max1.Y < min2.Y - tol or min1.Y > max2.Y + tol)

def get_text_notes(view):
    return [t for t in FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(TextNote)]

def get_revision_clouds(view):
    return [c for c in FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(RevisionCloud)]

def get_tags_without_hosts(view):
    tags = FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(IndependentTag)
    bad = []
    for t in tags:
        try:
            if t.TaggedLocalElementId == ElementId.InvalidElementId and t.TaggedElementId == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                bad.append(t)
        except:
            pass
    return bad

def get_dimensions_with_overrides(view):
    dims = FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id).OfClass(Dimension)
    return [d for d in dims if d.ValueOverride and d.ValueOverride.strip() != ""]

def view_has_template(v):
    try:
        return v.ViewTemplateId and v.ViewTemplateId != ElementId.InvalidElementId
    except:
        return False

def view_overrides_exist(v):
    # cheap test: if template applied but any category overrides exist
    try:
        if not view_has_template(v): return False
        cats = doc.Settings.Categories
        for cat in cats:
            if v.GetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id) and not v.GetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id).IsEmpty:
                return True
        return False
    except:
        return False

def grids_inconsistent_extents(doc):
    grids = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Grid)
    by_name = {}
    for g in grids:
        n = g.Name
        if n not in by_name: by_name[n] = []
        by_name[n].append(g)
    # Heuristic: same name should have similar curve length
    inconsistent = []
    for n, gs in by_name.items():
        lengths = []
        for g in gs:
            crv = g.Curve
            if crv: lengths.append(round(crv.Length, 6))
        if lengths and (max(lengths) - min(lengths) > 0.001):
            inconsistent.extend(gs)
    return inconsistent

def structural_elements_non_rbg_types(doc, name_prefixes=("RBG", "RBG_","RBG-")):
    cats = [BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming, BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns,
            BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFoundation, BuiltInCategory.OST_WallsStructural,
            BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors]
    elems = []
    for bic in cats:
        for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfCategory(bic).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
            et = doc.GetElement(e.GetTypeId())
            if et:
                tn = et.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM).AsString()
                if tn and not tn.startswith(tuple(name_prefixes)):
                    elems.append(e)
    return elems

def titleblock_inconsistencies(doc, required_params=("Sheet Number","Sheet Name")):
    sheets = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSheet)
    issues = []
    for s in sheets:
        if s.IsPlaceholder: 
            continue
        tbs = [doc.GetElement(id) for id in s.GetAllPlacedViews() if isinstance(doc.GetElement(id), FamilyInstance)]
        # Actually titleblocks are OST_TitleBlocks instances in sheet doc; better collect by view: sheet.Id
        tblocks = FilteredElementCollector(doc, s.Id).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
        if not any(True for _ in tblocks):
            issues.append(("No titleblock", s))
        for p in required_params:
            prm = s.LookupParameter(p)
            if not prm or (prm.AsString() or "").strip() == "":
                issues.append(("Missing param: %s" % p, s))
    return issues

def views_with_wrong_crop_state(sheeted_views):
    bad = []
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted_views:
        try:
            if hasattr(v, "CropBoxActive"):
                if not v.CropBoxActive:
                    bad.append(v)
        except: 
            pass
    return bad

def revision_clouds_without_tags(sheeted_views):
    bad = []
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted_views:
        clouds = get_revision_clouds(v)
        if not clouds: 
            continue
        # naive: check if any IndependentTag of revcloud exists
        tags = [t for t in FilteredElementCollector(doc, v.Id).OfClass(IndependentTag)]
        cloud_ids = set(c.Id.IntegerValue for c in clouds)
        tagged_ids = set()
        for t in tags:
            try:
                if t.TaggedElementId != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                    tagged_ids.add(t.TaggedElementId.IntegerValue)
            except:
                pass
        for c in clouds:
            if c.Id.IntegerValue not in tagged_ids:
                bad.append(c)
    return bad

def textnote_collisions_in_view(v, tol=0.15):
    notes = get_text_notes(v)
    bad_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(notes)):
        bbi = notes[i].get_BoundingBox(v)
        for j in range(i+1, len(notes)):
            bbj = notes[j].get_BoundingBox(v)
            if bb_intersects(bbi, bbj, tol):
                bad_pairs.append((notes[i], notes[j]))
    return bad_pairs

def dimensions_with_overrides_in_view(v):
    return get_dimensions_with_overrides(v)

def unreferenced_tags_in_view(v):
    return get_tags_without_hosts(v)

def views_without_template_or_with_overrides(sheeted_views):
    bad_tpl = []
    bad_ovr = []
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted_views:
        if not view_has_template(v):
            bad_tpl.append(v)
        elif view_overrides_exist(v):
            bad_ovr.append(v)
    return bad_tpl, bad_ovr

def levels_duplicates(doc):
    names = {}
    dups = []
    for lvl in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Level):
        n = lvl.Name
        if n in names: dups.append(lvl)
        else: names[n] = lvl
    return dups

def write_report_text(dv, lines, x=0.1, y=0.0, lh=0.0075, title="QA Report"):
    TextNote.Create(doc, dv.Id, XYZ(x, 0.28, 0), TextNoteOptions(ElementId.InvalidElementId), title)
    row = 0
    for line in lines:
        TextNote.Create(doc, dv.Id, XYZ(x, 0.26 - row*lh, 0), TextNoteOptions(ElementId.InvalidElementId), line)
        row += 1

def element_link(el):
    return "Id:%s Cat:%s" % (el.Id.IntegerValue, el.Category.Name if el.Category else "?")

def view_link(v):
    return "View:%s (Id:%s)" % (v.Name, v.Id.IntegerValue)

def sheet_link(s):
    return "Sheet:%s - %s (Id:%s)" % (s.SheetNumber, s.Name, s.Id.IntegerValue)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    qa_lines = []
    t = Transaction(doc, __title__)
    t.Start()

    dv = ensure_drafting_report(doc)

    sheeted = get_sheeted_views(doc)
    loose = get_loose_views(doc)

    # 1. Views without template / with overrides
    no_tpl, has_ovr = views_without_template_or_with_overrides(sheeted)
    if no_tpl:
        qa_lines.append("Views without template:")
        for v in no_tpl[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + view_link(v))
    if has_ovr:
        qa_lines.append("Views overriding template:")
        for v in has_ovr[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + view_link(v))

    # 2. Loose views
    if loose:
        qa_lines.append("Views not placed on sheets:")
        for v in loose[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + view_link(v))

    # 3. Titleblock issues
    tb_issues = titleblock_inconsistencies(doc)
    if tb_issues:
        qa_lines.append("Sheet/titleblock issues:")
        for msg, s in tb_issues[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - %s | %s" % (msg, sheet_link(s)))

    # 4. Grid extents inconsistent
    bad_grids = grids_inconsistent_extents(doc)
    if bad_grids:
        qa_lines.append("Inconsistent Grid extents by name:")
        for g in bad_grids[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(g))

    # 5. Text collisions on sheeted views
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted[:100]:
        collisions = textnote_collisions_in_view(v)
        if collisions:
            qa_lines.append("Text collisions in %s:" % view_link(v))
            for a,b in collisions[:5]:
                qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(a) + " <> " + element_link(b))

    # 6. Revision clouds without tags
    bad_clouds = revision_clouds_without_tags(sheeted)
    if bad_clouds:
        qa_lines.append("Revision clouds without tags:")
        for c in bad_clouds[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(c))

    # 7. Dimensions with overrides
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted[:100]:
        d_over = dimensions_with_overrides_in_view(v)
        if d_over:
            qa_lines.append("Dimension overrides in %s:" % view_link(v))
            for d in d_over[:10]:
                qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(d))

    # 8. Unreferenced tags
    for vs, v, vp in sheeted[:100]:
        utags = unreferenced_tags_in_view(v)
        if utags:
            qa_lines.append("Unhosted tags in %s:" % view_link(v))
            for ttag in utags[:10]:
                qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(ttag))

    # 9. Crop box off
    bad_crops = views_with_wrong_crop_state(sheeted)
    if bad_crops:
        qa_lines.append("Views with crop box OFF:")
        for v in bad_crops[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + view_link(v))

    # 10. Levels duplicate names
    dup_lvls = levels_duplicates(doc)
    if dup_lvls:
        qa_lines.append("Duplicate Level names:")
        for lv in dup_lvls[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(lv))

    # 11. Structural elements on non-RBG types (name pattern)
    non_rbg = structural_elements_non_rbg_types(doc)
    if non_rbg:
        qa_lines.append("Structural elements on NON-RBG types:")
        for e in non_rbg[:50]:
            qa_lines.append(" - " + element_link(e))

    if not qa_lines:
        qa_lines.append("No issues found by current rules.")

    write_report_text(dv, qa_lines, title="QA Report – %d items" % len(qa_lines))

    t.Commit()
    print("\n".join(qa_lines))
    print("-"*50)
    print("Report written to Drafting View '_QA_Report'.")
```

Check model and sheet consistency and write a compact QA report for common coordination issues.

## Critical Constraints

- Preserve compatibility across the stated Revit version range.

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import division
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

from collections import defaultdict, deque
from System.Collections.Generic import List
from pyrevit import revit, DB, forms, script
doc = revit.doc
uidoc = revit.uidoc
logger = script.get_logger()
SHORT_TOL = doc.Application.ShortCurveTolerance
TOL = 0.001
# Tolerance for rounding points to create keys for deduplication.
LEVEL_Z_TOL = 20.0
# Tolerance for considering a beam/shaft as part of a level based on its bounding box.
MODIFIED_FLAG = "modified"
# Protect areas with this in comments from deletion on future runs.
INCLUDE_BEAMS_IN_FOOTPRINT = False
# Toggle: False = floors-only footprint, True = floors + beams footprint.
REGION_MIN_AREA_FT2 = 50.0
# Minimum area for a region to be kept as GBA, in square feet.
SMOOTH_LEN_FT = 2.0
# Length threshold in feet for smoothing small spikes in the boundary loops.

def delete_nonplaced_areas_in_scheme(document, scheme):
    areas = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_Areas) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    ids_to_delete = List[DB.ElementId]()
    for a in areas:
        area = a if isinstance(a, DB.Area) else None
        if not area:
            continue
        if area.AreaScheme.Id != scheme.Id:
            continue
        # Only Not Placed areas have no Location
        if area.Location is None:
            ids_to_delete.Add(area.Id)
    if ids_to_delete.Count > 0:
        document.Delete(ids_to_delete)

def point_key_2d(xyz):
    return (round(xyz.X / TOL), round(xyz.Y / TOL))

def get_gross_building_scheme(document):
    schemes = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfClass(DB.AreaScheme) \
        .ToElements()
    for s in schemes:
        if s.Name.lower() == "gross building":
            return s
    levels = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfClass(DB.Level) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    level_ids = [l.Id for l in levels]
    if not level_ids:
        raise Exception("No levels found to build Gross Building scheme.")
    return DB.AreaScheme.Create(document, level_ids, "Gross Building")

def get_or_create_area_plan(document, scheme, level):
    views = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfClass(DB.ViewPlan) \
        .ToElements()
    for v in views:
        if v.ViewType == DB.ViewType.AreaPlan \
           and v.AreaScheme.Id == scheme.Id \
           and v.GenLevel.Id == level.Id \
           and not v.IsTemplate:
            return v
    view = DB.ViewPlan.CreateAreaPlan(document, scheme.Id, level.Id)
    view.Name = "{} - GBA".format(level.Name)
    return view

_geom_opts = None
def get_geom_options():
    global _geom_opts
    if _geom_opts is None:
        opts = DB.Options()
        opts.ComputeReferences = False
        opts.DetailLevel = DB.ViewDetailLevel.Fine
        _geom_opts = opts
    return _geom_opts

def curveloop_area_xy(loop):
    pts = []
    for c in loop:
        try:
            pts.append(c.GetEndPoint(0))
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not pts:
        return 0.0
    pts.append(pts[0])
    area = 0.0
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x1, y1 = pts[i].X, pts[i].Y
        x2, y2 = pts[i + 1].X, pts[i + 1].Y
        area += (x1 * y2 - x2 * y1)
    return 0.5 * area

def ensure_sketchplane_for_view(document, view, level):
    sp = view.SketchPlane
    if sp:
        return sp
    plane = DB.Plane.CreateByNormalAndOrigin(DB.XYZ.BasisZ,
                                             DB.XYZ(0, 0, level.Elevation))
    sp = DB.SketchPlane.Create(document, plane)
    view.SketchPlane = sp
    return sp

def get_main_solid(elem):
    opts = get_geom_options()
    geo = elem.get_Geometry(opts)
    best = None
    max_vol = 0.0
    for g in geo:
        solid = g if isinstance(g, DB.Solid) else None
        if not solid or solid.Volume <= 0:
            continue
        if solid.Volume > max_vol:
            max_vol = solid.Volume
            best = solid
    return best

def build_union_solid(floors_for_level, level, framing_all=None):
    """Union of all floor solids on this level, optionally including beams."""
    z = level.Elevation
    union_solid = None
    # Floors (always included)
    for f in floors_for_level:
        solid = get_main_solid(f)
        if not solid:
            continue
        if not union_solid:
            union_solid = solid
        else:
            try:
                union_solid = DB.BooleanOperationsUtils.ExecuteBooleanOperation(
                    union_solid,
                    solid,
                    DB.BooleanOperationsType.Union
                )
            except Exception as ex:
                logger.warning("Floor union failed on {}: {}".format(f.Id.IntegerValue, ex))
                continue
    # Optionally include Structural Framing
    if INCLUDE_BEAMS_IN_FOOTPRINT and framing_all:
        for b in framing_all:
            bbox = b.get_BoundingBox(None)
            if not bbox:
                continue
            # beams whose Z-range crosses this level (with tolerance)
            if not (bbox.Min.Z - LEVEL_Z_TOL <= z <= bbox.Max.Z + LEVEL_Z_TOL):
                continue
            solid = get_main_solid(b)
            if not solid:
                continue
            if not union_solid:
                union_solid = solid
            else:
                try:
                    union_solid = DB.BooleanOperationsUtils.ExecuteBooleanOperation(
                        union_solid,
                        solid,
                        DB.BooleanOperationsType.Union
                    )
                except Exception as ex:
                    logger.warning("Beam union failed on {}: {}".format(b.Id.IntegerValue, ex))
                    continue
    return union_solid

def get_regions_from_union(level, floors_for_level, framing_all):
    """
    Returns outer loops only for this level as a list of CurveLoop.
    One outer loop per slab/plate region; internal voids are ignored here.
    """
    union_solid = build_union_solid(floors_for_level, level, framing_all)
    if not union_solid or union_solid.Faces.IsEmpty:
        return []
    regions = []
    for face in union_solid.Faces:
        pf = face if isinstance(face, DB.PlanarFace) else None
        if not pf:
            continue
        n = pf.FaceNormal
        # only roughly horizontal top faces
        if n.Z < 0.9:
            continue
        loops = pf.GetEdgesAsCurveLoops()
        if not loops:
            continue
        loop_areas = [(loop, abs(curveloop_area_xy(loop))) for loop in loops]
        loop_areas.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        if not loop_areas:
            continue
        # largest loop = outer footprint of this region
        outer_loop = loop_areas[0][0]
        outer_area = loop_areas[0][1]
        # only keep "real" regions (slabs/plates), not tiny scraps
        if outer_area >= REGION_MIN_AREA_FT2:
            regions.append(outer_loop)
    return regions

def add_shaft_boundaries_for_level(document, area_view, level, sketchplane):
    z = level.Elevation
    shafts = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_ShaftOpening) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    for sh in shafts:
        bbox = sh.get_BoundingBox(None)
        if not bbox:
            continue
        if not (bbox.Min.Z - LEVEL_Z_TOL <= z <= bbox.Max.Z + LEVEL_Z_TOL):
            continue
        try:
            curves = sh.BoundaryCurves  # CurveArray
        except Exception:
            continue
        for c in curves:
            try:
                p0 = c.GetEndPoint(0)
                p1 = c.GetEndPoint(1)
            except Exception:
                continue
            p0f = DB.XYZ(p0.X, p0.Y, z)
            p1f = DB.XYZ(p1.X, p1.Y, z)
            if p0f.DistanceTo(p1f) < SHORT_TOL:
                continue
            try:
                if isinstance(c, DB.Arc):
                    mid = c.Evaluate(0.5, True)
                    midf = DB.XYZ(mid.X, mid.Y, z)
                    arc = DB.Arc.Create(p0f, p1f, midf)
                    if arc.Length >= SHORT_TOL:
                        document.Create.NewAreaBoundaryLine(sketchplane, arc, area_view)
                else:
                    line = DB.Line.CreateBound(p0f, p1f)
                    if line.Length >= SHORT_TOL:
                        document.Create.NewAreaBoundaryLine(sketchplane, line, area_view)
            except Exception:
                continue

def flatten_loop_to_level(curve_loop, level_z):
    pts = []
    for c in curve_loop:
        try:
            p = c.GetEndPoint(0)
        except Exception:
            continue
        pts.append(DB.XYZ(p.X, p.Y, level_z))
    if not pts:
        return []
    # close loop if needed
    if pts[0].DistanceTo(pts[-1]) > SHORT_TOL:
        pts.append(pts[0])
    # simplify spikes on the closed ring
    ring = pts[:-1]
    ring = simplify_loop_points(ring)
    if len(ring) < 3:
        return []
    ring.append(ring[0])  # close again after simplification
    flat_curves = []
    for i in range(len(ring) - 1):
        p0 = ring[i]
        p1 = ring[i + 1]
        if p0.DistanceTo(p1) < SHORT_TOL:
            continue
        try:
            line = DB.Line.CreateBound(p0, p1)
            if line.Length >= SHORT_TOL:
                flat_curves.append(line)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return flat_curves

def simplify_loop_points(points):
    # remove tiny spikes where two short edges form a small jog
    if len(points) < 4:
        return points
    changed = True
    while changed and len(points) > 3:
        changed = False
        n = len(points)
        remove_indices = set()
        for i in range(n):
            a = points[i - 1]
            b = points[i]
            c = points[(i + 1) % n]
            ab = a.DistanceTo(b)
            bc = b.DistanceTo(c)
            ac = a.DistanceTo(c)
            if ab < SMOOTH_LEN_FT and bc < SMOOTH_LEN_FT and ac < SMOOTH_LEN_FT * 1.5:
                remove_indices.add(i)
        if not remove_indices:
            break
        for idx in sorted(remove_indices, reverse=True):
            if 0 <= idx < len(points):
                del points[idx]
        changed = True
    return points

def loop_centroid_xy(curve_loop):
    pts = []
    for c in curve_loop:
        try:
            pts.append(c.GetEndPoint(0))
        except Exception:
            continue
    if not pts:
        return None
    pts.append(pts[0])
    area = 0.0
    cx = cy = 0.0
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x1, y1 = pts[i].X, pts[i].Y
        x2, y2 = pts[i + 1].X, pts[i + 1].Y
        cross = x1 * y2 - x2 * y1
        area += cross
        cx += (x1 + x2) * cross
        cy += (y1 + y2) * cross
    if abs(area) < 1e-9:
        return None
    area *= 0.5
    cx /= (6.0 * area)
    cy /= (6.0 * area)
    return DB.UV(cx, cy)

def create_boundaries_and_areas(document, area_view, level,
                                floors_for_level, framing_all):
    regions = get_regions_from_union(level, floors_for_level, framing_all)
    if not regions:
        return 0, 0
    sp = ensure_sketchplane_for_view(document, area_view, level)
    z = level.Elevation
    # Clear boundary lines
    existing_lines = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document, area_view.Id) \
        .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_AreaSchemeLines) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    for l in existing_lines:
        document.Delete(l.Id)
    # Clear non-modified Areas in this Area Plan
    existing_areas = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document, area_view.Id) \
        .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_Areas) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    for a in existing_areas:
        area = a if isinstance(a, DB.Area) else None
        if not area:
            continue
        if area.AreaScheme.Id != area_view.AreaScheme.Id:
            continue
        p = area.get_Parameter(DB.BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS)
        comments = ""
        if p and p.AsString():
            comments = p.AsString().strip().lower()
        if comments == MODIFIED_FLAG:
            continue
        document.Delete(area.Id)
    total_lines = 0
    area_count = 0
    # Outer boundaries & Areas (one per region)
    for outer_loop in regions:
        outer_curves = flatten_loop_to_level(outer_loop, z)
        for c in outer_curves:
            try:
                document.Create.NewAreaBoundaryLine(sp, c, area_view)
                total_lines += 1
            except Exception:
                continue
        centroid_uv = loop_centroid_xy(outer_loop)
        if centroid_uv:
            try:
                document.Create.NewArea(area_view, centroid_uv)
                area_count += 1
            except Exception:
                pass
    # Internal boundaries: only shaft openings
    add_shaft_boundaries_for_level(document, area_view, level, sp)
    return total_lines, area_count

def get_levels_with_floors(document):
    floors = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfClass(DB.Floor) \
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
        .ToElements()
    floors_by_level = defaultdict(list)
    for f in floors:
        try:
            lvl_id = f.LevelId
        except Exception:
            continue
        floors_by_level[lvl_id].append(f)
    levels = []
    for lvl_id in floors_by_level.keys():
        lvl = document.GetElement(lvl_id)
        if isinstance(lvl, DB.Level):
            levels.append(lvl)
    levels.sort(key=lambda l: l.Elevation)
    return levels, floors_by_level

def add_field_if_possible(defs, bip):
    param_id = DB.ElementId(bip)
    for i in range(defs.GetFieldCount()):
        f = defs.GetField(i)
        if f.ParameterId == param_id:
            return f
    try:
        sfields = defs.GetSchedulableFields()
    except Exception:
        return None
    target_sfield = None
    for sf in sfields:
        if sf.ParameterId == param_id:
            target_sfield = sf
            break
    if not target_sfield:
        return None
    try:
        res = defs.AddField(target_sfield)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if isinstance(res, DB.ScheduleField):
        return res
    try:
        return defs.GetField(res)
    except Exception:
        return None

def get_or_create_gba_schedule(document, scheme):
    schedules = DB.FilteredElementCollector(document) \
        .OfClass(DB.ViewSchedule) \
        .ToElements()
    for s in schedules:
        if s.Name == "GBA - Gross Building":
            return s
    cat_id = DB.ElementId(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_Areas)
    sched = DB.ViewSchedule.CreateSchedule(document, cat_id, scheme.Id)
    sched.Name = "GBA - Gross Building"
    defs = sched.Definition
    add_field_if_possible(defs, DB.BuiltInParameter.ROOM_LEVEL_ID)
    add_field_if_possible(defs, DB.BuiltInParameter.ROOM_NAME)
    add_field_if_possible(defs, DB.BuiltInParameter.ROOM_AREA)
    add_field_if_possible(defs,
                          DB.BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS)
    return sched

# ----------------- main -----------------
levels, floors_by_level = get_levels_with_floors(doc)
if not levels:
    forms.alert("No floors found in the model. Nothing to do.", exitscript=True)
framing_all = DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc) \
    .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming) \
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType() \
    .ToElements()
if not forms.alert("Process Gross Building Areas for {} level(s)?"
                   .format(len(levels)),
                   yes=True, no=True):
    forms.alert("Cancelled.", exitscript=True)
t = DB.Transaction(doc, "Auto GBA Area Plans")
t.Start()
scheme = get_gross_building_scheme(doc)
# Clean start: delete all Not Placed areas in Gross Building scheme
delete_nonplaced_areas_in_scheme(doc, scheme)
total_views = 0
total_lines = 0
total_areas = 0
for i, lvl in enumerate(levels):
    logger.info("Processing level {0}/{1}: {2}"
                .format(i + 1, len(levels), lvl.Name))
    floors_for_level = floors_by_level.get(lvl.Id, [])
    if not floors_for_level:
        continue
    try:
        area_view = get_or_create_area_plan(doc, scheme, lvl)
        lines_count, areas_count = create_boundaries_and_areas(
            doc, area_view, lvl, floors_for_level, framing_all)
        total_views += 1
        total_lines += lines_count
        total_areas += areas_count
    except Exception as ex:
        logger.error("Failed on level '{}': {}".format(lvl.Name, ex))
gba_sched = get_or_create_gba_schedule(doc, scheme)
t.Commit()
forms.alert("GBA automation complete.\n\n"
            "Area Plans created/updated: {0}\n"
            "Boundary lines created:    {1}\n"
            "Areas created:             {2}\n"
            "Schedule:                  {3}"
            .format(total_views, total_lines, total_areas, gba_sched.Name))

```

import os
import clr
from pyrevit import forms

def find_extension_root(start_path):
    folder = os.path.dirname(start_path)
    while folder:
        if folder.lower().endswith('.extension'):
            return folder
        parent = os.path.dirname(folder)
        if parent == folder:
            break
        folder = parent
    return None

ext_root = find_extension_root(__file__)
lib_dir = os.path.join(ext_root, 'lib')

nts = os.path.join(lib_dir, 'NetTopologySuite.dll')
geo = os.path.join(lib_dir, 'FloorSplitGeometry.dll')

clr.AddReferenceToFileAndPath(nts)
clr.AddReferenceToFileAndPath(geo)

from FloorSplitGeometry import Point2D, FloorPartitioner

forms.alert("DLLs loaded successfully.")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

import csv
import datetime
import io
import json
import os

from pyrevit import forms, script


def _safe_int(value):
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def _ensure_dir(path):
    if not os.path.isdir(path):
        os.makedirs(path)


def _collect_root_totals(root):
    summaries = telemetry.summarize_root(root)

    total_events = 0
    total_tool_clicks = 0
    total_gui_clicks = 0

    user_totals = {}
    control_totals = {}

    for item in summaries:
        total_events += _safe_int(item.get('events'))
        total_tool_clicks += _safe_int(item.get('tool_clicks'))
        total_gui_clicks += _safe_int(item.get('gui_clicks'))

        payload = telemetry.read_tool_payload(item.get('file_path')) or {}
        by_date = payload.get('by_date') or {}

        for date_key, date_data in by_date.items():
            users = (date_data or {}).get('users') or {}
            for user_key, user_data in users.items():
                bucket = user_totals.get(user_key)
                if not isinstance(bucket, dict):
                    bucket = {
                        'events': 0,
                        'tool_clicks': 0,
                        'gui_clicks': 0
                    }
                    user_totals[user_key] = bucket

                bucket['events'] += _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('events'))
                bucket['tool_clicks'] += _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('tool_clicks'))
                bucket['gui_clicks'] += _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('gui_clicks'))

            controls = (date_data or {}).get('controls') or {}
            for control_key, control_data in controls.items():
                bucket = control_totals.get(control_key)
                if not isinstance(bucket, dict):
                    bucket = {
                        'type': (control_data or {}).get('type') or 'unknown_type',
                        'name': (control_data or {}).get('name') or 'unknown_control',
                        'clicks': 0
                    }
                    control_totals[control_key] = bucket

                bucket['clicks'] += _safe_int((control_data or {}).get('clicks'))

    return {
        'summaries': summaries,
        'totals': {
            'events': total_events,
            'tool_clicks': total_tool_clicks,
            'gui_clicks': total_gui_clicks
        },
        'user_totals': user_totals,
        'control_totals': control_totals
    }


def _export_reports(data, root):
    local_root = telemetry.get_local_root()
    reports_dir = os.path.join(local_root, 'reports')
    _ensure_dir(reports_dir)

    stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
    json_path = os.path.join(reports_dir, 'telemetry_summary_{0}.json'.format(stamp))
    csv_path = os.path.join(reports_dir, 'telemetry_summary_{0}.csv'.format(stamp))

    payload = {
        'generated_at': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
        'source_root': root,
        'totals': data.get('totals') or {},
        'tools': data.get('summaries') or [],
        'users': data.get('user_totals') or {},
        'controls': data.get('control_totals') or {}
    }

    with io.open(json_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        json.dump(payload, stream, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    with io.open(csv_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.writer(stream)
        writer.writerow(['tool_name', 'tool_clicks', 'gui_clicks', 'events', 'days_recorded', 'updated_at', 'file_path'])
        for item in data.get('summaries') or []:
            writer.writerow([
                item.get('tool_name') or '',
                _safe_int(item.get('tool_clicks')),
                _safe_int(item.get('gui_clicks')),
                _safe_int(item.get('events')),
                _safe_int(item.get('days_recorded')),
                item.get('updated_at') or '',
                item.get('file_path') or ''
            ])

    return json_path, csv_path


def _show_summary(data, root, json_path, csv_path):
    output = script.get_output()
    output.print_md('## Telemetry Summary')
    output.print_md('Source root: {0}'.format(root))

    totals = data.get('totals') or {}
    output.print_md('Totals: events={0}, tool_clicks={1}, gui_clicks={2}'.format(
        _safe_int(totals.get('events')),
        _safe_int(totals.get('tool_clicks')),
        _safe_int(totals.get('gui_clicks'))
    ))

    tool_rows = []
    for item in data.get('summaries') or []:
        tool_rows.append([
            item.get('tool_name') or '',
            _safe_int(item.get('tool_clicks')),
            _safe_int(item.get('gui_clicks')),
            _safe_int(item.get('events')),
            _safe_int(item.get('days_recorded')),
            item.get('updated_at') or ''
        ])

    if tool_rows:
        output.print_md('### Tools')
        output.print_table(
            table_data=tool_rows,
            columns=['Tool', 'Tool Clicks', 'GUI Clicks', 'Events', 'Days', 'Updated At']
        )

    user_rows = []
    for user_key, user_data in sorted((data.get('user_totals') or {}).items(), key=lambda x: (-_safe_int((x[1] or {}).get('events')), x[0]))[:20]:
        user_rows.append([
            user_key,
            _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('tool_clicks')),
            _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('gui_clicks')),
            _safe_int((user_data or {}).get('events'))
        ])

    if user_rows:
        output.print_md('### Top Users')
        output.print_table(
            table_data=user_rows,
            columns=['User', 'Tool Clicks', 'GUI Clicks', 'Events']
        )

    control_rows = []
    for control_key, control_data in sorted((data.get('control_totals') or {}).items(), key=lambda x: (-_safe_int((x[1] or {}).get('clicks')), x[0]))[:20]:
        control_rows.append([
            (control_data or {}).get('type') or 'unknown_type',
            (control_data or {}).get('name') or 'unknown_control',
            _safe_int((control_data or {}).get('clicks'))
        ])

    if control_rows:
        output.print_md('### Top GUI Controls')
        output.print_table(
            table_data=control_rows,
            columns=['Control Type', 'Control Name', 'Clicks']
        )

    output.print_md('Reports written:')
    output.print_md('- JSON: {0}'.format(json_path))
    output.print_md('- CSV: {0}'.format(csv_path))


def _select_root():
    roots = telemetry.get_target_roots()
    options = []
    labels = []

    for root in roots:
        exists = os.path.isdir(root)
        label = '[{0}] {1}'.format('Exists' if exists else 'Missing', root)
        labels.append(label)
        options.append(root)

    selected = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        labels,
        title='Telemetry Viewer - Select Source Root',
        button_name='Load',
        multiselect=False
    )

    if isinstance(selected, list):
        if not selected:
            return None
        selected = selected[0]

    if not selected:
        return None

    try:
        index = labels.index(selected)
        return options[index]
    except Exception:
        return None


def main():
    flush_choice = forms.alert(
        'Flush buffered telemetry before loading report?\n\nYes = flush local + network now\nNo = report from already-written files only',
        yes=True,
        no=True,
        cancel=True
    )
    if flush_choice is None:
        script.exit()

    flush_result = None
    if flush_choice:
        flush_result = telemetry.flush_now(push_network=True, reason='viewer_report')

    root = _select_root()
    if not root:
        script.exit()

    if not os.path.isdir(root):
        forms.alert('Selected root does not exist yet:\n\n{0}'.format(root), exitscript=True)

    data = _collect_root_totals(root)
    if not data.get('summaries'):
        forms.alert('No telemetry tool JSON files were found in:\n\n{0}'.format(root), exitscript=True)

    json_path, csv_path = _export_reports(data, root)
    _show_summary(data, root, json_path, csv_path)

    forms.alert(
        'Telemetry summary complete.\n\nTools: {0}\nTool Clicks: {1}\nGUI Clicks: {2}\n{3}\n\nJSON: {4}\nCSV: {5}'.format(
            len(data.get('summaries') or []),
            _safe_int((data.get('totals') or {}).get('tool_clicks')),
            _safe_int((data.get('totals') or {}).get('gui_clicks')),
            'Flush: local={0}, network={1}'.format(
                (flush_result or {}).get('local', {}).get('flushed', 0) if flush_result else 0,
                (flush_result or {}).get('network', {}).get('flushed', 0) if flush_result else 0
            ),
            json_path,
            csv_path
        ),
        title='Telemetry Viewer'
    )


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
